title: Ayali
summary: Ayali is a 2023 Indian Tamil-language  streaming television series written and directed by Muthukumar for ZEE5 which focuses on the patriarchal aspects of Tamil society and Indian society in general. The principal characters of the series include Abi Nakshatra, Anumol, Madhan, Linga and Singampuli. The eight episodic series premiered on ZEE5 on 26 January 2023.
plot: The story revolves around the life of a young teenage girl (Tamizhselvi) who defies the horrible 500-year-old customs and traditions that oppress the women of Veerappannai village in Pudukkottai towards her dream of becoming a doctor.

articleSections.title: Guest appearances
articleSections.text: Lakshmi Priya as Inspector * Smruthi Venkat as English Teacher * Bagavathi Perumal as M.L.A * Kodangi Vadivelu

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series is produced by Kushmavathi under the production house of Estrella Stories, with music composed by Revaa and screenplay and dialogues by Veenai Maindhan, Sachin, and Muthu Kumar. Muthukumar marked his web series debut with this series.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Abi Nakshatra was cast in the female lead role as Tamizhselvi. Malayalam film Actress Anumol was cast as a Tamizhselvi's mother. Madhan, Linga and Singampuli were also selected for supporting roles. Bagavathi Perumal, Lakshmi Priya and Smruthi Venkat also appear as guest stars.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: It was announced on Wednesday 26 January 2023 that the series will be released in Tamil and Telugu languages on ZEE5.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text:
Anusha Sundar of The New Indian Express wrote "Ayali lacks a consistent storytelling. Ayali’s antagonists are over-the-top caricatures. They stick to all the usual tropes of a villain just to reiterate the core message. This repetitive pattern only creates a sense of detachment and a bitter aftertaste. A little subtleness could have gone a long way to tell this tale that every other woman can relate to."
R. Srinivasan of Cinema Vikatan wrote "Ramji's cinematography captures the warmth of the village and the nature of its people without diminishing realism. Starting with the title sequence, Revaa's music helps convey the impact of several serious scenes. Editor Ganesh Siva has compiled the eight episodes perfectly without losing interest."
Mankandan Sakthivel of Behind Talkies said "All in all “Aayali” is an amazing OTT series that should be watched by people of all ages."
Janani K at India Today rated the series 3.5/5, stating "Director Muthukumar’s Ayali, starring Abi Nakshathra, Anumol and Aruvi Madhan, is a bold show that questions patriarchy and holds a mirror to society. The show is a must-watch, says our review."
Bharathy Singaravel of The News Minute gave 4 stars out of 5 and wrote "Ayali, despite a few flaws, is receiving the praise it well deserves. It gives hope that the Tamil web series genre will choose nuanced storytelling over trying to stretch out cinematic mass moments for its actors."
Bhuvanesh Chandar of The Hindu wrote "the series raises its voice against the socio-religious factors that are used by men to oppress women, but you wish the series used the long format to maximise its potential and with a better screenplay."

episodesList.title: The Achievers' Board
episodesList.summary: In the '90s, the people of Veerappannai take pride in marrying off girls as soon as they reach puberty. Tamizh Selvi who hails from that village dreams of becoming a doctor.

episodesList.title: The Red Pain
episodesList.summary: Selvi fears that her doctor dream will fail as soon as she reaches puberty. She realizes that her parents will not support her due to the customs of this village. She prays to God that she should never reach puberty so that she can continue her studies. Selvi goes through puberty.

episodesList.title: Kuruvammal Challenge
episodesList.summary: Selvi hides her puberty from everyone and violates the village's most important belief for the sake of her education. While hoping that God will help her keeping it a secret, When Selvi’s puberty is discovered by her mother Kuruvammal, Selvi successfully manages to convince her mother to support her.

episodesList.title: Hall Ticket
episodesList.summary: Selvi is the first student in that village to study 10th standard. Many slander her. Selvi happily goes to school despite all the hurdles. A compulsion to go to the town school to write the 10th grade public examination arises for Selvi. Tirupati, the village head forbids Selvi from going out of village citing the customs and restrictions of the village.

episodesList.title: Three Flowers
episodesList.summary: Selvi and Kuruvammal are happily travelling to town by bus to write 10th class public examination of Selvi. Selvi's father Thavasi gets injured in an accident. Kuruvammal believes this to be a punishment of god for breaking village customs. She forbids Selvi from going to school.

episodesList.title: No Boundaries for Bold Women
episodesList.summary: Selvi's friend Kayalvizhi is getting married. Selvi and Kayalvizhi come up with a plan to stop it by breaking the temple based village custom. It causes great shock in the entire village. It overturns all the customs and rituals that have been practiced in that village all the years.

episodesList.title: The Revolution
episodesList.summary: All the women come forward to enter the temple due to Selvi's motivation. She is happy that once the women enter the temple, all the restrictions in the village will be removed and the women will study and live freely. Sakthivel, Thiruppathi’s son crushes her plan to pieces. Selvi reveals the secret of hiding her puberty to save Kayalvizhi.

episodesList.title: Ayali
episodesList.summary: Marriage is arranged between Selvi and Sakthivel. All women are trying to stop the marriage. All the women come together and raise the voice for their freedom to break the traditions and customs that is holding them back.

title: Aha Naa Pellanta
summary: Aha Naa Pellanta is a 2022 Indian Telugu-language streaming television series directed by Sanjeev Reddy and produced by Surya Rahul Tamada under the Tamada Media banner. It stars Raj Tarun and Shivani Rajashekhar in lead roles, while Aamani, Harsha Vardhan, and Getup Srinu in supporting roles. Set in the backdrop of Rajamundry, the series is a comical narrative of a groom, isolated by the bride on their wedding day. The series was released on ZEE5 on 17 November 2022.
plot: This eight-episode series centres on a bride who escapes with her ex-boyfriend and leaves the groom waiting in the mandap. The story unfolds when this guy decides to take revenge. The series is a humorous take on revenge and an irrational oath which changes the protagonist's fate forever.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
In early 2022, ZEE5 announced a slate of Telugu series and films, with Aha Naa Pellanta being one of them, scheduled for a release on 17 November 2022.
The makers unveiled the first look teaser through social media platforms on 31 October 2022 and an official trailer on 4 November 2022 which begins with the introduction of Srinu’s (Raj Tarun) family. As Srinu agrees for marriage, his parents (played by Harsha Vardhan and Amani) fix the match with a girl in the same town. Later, on the wedding day, the bride escapes with her boyfriend.
The title track for Aha Naa Pellanta was released on 5 November 2022.

articleSections.title: Home media
articleSections.text: The streaming rights for Aha Naa Pellanta were acquired by ZEE5.

episodesList.title: Therasala
episodesList.summary: Sinu narrates a childhood incident that prompted him to vow to never flirt with any girl before marriage. Now an adult, he finally finds his match in Sudha, who elopes on their wedding day.

episodesList.title: Pani Grahanam
episodesList.summary: Sinu moves to Hyderabad to pursue a job and stays with his friends Dass and Bala. Sudha’s father meets Sinu and convinces him to abduct Sudha’s accomplice Maha.

episodesList.title: Brahma Mudi
episodesList.summary: Ready to avenge himself, Sinu and his friends abduct Maha a day before her wedding. While Sudha’s father plans to kill the girl, Sinu saves her. They together leave for Hyderabad to start afresh.

episodesList.title: Sapatha Padi
episodesList.summary: On reaching Hyderabad, Maha is rejected by her family. Stuck, helpless, and alone, she has nowhere to go. Sinu witnesses her situation and hesitantly offers her shelter at his place.

episodesList.title: Arundhati Nakshaatram
episodesList.summary: In order to stop Maha from filing a complaint, Sinu asks one of his friends to impersonate a police officer. As the footage of the abduction goes missing, Sudha’s father continues to threaten Maha.

episodesList.title: Jeelakarra Bellam
episodesList.summary: Friendship and love brew between Sinu and Maha during their stay together. Maha, however, faces problems with her ex over a house promised in dowry. An angry Maha reveals why she helped Sudha elope.

episodesList.title: Madhuparakam
episodesList.summary: Sinu helps in solving Maha’s house issue. As Sinu’s wedding gets fixed with another girl, both realise their love for each other. But Sudha’s father exposes Sinu as Maha's abductor to her father.

episodesList.title: Mangalasoothra Dhaarana
episodesList.summary: Maha decides to profess her love for Sinu but gets to know the story behind her abduction. A heartbroken Maha decides to leave the country, but the lovers are once again brought together by fate.

title: Anandha Ragam
summary: Anandha Ragam (transl. A Blissful Tune) is a 2022 Indian Tamil-language family drama series starring Anusha Hegde and Alagappan. It premiered on 29 August 2022 on Sun TV and ended on 14 January 2026, along with Ilakkiya. This serial digitally available on Sun NXT.
reception: The series was described by the Times of India as "one of the most-watched daily soaps on Tamil television". It had 560 episodes as of July 2024 and was said to be one of the top serials airing on Sun TV.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Kannada television actress Anusha Prathap was cast in the female lead role as Eshwari, making her debut in Tamil television dramas. Tamil actor Alagappan was selected to play the male lead of Azhagu Sundaram, making his debut in a male lead role. In cameo roles, Tamil actor Ilavarasu and Vinodhini Vaidyanathan were cast as Eshwari's parents.
Actress Reehana was cast as Saranya, who is Sampath's ex-lover and Shilpa's mother. Indhu Chowdary was cast as Shilpa. In May 2024, Sivaranjani Vijay portraying Girija quit and her character was shown in comatose. She is replaced by Sai Madhavi in December. In the same month, actress Indira Priyadarshini replaced Sangeetha as Durga.
In January 2025, Swetha Senthilkumar portraying Abhi, quit after a period of 2.5 years since the show's inception in 2022. She was replaced by Reshma Shajahan in February.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: The series was described by the Times of India as "one of the most-watched daily soaps on Tamil television". It had 560 episodes as of July 2024 and was said to be one of the top serials airing on Sun TV.

title: Ali Baba
summary:
Ali Baba is an Indian fantasy television series based on the Arabian Nights character Ali Baba. Produced by Alind Srivastava and Nissar Parvez under Peninsula Pictures, the series follows the life of an orphan Ali Baba, from the Mamuli Gali of Kabul, and the challenges he faces in trying to protect and care for five other orphaned children.
It starred Sheezan Khan, Tunisha Sharma, Karthik Jayaram and Sayantani Ghosh in the first season titled Ali Baba: Dastaan-e-Kabul: Chapter 1 (Translation - Ali Baba: Legend of Kabul: Chapter 1). It aired from 22 August 2022 to 14 January 2023 on Sony SAB and digitally streams on SonyLIV.
It starred Abhishek Nigam replacing Khan and Manul Chudasama replacing Tunisha as the leads in the new season titled Ali Baba: Ek Andaaz Andekha : Chapter 2 (Translation: Ali Baba: A Style Unseen : Chapter 2). It aired from 16 January 2023 to 9 June 2023.

articleSections.title: Chapter 1: Dastaan-E-Kabul
articleSections.text:
Ali Baba is a poor, yet a very good person living with 5 adorable orphan children viz Gulrez, Poya, Imaad, Nafi and Alifi. He always gets flashbacks of when his father, the great magician Mustafa gets killed while destroying the Forty Thieves and their Leader, Iblis. However, he makes a prophecy that Ali will write and complete 'Legend of Kabul'. Simsim who loves and respects Iblis, decides to crack the moon to break the curse to get the Forty Thieves back and succeeds in it. Princess Mariam loses her father due to a fight between her father and her wicked uncle, Saddam; a cunning person who helps Simsim but wants to sit on the Throne. Later, Mariam escapes and after a lot of turns meets Ali.
They slowly develop feelings for each other and Ali, Mariam and the children reach Ali's home. Ali and Simsim come face to face but Ali wins the Talisman and becomes the Saviour of Parvaz. After a series of events, Ali Baba finally takes the treasure but Qasim had watched him. Then Qasim gets brutally killed by the Forty Thieves and Simsim and they hung him in the centre of Parvaz to give warning to the people. They also gave the note that if anyone gets him down then his whole family will die. So, for the sake of his family, Ali Baba can't gets Qasim down. But later Ali, in the form of Rakhwala, with the help of the Talisman provides proper burial to Qasim. Then, Ali Baba promises to finish Simsim and the Forty Thieves.
Ali Baba now tries to find a way to kill the Forty Thieves and Simsim once and for all. Then by solving clues of his father, Ali reaches his father's magical world and after a lot of turns meets his father who gives him the 'Noor' but warns him that the Noor works only with the Talisman. After returning, he discovers that Nazia has sold the Talisman. Ali goes to find the Talisman but gets to know from Nafi that Marjina has been captured. Then he decides to save Marjina's life first. On the quest to save Marjina, Ali fails and burns his face by the Forty Thieves and was left to die.
Simsim gets out of the cave by breaking the curse from sacrificing Marjina and enters Parvaz as Simijaan to catch the Rakhwala. She also captures Ali's grandmother. Very soon, she enters Mustafa's magical world to find her answers and again comes face to face with Mustafa.

articleSections.title: Chapter 2: Ek Andaaz Andekha
articleSections.text:
Simsim asks Mustafa who the Rakhwala is and he answers that his son, Ali is. At the same time, Alifi saves Noora Dadi and burns the entrance to Mustafa's world to finish Simsim but fails. Ali gets the cure. He then returns to Parvaz as Chota Kotwal to find Simsim. Very soon, Ali imprisons Simsim and gets to know the real place of Marjina. Then he finds Marjina but is shocked to see that Marjina has lost her memory. Ali gets to know that the Prince of Ras Al Khaimah is responsible for Marjina losing her memory and after a lot of turns, Ali defeated the Prince and takes Marjina back to Parvaz. The children also fall in danger but ultimately succeeds and returns to Parwaaz.
On the way, Ali and Marjina unknowingly disturb a marriage as a headless woman comes and takes the groom. To help the people and to free the groom, Ali makes a plan to catch the headless woman. On the other hand, the children goes to find the Talisman and ends up in the Snake World. On the other hand, Ali promises to find the head of the headless woman and succeeds. Simsim is freed by the Forty Thieves. Simsim then seeks to take revenge on Ali. Ali goes in search of Marjina's memories. Ali then gives the memory of Marjina to her and she recalls everything but questions about Ali's face but Ali explains her how his face changed. The children also escaped from the Snake World but Saddam brings the news to Simsim about the Talisman and tortures the children.
On returning home happily, Ali and Marjina gets to know from Hasan, (who was stabbed by Simsim and left alive to give the information to Ali), that the children are kidnapped by Simsim in the palace of Kabul Shahi. Ali and Marjina rush to Kabul Shahi to save the children and where Ali realises that Marjina is actually Princess Mariam. Then they successfully saved the children and Mariam finally kills Saddam. Simsim goes to find the Talisman but fails and gets to know that she needs Ali's helps to get the Talisman as she saw the Noor of Shangrila on Ali 's back when she was fighting against him. She asks for Ali's help but he refuses. Then she kills Noora Dadi and threatens Ali that she will kill every one Ali has loved and will destroy the entire Parvaz. So, for the sake of everyone's life, Ali Baba promises to get the Talisman for her.
Then they reach the Shangrila in the north of Hindustan to get the Talisman where Ali gets injured while saving Roshni from an arrow. Then Roshni takes them inside the Shangrila. There, Ali Baba takes the Talisman and Roshni is apparently killed by Simsim, but Ali blames himself for her death. On returning to Parvaz, Ali seemingly gives the Talisman to SImsim. Mariam reveals to Ali that Roshni is his mother. Ali is mortified and swears revenge, revealing he has the real Talisman. Then Ali goes to the cave of Simsim and when he was about to open the door of Simsim's Cave, he was confronted by the guru of Shangrila Tribe and he says that Roshni has not been killed but vanished and kidnapped by Simsim. He then finds the prison which had Roshni and Ali frees her and they both go to Parvaaz. They then were having a feast on the birthday of Ali's father Mustafa. On the same day Simsim and the Forty Thieves comes to Parvaaz to recover the Talisman from Ali.
Mariam sets fire to the boxes that held captive the Forty Thieves. Simsim pretends to have burned as well. Using this trick, she steals the Talisman from Ali and starts the ceremony to awaken Iblis. Ali stops her, and burns Iblis's body to ashes. Simsim swears revenge and decides to use the Talisman for her vengeance.
However, she finds a suitable body and Iblis returns to life. Simsim and Iblis goes to Parvaz. To save Ali, Roshni pushes him to a magical world and there he is hung upside down and sees his long lost brother, Hatim.
Hatim and Ali Baba initially gets into rivalry but still they have to fight together as Iblis has been reborn and is destroying the world to find Ali as he has the "Roshan Dil" and it is in destiny of Ali Baba to kill Iblis and finish the darkness but Ali can't defeat Iblis because he is too weak against Iblis. On Behrouz Baba's insist, Tahira convinces Hatim to train Ali because Hatim has experience and Ali has power. Iblis finds Ali and kills Behrouz Baba but Ali Baba, Tahira and Hatim escaped to find the seven most difficult questions of the universe to train Ali and to get the magical stone to defeat Iblis.
However, one of the fourteen devils tries to capture Ali, but fails the first time and Ali, Hatim and Tahira found the first question's answer but the devil succeeds in capturing Ali the second time and he takes Ali to Kabul. On reaching, Ali captured the devil by using Hatim's inventory pocket. Now, Ali and Hatim have divided their works as Hatim would find the answers of the questions and Ali will capture all the other devils of Iblis. The Black Genie wants to marry Simsim and Iblis agrees. Iblis tells Mariam that Ali is dead and that she will be his wife. Mariam refuses. Simsim gets extremely happy thinking that she is going to marry Iblis.
On the wedding day, Ali and Marjina meets. Simsim gets to know about Iblis' real intention and Simsim protests against him and Iblis takes her power and abandoned her. Now, Ali Baba and Simsim unites together to kill Iblis. Simsim and Ali enters Iblis' palace and they convinced him to trust them.
Ali captured all the fourteen devils of Iblis' with the help of Simsim, by which Iblis gets weaker than before. On the other hand, Iblis gets the magical stone after capturing Hatim in the world of most difficult questions and after his return, Iblis captures Ali and his team and he reveals his real plans to Simsim. Simsim got to know that Iblis has to sacrifice his wife and all of his devils so he had to marry princess Mariam and to capture all his devils. Iblis gives Simsim her powers back. Simsim takes Roshni's powers and disguises herself as Roshni and tries to send Ali to Iblis so that Iblis can use the Roshan Dil but Ali recognised her. Ali helps Hatim to release himself while Hatim gives an idea to Ali to defeat Iblis. Ali goes after Iblis with a plan. Hatim goes to find the Talisman. Ali with the help of Hatim defeated Iblis by the use of Talisman. But Simsim escapes and wanted to become the supreme darkness and burns Ibils' body so that he can never return. Simsim divides her soul into four halves in air, water, land and lava. Roshni, Marjina, Hatim and Ali respectively goes and finally found the halves of Simsim 's soul. After uniting the soul, Ali Baba finally defeated Simsim as well. The series ends with Ali Baba, Marjina and his family living happily ever after.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Sheezan Khan was cast in the titular role, and was joined by Tunisha Sharma, Karthik Jayaram and Sayantani Ghosh as leads.
Navina Bole was cast to portray Fatima's mother in October 2022.
Abhishek Nigam replaced Sheezan Khan in Season 2 in January 2023 post Sharma's demise while Manul Chudasama replaced Tunisha as Mariam in the following month.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text:
On 24 December 2022, actress Tunisha Sharma playing the lead role of Shehzaadi Mariam, committed suicide by hanging herself in the green room of co-star Sheezan Khan on set. She was taken to a nearby hospital where she was declared dead on arrival.
Hours after her death her co-actor, rumored boyfriend and the lead Sheezan Khan was booked in the case of abetment for suicide by her mother.
On 4 January 2023, Federation of Western India Cine Employees, president BN Tiwari demanded strict action against the makers for negligence.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The series was announced by Peninsula Pictures in March 2022 and was confirmed in July 2022 by Sony SAB. The shooting of the series began in June 2022 in Ladakh, India.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text:
The shooting of the series halted after the lead actress Tunisha Sharma committed suicide on set in Naigaon. The show had an episode bank of one week.
The cast resumed the shooting of the series on 4 January 2023, on Renu Studio in Naigaon. Actor Abhishek Nigam was finalized to replace Sheezan Khan as Ali Baba in a new plot.

title: Ajooni
summary: Ajooni (transl. Infinite) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series that starred Ayushi Khurana and Shoaib Ibrahim. It aired from 26 July 2022 to 23 August 2023 on Star Bharat.
plot:
It is the story of a woman named Ajooni Vohra who will go to any lengths to fight for her rights. Rajveer Singh Bagga belongs to the Bagga family, known for their power in Punjab. The Baggas, headed by Rajveer's father, Ravindra Singh Bagga, are rooted deep in tradition and superstition. The Vohra family, however, are traditional but believe in progressive thinking and educating their daughters Ajooni and Meher. Rajveer Singh Bagga and Ajooni Vohra eventually fall in love despite seeming incompatible in the beginning.
The story is set in Haryalipur, where Ajooni and Avinash are to be engaged but then Ajooni accidentally meets Rajveer in the market and he falls for Ajooni - love at first sight, He starts stalking her and breaks her engagement with Avinash. After no option left, Ajooni agrees to marry Rajveer. After the marriage there are many dramas. Rajveer's younger sister, Dolly plots against Ajooni as she does not like her. Ajooni supports Amanpreet, her sister-in-law. Harman and Dolly plots together. Avinash returns to Ajooni's life. Ajooni is not initially satisfied with her marriage, but over time she realizes Rajveer's genuine love for her. After time and difficulties for Ajooni she faces more difficulties including the time when Harvendra Singh Bagga does not become a father After a lot of tries, he decides to marry Shikha, a girl who he has secretly meet but in real Shikha just wants all the money, respect and property of the Baggas. After plotting tons of times Ajooni finds her secret and poses as Kamali, a new maid. Slowly she got closer and closer until Shikha and her boyfriend fall into a trap. Their secret is out but the money that the Baggas had for loan was stolen by Ravindra's younger stepbrother Tejendra Singh Bagga and his son Shankar "Shanky" Singh Bagga. But all this was plotted by Tejendra's evil and vicious mother, Amrit Jarnail Singh Bagga. Ravindra, after knowing this called Tejendar to the Bagga house only to humiliate and build anger in Tejendra. But he knows a secret that nobody else knows that is he had switched Rajveer and Shanky at birth but his good and naive wife Kaveri Tejendra Singh Bagga told Tejendra that when she saw him switching Rajveer and Shanky she switched them back after Tejendra went away. After scoldings by both Tejendra and Amrit they thought to themselves that they don't know about this so Tejendra breaks the news and the Baggas are shattered and Rajveer goes to Tejendra's house and Shanky goes to the Bagga house. After having trouble and punishment at the Bagga house Shanky is building his anger while at Tejendra's house they are inside out torturing Ajooni and Rajveer. One night while the lights go out Ajooni is attacked and the goon says that it's an old lady and a couple days earlier Manjyot, Ravindra's mother, came to Tejendra's house for threatening Ajooni. Though it was Amrit who did this but Rajveer suspected Manjyot and broke all ties with the Bagga house and they rift apart. After they had too much hate for each other Ajooni and Harman scheme to get them together but the opposite happens. The night Rajveer and Ravindra were meeting, Ravindra got shot by Shanky. When Rajveer saw him shot he rushed Ravindra to the hospital. But Amrit blamed him and got the cops on him and he nearly escaped. After Rajveer made a run, he went to the Bagga house to meet Ravindra. In the Bagga House Tejendra's family show their true colors and get the property papers and they shoot Rajveer and throw him in the river. When Ajooni hears this she swore to kill Shanky but Rajveer was alive because his younger sister Dolly switched the real bullets with the fake. When Ajooni goes up to try and kill Shanky so Rajveer aka Pathan can save him and gain their trust. After torturing the Baggas too much they finally found out about Rajveer and put him and tie him on a chair that spins so they can shoot arrows at him. Then when the last arrow goes straight to his head Ravindra stands up and beats up the goons and punishes each and everyone that tortured him and his family. Then Shanky finds a gun and attempts to shoot Ravindra but Rajveer pulls him out just in time and the bullet hits Tejendra. The Baggas celebrate that the truth has won and have a party and pray to God for prosperity at all times.
Then Rajveer and Ajooni go to honeymoon. Shanky, escaped from jail decides that he will kill each man of the Bagga house. Shikha, who completed her imprisonment, saves them from Shanky and when Shanky tries to shoot Rajveer, his mother Kaveri kills him and surrenders herself to police. Shikha was injured and admitted to hospital by Ajooni and Rajveer. Shikha said that her parents thrown out from their house. Rajveer gives her a room in a working women's hostel. Shikha plans to takeover the property of Baggas. Ravinder gives the throne of Baggas to Rajveer and responsibility of Bagga Factories to Harvendra.
She meets Harvendra for her plan to take over the property and the throne. Arvinder joins her due to the greed of Throne. Shikha approaches to Gyaneshwar Singh, a poor Hindi professor and lookalike of Ravindra to convince him for acting as Ravindra for taking away the property of Baggas because he was a man of principles, they bribed him and kidnapped Chikoo (adopted daughter of Gyaneshwar) with the help of Garewal, a goon. Then, Garewal kidnapped Ravindra and forcibly signed his all property to Shikha. Fortunately, Ajooni and Rajveer save Ravindra and Chikoo. Ravindra, in front of Harvendra acts as Gyaneshwar in Bagga House. Shikha goes to Bagga house for taking her property. Then Ravindra, Rajveer and Ajooni revealed about Ravindra's lookalike, Gyaneshwar. Ravindra guarantees him that from school till Chikoo's marriage, he will carry the expenses. Gyaneshwar thanks him and says that if Ravindra will be in problem, he will pray to God that the problem will come on Gyaneshwar.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Ayushi Khurana as Ajooni Bagga (nee Vohra): Neeru and Subhash's daughter; Meher and Bharat's sister; Avinash's ex fiance; Rajveer's wife (2022–2023) * Shoaib Ibrahim as Rajveer Singh Bagga: Ravindra and Harman's son; Harvendra and Dolly's brother; Ajooni's husband (2022–2023)

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: On 10 March 2023 around 4:30pm a massive fire broke out on the neighboring set of Ghum Hai Kisikey Pyaar Meiin turning the set into ashes and it was reported that the fire even reached the Ajooni set and another neighboring set of Teri Meri Doriyaann too.

episodesList.title: Meet the Fearless Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Brave girl, Ajooni teaches a lesson to a roadside Romeo with her befitting move. On the other hand, Rajveer resorts to violence to defend his territory.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Meets Rajveer
episodesList.summary: Rajveer saves Ajooni when she accidentally slips on the road. Elsewhere, Ajooni's family members start preparing for her marriage to Avinash.

episodesList.title: Love at First Sight for Rajveer
episodesList.summary: On seeing Ajooni, Rajveer feels an instant attraction towards her. Later, he arrives at her house for the Satyanarayan Pooja and gets furious to see her with a guy.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Proposes to Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Rajveer gets furious when he spots Ajooni with Avinash in a jewellery shop. Later, he buys an expensive ring and proposes to Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Rajveer at Ajooni's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Ajooni feels helpless when Rajveer forces her to take the dress. Later, he arrives at her and Avinash's engagement ceremony and creates havoc.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Unsettling Demand
episodesList.summary: Rajveer storms into Ajooni's engagement venue and at gunpoint, asks her to marry him. When he creates chaos outside Ajooni's house, the police take him away.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Gets Released
episodesList.summary: After learning of Rajveer's arrest, Ravinder rushes to the police station. Ravinder, with his social power, forces Manjeet to release Rajveer from jail.

episodesList.title: Rajveer, Avinash's Face-off
episodesList.summary: Avinash gets into a fight with Rajveer as the latter announces his engagement with Ajooni. Later, Rajveer sends goons to attack Avinash in the hospital.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Is Angry with Avinash
episodesList.summary: Subhash reaches higher authorities to complain against Rajveer. Later, Rajveer decides to teach a lesson to Avinash after he finds Ajooni near his house.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Diabolical Threat
episodesList.summary: After Rajveer kidnaps Avinash's sister, the latter breaks off his engagement with Ajooni. Later, Rajveer announces on a news channel that Ajooni is to get engaged to him.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Manipulates Bebe
episodesList.summary: When Bebe disrupts Rajveer's plans of marrying Ajooni, he cuts his hand and threatens to kill himself. Later, he stops Ajooni's family from leaving at gunpoint.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Agrees to Marry Rajveer
episodesList.summary: Ajooni gets worried about what Rajveer might do to her family and agrees to marry him. However, she asks Rajveer to publicly apologise to her family as a condition.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Threatens Ravinder
episodesList.summary: At gunpoint, Rajveer threatens Ravinder to accept his wedding with Ajooni. Bebe behaves harshly with Ajooni and her family when they arrive for the ceremony.

episodesList.title: A Clash at Ajooni, Rajveer's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Before Ajooni and Rajveer's wedding, both the families are at loggerheads. Rajveer keeps his promise to Ajooni and apologises to her family in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Ajooni, Rajveer Get Hitched
episodesList.summary: After overcoming several obstacles, Ajooni and Rajveer finally get married. Later, Rajveer defends Ajooni when the Baggas humiliate her and want to change her name.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Makes it Clear
episodesList.summary: Ajooni takes a firm stand against the Baggas by refusing to change her name after marriage. Later, Ravjeer defends Ajooni when Bebe tries to slap her.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Mooh Dikhai
episodesList.summary: The Bagaas host Ajooni's Mooh Dikhai ceremony at their mansion. While the guests face awkwardness, Rajveer whips the servant for breaking a precious gift.

episodesList.title: Neelu, Subhash Face Embarrassment
episodesList.summary: Ajooni informs Subhash about the occurrences at the Bagaa mansion. Later, Ravinder humiliates Neelu and Subhash for coming home uninformed.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Forces Ajooni to Apologise
episodesList.summary: Harman and Dolly demand Ajooni to cook non-veg food, but she refuses. Later, Rajveer forces Ajooni to apologise to Harman as Dolly instigates him.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Ongoing Struggles
episodesList.summary: Ajooni has a hard time adjusting to her new family's rules and gets into constant arguments. Rajveer gets slapped by Ravinder while trying to protect Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Foul Intent
episodesList.summary: To put Ajooni in trouble, Dolly puts chilli powder in her cooked food. Rajveer saves Ajooni from getting the punishment and endures the pain instead.

episodesList.title: Ajooni to Help Aman
episodesList.summary: Dolly fails to bring trouble into Ajooni's life after several attempts. Unable to endure the cruel treatment Aman receives from Harvinder, Ajooni tries to save her.

episodesList.title: Great News for Ajooni!
episodesList.summary: Ravinder punishes Harman and throws her out of the Bagga mansion. Later, the family is taken aback when Rajveer celebrates Ajooni's distinction.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Feels Ecstatic
episodesList.summary: Rajveer is on cloud nine as he celebrates Ajooni's triumph. In the meantime, Dolly and Surbhi lay a trap to frame Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Race Against Time
episodesList.summary: Dolly seeks revenge against Ajooni by playing a trick on her. Nonetheless, Rajveer rushes to Ajooni's rescue when she lands in a fix!

episodesList.title: Rajveer Is Knocked Senseless
episodesList.summary: Rajveer is unable to believe that Ajooni filed a case against Ravinder when the cops arrive at the Bagga mansion. Furthermore, Rajveer fights goons to save Mehr.

episodesList.title: Rajveer to the Rescue!
episodesList.summary: Dolly pays the price for attempting to frame Ajooni. On the other hand, Rajveer gets injured when he saves Mehr from a group of deadly goons.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Prays for Rajveer
episodesList.summary: Ajooni tends to Rajveer's wounds when his health condition deteriorates. She prays for his speedy recovery after she learns of his fight with the goons for her.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Faces Allegations
episodesList.summary: Concerned about Rajveer, Ajooni's family members visit the Bagga mansion. While the Baggas curse Ajooni, Rajveer's health worsens.

episodesList.title: A Miracle for Rajveer, Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Ajooni gets slapped by Harman as she is blamed for Rajveer's worsening state. Later, when she starts shouting, Rajveer responds and is declared out of danger.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Continues to Suffer
episodesList.summary: Ravinder makes Ajooni suffer and lose her self-esteem in order to stay at his house. Later, Mr. Sethi suggests that Ajooni should be given their party's ticket.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Exposes Dolly's Ruse
episodesList.summary: Rajveer accuses Dolly of hatching a devious plot against Ajooni and shares the evidence. When Dolly tries to frame Harman, Ajooni confronts her.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Subhash
episodesList.summary: Subhash gets anxious when Ravinder and Dolly visit his house with a shocking appeal. Later, upon Rajveer's request, Ravinder withdraws all the conditions from Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Harman's Vindictive Motives
episodesList.summary: Harman orders the maid to put glass pieces in the laundry so Ajooni injures herself while doing the chores. Later, the Baggas urge Ajooni to start her family.

episodesList.title: Ajooni, Rajveer in a Conflict
episodesList.summary: Ajooni gets treated suspiciously after Bebe sees Rajveer sleeping on the floor. Though Rajveer tries to side with Ajooni, the commotion leads to a dispute between them.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Feels Jealous
episodesList.summary: Rajveer takes Ajooni to a special place with the intent of proposing to her. But he grows envious of Ajooni's chatter with her male friend and strikes him.

episodesList.title: Harman Annoys Ajooni
episodesList.summary: To teach Ajooni a lesson, Harman plans to trouble her. He asks her to wash the utensils in the bathroom and turns on the geyser.

episodesList.title: Dolly Pays the Price
episodesList.summary: Subhash raises his voice at Dolly for chewing a piece of gum in the class. While Mehr teaches Dolly a lesson for troubling him, Harman slaps Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Helps Ajooni
episodesList.summary: To seek revenge, Harman and Dolly make an evil plan. Ajooni falls into their trap and gets hot oil splattered over her. Later, she accepts Rajveer's help.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Exposes Harman!
episodesList.summary: Chamko informs Ajooni that Harman has constantly desired to hurt her. Later, Ajooni confronts the family with the truth about Harman's horrible activities.

episodesList.title: Is Ajooni a Liar?
episodesList.summary: Ajooni is tagged as a liar after Chamko retracts her story, saying that she paid her to lie about Harman. As a punishment, Ajooni is forced to wash Harman's feet.

episodesList.title: Shikha Accepts Harvinder
episodesList.summary: Shikha and her parents visit the Baggas at their residence. Furthermore, Shikha likes Harvinder as their wedding gets fixed.

episodesList.title: Ajooni, Rajveer's Romantic Time
episodesList.summary: An intoxicated Harvinder dreams about his honeymoon with Shikha. On the other hand, Ajooni and Rajveer share a romantic moment at midnight.

episodesList.title: Harman Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Harvinder gets angry at Aman as he becomes the victim of Harman's foul plan. Harman makes a silly mistake and gets caught before the Baggas.

episodesList.title: Dolly Consumes Vinegar
episodesList.summary: Rajveer goes into a romantic hallucination while Dolly accidentally drinks vinegar. Later, Ajooni takes Aman to the hospital for a test.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Reveals the Report
episodesList.summary: As Ravinder decides to call Sikha's father, Ajooni shows Aman's fertility report. Harvinder is unable to accept the truth and tortures Aman.

episodesList.title: Shikha, Harvinder's Outing
episodesList.summary: A heated conflict sparks between Harvinder and Rajveer as Ravinder reprimands their silly behaviour. Later, Shikha and Harvinder go out on a date.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Stands for Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Ajooni lashes out at Sikha as she abuses Aman. Later, when Ravinder urges Rajveer to punish Ajooni for her conduct with Sikha, he stands up for Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Gives an Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: Ajooni identifies the doctor who checks on Aman's health condition. Later, Ravinder makes a startling announcement, regarding Harvinder's wedding.

episodesList.title: Good News for the Baggas
episodesList.summary: At Ravinder's birthday party, he announcesto the good news of Harvinder and Sikha's wedding, and Aman too, announces herpregnancy news. The Baggas celebrate the joy.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Rebukes Harvinder
episodesList.summary: After learning about Aman's pregnancy, Rajveer expresses his love and affection toward the unborn child. Later, Ravinder slaps Harvinder as he wishes to marry Shikha.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Loses His Temper
episodesList.summary: Dolly lays a cunning trap. Later, Aman gets an electric shock in the kitchen. When Dr. Avinash Khanna visits the Bagga mansion, Rajveer boils in rage.

episodesList.title: Harvinder's Promise to Shikha
episodesList.summary: Harvinder promises to kill Aman so he can marry Shikha. As per the plan, his henchman locks Aman in a lift and starts a smoke machine, getting him unconscious.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Discovers a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Ravinder condemns Ajooni's carelessness and holds her responsible for Aman's condition. Later, Ajooni gets shocked to learn of Aman's lie about her pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Lashes Out at Harvinder
episodesList.summary: Ravinder thrashes Harvinder proclaiming his involvement in the hospital mishap. Rajveer fumes in rage when he finds Ajooni and Avinash engaged in private conversation.

episodesList.title: Game Over, Harvinder!
episodesList.summary: The news of Aman's snakebite makes Ravinder certain about the conspiracy. Further, Harvinder gets caught as the hospital staff spill the truth.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Doubts Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Ravinder punishes Harvinder and Dolly for their crimes and warns them not to repeat them in future. Rajveer misinterprets Ajooni when he sees Avinash's text on her phone.

episodesList.title: Dolly, Harman's Notorious Act
episodesList.summary: Dolly and Harman's plan works as Ajooni's condition keeps deteriorating after the doctor injects a harmful substance into her body. Will Ajooni survive?

episodesList.title: Shikha Attains Her Target
episodesList.summary: Shikha creates a false scenario in which she attempts to end her life to persuade Harvinder to marry her. Meanwhile, Rajveer notices Ajooni and Avinash together.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Faces Harsh Repercussions
episodesList.summary: When Ravinder discovers Ajooni and Avinash together, he gets violent and imposes a severe penalty. Meanwhile, Rajveer is skeptical of Ajooni's innocence.

episodesList.title: Rajveer to Leave the House
episodesList.summary: Rajveer stops Ravinder from shooting Ajooni or giving her any punishment. Aman comes clean about her secret and Rajveer decides to leave the house with Ajooni.

episodesList.title: A Challenge for Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Ajooni gets shocked to learn about the messages, for which Rajveer misunderstands her. She takes up the challenge of finding the responsible within twenty-four hours.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Seeks Avinash's Help
episodesList.summary: Ajooni begs Avinash to assist her in establishing their innocence. However, Harman and Dolly continue to refine their strategy for their upcoming action.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Exposes the Truth!
episodesList.summary: Ajooni successfully uncovers the actual facts about how she was framed by Harman and Dolly. Moreover, Dolly reveals how she discovered Aman's truth.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Unexpected Request
episodesList.summary: After punishing Harman and Dolly for their actions, Ravinder asks that Ajooni demand a reward. Ajooni then requests him to bring Aman back.

episodesList.title: Aman Attempts Suicide
episodesList.summary: While Harvinder throws Aman out of his room, the latter breaks down. Meanwhile, Harman makes a promise to Rajveer and requests to bring Ajooni to Bagga's house.

episodesList.title: Ravinder vs Rajveer
episodesList.summary: While Ajooni is away from the house, Harman gets punished for objecting to Rajveer's second marriage. Later, Rajveer and Ravinder compete in a challenge.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Sincere Efforts
episodesList.summary: As Rajveer sneaks into Ajooni's room, the latter grows anxious and unknowingly hits him. Later, Rajveer makes a sincere effort to convince Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Bebe Slaps Harman!
episodesList.summary: While decorating the house, Rajveer saves Ajooni when she falls off the stool. Elsewhere, an infuriated Bebe smacks Harman for speaking ill about her.

episodesList.title: Harvinder, Sikha's Wicked Motive
episodesList.summary: Rajveer and Ajooni spent a blissful time together at Meher's birthday party. Meanwhile, Harvinder and Sikha plan to push Aman into the pond while she goes to fetch water.

episodesList.title: Rajveer, Ajooni Learn a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Rajveer plans a prank with Meher and tricks Ajooni into believing that he is having an affair. Later, Biji advises Ajooni and Rajveer to save their marriage.

episodesList.title: Ravinder's Shocking Move
episodesList.summary: Ravinder makes Dolly welcome Ajooni into the house and also asks her apologise to the latter by touching her feet. Later, Rajveer gives a romantic gift to Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Dolly Forges an Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Despite Harmans warnings, Dolly devises a malicious ploy against Ajooni. Meanwhile, on the eve of Karwa Chauth, Rajveer and Ajooni begin to get closer.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's First Karwa Chauth
episodesList.summary: Rajveer displays his affection while performing Karwa Chauth rituals with Ajooni. Later, a conflict occurs when Harvinder demands a divorce from Aman.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Ravinder
episodesList.summary: Ravinder gets astonished when Guru Maharaj informs him about Rajveer's shocking fate. Elsewhere, Rajveer grows suspicious when he gets attacked.

episodesList.title: Rajveer, Ajooni’s Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: Romantic feelings seep in as Rajveer and Ajooni cherish each and every moment of their honeymoon. Elsewhere, Harvinder forges a wicked plot against Rajveer.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Life at Risk
episodesList.summary: The Baggas feel worried about the troubled times in Rajveer’s life. In the meantime, a fan falls over Rajveer, and Ajooni seeks immediate help.

episodesList.title: Ajooni at Crossroads
episodesList.summary: Rajveer wishes to relive his honeymoon with Ajooni as their first one was cut short. Meanwhile, Harman pleads with Ajooni to keep a distance from Rajveer.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Miraculous Save
episodesList.summary: To harm Rajveer, Harvinder sets a trap for him and poisons the arrow. In a twist of events, Harvinder gets hurt and is saved by Rajveer.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Promise to Ajooni
episodesList.summary: While Rajveer gets ready for his first rally, Ajooni expresses her fear of him becoming a tyrant after joining politics. He reassures her and makes a promise.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Remains Steadfast
episodesList.summary: Ajooni holds her position, despite Guruji being infuriated with her for disagreeing with him. Enraged, Ravinder attacks Ajooni and threatens to punish her.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Worries About Ajooni
episodesList.summary: When Ajooni falls sick after the rituals, Rajveer takes care of her. Later, Harvinder tries to hurt Rajveer but Bebe catches him red-handed.

episodesList.title: Harman Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: Bebe admonishes Harvinder after he gets caught while attempting to kill Rajveer. Later, Harman promises to get Aman and Harvinder divorced so he can marry Shikha.

episodesList.title: Harman's Vindictive Plan
episodesList.summary: Harman hides the divorce papers of Aman and Harvinder from Ravinder. Later, Harman poisons Aman's mind and asks her to hit Chamko with a stick.

episodesList.title: Aman Misunderstands Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Ajooni unknowingly makes Aman sign the divorce papers and Harman accuses the former of cheating on Aman. Further, Aman misunderstands Ajooni as Harman provokes her.

episodesList.title: Rajveer in a Risky Situation
episodesList.summary: Ravinder punishes Aman for the excess salt in the food. Mangi Ram tells Rajveer in the drunk state about the life risk of cohabiting with Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Chamko Instigates Aman
episodesList.summary: Aman aims to teach Ajooni a lesson and comes up with a plan when Chamko infuses venom into his mind. On the other side, Rajveer discovers Guruji's truth.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Life at Stake
episodesList.summary: Rajveer tells Ajooni not to believe Maharaj's foretelling and to keep faith in their love. Later, the opposition party abducts Rajveer and shoots him in the conflict.

episodesList.title: Harman in Rajveer's Trap
episodesList.summary: Rajveer speaks out unexpectedly, while Harman sobs and declares Maharaj Ji's prophecy as a false one. Further, he questions Harman for troubling his marital life.

episodesList.title: Harman Pays the Price!
episodesList.summary: Rajveer castigates Harman's heinous conduct but refuses to punish her. However, Harman couldn't escape Ravinder's brutal anger and faces harsh repercussions.

episodesList.title: Rajveer to Harman's Rescue!
episodesList.summary: On Ajooni's insistence, Rajveer arrives to spare Harman from Ravinder's punishment. However, he refuses to forgive her and makes a crucial choice.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Ruins Harvinder's Plan
episodesList.summary: Ajooni thwarts Harvinder's plot when he brings Shikha dressed as Aman to the magistrate's office to complete the divorce. Aman apologises to Ajooni for mistaking her.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Stands Her Ground
episodesList.summary: Ajooni gives a stern reply to Bebe when she accuses her of ruining the Bagga's name. While Rajveer gets election tickets, the women protest against the Baggas

episodesList.title: Ajooni Reveals Harvinder's Truth
episodesList.summary: Ajooni confronts Ravinder about his aggressive demeanour and informs him of Harvinder's plot. However, Ravinder gives Ajooni a deadline to prove her claim.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Faces a Setback
episodesList.summary: Harvinder tricks Aman into taking the recorder that Ajooni has hidden. As it begins to play the song, Ajooni encounters a setback in front of Ravinder.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Takes Up a Challenge
episodesList.summary: Rajveer pledges to gather evidence to save Ajooni from Ravinder's harsh penalty. Meanwhile, Harvinder and Shikha team up to destroy the proof.

episodesList.title: Bebe Punishes Rajveer, Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Bebe decides to teach Ajooni a lesson, but Rajveer defends Ajooni. While Bebe punishes both Rajveer and Ajooni, the police deliver shocking news about Harvinder.

episodesList.title: The Baggas Get Shattered
episodesList.summary: Ajooni asks Rajveer to search for Shikha, as she was with Harvinder before the accident. The Baggas are devastated to discover Harvinder's fully burned corpse.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Faces an Accusation
episodesList.summary: After Rajveer brings ShikhaÂ to the Bagga house, sheÂ accuses AjooniÂ of killing Harvinder. Ravinder then decides to punish Ajooni after finding evidence against her.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Accepts the Charge
episodesList.summary: Rajveer brings along a witness to prove Harvinder's intent to kill him. After Ravinder lashes out at Rajveer, he confesses to killing Harvinder.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Confronts Rajveer
episodesList.summary: Ajooni faces Rajveer and briefs Shikha on her role in Harvinder's murder. Harman informs Ravinder of Rajveer's cooked-up story, after overhearing his conversation with Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Shikha Is Pregnant!
episodesList.summary: When Ravinder mistreats Ajooni for ruining his family, Rajveer brings evidence against Shikha. Meanwhile, Shikha's parents announce Shikha's pregnancy to the Baggas.

episodesList.title: Aman Loses Control
episodesList.summary: After Harman confirms Shikha's pregnancy, she convinces Ravinder to let Shikha stay at the house. However, an unhappy Aman tries to attack Shikha secretly.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Ajooni objects when Bebe and Harman decide to kick Aman out of the house. Meanwhile, Nari Morjya visits the Bagga mansion and demands punishment for Ravinder.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Misunderstands Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Upon the demand of Nari Morjya, Ravinder and Harman apologise before Ajooni and Aman. Later, Rajveer refuses to believe when Ajooni tries to clarify herself.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Stops Ravinder
episodesList.summary: Ravinder plans to shoot Ajooni to punish her for destroying his dream, but Rajveer tries to stop him. Later, the police bring Harvinder to Rajveer's house.

episodesList.title: Harman, Bebe Get Arrested
episodesList.summary: An officer from the Human Rights Association brings the cops to the Bagga mansion to question Ajooni. Her confession lands Harman and Bebe behind the bars.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Threatens the Cops
episodesList.summary: After Bebe and Harman are arrested, Rajveer holds himself responsible for the family feud. Later, Ravinder threatens the cops to release Bebe and Harman.

episodesList.title: Will Ajooni Withdraw the Complaint?
episodesList.summary: Rajveer begs Ajooni to dismiss her allegation against Harman and Bebe. However, despite being convinced, Ajooni offers to drop the allegations on one condition.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Confronts Ajooni
episodesList.summary: After being misled about Ajooni's intentions, Rajveer confronts her and gets Harman released. Later, Ravinder declares a punishment for Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Presents Evidence
episodesList.summary: Shikha and Aman fight over serving food to Harvinder. Elsewhere, as Shikha's parents arrive, Ajooni offers evidence to reveal the perpetrator inside the house.

episodesList.title: Rajveer, Ajooni's Quality Time
episodesList.summary: Rajveer informs Ravinder of Bebe's fictitious acting after Shikha is ousted. Later, he apologises to Ajooni and the two of them have a good time together.

episodesList.title: Harvinder Challenges Ajooni
episodesList.summary: When Ajooni discovers Harvinder's truth, he challenges her to stop him from marrying Shikha. Later, Shikha uses Harvinder as the trump card for her plot.

episodesList.title: Harvinder Gets Caught!
episodesList.summary: To get a confession from Harvinder about the chandelier, Ravinder sets up a devious trap. Later, Ravinder swears that he won't let Harvinder marry Shikha.

episodesList.title: Harvinder Attacks Aman
episodesList.summary: Lying to Ravinder, Bebe and Harvinder go to Shikha's house to give her the jewellery. Later, Harvinder attacks Aman in order to make her sign the divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Rajveer and Ajooni attempt to stop Harvinder and Shikha's wedding, but their efforts go in vain. Later, Ravinder refuses to let Shikha enter the house.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Fumes in Anger
episodesList.summary: After spotting a bruise on Amans neck, an infuriated Ravinder questions Harvinder. Later, he warns Bebe about her decision to bring Shikha to the Bagga house.

episodesList.title: Shikha's Diabolical Motive
episodesList.summary: Shikha deceives Aman by promising to give the baby to her as soon as it is born. During her Pehli Rasoi, Shikha tricks Aman into doing her part of the task.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Is Framed
episodesList.summary: Shikha accuses Ajooni of stealing, leaving the Baggas with no choice but to check her room. Surprisingly, the stolen item is found in her room.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Ravinder puts Shikha to the test in the kitchen to prove her lying about her abilities. Later, he takes action to prove Shikha's malice towards Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Saves Aman
episodesList.summary: Rajveer remains baffled about Shikha's accusation against Ajooni. Further, Ajooni stops Aman from consuming poisonous milk after getting a warning note.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Faces Backlash
episodesList.summary: When Shikha drinks the glass of milk and remains harmless, Ajooni receives criticism from Ravinder. To keep Ajooni away from issues, Rajveer plans a vacation.

episodesList.title: Aman Faces Obstacle
episodesList.summary: Rajveer practises proposing Ajooni before they go out for the trip. Further, Shikha creates problems for Aman and makes her incensed before the Baggas.

episodesList.title: Rajveer, Ajooni's Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: A mysterious man tries to abduct Ajooni but Rajveer manages to chase him down and rescue Ajooni. Later, Ajooni and Rajveer get romantic in their hotel room.

episodesList.title: Ajooni in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Aman confronts Harvinder as she hears his plan to put her in the hospital. As Ajooni and Rajveer spend quality time, an unknown person captures her and locks in room.

episodesList.title: Shikha Executes Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Shikha receives news from Harsh that he has trapped Ajooni in a secret chamber inside the hotel. While Rajveer tries to find her, Shikha asks Harsh to kill the former.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Finds Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Rajveer gets agitated as he hears Ajooni's voice but is unable to trace her. Despite the management's objection, he breaks the wall and finds her.

episodesList.title: Ajooni, Rajveer are Worried
episodesList.summary: Harvinder and Shikha hide Aman's body in the forest. Ajooni and Rajveer feel concerned and rush to Bagga's mansion after learning that Aman is missing.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Puts Shikha in a Spot
episodesList.summary: To expose Shikha's role in Aman's disappearance, Ajooni comes up with a scheme. Later, Shikha finds herself in trouble when her parents arrive

episodesList.title: Shikha Builds a False Story
episodesList.summary: Shikha fabricates a blatant lie to put Ajooni in a spot in front of everyone. Ajooni later devises a plan to teach Shikha a lesson when Ravinder arrives.

episodesList.title: Aman's Saviour Appears
episodesList.summary: Much to the surprise of the Baggas, Durga, Aman's aunt, shows up looking for her. While everyone gets tensed, she threatens Bebe and Harman.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Firm Stand
episodesList.summary: Harman fumes in anger when Ajooni takes a firm stand and refuses to stand by her. Later, Harman furiously devises a vile plan to spoil Rajveer and Ajooni's movie plans.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Exacts Her Retribution
episodesList.summary: By making Shikha touch her feet and beg her to honour the request, Ajooni exacts her vengeance. Later, Shikha uses her evil scheme against Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Misconduct is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Rajveer stands up for Ajooni and reveals how Dolly tried to embarrass her by substituting the meal. Later, Ravinder asks Shikha to slap Dolly as retribution.

episodesList.title: Durga Discovers Shikha's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: Harvinder informs Durga about Shikha's pregnancy in order to conceal his affair with her. Durga later decides to look after Shikha until she gives birth.

episodesList.title: Ajooni, Rajveer Hatch a Plan
episodesList.summary: Ajooni and Rajveer plan to haunt Harvinder and Shikha and expose their heinous acts. To trouble Durga, Shikha intends to steal the former's inhaler.

episodesList.title: Shikha Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Durga accuses Shikha of stealing her inhaler and searches her room. As Ajooni makes Shikha confess the truth, Durga gets determined to inform the police.

episodesList.title: Shikha Utters the Truth
episodesList.summary: When Durga sends Shikha out of the house, the latter speaks about her relationship with Harvinder. Harman finds Aman with Mahek and informs Ravinder.

episodesList.title: The Baggas Are Determined
episodesList.summary: Ajooni and Rajveer get startled as Harman and Bebe visit their house to search for Aman. However, Durga arrives in time to help Aman escape from the Baggas.

episodesList.title: Harman Is Punished
episodesList.summary: Harvinder punishes Harman for the humiliation he faced before Ajooni's family. Ravinder forces an inebriated Harvinder to confess the truth about Aman's ghost.

episodesList.title: Harvinder, Shikha Get Trapped
episodesList.summary: Rajveer and Ajooni prepare Aman to haunt Shikha and Harvinder. After witnessing Aman's spirit, Harvinder becomes alarmed and hurries to find her corpse.

episodesList.title: Harvinder, Shikha Get Exposed
episodesList.summary: Rajveer and Ajooni reveal Harvinder and Shikha's crime before the Baggas. Shikha tries to make up a tale, but Rajveer brings out the video of her confession.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Punishes Shikha
episodesList.summary: When Bebe obstructs Ravinder from punishing Shikha, he asks Ajooni to do it. Later, Ajooni seizes Shikha's rights and asks her to stay in the house as a guest.

episodesList.title: Harsh at Bagga Mansion
episodesList.summary: Ravinder is pleased to see Aman's new look and appreciates Ajooni for her idea. As Shikha refuses to speak with Harsh, he visits the Bagga mansion in disguise.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Gets Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Ajooni gets suspicious of Harsh's disguise and asks Mangiram to keep a close eye on him. Further, Shikha takes revenge on Chamko for troubling her.

episodesList.title: Shikha's Wicked Move
episodesList.summary: Ravinder strictly obstructs Shikha's participation in the Kul Devi Pooja with Harvinder. Later, to cause trouble, Shikha puts Ajooni's new dress in the dustbin.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Proves Her Love
episodesList.summary: To prove her love for Rajveer, Ajooni finds the dress in the garbage. Later, when Bebe wants to punish Ajooni, Rajveer creates obstructions.

episodesList.title: Shikha Gets Her Way
episodesList.summary: Shikha convinces Bebe that Ajooni tried to harm her and the latter declares that Ajooni's baby shower is cancelled. However, Durga takes a stand on Ajooni's behalf.

episodesList.title: Aman Falls Prey to Shikha's Plot
episodesList.summary: Shikha intoxicates the collector officer's drink, but Aman drinks it by accident. Soon, Aman loses her mind and starts acting insane, resulting in a shambles.

episodesList.title: The Baggas Celebrate Lohri
episodesList.summary: Ravinder rebukes Shikha for plotting against Aman. While the Baggas prepare to celebrate Lohri, Rajveer comes in the disguise of a dancer and dances with Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Shikha's Devious Move
episodesList.summary: As the Baggas play Antakshari, Ajooni confesses her love to Rajveer through a song. Meanwhile, Shikha devises a new ploy after receiving Dolly's letter.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Firm Stand
episodesList.summary: As Chamko gives a befitting reply, Shikha hatches a plan against her. Later, Ajooni takes a firm stand when Bebe decides to throw Chamko out of the house.

episodesList.title: Dolly Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Harman plans to teach Shikha an apt lesson for her vile deeds. Elsewhere, Dolly gets kidnapped and is shocked to see the Baggas behaviour towards her.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Phoney Act
episodesList.summary: Executing her trap, Dolly gains Ravinders sympathy to get back into the Bagga house. Later she forges a vicious plan against Shikha.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Smart Move
episodesList.summary: Ravinder gets impressed with Ajooni's clever move as she fixes his ruined Kurta with her sewing skill. Later, Ravinder issues a punishment to Shikha.

episodesList.title: Shikha Steals the Necklace
episodesList.summary: Shikha steals the necklace from Bebe's room and sells it to the goldsmith. Later, she gets shocked to see Harsh at the Bagga mansion and enquires about his visit.

episodesList.title: Neelu in Shikha's Trap
episodesList.summary: Shikha engages Neelu in a friendly conversation and puts the imitation necklace in the latter's bag. The Baggas get shocked to find the necklace in Neelu's bag.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Lashes Out at Shikha
episodesList.summary: Ravinder gets shocked to see the video of his house on the news channel. After learning about Shikha's involvement, he lashes at her and turns her out of the house.

episodesList.title: The Baggas Apologise to Neelu
episodesList.summary: The Nari Morcha team belittle Ravinder for defaming the women inside his house. Before the media, the Baggas apologise to Neelu for the false accusations.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Fumes in Anger
episodesList.summary: Ravinder gets angry when Dolly manipulates him against Shikha after the income tax raid. Rajveer takes a shocking decision when Ajooni breaks down.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Faces Bebe's Wrath
episodesList.summary: As per Shikha's villainous plan against Ajooni, the latter faces Bebe's wrath. On the other hand, Shikha meets a Tantrik to find a way to destroy the Bagga family.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Faces Accusations
episodesList.summary: Bebe and Harman bring the Tantrika home to save the Baggas from the ominous things. Tantrika accuses Ajooni of the consequences in the family.

episodesList.title: The Baggas in Trouble
episodesList.summary: The infuriated Tantrika wants to take revenge on Ajooni for the humiliation. The Baggas get worried after experiencing ominous events inside the house.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Evil Plot
episodesList.summary: Dolly seeks to take advantage of Tantrika to harm the Baggas as part of her nefarious plan. Afterwards, she hurts Ravinder by exploding a glass bottle.

episodesList.title: Bebe's Shocking Move
episodesList.summary: Upon Tantrika's order, Bebe decides to throw Ajooni out of the Bagga house. Ajooni is determined to leave the house instead of apologising to Tantrika.

episodesList.title: Can Badshah Help Ajooni?
episodesList.summary: Ravinder visits the Tantrika's cave and gets furious to learn about the latter's accusation against Ajooni. Rajveer and Ajooni seek Badshah's help to expose Tantrika.

episodesList.title: Tantrika's Scam Is Exposed!
episodesList.summary: To reveal Tantrika's deceit, Rajveer instructs Ajooni to step over the scorching embers. Later, Rajveer demonstrates each of Tantrika's deceptions.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Digs Deeper
episodesList.summary: Rajveer requests Ravinder to find the family member who is involved with Tantrika. When Harvinder appears, Ravinder accuses Shikha of causing all the trouble.

episodesList.title: Chamko's Sudden Change
episodesList.summary: After Chamko wins the lottery, she returns with a new look and denies being the Baggas' servant. Ravinder tells Bebe about the arrival of Dolly's prospective groom.

episodesList.title: Marriage Proposal for Dolly
episodesList.summary: Dolly gets a makeover from Ajooni before appearing in front of the suitor's family. In the meantime, Shikha commits a sinister deed by publicly framing Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Befitting Reply
episodesList.summary: Ajooni gives a befitting reply to Shikha when she insults Sundari. Shikha seizes the opportunity when Ajooni gets furious to see Sunadari and Rajveer together.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Surprise for Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Rajveer plans a surprise dinner to calm Ajooni's anger, and they spend a moment together. Dolly is shocked to discover Harsh and Shikha's vile motives.

episodesList.title: Shikha Manipulates Harvinder
episodesList.summary: Ravinder decides to punish Dolly after learning of her wrongdoings. Shikha tries to instigate Harvinder to execute her heinous plan against Rajveer and Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Ajooni's Firm Stand
episodesList.summary: Ajooni is furious upon discovering Harvinder's abominable deeds towards Sundari. Later, the Baggas are astonished when Ajooni takes a firm stand for Sundari.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Makes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Ravinder gets infuriated by Harvinder's act and decides to give a fair judgement. While Shikha defends Harvinder, Ajooni briefs Sundari about the incident.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Feels Shattered
episodesList.summary: Ajooni is shocked as Sundari changes her statement and accepts her ill intentions. Rajveer gets into a tough spot when Ravinder asks him to give his verdict.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Lashes Out at Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Shikha wins Ravinder's heart and earns a special place at his house. Later, Rajveer bursts out in rage and blames Ajooni for all the humiliation he has faced.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Is Baffled
episodesList.summary: Ajooni saves Sundari from the goons and learns about Shikha's evil acts. Later, Ajooni gets shocked when her plan to prove herself to the Baggas backfires.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Shocking Move
episodesList.summary: Ajooni falls into Shikha's trap and receives a harsh punishment from Bebe. But, Rajveer interrupts them and stuns everyone with his move.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Gets Abducted
episodesList.summary: Yash and Shikha get frightened about being exposed by Rajveer and they kidnap him. Later, Ajooni gets worried about Rajveer and rushes to Bagga mansion.

episodesList.title: Harsh's Dreadful Strategy
episodesList.summary: Shikha is terrified when Ravinder begins to doubt her, but Harsh invents a plan to kill Rajveer. Later, when Rajveer attempts to flee, Harsh strikes him again!

episodesList.title: Shikha Brainwashes Harvinder
episodesList.summary: Shikha plans to take advantage of Harvinder's emotions and brainwash him into killing Rajveer. Will Harvinder be swayed by Shikha's words to kill his brother?

episodesList.title: Rajveer Is Attacked
episodesList.summary: Shikha plans an attack on Rajveer, but Ajooni detects it ahead of time. Later, as Ajooni pursues him, the attacker holds Shikha at his knifepoint.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Loses His Memory
episodesList.summary: Rajveer gets an electric shock after Ajooni turns on the medical system. Later, as he regains consciousness he is unable to recognise the Baggas.

episodesList.title: Harvinder Gets Punished
episodesList.summary: Rajveer misunderstands Ajooni after getting glass pieces in his food. When Ravinder learns of Harvinder's inappropriate behaviour with Sundari, he punishes him.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Remains Perplexed
episodesList.summary: Ravinder arrives suddenly as Harvinder intends to throw an unconscious Rajveer from the terrace. Rajveer gets baffled about his enemy being inside the house.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Gets Attacked
episodesList.summary: Rajveer grows irritated as Ajooni tries to help him regain his memories. Meanwhile, Shikha and Harvinder plan an attack against Rajveer to clear their suspicions.

episodesList.title: Shikha's Foul Plan
episodesList.summary: After spotting her bangles, Rajveer accuses Shikha of making him unconscious. Further, Shikha plans to sow doubts in Rajveer's mind against Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Is Framed!
episodesList.summary: Shikha attempts to persuade the Baggas, labelling Ajooni as the culprit behind all mishaps. To frame Ajooni, Harvinder places a pistol in her room.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Suspects Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Rajveer lies to Ravinder in order to save Harvinder. Later, Shikha manipulates Rajveer into believing that Ajooni is having an affair with Harsh.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Is Attacked
episodesList.summary: Rajveer shows his trust in Ajooni while Shikha forges a plan targeting him. Later, Harsh attacks Rajveer and makes him unconscious.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Locates Rajveer
episodesList.summary: While the Baggas search for Rajveer, Ajooni finds him inside the Holika. Later, Shikha sows doubt in Rajveer's mind against Harsh and Ajooni's relationship.

episodesList.title: Shikha Instigates Rajveer
episodesList.summary: While Ajooni mistakenly puts colour on Harsh's face, Shikha instigates Rajveer against the former. Shikha advises Rajveer to find a solution to punish Ajooni.

episodesList.title: Rajveer's Shocking Plan
episodesList.summary: A furious Rajveer hatches a plan to kill Ajooni. Shikha decides to follow Rajveer and Ajooni to destroy them together.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: Ajooni breaks down in tears as Rajveer blames her for yet another fatal situation. Ajooni gets shocked when Rajveer questions her intention.

episodesList.title: Rajveer to Catch Harsh?
episodesList.summary: After getting attacked again, Rajveer rushes to catch the attacker and confronts Harsh. Later, Ajooni grows anxious when Rajveer furiously attempts to kill her.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Recovers Memories
episodesList.summary: Rajveer regains his memory while he attempts a fatal attack on Ajooni. Later, Ajooni and Rajveer plan to expose Harsh and Shikha's vile intentions.

episodesList.title: Shikha's Strategy Pays Off?
episodesList.summary: Rajveer tells Shikha that he murdered Ajooni and her lover. While Shikha is pleased that her strategy is bearing fruit, the Baggas maid, Kamli arrives.

episodesList.title: Rajveer Assists Ajooni
episodesList.summary: After learning about Ajooni's punishment, Rajveer secretly helps her with the work. Later, Ajooni follows the rituals and performs Rajveer's Aarti.

episodesList.title: Ajooni, Aman on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Ajooni and Aman chase after Shikha as she steals ornaments from the Baggas to give them to Harsh. Later, Ajooni discovers that Shikha falsely accused her mother.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Gets Emotional
episodesList.summary: Ajooni's parents get worried about her and leave the house in disappointment. Ajooni breaks down after the Baggas defame her character.

episodesList.title: Ajooni in a Tough Situation
episodesList.summary: Shikha notices Rajveer and Ajooni together and plans to cause trouble for the latter. The next day, Shikha accuses Ajooni of robbing the Baggas' belongings.

episodesList.title: Shikha's Plan in Action
episodesList.summary: During the political campaign, Shikha presents a video of Kamli and Rajveer's romance. Will Rajveer be forced to admit that Kamli is none other than Ajooni?

episodesList.title: Harman Gets a Responsibility
episodesList.summary: Ravinder brings a large box containing one crore rupees, and requests Harman to safeguard it. However, Shikha and Tejender resolve to steal the money.

episodesList.title: Rajveer, Ajooni Lay a Trap
episodesList.summary: Rajveer and Ajooni sow seeds of doubt in Shikha and Harsh's minds to extract the truth from them. Meanwhile, Tejender and his son enter the Bagga residence.

episodesList.title: Shikha, Harsh are Exposed!
episodesList.summary: Harvinder faces Ravinder's wrath after the bag having the money goes missing. Later, Harsh and Shikha's role in every single offence is revealed.

episodesList.title: Shikha Admits the Truth
episodesList.summary: Shikha confesses that the father of the unborn child is Harsh, and she goes on to disclose a startling fact about Harvinder. Eventually, Shikha gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Comforts Harvinder
episodesList.summary: Harvinder is devastated by his health problems, but Ravinder gently soothes him. Later, the Baggas are perplexed by the news of the stolen money.

episodesList.title: Rajveer on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Ravinder gets a warning and a deadline for returning bankers money. Rajveer then takes up the challenge and heads to Tejender's house.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Loses Confidence
episodesList.summary: In order to further his goal, Rajveer challenges Shanky to a game. On the other hand, Ravinder is devastated at the prospect of quitting.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Teaches a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Tejender grows happy after Ravinder calls him to his house and seeks help. Soon after, Ravinder teaches him a lesson by forcing him to eat cash.

episodesList.title: Harman to Take Revenge
episodesList.summary: After Dolly instigates Harman against Ajooni, the latter wants to take revenge on her. Elsewhere, Shanky grows resolved to murder Rajveer in order to prove himself.

episodesList.title: Harman, Dolly Are Punished
episodesList.summary: Bebe becomes enraged and punishes Harman and Dolly for their plan of putting her in danger. Tejender gets shot when Shanky tries to kill Rajveer.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Dolly vows to teach Ajooni a lesson and places an electric wire under the gas burner. Unfortunately, Dolly herself gets an electric shock when she lights the burner.

episodesList.title: Amrit Takes a Shocking Oath
episodesList.summary: Rajveer finds a witness and visits Tejender's house to prove Shanky's crime. Amrit takes an oath to take her revenge and devises a plan against Ravinder.

episodesList.title: Dolly Frames Ajooni
episodesList.summary: Dolly fabricates a lie to Ajooni about having an affair with Bharat to cancel her wedding. Later, Dolly accuses Ajooni of provoking her to flee from home.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Proves Herself
episodesList.summary: Ajooni confronts Dolly and proves Bharat and herself innocent in front of the Baggas. Later, the family grows anxious when Dolly goes missing from the temple.

episodesList.title: Tejender Reveals a Shocking
episodesList.summary: Truth	Bharat kidnaps Dolly to give her a befitting punishment for her misdeeds. On the other hand, Tejender shocks everyone with a startling revelation.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Condemns Dowry
episodesList.summary: Shanky decides to visit the Bagga house to disclose Tejender's secret. Elsewhere, when Dolly's would-be in-laws demand a huge dowry, Ajooni firmly objects.

episodesList.title: Shankys Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Shanky approaches Ravinder and accuses the Chaddas of being thugs. Adding more to his truth bombs, he claims to be Ravinder's son.

episodesList.title: Amrit, Tejender's Heinous Plan
episodesList.summary: After Kaveri's shocking revelation, Amrit and Tejender devise a plan to use Shanky against Ravinder. Meanwhile, Ravinder gives Shanky a chance to prove his claim.

episodesList.title: Ravinder Gets Worried
episodesList.summary: When Shanky tries to prove his claim, Tejender interferes and takes him away. However, Tejender and Amrit get happy, sowing doubts in Ravinders mind.

episodesList.title: Rajveers Fear Comes True?
episodesList.summary: Ajooni promises to bring out the truth about Rajveer's biological parents. Later, Rajveer gets shocked when he visits the hospital to collect the information.

episodesList.title: Ajooni Gives a New Idea
episodesList.summary: As Tejender's lawyer informs the Baggas that Rajveer owns their property, Ajooni advises conducting a DNA test. Will the Baggas agree to it?

cast.name: Ayushi Khurana
cast.role: Ajooni Bagga (nee Vohra): Neeru and Subhash's daughter; Meher and Bharat's sister; Avinash's ex fiance; Rajveer's wife (2022–2023)

cast.name: Shoaib Ibrahim
