title: Anupamaa
summary:
Anupamaa is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiered on 13 July 2020 on StarPlus and streams digitally on Disney+ Hotstar. Produced by Rajan Shahi and Deepa Shahi under the banner of Director's Kut Productions, it is a remake of Star Jalsha's Bengali series Sreemoyee. It is one of the longest-running Indian television soap opera. Rupali Ganguly plays the titular role and formerly starred Sudhanshu Pandey, Madalsa Sharma and Gaurav Khanna. Since October 2024, the series stars Ganguly with Adrija Roy (replaced Alisha Parveen Khan) and Shivam Khajuria as second-generation leads.
The show revolves around Anupamaa Shah, a homemaker whose family has a low opinion of her and whose husband cheats on her. She gains more self-respect and becomes more independent. She navigates relationships and societal expectations while on her path of personal growth.
plot:
Anupamaa is a middle-aged housewife who toils for her family but is always insulted by her husband, Vanraj, and her mother-in-law, Leela, for being uneducated. Anupamaa's constant emotional supports are her younger son, Samar, and her father-in-law, Hasmukh. However, on her 25th wedding anniversary, upon discovering that Vanraj has cheated on her with his colleague, Kavya, she feels heartbroken and sets out to create her identity. Meanwhile, Anupamaa's elder son, Paritosh, marries Kinjal, while Samar and Nandini, Kavya's niece, fall for each other. Anupamaa and Vanraj divorce, and he marries Kavya soon after her divorce from her husband, Aniruddh.
Anupamaa, along with Samar and Nandini, opens a dance academy due to their shared passion for dance. However, Nandini breaks up with Samar and leaves him forever because of her misunderstandings and insecurities towards him. Anupamaa later reconnects with her college classmate, Anuj Kapadia, who has been in love with her since her college days. Anupamaa eventually falls in love with Anuj, and they marry. Together, they adopt a girl, Chhoti Anu. Anupamaa struggles to balance her responsibilities between her two families. Amidst all this, Kinjal gives birth to a baby girl, Aarya, and learns that Paritosh has cheated on her, but they reconcile for the sake of their child. Anupamaa's daughter, Pakhi, marries Adhik, who is the younger brother and foster son of Anuj's sister-in-law, Barkha. Samar marries a rape victim, Dimple, who herself was divorced by her husband after her rape.
Later on, Chhoti Anu's biological mother, Maya, arrives and takes Chhoti Anu with her. Anuj and Anupamaa feel devastated on Anu's departure, and Anuj leaves Anupamaa to stay with Maya and Chhoti Anu. Maya and Barkha conspire to keep Anuj and Anupamaa apart. Later on, Anupamaa has a chance to be a part of Malti Devi's Academy, Gurukul. Malti Devi is impressed with Anupamaa's hard work and dedication, and offers her a three-year contract to work with her and declares that she would be the heir of Gurukul. Maya realizes her mistake when she tries to separate Anuj and Anupamaa and asks for their forgiveness, but a truck hits her, and Maya dies. Before leaving for America, Anupamaa learns that Anu's health has deteriorated, and she rushes back to her. This angers Malti Devi, so she expels Anupamaa from her Gurukul. Meanwhile, Kavya is pregnant with Aniruddh's child, and Vanraj learns about that and avoids her. Later on, Anupamaa finds Malti Devi roaming in the streets, in a deteriorated condition, and brings her to her house. On Anuj's birthday, the entire family is shocked to know that Malti Devi is Anuj's biological mother, but Anuj refuses to accept her. Later on, Samar is murdered at a party, leaving behind Dimple, who is pregnant with his child. Anupamaa, Vanraj, and Anuj find out Samar's murderer and have him arrested. Paritosh, Kinjal, and Aarya move out of India.
Pakhi, Barkha, and Malti Devi instigate Chhoti Anu against Anupamaa, and she goes against her, whereas Dimple meets a dancer, Tapish, and they become friends. Vanraj tells Dimple to stay away from Tapish, or else he will keep Dimple's child away from her. Kinjal, Paritosh, and Aarya return to India to celebrate Aarya's first birthday. Anupamaa comes to meet Aarya, but Vanraj asks her to leave and tells her to never return to the house. Kavya also leaves the house after Vanraj tells her that her child has no place in this house. Malti Devi and Barkha collaborate to expel Anupamaa from Anuj's life and start instigating Chhoti Anu against Anupama. Anupamaa, Kinjal, Aarya, and Chhoti Anu go out for a picnic, but the car meets with an accident. Although Anupamaa rescues everyone, she is berated by Vanraj and Paritosh. Anupamaa decides to never return to the Shah house and returns to the Kapadia house. Chhoti Anu berates Anupamaa and avoids her. Anuj feels that Anupamaa has never paid attention to Chhoti Anu and the Kapadia family, and has always paid attention to the Shah family, and feels that he has married Anupamaa hastily. Anupamaa then decides to leave Anuj and Chhoti Anu forever and leaves the house. Anuj divorces Anupamaa and renames Chhoti Anu to Aadhya and leaves India.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Rupali Ganguly as Anupamaa Joshi: Kanta's daughter (2020–present) * Sudhanshu Pandey as Vanraj Shah: Leela and Hasmukh's son (2020–2024) * Madalsa Sharma as Kavya Shah: Aniruddh's ex-wife (2020–2024) * Gaurav Khanna as Anuj Kapadia: Malti Devi's son (2021–2024) * Alisha Parveen Khan / Adrija Roy as Rahi "Aadhya" Kapadia Kothari: Maya's daughter (2024–present) ** Aurra Bhatnagar Badoni as Teenage Aadhya Kapadia (2023–2024) *** Asmi Deo as Child Anu "Chhoti" Kapadia (2022–2023) * Shivam Khajuria as Prem "Tinku" Kothari: Gayatri and Parag's son (2024–present) ** Parth as Child Prem (2025)

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
In February 2020, Rajan Shahi, the producer of Aai Kuthe Kay Karte, announced his plan to produce its Hindi remake, Anupamaa, stating, "This interesting concept around a mother's journey has been so inspirational that Star wants to bring it in Hindi too".
To celebrate Raksha Bandhan in 2020, the cast of the series created a special song titled Aaj Rakhi Nau Tyohaar Chhe (Today is Raksha Bandhan's festival). This unique song blended Gujarati, Hindi, and English languages.
The story took a five-year leap on 20 December 2023, with Anuj and Anupamaa's divorce and Anupamaa visiting the USA. On 15 July 2024, the show took another leap of six months showcasing Anupamaa and Anuj separately living miserable lives without Aadhya. On 14 October 2024, the show took a ten-year leap showcasing Anupamaa finding Aadhya/Raahi and Raahi's love story with Prem Kothari.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Casting of the series started in February 2020 with Rupali Ganguly being cast as the protagonist Anupamaa Shah, returning to television after seven years. She said, "When I joined Anupamaa, I was a little plump and I told our producer Rajan Shahi that you want a heroine and at this age, let me lose some weight. But the producer told me that he didn't want a heroine but a mother instead. ‘I want a mother and you are perfect for the role because mothers are like this."
Sudhanshu Pandey was cast as Anupamaa's husband Vanraj Shah, Paras Kalnawat, Muskan Bamne and Aashish Mehrotra as Anupamaa's children Samar Shah, Pakhi Shah and Paritosh Shah respectively, Alpana Buch and Arvind Vaidya being cast as Anupamaa's in-laws Leela Shah and Hasmukh Shah respectively. Later Madhavi Gogate and Mehul Nisar joined as Anupamaa's mother and brother, Kanta Joshi and Bhavesh Joshi, respectively, while Ekta Saraiya, Paresh Bhatt, Stuti Zakarde and Bhakti Chauhan were cast to play Dolly Shah Dhamecha, Sanjay Dhamecha, Meenakshi Dhamecha and Jhilmil respectively. However, days before the filming resumed after the COVID-19 outbreak in late June, Additi Gupta was confirmed to be infected with the virus. She was replaced by Madalsa Sharma and the sequences earlier shot by Gupta as Vanraj's girlfriend Kavya Gandhi, were reshot by Sharma.
Days after premiering in July 2020, Shekhar Shukla was cast to play Leela's brother Jignesh while Nidhi Shah was cast opposite Mehrotra as Kinjal Dave and Tassnim Sheikh and Farooq Saeed were signed to play Kinjal's parents Rakhi Dave and Pramod Dave respectively. The next month Anagha Bhosale was cast opposite Kalnawat as Nandini Iyer while Rushad Rana was cast as Kavya's husband Aniruddh Gandhi. In April 2021, Apurva Agnihotri joined the cast as Dr. Advait Khanna for a cameo and completed his role in June 2021.
In June 2021, rumours of "conflicts and groupism on sets" arose between cast members, one group led by Ganguly with Buch, Mehrotra and Bamne, and another by Pandey, with Sharma, Kalnawat and Bhosale which cast denied.
In late August 2021 Gaurav Khanna was cast opposite Ganguly as Anuj Kapadia.
In September 2021, Deepak Gheewala was cast to play Anuj's helper Gopichandra Karodia. Also that month, Varun Sharma was cast to play a cameo as Nandini's ex-boyfriend and obsessive lover Rohan and he finished off his role in October 2021. Next, Savita Prabhune replaced Madhavi Gogate (due to the latter's death) as Kanta Joshi in late October 2021. In December 2021, actress Aneri Vajani joined the cast to play Anuj's sister, Malvika Kapadia.
In January 2022, there were rumours of "ego clashes" between Pandey and Khanna, which they both publicly denied.
In March 2022, Anagha Bhosale playing Nandini announced her decision to take a break from acting, and later quit acting forever, ending Nandini's character and shot her last scene in February 2022. Later that month, Aneri Vajani playing Malvika also announced that her role was just a cameo and right now its shown on a long break due to viewers' disconnect with her role's negative development.
In May 2022, singer Mika Singh made a special appearance as Anuj's friend in Anupamaa and Anuj's Mehendi and Sangeet ceremony and to promote his upcoming show Swayamvar – Mika Di Vohti. During that month, Aneri Vajani announced her decision to participate in Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 12 and quit the series permanently.
Later that month, Rohit Bakshi and Ashlesha Sawant were cast to play Anuj's brother and sister-in-law, Ankush Kapadia and Barkha Mehta Kapadia respectively while Alma Hussein and Adhik Mehta were cast to play Barkha's daughter and brother, Sara Kapadia and Adhik Mehta opposite Kalnawat and Bamne respectively. In an interview after being cast as Adhik Mehta, Mehta revealed that "he earlier auditioned for the role of Samar (which eventually locked to Kalnawat) in the casting phase of the series but it didn't happened at that time". Child artist Asmi Deo was also cast as an orphan Anu but her track was put on hold and resumed in July 2022 as Anuj and Anupamaa's adopted daughter.
In July 2022, Paras Kalnawat signed on to appear on the dance-based reality show Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 10 on rival network Colors TV. Anupamaa makers objected and terminated his contract overnight on 26 July 2022. Kalnawat revealed that "after Bhosale's exit his character never evolved, and that he was unhappy with his role being reduced to a mere family member standing in background with nothing to do anything." Later after facing several controversies related to the series, makers replaced Kalnawat overnight by Sagar Parekh in the same month.
In September 2022, Alma Hussein who was cast opposite Kalnawat also quit the series, saying she was unhappy with the lack of character development and shot her last scene in early August 2022.
In January 2023, actress Chhavi Pandey was cast to do an extended cameo of Anu's biological mother, Maya, who wrapped up in July 2023 following her character's death. In May 2023, Apara Mehta was cast as Anuj's mother Malti Devi, while her daughter Khushali Jariwala played her younger version on screen and she quit the series prior to the first leap in December 2023.
In August 2023, Ekta Saraiya, who portrayed Vanraj's sister Dolly, quit the series for her show Kyunki... Saas Maa Bahu Beti Hoti Hai on Zee TV. In same month, Viraj Kapoor entered the show as Ankush's illegitimate son Romil Kapadia.
In October 2023, Sagar Parekh, who replaced Paras Kalnawat in the role of Samar in July 2022, was confirmed exiting the show with storyline showcasing Samar's death due to decreasing TRP ratings of the show. In the following month actor and dancer Kunwar Amar joined the cast as Tapish opposite Nishi Saxena.
In December 2023, the show took its first leap of five years. Post-leap, child actress Asmi Deo was replaced by Aurra Bhatnagar Badoni to play the adolescent version of Aadhya Kapadia while Savita Prabhune's character Kanta was shown dead thus marking an end to her character. Child actor Trishaan Shah was cast to play Samar and Dimple's son Ansh Shah. and was later replaced by Chandni Bhagwanani while child actor Aadhya Barot was cast as her daughter Ishani Mehta the same month. Sukirti Kandpal too entered the show as Anuj's fiancée Shruti Ahuja the same month. Following this Rituraj Singh and Dishi Duggal too entered the show as Yashpal and his mother.
In April 2024, Aashish Mehrotra, who portrayed Paritosh, quit the series the following month after playing it for four years to participate in Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 14 and was replaced by Gaurav Sharma the same month. In July 2024, Sukirti Kandpal aka Shruti's track ended marking her exit. In same month show took its second leap, a small leap of six months and Nitin Babu and Akshita Tiwari entered the show as Sagar and Nandita respectively while Sonal Khilwani entered the show as the adult Meenakshi Dhamecha thus replacing Stuti Zakarde.
On 28 August 2024, Sudhanshu Pandey announced his decision to quit the series after playing it for four years via his Instagram handle and said "his last appearance was in Raksha Bandhan special episodes and he will continue entertaining his audience through new roles."
In 2024 after Sudhanshu Pandey quit the show, Ekta Saraiya Mehta, who played Dolly Shah Dhamecha from 2020 to 2023, rejoined and reprised her role the following month while Madalsa Sharma playing Kavya also quit the series as she felt she was "sidelined after removal of grey element from her character". Later she said that Rupali Ganguly was "two-faced" thus confirming the earlier reported split amongst cast members in 2021.
The show took its first generation leap on 14 October 2024 with Aurra Bhatnagar Badoni being replaced by Alisha Parveen while Kunwar Amar playing Tapish too announced his exit. Gaurav Sharma was also replaced by Manish Naggdev as older Paritosh due to Sharma's refusal to play and be typecast "as a father of 21-year-old Aarya". Additionally, Nidhi Shah, who has portrayed Kinjal since the show's inception, announced her exit before the leap as she "wants to focus more on other platforms and lead roles" and was replaced by Milloni Kapadia as older Kinjal. Chandni Bhagwanani too announced her exit from the show prior to the leap as she too "didn't wanted to play mother to a 22-years-old Ishani" and was replaced by Krutika Desai as older Pakhi. On 20 December 2024, leading actress Alisha Parveen Khan was terminated overnight without any prior warning. Regarding her termination Khan said, "It is shocking and disappointing. I am not sure what exactly happened and why I am being replaced! Today was my last day on the set of Anupamaa." Within few hours she was replaced by Adrija Roy. while Mazher Sayed who earlier worked with the production house in 2015 in another show Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai and Shiwani Chakraborty joined in as Prem's uncle and aunt.
In March 2025, actors Randeep Rai and Manish Goel joined as Prem's half-brother, Aryan Kothari and Raghav Singh respectively. However, Rai quit in June 2025, following the death of his character while Manish Goel playing Raghav also quit. In the same month, the show took a leap of eight months, and Aarti Birajdar and Gurpreet Kaur entered as Bharti and Jaspreet respectively. while veteran actor Kanwarjit Paintal entered as Pandit Manohar.
In October 2025, Sagar Parekh, who quit in 2023 owing the death of his character Samar, returned for a special segment as Samar's spirit. In the same month, Vidushi Tiwari playing Ishani, quit owning health issues and she is replaced by Akshita Vatsayan.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text:
Set in Gujarat, the series is mainly shot at Film City in Mumbai. Some initial sequences were shot in Ahmedabad during early March 2020.
On 13 February 2021, the filming was halted for a day for sanitisation when Paras Kalnawat playing Samar, tested positive for COVID-19 virus. The sequences of Kalnawat with Anagha Bhosale playing Nandini were cancelled including proposal sequence of their characters and were replanned until his recovery and return in late February 2021. However he shot some sequences from his home under his and his mother's quarantine period.
On 2 April 2021, Rupali Ganguly, Sudhanshu Pandey and Aashish Mehrotra who portray Anupamaa, Vanraj and Paritosh respectively and producer Rajan Shahi tested positive for COVID-19. Certain sequences were postponed and the story focused more on the characters Rakhi, Kavya and Leela while Ganguly, Pandey and Mehrotra shot for few sequences from their homes. A few days later, Tassnim Sheikh, Alpana Buch and Nidhi Shah also tested positive for COVID-19 and the story focussed more on Samar, Nandini and Pakhi's characters.
On 13 April 2021, the Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Uddhav Thackeray announced a sudden curfew due to increased Covid cases in Maharashtra, while the production halted from 14 April 2021. Hence, the production location was soon shifted temporarily to Silvassa alongside other shows of the production house. In June 2021, the Maharashtra government permitted shooting within the state with certain restrictions, following which the whole cast and crew returned to Mumbai on 8 June 2021 and resumed shooting the following day.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: On 14 November 2024, a 32-year-old, Vineet Kumar Mandal, who worked as a camera attendant was fatally electrocuted whilst filming. Following which AICWA lodged a case against the production house for negligence in safety measures of crew members on sets and trying to suppress the matter by being backed by the channel.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Initially scheduled to premiere on 16 March 2020, it was postponed due to the coronavirus scare. Anupamaa finally premiered on 13 July 2020 on Star Plus, replacing Yeh Rishtey Hain Pyaar Ke. Since 2 October 2022, it is broadcast daily along with other Star Plus's shows.

articleSections.title: Prequel series
articleSections.text: An eleven-episode prequel web series, Anupama: Namaste America, was released on Disney+ Hotstar on 25 April 2022. The story is set ten years after Anupamaa and Vanraj's marriage in the year 2005.

articleSections.title: ''Ravivaar With Star Parivaar'' (2022)
articleSections.text: The cast of Anupamaa participated as a team in the musical game show Ravivaar With Star Parivaar. It competed with the teams of other Star Plus's shows. Anupamaa emerged as the 2nd runner-up of the show.

articleSections.title: Crossovers
articleSections.text:
Anupamaa had three crossover with Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai. The first was from 26 March 2022 to 28 March 2022, the second from 21 December 2023 to 22 December 2023 and the third was on 19 August 2024.
On 3 December 2023, Anupamaa had a crossover with Baatein Kuch Ankahee Si.

articleSections.title: Critics
articleSections.text:
India Today stated, "Rupali Ganguly fits the character perfectly and aces the role of a Gujarati homemaker. The show strikes a chord with the homemakers as they can identify with the protagonist. Anupamaa has the right amount of emotions, drama, and spice. The show has the right mix of family values and a modern outlook. The show is a heartwarming tale".
ThePrint appreciated the series, along with few other Hindi GECs based on the story of a mother, mentioning that it delivered moral lessons and calling the character Anupamaa a paragon of virtue and farcical.
On its popularity, Yashika Singla of The Print noted, "It has become a feminist movement in itself. From young women commuting in the Metro to mothers and grandmothers at home, everyone is watching it."
Shephali Bhatt of The Mint stated, "At a time when the plot points of Indian TV shows get more outlandish every day — Anupama seems to be rewriting the Indian television playbook".

articleSections.title: In popular culture
articleSections.text:
Anupamaa's (Rupali Ganguly) "aapko kya" dialogue went viral on social media and was the subject of various memes and recreations.
In October 2024, after the fifteen-year generation leap in the story, netizens spotted similarities between the Aadhya-Anupamaa reunion track and reunion track of "Akshara-Naira"(2016) from Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai, another popular soap of the same production house. The Times of India stated, "Now, fans have taken to their Instagram handles to find the exact same scene from the show Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai when "Akshara" (Hina Khan) reunited with "Naira" (Shivangi Joshi) after a leap. As the fanpage posted both promos, many of them have commented, a user wrote, "Kitna vi kar le Akshara or naira jaisa nhi ho sakta" (They can never match Akshara and Naira)."

articleSections.title: Adaptations
articleSections.text: Star Plus's Anupamaa is an official Hindi remake of Star Jalsha's Sreemoyee. Sreemoyee's Marathi remake, Aai Kuthe Kay Karte, and Anupamaa both are produced by same producer Rajan Shahi under Director's Kut Productions and follow the same plot.

episodesList.title: Meet Anupama
episodesList.summary: A devoted mother and wife, Anupama loves her family and fulfills their every need. However, she is bereft of the same love and respect in her own house.

episodesList.title: Samar Stands by Anupama
episodesList.summary: Samar criticises Vanraj for throwing Anupama out while she feels guilty. Next day on her birthday, a statement by Vanraj makes Anupama hopeful. Is she guessing right?

episodesList.title: Anupamaa's Special Day
episodesList.summary: On her birthday, Anupamaa merrily gets things organised for the party. As Samar notices a strange sight, Vanraj's announcement leaves Anupamaa shattered.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Insults Anupamaa
episodesList.summary: Samar enthusiastically celebrates Anupamaa's birthday, unaware that the party is for Kavya. Later, Vanraj belittles Anupamaa in front of the family.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa to Showcase Her Skills
episodesList.summary: Pakhi announces a talent fair at her school for mothers but is embarrassed to let Anupamaa participate. However, Anupamaa decides to set up her stall at the event.

episodesList.title: Vanraj's Scathing Remarks
episodesList.summary: An excited Anupamaa prepares to go to Pakhi's school fair early in the morning. However, Vanraj spots her and berates her.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Wins the Trophy
episodesList.summary: Vanraj, Pakhi and Kavya are shocked to see Anupamaa at the school. Later, Vanraj stuns everyone with his speech when the winner of the competition is announced.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Gets a Shock
episodesList.summary: A furious Vanraj berates Anupama for her actions and belittles her trophy. Later, Kavya makes a shocking decision that leaves Vanraj baffled.

episodesList.title: A Job Offer for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Impressed by her cooking skills, Pakhi's principal offers Anupamaa a job. While most of the family is against it, Samar encourages her to accept the offer.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Takes the Job!
episodesList.summary: Kavya's unexpected advice to Anupamaa stuns Vanraj and the rest of the family. Feeling determined, Anupamaa decides to take up the job offer.

episodesList.title: Samar's Unexpected Proposition
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa hugs Vanraj and thanks him for supporting her decision. While she gets ready for her first day, Samar's unexpected proposition leaves everyone stunned.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa's First Day at Work!
episodesList.summary: Following a series of mishaps, Anupamaa ends up being late to her very first day of work. Later, she introduces herself to the students.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa's First Salary!
episodesList.summary: Kavya sternly stands her ground during a heated argument with Vanraj. Elsewhere, Anupamaa is overwhelmed upon receiving her first salary!

episodesList.title: Vanraj Celebrates His Success
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa's joy is short-lived as Pakhi voices her complaints. While Vanraj celebrates his success with the family, some shocking news awaits Anupamaa.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Signs Her First Cheque!
episodesList.summary: Samar helps Anupamaa to sign her first cheque. While Anupamaa faces a crisis, Vanraj's request leaves her in a state of shock.

episodesList.title: Anupama Gets Late for School
episodesList.summary: Tending to Vanraj's needs, Anupamaa gets late for the inspection at school. Later, Vanraj is perplexed when Anupamaa receives praises for her talent.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Loses Her Job!
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa gets fired for arriving late while Kavya and Vanraj get in a heated exchange. Later, Paritosh makes a sudden announcement.

episodesList.title: Kinjal's Parents Pay a Visit
episodesList.summary: Samar gets worried when he cannot find Anupamaa. Later, Kavya puts on an act in front of Kinjal's parents as Anupamaa makes a sudden entry.

episodesList.title: Challenging Times for Anupamaa
episodesList.summary: Kinjal's mother questions Anupamaa's educational qualifications. While Vanraj insults Anupama for losing her job, her answer stuns the family.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Speaks Out!
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa expresses out loud how poorly she has been treated in front of the family and takes a firm decision. Later, the Shahs prepare to celebrate Raksha Bandhan.

episodesList.title: Samar Is in Love?
episodesList.summary: Samar is awestruck after meeting a girl at the market. Later, the Shahs welcome some guests on the occasion of Raksha Bandhan.

episodesList.title: Raksha Bandhan with the Shahs!
episodesList.summary: The Shahs celebrate Raksha Bandhan with great pomp! Later, Vanraj gets an unexpected phone call from Kavya.

episodesList.title: Vanraj's Drastic Move
episodesList.summary: Furious, Vanraj slaps Samar when a stranger arrives at the Shah house and reveals a shocking truth. Later, a guilt-ridden Anupamaa breaks down into tears.

episodesList.title: Kinjal Supports Anupamaa
episodesList.summary: Kinjal takes a stand for Anupamaa and berates Paritosh for his rude behaviour. Later, Anirudh walks in on Vanraj and Kavya as they get close.

episodesList.title: Devika Is All Praise for Anupamaa
episodesList.summary: While tension rises between Vanraj, Anirudh and Kavya, Anupamaa's old friend Devika visits her. Later, Devika's praises for Anupamaa leaves everyone in a shock.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Showcases Her Talent
episodesList.summary: Devika reveals how Anupamaa stood up for her during their school days. While Anirudh taunts Vanraj, Anupamaa leaves her kids stunned with her performance.

episodesList.title: Is Vanraj in Trouble?
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa and Devika spend the entire night talking while the latter notices something strange about Vanraj. Later, tensions flare between Devika and Anupamaa.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa, Devika at Loggerheads
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa and Devika get into a heated exchange while Vanraj stalks Kavya and Anirudh. Later, Anupamaa enthusiastically prepares for the Janmashtami Puja.

episodesList.title: Nandini Meets the Shahs
episodesList.summary: Kavya's niece, Nandini locks horns with Samar as the family stands amused. Later, Vanraj executes his sleazy plan to invite Kavya for the puja.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Prepares for Janmashtami
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa invites Kavya to join the Shahs for Janmashtami and spends some quality time with Kinjal. Elsewhere, Kavya is taken aback by Vanraj's odd behaviour.

episodesList.title: Kavya Feels Insecure
episodesList.summary: Paritosh is overjoyed to see Kinjal all dressed up for the festival. Later, Kavya feels insecure, noticing Vanraj and Anupamaa's closeness during the Janmashtami Puja.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Dances with Anupamaa
episodesList.summary: Kavya fumes at the sight of Vanraj and Anupamaa's dance performance. While Kinjal's mother causes a ruckus, Anupamaa gets insulted in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Vanraj supports Anupamaa when Kinjal's mother crosses a line. While the scene quickly spirals out of control, Vanraj's firm statements leave everyone shocked.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa Is on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Paritosh and Samar get into a huge disagreement disturbing the atmosphere at home. Later, Anupamaa sets off to make things right.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Is in Danger?
episodesList.summary: Rakhi puts forth a condition for Paritosh and Kinjal's wedding. While Samar finds cigarettes in Pakhi's school bag, Paritosh experiences a panic attack.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Leaves the House!
episodesList.summary: A furious Paritosh leaves the house after Vanraj berates him. Later, Samar breaks down while Anupamaa tries to stop her son.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Gets Teary-eyed
episodesList.summary: Kinjal's mother gives Paritosh a grave ultimatum while a teary-eyed Vanraj contemplates his decision. Later, Paritosh struggles to conform to the habits of his new home.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa's Horrible Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Anupamaa is worried sick following a nightmare about Paritosh's death. Later, Samar confronts Pakhi about the cigarettes found in her bag.

episodesList.title: Anupamaa's New Mission
episodesList.summary: A furious Vanraj forsakes all ties with Paritosh after learning about the ultimatum he readily accepted. Later, Anupamaa takes it upon herself to bring Paritosh back home.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Crosses the Line?
episodesList.summary: Vanraj has an emotional breakdown while Anupamaa manages to get Paritosh back home. Later, Vanraj orders Paritosh and Anupamaa to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Gets Caught?

episodesList.title: Anupama to Punish Dholakia

episodesList.title: Anuj Longs for Anupama

episodesList.title: Anupama Stands Strong

episodesList.title: Anuj Grows Restless

episodesList.title: Anuj's Romantic Dream
episodesList.summary: Rohan threatens to take action against Samar while Anuj romantically dreams of Anupama. Later, Devika surprises the Shahs with special dresses.

episodesList.title: Anuj Threatens Rohan
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Navratri, Rohan attempts an attack on Anupama. However, Anuj gives Rohan a stern warning and puts forth a condition.

episodesList.title: Anupama Gets Rebuked
episodesList.summary: Rohan apologises to the Shahs and tells them that Anuj made him understand the true meaning of love. Later, Devika scolds Anupama for not standing up for Anuj.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Classic Justification

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj's Memorable Night
episodesList.summary: With the college students, Anupama and Anuj relish the party and shake a leg. While Vanraj feels insecure, Anuj is down with high fever.

episodesList.title: Anupama to Leave Home?

episodesList.title: Anupama's New Home

episodesList.title: Anupama to Move On
episodesList.summary: Kanta requests Anupama to forget the Shahs and move ahead in life. Later, Anupama shuts the landlord with a striking answer.

episodesList.title: Anupama Praises Anuj

episodesList.summary: Anuj watches Anupama restricting a lady from bargaining with a street vendor. Elsewhere, Leela motivates Kavya to gain Hasmukhs's trust and take Anupama's post.

episodesList.summary: Anupama, Anuj and Devika shake a leg while Kavya experiences a strange nightmare. Later, the Shahs visit Anupama's new house to celebrate Diwali.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Rebukes Dolly
episodesList.summary: The Shahs enjoy their time at Anupama's new house by playing some games. Elsewhere, Vanraj reprimands Dolly when she supports Anupama.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Crosses the Line
episodesList.summary: During the festivities, Paritosh loses his temper on Anuj and Anupama's bonding. Elsewhere, Vanraj regrets misbehaving with Dolly in front of Sanjay.

episodesList.title: Anuj to Convince Vanraj?

episodesList.title: Anuj's Emotional Outburst

episodesList.title: Samar Confronts Anupama
episodesList.summary: Vanraj leaves town for a business meeting while Anuj regrets his confession at the Shah house. Elsewhere, Samar questions Anupama about her feelings for Anuj.

episodesList.title: Anupama Confronts Anuj
episodesList.summary: Anupama questions Anuj about having feelings for her while the latter says that he never wanted her to find out. Further, he defends his love.

episodesList.title: Leela's Sudden Outburst

episodesList.title: Anuj's Drastic Step!

episodesList.title: Anupama's Futile Efforts

episodesList.title: Trouble for Kavya, Leela

episodesList.title: Anupama Consoles Leela

episodesList.title: Hasmukh Returns Home?
episodesList.summary: Vanraj gives Leela an ultimatum and tries to slam the door on her face. Later, Hasmukh returns to the Shah house. Will he forgive Leela and step in?

episodesList.title: Kavya, Vanraj to Leave?

episodesList.title: Anupama's Unbelievable Act

episodesList.title: Anupama Back in Shah House?

episodesList.title: Leela's Humble Request
episodesList.summary: Leela pleads with Anupama to keep visiting them, and she reluctantly agrees. Later, Anupama can't stop thinking about Anuj.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Desires Success!
episodesList.summary: Anupama prepares a special dish for Anuj while the Shahs celebrate Bhai Dooj. Later, Vanraj wishes to forget the past and move ahead in life.

episodesList.title: Anupama Feels Guilty
episodesList.summary: Anupama witnesses Anuj's patience and his availability for her needs and feels guilty. Later, Kavya oders Leela to take her permisson before inviting Anupama.

episodesList.title: Kavya Brainwashes Paritosh
episodesList.summary: The Shahs discuss about celebrating Leela and Hasmukh's fiftieth wedding anniversary. In the meantime, Kavya manipulates Paritosh against the family.

episodesList.title: Anupama to Stay with the Shahs

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj's Special Moment
episodesList.summary: Vanraj tries to degrade Anupama and Anuj as they share some special time with the Shahs. Later, a heated argument sparks between Kanta and Leela.

episodesList.title: A Suggestion for Anupama
episodesList.summary: While the Shahs take part in some fun activities, Kanta gives an important piece of advice to Anupama. Later, Anuj and Anupama get ready for a date.

episodesList.title: Anuj, Anupama's Fun Time
episodesList.summary: Anupama defends her decision when Leela asks her not to go on a date with Anuj. Later, Anuj and Anupama dress young and enjoy a romantic bike ride.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Gets Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Anuj takes Anupama to their college and reminisces about the old days with her. Elsewhere, Vanraj gets doubtful about Hasmukh's secret.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Feels Left Out
episodesList.summary: While Vanraj's children speak fondly of Anuj, he fears losing them. Later, Anuj and Anupama share an emotional moment when he asks her about her desires.

episodesList.title: Anuj's Surprise for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Gopi Kaka gets worried and hides Hasmukh's medical reports from everyone. Later, Anuj surprises Anupama by inviting Mika Singh to the Mehendi ceremony.

episodesList.title: Anupama Gets Tensed
episodesList.summary: When a furious Vanraj takes Anuj away from the venue, Anupama gets worried. Meanwhile, during the Mehndi ceremony, Rakhi gets Hasmukh's medical reports.

episodesList.title: MaAn's Sangeet Ceremony!
episodesList.summary: Anuj and Vanraj embroil in a spat while the Shahs grow concerned about them. Later, Anupama and Anuj's Sangeet ceremony commences.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Blames Anupama, Anuj
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Anuj give a stunning dance performance. During the ceremony, Hasmukh falls unconscious. Vanraj accuses Anupama and Anuj for his health condition.

episodesList.title: Hasmukh Is Stubborn
episodesList.summary: Anupama, Anuj and the Shahs are concerned about Hasmukh's health condition. Regardless, he remains adamant and refuses to get admitted to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Dolly Pleads with Leela
episodesList.summary: Leela blames Anupama for Hasmukh's condition. Later, Dolly requests Leela to attend Anupama and Anuj's wedding.

episodesList.title: Anupama Is Moved to Tears
episodesList.summary: Anupama cries tears of joy as the Haldi ceremony exceeds her expectations. Meanwhile, Anuj's warm gestures remind her of every unhappy moment spent in the past.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj Feel Blessed!
episodesList.summary: A group of transgenders shower their blessings on Anupama and Anuj after their Haldi rites. Later, Pakhi and Kinjal offer to help Anupama gear up for her wedding.

episodesList.title: Malvika Departs for the USA
episodesList.summary: Anupama spends quality time with Paritosh, Samar, Pakhi and Kinjal before her wedding. On the other hand, Malvika leaves for the USA due to an emergency.

episodesList.title: MaAn's Grand Day!
episodesList.summary: The family is astonished when Leela attends the marriage. Later, an elated Anupama and Anuj arrive at the wedding venue.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj Tie the Knot
episodesList.summary: The family members feel overjoyed as Anuj and Anupama get married. Later, Anuj coyly expresses his disbelief in their union.

episodesList.title: MaAn's Successful Wedding!
episodesList.summary: Vanraj presents Anupama and Anuj with a bouquet during their wedding. Eventually, Anupama and Anuj's wedding is successfully completed

episodesList.title: Anupama's Bidaai Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The Shahs write special messages on a white piece of cloth for Anupama. As they wish her luck during her Bidaai ceremony, Anupama gets emotional.

episodesList.title: Anuj's Surprise for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anuj cheers up an upset Anupama after her Bidaai. Later, he surprises her by taking her to his real house, and her Griha Pravesh takes place there.

episodesList.title: Anuj's Wedding Gift for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anuj shocks Anupama with an unexpected wedding gift. Later, he takes her on a tour around the Kapadia Sadan.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj's New Beginning
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Anuj are delighted to start their new life. Elsewhere, Kavya furiously announces her decision to divorce Vanraj.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Makes a Decision
episodesList.summary: Vanraj decides to take his family's responsibility. Elsewhere, Hasmukh gets furious when Leela blames Anupama for the mishaps in Vanraj's life.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj's Honeymoon Trip
episodesList.summary: The newlyweds feel delighted on their honeymoon trip. Later, Kinjal confronts Samar and requests him to forgive Vanraj.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj Get Romantic
episodesList.summary: Kinjal consoles Leela as she gets nostalgic and misses Anupama. Elsewhere, a shy Anupama wears Anuj's gift, and they spend a romantic moment with each other.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj's Mumbai Outing
episodesList.summary: During their special anniversary, Anupama and Anuj enjoy sightseeing in Mumbai. Later, Anuj takes Anupama to an old place, remembering his childhood.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Anuj Visit the Orphanage
episodesList.summary: Paritosh spends some quality time with a pregnant Kinjal. On the other hand, Anupama and Anuj encounter Anu at the orphanage.

episodesList.title: Anu's Beach Visit
episodesList.summary: Vanraj spots Samar and Paritosh dance and relishes their bromance. Meanwhile, Anupama and Anuj take Anu to the beaches of Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Anuj to Adopt Anu
episodesList.summary: Anuj gets emotional thinking about his own family and decides to adopt little Anu. Later, Devika talks to Kavya to try and save her marriage with Vanraj.

episodesList.title: Anupama Makes Anuj Happy
episodesList.summary: Anuj is pleasantly surprised when Anupama agrees to adopt Anu, and the two share a romantic moment. Later, they give Anu the good news.

episodesList.title: A Surprise for Anupama, Anuj
episodesList.summary: After returning from the honeymoon, Anuj and Anupama are delighted to see his sister-in-law, Barkha. Later, Vanraj promises Toshu to take care of Kinjal.

episodesList.title: Barkha Gets Envious
episodesList.summary: Barkha feels jealous of Anupama when she sees her and Anuj's love for each other. Elsewhere, Paritosh feels Pakhi is being harrassed and attacks Adhik.

episodesList.title: Barkha Urges Ankush to Fight
episodesList.summary: Barkha instigates Ankush to fight for his right in Anuj's business. Later, Anuj and Anupama make a romantic promise to each other.

episodesList.title: Anuj Reveals a Shocker
episodesList.summary: Barkha tells Anuj and Anupama that she has arranged a party for the former's business. However, she gets shocked when Anuj reveals that Anupama is the boss.

episodesList.title: Anupama Is Welcomed at Her Maika
episodesList.summary: Anupama's children visit Anuj's home and are shocked to meet Ankush and Barkha. Later, Anupama returns to the Shah house for the Pagphera ritual.

episodesList.title: Anuj's Gift Stuns Anupama
episodesList.summary: Barkha discusses with Ankush her plan to infiltrate Anuj's business. Later, Anupama falls unconscious after learning the price of the necklace bought for her by Anuj.

episodesList.title: Leela, Hasmukh Face Insults
episodesList.summary: Anupama doesn't like it when Barkha allows the media to enter the house in their shoes. Later, Barkha doesn't recognise Leela and Hasmukh and insults them.

episodesList.title: Anupama Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: While Barkha insults Vanraj and his family, Anupama stands by them. Later, Barkha gets anxious to see Anupama's befitting move against her choice.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Housewarming Pooja
episodesList.summary: Anupama requests the guests to attend both the housewarming pooja and the party. Later, she makes an auspicious entry into the new home along with her family.

episodesList.title: Anupama Stands Up for Hasmukh
episodesList.summary: Anupama is glad to learn that Hasmukh likes her home. Later, she demands an apology on Hasmukh's behalf as one of Barkha's guests insults him.

episodesList.title: Anuj's Suggestion Upsets Anupama
episodesList.summary: Vanraj and the family leave the party without having lunch. Later, Anuj suggests buying a separate house for Ankush and Barkha, which bothers Anupama.

episodesList.title: Anuj Takes a Stand
episodesList.summary: Anuj confronts Barkha and takes a firm stand for Anupama and her family. Later, Vanraj gets furious when Pakhi misbehaves with him.

episodesList.title: A Tricky Spot for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Ankush asks Anuj if he can join his business and the latter puts Anupama in the tough spot of deciding. Later, Barkha learns about Anupama's ventures.

episodesList.title: Anupama Defends Her Choice
episodesList.summary: Barkha questions Anupama's choice to keep working even though she is Anuj's wife, but Anupama defends her decision. Elsewhere, Vanraj asks Samar for a job.

episodesList.title: Kinjal Gets Hurt!
episodesList.summary: Vanraj feels upset being away from his kids while Anuj and Ankush throw a wild party to entertain them. However, the fun ends when Kinjal falls on the floor.

episodesList.title: Anupama Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: Vanraj accuses Anupama and lashes out at her for Kinjal's accident. Anuj takes Anupama's side and decides to send Kinjal to Vanraj's house.

episodesList.title: Anuj's Advice to Anupama
episodesList.summary: Unable to tolerate Anupama's humiliation, Anuj advises her to cut down her affinities with the Shahs. Later, Pakhi argues with Vanraj.

episodesList.title: Anuj Reconciles with Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anuj and Anupama discuss and sort out their differences. Elsewhere, Hasmukh gets insulted by Rakhi for helping Leela with household chores.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Befitting Reply
episodesList.summary: While Rakhi tries to humiliate Hasmukh, Anupama gives her an apt reply. Leela and Rakhi get into a conflict while planning Kinjal's baby shower ceremony.

episodesList.title: Hasmukh Supports Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Leela argue about who to invite to the baby shower when Hasmukh interferes. Later, Hasmukh decides to invite Anupama's in-laws.

episodesList.title: Anupama Gets Anxious
episodesList.summary: While the Shahs plan a party for Kinjal's baby shower, Vanraj gets upset about missing it. Later, Anupama worries about having Barkha, Rakhi and Leela at the party.

episodesList.title: Leela Welcomes the Kapadias
episodesList.summary: The Kapadias come for Kinjal's baby shower, and Leela welcomes them with a grand gesture. Later, Anupama introduces Barkha to Rakhi.

episodesList.title: Rakhi Insults Leela's Gift
episodesList.summary: Rakhi learns that the jewellery gifted to Kinjal by Leela is old and insults her for it. However, Hasmukh defends Leela and reveals her emotions behind it.

episodesList.title: Kinjal's Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: The Shahs and the Kapadias enjoy Kinjal's baby shower ceremony. On behalf of Kavya and Vanraj, Anupama and Anuj complete the rituals.

episodesList.title: Kinjal's Request to Anupama
episodesList.summary: When Rakhi instigates Barkha against Anupama with an evil motive, the latter gives an apt reply to her. Later, Kinjal makes a request to Anupama.

episodesList.title: Adhik, Pakhi Get Caught
episodesList.summary: The baby shower celebration gets disrupted when Vanraj walks in on Pakhi and Adhik getting close in a room. Vanraj slaps Adhik and Pakhi breaks down.

episodesList.title: Vanraj Gets Infuriated
episodesList.summary: Vanraj gets furious to learn about Pakhi and Adhik's feelings for each other. Later, when Pakhi starts arguing, Anupama gives her a befitting reply.

episodesList.title: Vanraj, Anupama in a Feud
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Vanraj blames Anupama for the problems between the two families. Elsewhere, Adhik and Pakhi try to pacify each other.

episodesList.title: Rahi Gets Attacked
episodesList.summary: Prem and Rahi get stranded in a remote area, and Prem leaves to fetch water. Meanwhile, a stranger attacks Rahi, trying to steal her necklace.

episodesList.title: Rahi Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: Jigna informs Anupama that she was unable to see her husband before he fell into a coma because of Rahi. Later, a client accuses Rahi of providing poor quality food.

episodesList.title: Guilt Overtakes Rahi
episodesList.summary: Rahi watches as Anupama is arrested and realises that her mistake has ruined Anupama's reputation. Despite her apology, Anupama remains silent.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Silent Withdrawal
episodesList.summary: Rahi tries to apologise to Anupama, but the latter locks herself in her room and hallucinates a conversation with Kanta Joshi. Later, Rahi loses consciousness.

episodesList.title: Mahi Feels Devastated
episodesList.summary: During the Vivah Panchami celebration, Mahi is thrilled to play Sita. Later, she is heartbroken to see Rahi and Prem sharin the stage as Sita and Ram.

episodesList.title: Ansh Decides to Steal Money!
episodesList.summary: Saloni threatens to ruin Ansh with a fake story unless he pays her. Desperate, Ansh plots to steal money from Leela's room.

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Moment of Truth
episodesList.summary: Prarthana reveals to the Kotharis that she's pregnant with Gautam's child and confesses her feelings for Ansh. Later, Anupama sells the jewellery gifted by Anuj to fund Bharati's treatment.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Fight For Bharati's Surgery
episodesList.summary: Anupama decides to enter a dance competition to fund Bharati's surgery. While she comforts a disheartened Bharati, Rahi celebrates new beginnings at her dance academy.

episodesList.title: Kinjal Exposes Audit Flaws
episodesList.summary: Anupama urges Manohar to mentor their dance team to fund Bharati's treatment. Tensions rise as Kinjal visits the Kothari house and exposes the company's audit discrepancies.

episodesList.title: Rahi and Mahi's Dance Face-Off
episodesList.summary: The colony men inform Anupama that their wives won't participate in the dance competition. Later, Mahi provokes Rahi by comparing her to Anupama, leading to a dance face-off between them.

episodesList.title: Parag, Khyati's Clash
episodesList.summary: Gautam takes revenge on Kinjal for exposing audit flaws in Kothari's company. Later, Parag and Khyati get into an argument over her blocking admissions to Rahi's dance academy.

episodesList.title: Bharati Finds Anupama's Truth
episodesList.summary: Anupama encourages Sarita to join the dance competition, while Prem helps form a group with Rahi. Anupama later opens up to Bharati, who finds her dance video online.

episodesList.title: Prem Defends Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prem stands up for Rahi when Vasundhara fumes at her and the team for dancing. Later, Rahi and Prem confront each other over meeting Anupama and not revealing it.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Trick for Rita
episodesList.summary: Anupama assures Bharati that Rita will join their dance group. With Sarita pretending to be possessed, they convince Rita's mother-in-law to let her follow her passion.

episodesList.title: Will Manohar's Words Move Anupama?
episodesList.summary: After Manohar gets injured, he pushes Anupama to dance, asking her to lead and uplift the team's spirit. Meanwhile, Prem advises Rahi to stand out with classical dance forms.

episodesList.title: Anupama Takes the Lead
episodesList.summary: Manohar motivates Anupama to lead the dance team, giving her a new sense of purpose. Meanwhile, Kinjal confronts Paritosh over his reckless financial decisions.

episodesList.title: A Shocking Moment for Prem
episodesList.summary: Anupama assures Manohar she will lead her dance team to victory. Later, Prem is taken aback when she reveals her decision to participate in the dance competition.

episodesList.title: Prem Comforts Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prem comforts Rahi as she nervously prepares for the dance competition. Elsewhere, Anupama helps her team get ready with costumes for the event.

episodesList.title: Sarita's Nervous Moment
episodesList.summary: Anupama motivates her team for the dance competition. Later, tension rises as Sarita feels uneasy and Jaspreet leaves to attend an interview before the performance.

episodesList.title: Will Anupama's Team Secure a Spot?
episodesList.summary: Anupama introduces her team to the judges, sharing their purpose. During the performance, Sarita slips but recovers flawlessly. Later, Anupama's team anxiously awaits the results.

episodesList.title: Jaspreet Confronts Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama's team celebrates their victory after clearing the selection round in the dance competition. Later, Jaspreet questions Anupama for hiding her past.

episodesList.title: Rahi Reaches Out to Manohar
episodesList.summary: Parag offers Anil the role of leading his newly launched company. Later, Rahi decides to prepare for the competition under Manohar and plans to go to Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Will Anupama-Rahi's Paths Cross?
episodesList.summary: As Rahi packs for Mumbai, Prem worries about her crossing paths with Anupama. Later, Rahi and Pari arrive at Manohar's academy, where Rahi performs to show her talent.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Sarita's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Before Anupama arrives at Manohar's place, Rahi leaves. Later, Sarita confronts Anupama for hitting her husband earlier and declares she's quitting the Dance Ranis group.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Team Enters Semi-Finals
episodesList.summary: Anupama grows emotional at the orphanage, touched to learn it still receives help from Anuj's trust. Rahi and Prem discuss adoption while the dance team reaches the semi-finals.

episodesList.title: Ansh's Vow to Prarthana
episodesList.summary: Ansh stands by Prarthana after Gautam refuses divorce, vowing to support her and the baby. At the dance venue, tensions rise between Anupama and Rahi's teams.

episodesList.title: Can Anupama Dance Through Pain?
episodesList.summary: Prem worries Anupama and Rahi might cross paths at the competition. Meanwhile, Anupama breaks down on seeing Rahi, unable to compete against a team named after Anuj.

episodesList.title: Prem Caught in the Crossfire
episodesList.summary: Khyati blames Rahi for their encounter with Anupama, leading to tension. While Prem defends Anupama as the family confronts him, Bharati urges her to stay and fight.

episodesList.title: Anupama Stands Her Ground
episodesList.summary: Anupama boldly defends herself against her family's cruel accusations. Later, she joins her team with renewed spirit as they gear up for the crucial dance semi-final round.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama freezes mid-performance as Rahi's memories overwhelm her, and her team gets eliminated. Feeling betrayed, Jaspreet lashes out at her and demands that she leave the house.

episodesList.title: Wild Card Entry for Anupama's Team
episodesList.summary: Anupama is stunned to learn that her team is back in the competition as a wild card entry. But Jaspreet refuses to return, lashing out at her for breaking their trust.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Vow of Redemption
episodesList.summary: Anupama atones by holding a lit Diya and pledges to give her best in the contest. Meanwhile, tensions rise as the Kotharis learn that Prarthana and Gautam's divorce is final.

episodesList.title: Parag Eases Rahi's Anxiety
episodesList.summary: Prarthana and Ansh discuss whether the family will accept their relationship. Meanwhile, Parag consoles Rahi as she opens up about the pressure to win the competition.

episodesList.title: Anupama Rejects Parag's Offer
episodesList.summary: Anupama firmly rejects Parag's offer to back out of the competition to ease Rahi's win. Later, Prem surprises Rahi with an apology, and they share an emotional moment.

episodesList.title: Tension Rises Between Gautam, Ansh
episodesList.summary: Gautam insults Prarthana's character in public, sparking a heated fight with Ansh. Later, Parag lies to the family, saying he visited Mumbai to meet clients.

episodesList.title: Rahi, Anupama's Heated Clash
episodesList.summary: At the temple, Rahi and Anupama unexpectedly cross paths, sparking a heated argument. Later, Ansh and Prarthana leave the Kotharis stunned by announcing their decision to marry.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Return Stirs Emotions
episodesList.summary: Ansh rushes to Anupama after hearing her voice, leading to a heartfelt reunion. Later, the Shah family gets emotional and pleads with Anupama to come inside the house.

episodesList.title: Prem Calms Rahi
episodesList.summary: At Hasmukh's request, Anupama steps into the Shah house and performs the Aarti of the Deity. Meanwhile, Prem comforts Rahi, who grows anxious about Anupama's return.

episodesList.title: Anupama Guides Ansh, Prarthana
episodesList.summary: Prarthana and Ansh share their marriage plans with Anupama, who advises them to think wisely. Later, at the competition venue, Anupama and Jaspreet cross paths with Rahi.

episodesList.title: Leela Opposes Ansh's Decision
episodesList.summary: The Shahs happily enjoy the delicious meal prepared by the Dance Ranis. Later, Ansh reveals his decision to marry Prarthana, leaving Leela upset and firmly against the alliance.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Past Holds Her Back
episodesList.summary: Despite Leela's insistence, Anupama refuses to visit the Kothari house as her past still haunts her. Meanwhile, Rahi thanks Parag for securing a rehearsal hall.

episodesList.title: Parag's Unexpected Move
episodesList.summary: Tension rises at the Kothari house as Anupama arrives with Ansh and Prarthana's marriage proposal. Later, Vasundhara refuses to accept it, but Parag agrees to attend.

episodesList.title: Prem Confronts Khyati
episodesList.summary: The Shahs rejoice as Anupama announces Parag's approval for Ansh and Prarthana's wedding. Meanwhile, tensions stir as Prem confronts Khyati for clinging to past wounds.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Stern Warning to Gautam
episodesList.summary: The Shahs request Anupama to stay back after her dance finals. Later, Anupama warns Gautam that if he causes trouble at Ansh and Prarthana's wedding, she will not spare him.

episodesList.title: Parag's Advice to Rahi
episodesList.summary: Khyati shares with her family the pain and resentment she holds against Anupama. Later, Parag urges Rahi to attend Ansh and Prarthana's wedding and take the Shagun.

episodesList.title: Leela Shares Her Fear with Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama consoles Leela, who worries about Ansh and Prarthana's future. Later, Rahi feels moved as she watches Jaspreet and Bharati adorning Anupama for the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Ansh's Promise at Mehendi
episodesList.summary: At Prarthana and Ansh's Mehendi, Rahi and Prem plan a fun snakes and ladders game. Emotions run high as Ansh vows to be the loving father he never had.

episodesList.title: Pakhi Points Finger at Sarita
episodesList.summary: Parag defends the Kothari women from Gautam's insults. As Anupama and family celebrate Ansh and Prarthana's Mehendi, Pakhi accuses Sarita of theft, sparking fresh tensions.

episodesList.title: Sarita Freed from Blame
episodesList.summary: Accusations against Sarita spark tension until the truth comes out, clearing her name. Meanwhile, Vasundhara opens to Khyati about her worries for Parag and Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Reveals Pakhi's Deed
episodesList.summary: Paritosh confesses that Pakhi had hidden Prarthana's necklace. Further, Anupama sternly reminds Pakhi to respect others and makes her apologise to Sarita and the dance ranis.

episodesList.title: Gautam Fuels Khyati's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Gautam stirs Khyati and Vasundhara's anger by showing them a video of Rahi dancing with Anupama. Later, the Shah family rejoices as Leela's brother arrives for Raksha Bandhan.

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Rakhi Wins Hearts
episodesList.summary: The Shahs and Kotharis celebrate Raksha Bandhan with music and dance. While Prarthana's Rakhi warms the Kotharis, Pakhi's refusal to tie Paritosh a Rakhi stirs emotions.

episodesList.title: Anupama Reunites with Bhavesh
episodesList.summary: Anupama shares an emotional Rakhi reunion with her brother Bhavesh. Her joy is cut short when a video of Rahi and Pakhi accusing Sarita of theft starts circulating in the media.

episodesList.title: Anupama Provides Evidence!
episodesList.summary: Amid theft rumours and disqualification, Anupama uses a video to prove her team's innocence. Meanwhile, Rahi warns Pakhi to play fair or be out of the competition.

episodesList.title: Anupama Stands with Prarthana
episodesList.summary: Anupama gets emotional over Ansh's wedding as memories overwhelm her. Later, she stands by Prarthana when Vasundhara rejects her invitation, supporting her choice with strength.

episodesList.title: Will Parag Bless Prarthana?
episodesList.summary: Anupama supports Prarthana's right to choose and praises Ansh's virtues. Despite insults from Khyati and Vasundhara, she stands strong and urges Parag to bless the wedding.

episodesList.title: Prarthana, Ansh's Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Anupama breaks down into tears seeing Anu Ki Rasoi, recalling old memories. Later, the Shah family begins Ansh and Prarthana's Haldi celebration with joy.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Unexpected Demand
episodesList.summary: Mahi breaks down, recalling her memories with Aryan after watching the couples together. Later, Vasundhara demands that Prarthana hand over custody of her child to the Kotharis.

episodesList.title: Anupama Comforts Mahi
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Mahi dresses like a married woman, enraging Khyati. As Mahi breaks down, Anupama consoles her and shares the idea of her remarriage with Hasmukh.

episodesList.title: Parag Confronts Vasundhara's Demand
episodesList.summary: Parag grows emotional upon seeing Prarthana's photograph as a bride. Later, he fumes at Vasundhara, Gautam and Khyati for demanding custody of Prarthana's child.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Hopes for Parag's Arrival
episodesList.summary: The family rejoices as Ansh and Prarthana exchange garlands. As wedding rituals begin, Prarthana quietly hopes for Parag's arrival on her big day.

episodesList.title: Anupama Struggles with Rahi's Coldness
episodesList.summary: Parag turns emotional recalling Prarthana's childhood as Prem and Rahi perform her Kanyadaan. Meanwhile, Rahi saves Anupama from a fire but quickly pushes her away when provoked.

episodesList.title: Prarthana Rejoices Seeing Parag
episodesList.summary: Ansh and Prarthana get married and receive blessings from the family. Later, Parag's arrival fills Prarthana with joy, leading to an emotional moment between them.

episodesList.title: Parag Stands By Prarthana
episodesList.summary: Parag breaks down over his mistakes, regretting prioritising reputation over Prarthana's pain. He finally stands by her, as Anupama offers him comfort and gratitude.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Troubling Dream
episodesList.summary: The Shah family performs the Gruhapravesh ritual and welcomes Prarthana. Later, Anupama grows anxious after a nightmare about Gautam harming Ansh and Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Rahi-Prem Light Up Krishnashtami
episodesList.summary: The Shahs celebrate Krishnashtami with joy as Anupama remembers Anuj on his birthday. Meanwhile, Rahi and Prem spread cheer by performing as Krishna and Radha.

episodesList.title: Anupama Cherishes Anuj's Memories
episodesList.summary: Anupama drifts into Anuj's memories, recalling their moments filled with love. Later, Parag accosts Gautam after he demands that Prarthana's child be taken from her.

episodesList.title: Gautam Vows Against Anupama
episodesList.summary: Gautam vows to destroy Anupama, while she explains the essence of Mangala Gauri to the family. During Fugdi, Anupama and Rahi are paired together, sparking tensions.

episodesList.title: Parag's Emotional Confession
episodesList.summary: Jaspreet reveals to Rahi that Parag offered Anupama money to back off from the dance competition. Later, Parag tells Vasundhara about the pain he had kept to himself all along.

episodesList.title: Anupama Embraces Devika
episodesList.summary: Anupama rejoices at Devika's arrival, while Parag encourages Prem to chase his dreams. Later, Anupama says that Devika will replace Anita in Dance Ranis and perform in the final.

episodesList.title: Devika Hides Her Sorrow
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Devika share a conversation about life that ends with Devika in tears. Later, the Shahs and Kotharis perform a prayer to Lord Ganesh at their homes.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Rahi Clash
episodesList.summary: Rahi opposes Dance Rani's team for replacing Devika with Anitha. Meanwhile, the host and organizer exploit the clash between Anupama and Rahi for media hype and TRPs.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Rahi Honour Manohar
episodesList.summary: Anupama's and Rahi's teams dance together to open the competition with a prayer to Lord Ganesh. Later, Manohar is felicitated by Anupama and Rahi for his achievements.

episodesList.title: Anupama Shines on Stage
episodesList.summary: Manohar praises Anupama's hopeful outlook, while tensions spark as Mahi hides her team's props. Later, despite a surprise theme change, Anupama delivers a graceful performance.

episodesList.title: Dance Ranis Awaits Rahi's Call
episodesList.summary: Rahi's team lights up the stage with a dazzling performance. Later, the judges give Rahi the power to eliminate a team from the competition. Will she target the Dance Ranis team?

episodesList.title: Rahi's Bold Defiance
episodesList.summary: Rahi chooses not to eliminate Dance Ranis' team. Later, as the Kotharis questions her decision, she confidently asserts that she will prove her ability to win the competition.

episodesList.title: Anupama Senses Devika's Pain
episodesList.summary: Anupama senses Devika hiding her pain, while Gautam vows to block her victory. Later, on stage, Rahi and Anupama are shaken as the host plays an upsetting family video.

episodesList.title: Anupama in the Spotlight
episodesList.summary: Rahi slips during the one-handed dance, while Anupama wins the judges' praise. Tension builds as the host announces a one-on-one face-off between the two.

episodesList.title: Anupama Falls into Gautam's Trap
episodesList.summary: Gautam rejoices as Anupama gets trapped in his plan after being locked inside the room. Later, with the final competition nearing, Dance Ranis' team panics over her absence.

episodesList.title: Parag's Timely Help for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Parag rescues Anupama from a locked room after she triggers the fire alarm for help. Later, she seeks a moment from the judges to compose herself before performing.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Rahi's Final Showdown
episodesList.summary: Anupama gathers courage from cherished memories to face the finale. As she and Rahi take the stage, their graceful dance wins hearts, cheered on by audiences across cities.

episodesList.title: Will Anupama Win Over Rahi?
episodesList.summary: In a tense finale, Anupama and Rahi are both strong contenders to win. Anupama reveals she danced even with blurred vision, but the question is, who will take the ultimate prize?

episodesList.title: Anupama's Win, Rahi's Pain
episodesList.summary: Anupama celebrates her victory with family and Manohar. Later, her joy dims as Rahi vents her anger and vows to shut down the dance academy.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Moment of Glory
episodesList.summary: Anupama confronts Khyati over her deceit, sparking tensions between teams. Later, she celebrates her victory with the colony and inspires women with confidence before the media.

episodesList.title: Bharati's Heartfelt Gratitude
episodesList.summary: Bharati thanks Anupama and the Dance Ranis team for winning the competition to help with her surgery. Meanwhile, Rahi grieves over memories of the dance academy.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Seeks Anupama's Help
episodesList.summary: Anupama and her family celebrate Lord Ganesha's immersion with heartfelt wishes and dance. Later, Paritosh seeks Anupama's help when Mota Bhai threaten him for money.

episodesList.title: Anupama Cuts Ties with Paritosh
episodesList.summary: Paritosh begs Anupama for her prize money to repay Mota Bhai, but she angrily refuses and ends ties with him. Later, she advises Kinjal to stop compromising for him.

episodesList.title: Anupama Exposes Gautam's Video
episodesList.summary: Anupama and the family stand by Kinjal as she cuts all ties with Paritosh. Later, Anupama exposes Gautam's video to the Kotharis and confronts him for locking her up.

episodesList.title: Parag's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Anupama punishes Gautam for his misbehavior, and Rahi assures her that she did the right thing. Later, Parag stands by Anupama and kicks Gautam out of the house.

episodesList.title: Parag's Stand for the Kotharis
episodesList.summary: Leela suspects Paritosh's involvement in the house robbery. Meanwhile, Parag inspires his family to follow their dreams and defends his stand before Vasundhara.

episodesList.title: Khyati Struggles With Guilt
episodesList.summary: Anupama assures Parag that Ansh and the Shahs will take care of Prarthana. Overwhelmed with guilt, Khyati pleads with Anupama to expose her actions and help her find relief.

episodesList.title: Rahi Forgives Khyati's Mistake
episodesList.summary: Anupama joins Dance Rani to inaugurate a Saree showroom and enjoys a fun outing with fans. Later, Rahi stops Khyati from leaving the house over her mistake and urges her to stay.

episodesList.title: Anupama Chooses to Forgive
episodesList.summary: Prem stops Rahi from hurting herself and persuades her to apologise to Anupama. Later, Anupama asserts that she has forgiven Khyati, empathising with her as a fellow mother.

episodesList.title: Anupama Learns Devika's Truth
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Bharati visit the hospital, where Devika confides in Anupama that she has cancer. Later, Anupama comforts her, vowing they will face the battle together.

episodesList.title: Parag Supports Rahi's Goals
episodesList.summary: Devika shares with Anupama her dream to travel and complete her bucket list. Later, Parag encourages Rahi to focus on her studies and their restaurant business.

episodesList.title: Anupama Fulfils Devika's Dream
episodesList.summary: Anupama decides to accomplish Devika's bucket list as her birthday gift. Later, Devika goes to Kotharis to invite Rahi, Pari, and Mahi for the trip.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Prayer for a Safe Trip
episodesList.summary: Anupama and family celebrate Durga Puja with devotion, while Leela longs to reconcile with Damini. Later, Anupama prays for their trip's success and invites Khyati to join.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Squad Hits the Road
episodesList.summary: Anupama explains the significance of Navratri, and the family performs Garba. Later, Khyati and Meeta join the trip as Anupama and her squad board the bus and begin their journey.

episodesList.title: Parag Stands Up to Vasundhara
episodesList.summary: Anupama and the squad enjoy the trip, playing Antakshari. Meanwhile, Parag confronts Vasundhara for opposing Hasmukh and Ansh's entry into the Kothari house.

episodesList.title: Devika's Compassion Moves Anupama
episodesList.summary: Parag reminds Vasundhara of his promise to Anupama to look after Hasmukh. Later, Anupama gets emotional watching Devika console a tearful Jaya, who misses her mother deeply.

episodesList.title: Anupama Shields Rahi from Danger
episodesList.summary: Anupama protects Rahi from harassment and shares her wisdom with Rahi. Later, the squad face eerie vibes in Sarita's village, while Prem and the men enjoy carefree moments.

episodesList.title: Samar's Memories Haunt Anupama
episodesList.summary: Ansh offers to help Parag in his company, while Hasmukh suddenly experiences a wave of dizziness. Later, Anupama reminisces about Samar and shares stories of him with Devika.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Frightful Encounter
episodesList.summary: Rahi panics on seeing two strangers staring at Anupama. While Anupama envisions Samar, sensing his presence around her, Sarita informs her about Prakash.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Quest for Samar
episodesList.summary: Anupama envisions Samar asking her to find his killer and bring peace to his soul. Later, Prakash invites the Dance Ranis as guests of honor for the evening Navratri celebration.

episodesList.title: Hasmukh in Peril?
episodesList.summary: Anupama and the ladies happily cook using traditional methods. They then dress up in Nauvari sarees. Meanwhile, Hasmukh feels uneasy and falls.

episodesList.title: Prakash Honours Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Devika await the revelation of Prakash's identity. Later, Prakash praises and honours Anupama and the Dance Ranis, while Ansh grows worried about Hasmukh.

episodesList.title: Anupama Confronts Prakash
episodesList.summary: Anupama confronts Prakash about his men teasing Rahi and following her. Meanwhile, Parag and Prem assure Hasmukh that they will stay with him until he gets well.

episodesList.title: Ishani's Return Raises Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Anupama grows suspicious of Sonu Rathore and Prakash's connection. Meanwhile, Ishani returns home after quitting her course, leaving everyone suspicious of her behaviour.

episodesList.title: Girija Reveals Prakash's Truth
episodesList.summary: Girija warns Anupama that Prakash is dangerous, revealing his harassment and illegal acts. Despite opposition, Anupama stands by her, while investors reject the project deal.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Shocking Discovery
episodesList.summary: Prakash's wife alerts Anupama to leave the village. Later, Anupama is shocked to see Sonu Rathore at his house and angrily confronts Prakash about their connection.

episodesList.title: Anupama Protects Girija
episodesList.summary: Prakash's men attempt to attack Girija, but Anupama and the women fight them off. Later, Anupama encourages Girija to expose Prakash's crimes.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Promise for Justice
episodesList.summary: Anupama refuses Leela's request to return home, vowing to come back only after getting justice for Samar. Meanwhile, Sarita apologises to Prakash on behalf of Anupama.

episodesList.title: Leela's Concern for Hasmukh
episodesList.summary: Anupama confronts Prakash about Girija and vows to reveal his truth to everyone. Meanwhile, Leela grows anxious after noticing Hasmukh's leg injury upon returning home.

episodesList.title: Rahi Caught in Prakash's Trap
episodesList.summary: Bharati confronts Prakash, who admits the truth but says it can't be proven. Later, his men capture Bharati, Sarita, and Rahi, demanding Anupama in exchange for Rahi.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Quest for Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prakash warns Anupama to leave Sonu if she wants Rahi to be safe. Later, Prakash hints that Rahi is in the forest, and Anupama sets out to rescue her.

episodesList.title: Prem's Concern for Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prem grows tense as Rahi doesn't answer the call, and Anupama dives into a pothole searching for Rahi. Meanwhile, Vasundhara brings Gautam home, upsetting Parag and Prem.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Defends Gautam
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara announces to the Kotharis that Gautam will stay with them. Later, Rahi blames Anupama for her suffering, and Anupama urges her to fight and come out of the ditch.

episodesList.title: Anupama Rescues Rahi
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara informs the Kotharis about Gautam's sacrifices, while Anupama helps Rahi get out of the cave. Later, tension rises as Prarthana learns Gautam is back home.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Efforts to Save Anupama
episodesList.summary: Rahi panics as a rock seals the cave, trapping Anupama inside, and despite trying to move it, she fails. Meanwhile, Devika and the Dance Ranis search for them in the forest.

episodesList.title: Anupama Rises for Justice
episodesList.summary: Goutham saves Prarthana from falling on glass. Meanwhile, Anupama exposes Prakash and Sonu, compelling the villagers to turn against them and seek justice.

episodesList.title: A Heartfelt Reunion
episodesList.summary: Rahi feels guilty for misunderstanding Anupama, leading to an emotional reunion. Later, they head to Dwarka to spend some peaceful time together.

episodesList.title: Pari Shares Her Suspicions
episodesList.summary: The families are overjoyed as Anupama and Rahi return home. Later, Pari opens up to Rahi, expressing her concerns that Raja might be having an affair.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Diwali with the Kotharis
episodesList.summary: Anupama visits the Kotharis for Diwali and is stunned to see Gautam. Later, the family celebrates with dancing, while Prarthana grows suspicious of Mahi.

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Caution to Mahi
episodesList.summary: Prarthana alerts Mahi to stay away from Gautam after learning about her feelings for him. The families joyfully perform Govardhan Pooja, and Anupama shares the story with Jaya.

episodesList.title: Mahi's Growing Feelings for Gautam
episodesList.summary: Ishani tries to extort money from Raja through blackmail. Out of concern, Anupama advises Mahi to stay away from Gautam after Mahi reveals her feelings for him.

episodesList.title: Pari's Emotional Outburst
episodesList.summary: Rahi and the Kotharis bid farewell to Anupama. Later, a tearful Pari tells Anupama about Raja and Ishani's affair, while Gautam informs the Kotharis that their picture has been morphed.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Bold Decision
episodesList.summary: Parag warns Vasundhara not to involve Anupama, saying it's a matter between the Kothari and Shah families. Later, Leela, Kinjal, and Paritosh beg her to stay, but Anupama decides to leave.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Plea for Pari
episodesList.summary: Anupama advises everyone to choose wisely, while Parag loses his temper at Pari and Ishani. Later, Rahi urges Parag and Vasundhara to give Pari a chance and speak to her once.

episodesList.title: Pakhi Worries About Ishani
episodesList.summary: Leela stops Hasmukh from helping Pari, saying it's Pakhi's responsibility to solve the family issue. Later, tension arises when Ishani locks herself inside despite Pakhi's calls.

episodesList.title: Anupama Worries About Ishani
episodesList.summary: The family panics as they find Ishani lying unconscious on the floor. Later, Anupama breaks down in tears upon seeing Ishani admitted and helpless on the hospital bed.

episodesList.title: Anupama Supports Ishani
episodesList.summary: Anupama consoles Ishani and insists Varun must face punishment. Later, Rahi argues with Prem over last night, while Anupama reveals the truth about Raja and Ishani to Pari.

episodesList.title: Ansh Exposes Mahi's Love Interest
episodesList.summary: Ansh tells the Kotharis that Mahi loves Gautam and wants to marry him, leaving them stunned. Later, Anupama and the family apologise for Ishani and Pari's mistakes.

episodesList.title: Mahi's Plea to Vasundhara
episodesList.summary: Mahi tries to convince the family about Gautam's changed behaviour. Eventually, Vasundhara agrees to Mahi's request and consents to her marriage with Gautam.

episodesList.title: Rahi, Prem's Clash
episodesList.summary: Rahi confronts Prem about his priorities, while Vasundhara convinces Parag about Mahi and Gautam's wedding. Later, Anupama thrashes the man who tried to blackmail Ishani.

episodesList.title: Anupama Reprimands Varun
episodesList.summary: Anupama warns Varun and tells Ishani to delete all the photos from his phone. Later, Parag advises Ansh to focus on business and seek Gautam's help for better results.

episodesList.title: Anupama Comforts Rahi
episodesList.summary: Anupama accepts Mahi and Gautam's wedding invitation despite family disapproval. Meanwhile, she comforts Rahi, who breaks down over Prem's growing distance.

episodesList.title: Gautam Plots Revenge
episodesList.summary: Rahi refuses Gautam's gift, unaware he's plotting revenge against Anupama's family. Meanwhile, Ishani apologises to Pari for coming between her and Raja, praying for their reunion.

episodesList.title: Gautam Instigates Ansh
episodesList.summary: Gautam provokes Ansh, saying Prarthana will regret choosing Ansh over him. Meanwhile, Mahi reveals Gautam is the real father of Prarthana's pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Pakhi Seeks Anupama's Help
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Ansh decide to expose Gautam's true face and save Mahi from his trap. Later, Pakhi confides in Anupama about Ishani's trauma and pleads for her help.

episodesList.title: Ishani Finds Solace in Anupama
