episodesList.summary: Anupama consoles Ishani, showing her that despite struggles, people find reasons to live. Later, she grows emotional upon entering 'Anu Ki Rasoi', as memories flood back.

episodesList.title: Mahi, Gautam's Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Anupama reprimands Rahi for bringing Raja to meet Pari, thereby complicating the situation. Later, the families gather to perform the haldi rituals for Mahi and Gautam.

episodesList.title: Raja Stands Up for Pari
episodesList.summary: Raja firmly takes a stand for Pari, urging Vasundhara and Parga to forgive her. Later, Prem clashes with Rahi for helping Raja and Pari, leaving Anupama worried.

episodesList.title: Pari and Raja to Divorce?
episodesList.summary: Pari gets excited to return to the Kothari house, and Mahi and Gautam get married. Tensions rise when Parag hands over Anupama, Raja and Pari's divorce notice, shocking everyone.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Is Enraged
episodesList.summary: Tensions erupt in the family as Anupama pleads with Vasundhara not to separate Raja and Pari. Later, Paritosh fumes over the Kotharis' decision regarding Pari and Raja's divorce.

episodesList.title: Tensions Arise on Parag's Decision
episodesList.summary: Pari's breakdown over her divorce leaves Anupama and Kinjal emotional. Meanwhile, tensions rise as Parag agrees to make Gautam the CEO, sparking opposition from Rahi and Ansh.

episodesList.title: Prem Confronts Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prem apologises to Gautam and thanks him for helping him overcome business loss. Later, tension arises when Prem gets angry at Rahi for her behaviour toward his Kothari family.

episodesList.title: Parag Throws Ansh Out
episodesList.summary: In anger, Parag expels Ansh from the Kothari house for pushing Prarthana. Later, Prem apologises to Rahi for his rude behaviour, but she refuses to forgive him.

episodesList.title: Prem, Rahi Share a Moment
episodesList.summary: Rahi forgives Prem, and they share a heartfelt moment of love. Later, Ansh realises his mistake of ignoring the family while trying to impress Parag and apologises to them.

episodesList.title: Pari Slaps Raja
episodesList.summary: Prem apologises to Parag and the family for the loss incurred from the investment. Meanwhile, Pari loses her temper and slaps Raja after seeing him with another girl.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Big Decision
episodesList.summary: Tensions erupt at the Shah house when Meeta arrives with the police over Pari slapping Raja. Later, disturbed by the chaos, Anupama decides to take Pari and Ishani to Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Will Anupama Convince Pari, Ishani?
episodesList.summary: Pari and Ishani refuse Anupama's insistence that they accompany her to Mumbai for a fresh start. Later, Rahi informs Anupama of her decision to complete her course.

episodesList.title: Dance Ranis Rejoice for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Pari and Ishani agree to go to Mumbai with Anupama and begin their journey. Seeing Hasmukh and Leela's bond, Ansh misses Prarthana, while the Dance Ranis excitedly welcome Anupama.

episodesList.title: Parag Backs Rahi's Decision
episodesList.summary: Anupama is thrilled when Bharati and Jaspreet reveal they've bought the house. Later, Parag supports Rahi as she firmly decides to continue her studies, leaving her and Prem happy.

episodesList.title: Ansh Misunderstands Prarthana
episodesList.summary: The colony women and Dance Ranis help Anupama prepare food for Jaspreet's team. Later, Ansh misunderstands Prarthana upon seeing her with Gautam at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Prem, Rahi Happy for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Prem and Rahi are happy for Anupama after she shares that she has secured the catering contract. Later, Prarthana urges Ansh to let her explain and clear the misunderstanding.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Humiliates Rahi
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Rajini feel nostalgic as they recall their school memories. Later, Rahi breaks down when Vasundhara insults her for not being educated in front of the guests.

episodesList.title: Gautam Seeks Rajini's Approval
episodesList.summary: Rahi hides her pain from Anupama, pretending to attend her classes. Later, Gautam offers a proposal to Rajini to get her permission for construction in Purvichaya Colony.

episodesList.title: Raja's Emotional Outburst
episodesList.summary: Rajini reunites with Anupama and grows emotional, sharing her hardships. Meanwhile, Raja lashes out at the family, and tensions rise as Mahi belittles Rahi.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Harsh Accusations
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Anupama is accused of causing illness from the food she didn't prepare. Later, the Director humiliates her, threatens her with no future work, and fires Jaspreet.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Sinister Plan
episodesList.summary: Gautam tampers with Ansh's products, replacing them with duplicates to take revenge. The police take Anupama to the station, while Ansh and Leela are also taken, creating chaos.

episodesList.title: Rajini Stands Up for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Rahi insists that Gautam purposely tampered with Ansh's product. Meanwhile, Anupama thanks Rajini for supporting her and helping free her, Ansh, and Leela from the police.

episodesList.title: Anupama Guides Pari
episodesList.summary: Anupama is overwhelmed when she receives a new food order from the same production house that once fired her. Later, she teaches Pari the true value of relationships.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Ishani Land Lead Roles
episodesList.summary: The director offers lead roles to Anupama and Ishani, seeing them as perfect. Later, an angry Parag destroys Ansh's stall and takes Prarthana, vowing to get them divorced.

episodesList.title: Rajini, Anupama Enjoy Quality Time
episodesList.summary: Anupama joyfully celebrates Rajini's birthday by dancing and spending quality time together. Later, noticing Ansh is worried, the Shah family questions him about what happened.

episodesList.title: A Disappointment for Ishani
episodesList.summary: Everyone waits excitedly for Ishani's advertisement to air. Later, tension arises when another girl appears in the ad instead of Ishani, upsetting the family.

episodesList.title: Rajini's Price for Approval
episodesList.summary: Rajini demands a fifty per cent share to approve construction in Purvichaya Colony. Later, Anupama encourages the Dance Ranis to perform a ramp walk in Pari's designs at the event.

episodesList.title: Anupama Visits Rajini
episodesList.summary: As Anupama meets Rajini about the road potholes, Parag and Gautam also arrive. Meanwhile, Prarthana insists her baby shower will happen only if Ansh and his family joins them.

episodesList.title: Gautam Suspects Parag
episodesList.summary: Prem and Rani visit Anupama and team to surprise them for their team's dance event. Meanwhile, Gautam starts to suspect something when Parag sits silently in Rajini's presence.

episodesList.title: Event Organisers Demean Anupama
episodesList.summary: When event organisers insult Anupama, Rajini steps in to defend her. Later, Vasundhara and Mahi scold Khyati for sending Rahi to Anupama.

episodesList.title: Anupama Appreciates Dance Rani's
episodesList.summary: Parag pushes Kulkarni to make the project a success so they can fund Prem's dream restaurant. Later, Anupama thanks Dance Ranis for helping with the event decorations.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Stunning Performance
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara threatens the family, saying that she will complain to Parag and stop Rahi's studies. Meanwhile, Anupama and her team get ready to dazzle all with a fashion performance.

episodesList.title: Anupama Stands Strong
episodesList.summary: Anupama proudly watches Rahi perform and saves her from a falling light. Later, Rajini urges Anupama to stop the event, but Anupama refuses, citing their struggles.

episodesList.title: Anupama Apprehends the Culprit
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Rahi suspect the incident was a deliberate plot and catch the culprit. Meanwhile, Gautam and Mahi try to convince Vasundhra that it was a public stunt by Anupama.

episodesList.title: Rajini Humiliates Varun
episodesList.summary: Rajini publicly slaps Varun upon realising he set up Prem. When Rahi shares her suspicions about Rajini, Anupama comforts her, saying not all politicians are the same.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Assurance to Rajini
episodesList.summary: Rajini reveals to Varun that Anupama is being used solely to secure NOC for her project. Meanwhile, Anupama assures Rajini that she will guide her son to become a good person.

episodesList.title: Rahi and Prem in Danger
episodesList.summary: Diwakar deliberately crashes into Prem's bike from behind, endangering both Rahi and Prem. Later, Rajini is shocked to learn that Prem is Parag's son.

episodesList.title: Varun's Care for Bharati
episodesList.summary: Anupama grows suspicious of Varun's care for Bharati as Gautam decides to uncover Parag and Rajini's bond. Later, Anupama is shocked to see Parag at Rajini's place.

episodesList.title: Parag Warns Rajini about Anupama
episodesList.summary: Parag tells Rajini that Anupama's participation will doom the tower project. Later, Varun attempts to charm both Bharati and Anupama, but Anupama deals with him gracefully.

episodesList.title: Rajini's Call for Justice
episodesList.summary: Rajini urges Anupama to appeal in court and follow legal procedures to save the community from the builder. Later, Gautam regrets neglecting Mahi and explains his situation.

episodesList.title: Anupama Shares the Truth
episodesList.summary: Ansh warns Paritosh to do whatever he wants, as long as it doesn't affect Ansh's business. Later, Anupama reveals Bharati's past, hoping for a brighter future.

episodesList.title: Anupama Strikes Ishani
episodesList.summary: Prarthana happily shares the success of Ansh and Leela's beauty products with the Kotharis. Later, Anupama angrily slaps Ishani and demands that she leave the house.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Proposal for Bharati
episodesList.summary: Anupama presents a proposal to match Bharati with Varun, leaving Rajini excited. Later, Shanti urges Anupama to sign the document granting her full authority over the colony.

episodesList.title: Bharati's Wedding Gift
episodesList.summary: Rajini insists Bharati and Varun marry within two days, blessing Bharati with jewellery and a saree. Later, Prarthana congratulates Ansh and everyone on their business success.

episodesList.title: Rajini Reassures Parag
episodesList.summary: Rajini assures Parag that the project is being managed in a legal manner. Later, everyone in Purvichaya gives Anupama full authority to make decisions for the community.

episodesList.title: Anupama Believes Rajini
episodesList.summary: Rajini attempts to persuade Anupama to sign the document for a stay order. Later, Anupama agrees, trusting Rajini as she assures the community that she will take responsibility.

episodesList.title: Rahi Cautions Anupama
episodesList.summary: The Purvichaya community urges Anupama to place her handprints as a symbol of belonging. Later, Prem and Rahi warn Anupama not to sign anything without careful consideration.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Bold Stand
episodesList.summary: Anupama saves Rahi from Diwakar when he tries to misbehave with her. Later, Savita makes a shocking announcement to the family.

episodesList.title: Anupama Exposes the Necklace Thief
episodesList.summary: Anupama thanks God after recovering Bharti's necklace, feeling relieved. Later, she tearfully exposes the truth about who stole and sold it, leaving the family shocked and ashamed.

episodesList.title: Ishani Seeks Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Ishani pleads Anupama for forgiveness as she mentions calling the police. Later, Rahi admits that all of Anupama's children, including herself, are breaking her heart.

episodesList.title: Anupama Meets Her Fan Prerana
episodesList.summary: Tension rises as Rahi nearly sees the Purvichaya document, but Rajini quickly hides it. Later, Anupama unknowingly saves Prerana, who is her biggest fan, from being hit by a truck.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Caution to Anupama
episodesList.summary: Rahi alerts Anupama about her instincts and suspicions toward Rajini, urging her not to trust her. Later, Prerana and  Rahi get into a heated argument over a dress at the shop.

episodesList.title: Prem, Rahi's Special Moment
episodesList.summary: Anupama and the colony women share an emotional moment while performing pre-wedding rituals for Bharati. Later, Prem calms Rahi's anger, and the two share a loving moment.

episodesList.title: Varun, Bharati's Wedding Begins
episodesList.summary: Varun and Bharati exchange garlands, marking the beginning of the wedding rituals. Later, Anupama and the colony residents are stunned to learn that Prerana is Rajini's daughter.

episodesList.title: Prem Clears Rahi's Doubts
episodesList.summary: Ishani Falls Into the Trap of a Fake Production House for an Audition. Later, Prem reassures Rahi, confessing she is his first love and Prerna's love was one-sided.

episodesList.title: Police Arrest Ishani
episodesList.summary: Rajini schemes to trick Anupama into signing the document. Later, the police storm Varun and Bharti's wedding and publicly declare that Ishani has been arrested.

episodesList.title: Ishani, Jaspreet Face Judgment
episodesList.summary: Ishani tells Anupama she made a mistake but is not characterless. Meanwhile, Bharati and Varun marry as the neighbourhood shames Ishani and Jaspreet, questioning their morals.

episodesList.title: Anupama Exposes Society's Bias
episodesList.summary: Anupama silences society for judging women without truth. Later, a tearful Bharti begs Rahi to promise she'll protect Anupama after she's gone.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Moment of Guilt
episodesList.summary: Rahi feels remorse for her rude actions towards Anupama in the past. Later, Anupama and the family bid a happy farewell to the newlyweds, Bharati and Varun.

episodesList.title: Rahi Protects Her Bond with Prem
episodesList.summary: Rajini explains her choice of a small wedding with only those who matter. Later, Rahi fiercely confronts Prerna for crossing boundaries in her relationship with Prem.

episodesList.title: Khyati's Invitation to the Shahs
episodesList.summary: After talking with Prerana, Rahi trusts her intuition about Rajini and decides to uncover the truth. Later, Khyati visits the Shahs and invites them to Prarthana's Baby Shower.

episodesList.title: Rajini's Secret Plot
episodesList.summary: The Shahs rejoice as Anupama returns home, unaware that Rajini plans to exploit her absence to demolish the colony. Later, Rahi and Prem share a sweet moment of love.

episodesList.title: Pakhi's Stubborn Stand
episodesList.summary: Pakhi shocks Anupama and the Shah family by revealing her decision to marry Diwakar, leading to a heated clash. Despite everyone's pleas, Pakhi remains stubborn about her choice.

episodesList.title: The Kotharis Welcome the Shahs
episodesList.summary: Prem advises Raja to convince the family about Pari and bring her home. Later, the Kotharis warmly welcome the Shahs for Prarthana's Godh Bharai.

episodesList.title: Anupama Defines Motherhood
episodesList.summary: Ansh and Prarthana perform the Aarti as they step into parenthood. Later, Anupama gently explains the true meaning of motherhood to Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Pakhi's Bold Stand
episodesList.summary: Pakhi announces her wish to marry Dibakar, shocking the family. Later, Vasundhara taunts Anupamaa over her daughters' upbringing, sparking a heated confrontation.

episodesList.title: Anupama Draws the Line
episodesList.summary: Anupama shuts down Vasundhara's insults and stops Gautam from forcing Prarthana to sign papers about her unborn child. She warns them to stay away and stands by Ansh and Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Parag vs Anupama
episodesList.summary: Parag tries to convince Prarthana to stay back at the Kothari house. Later, he draws a firm line, forcing the family to choose between him and Anupama, putting Rahi in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: The Shahs Play Flute
episodesList.summary: Parag slaps Gautam for speaking against Prarthana. Later, on Sankranti, Anupama urges the Shahs to worship God by playing the flute, while the Kotharis offer heartfelt prayers.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Parag's Rivalry
episodesList.summary: As the Shahs and Kotharis cross paths, Anupama fears conflict. Soon, Parag targets Anupama's kite, turning the festive celebration into a tense and fierce rivalry.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Promise to Parag
episodesList.summary: As the families enjoy the festival, Prarthana slips and falls, leading the Kotharis to blame the Shahs. Later, Anupama assures Parag that she will stay and take care of Prarthana.

episodesList.title: Rajini and Parag's Plot Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Rajini informs Parag that the demolition will begin tomorrow in the Purvichaya community. Later, Anupama confronts the building developers who arrive to carry out the demolition.

episodesList.title: Hasmukh Supports Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama tries to convince the Shah family to let her go to Mumbai to save Purvichaya. Later, Hasmukh lashes out at Leela and everyone for stopping her and urges Anupama to leave.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Rajni's Truth
episodesList.summary: Anupama blocks the bulldozer, insisting she was unaware of the deal. Later, Rajini reveals the partnership and accuses Anupama of acting innocent despite knowing Parag was involved.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Stand Against Rajini
episodesList.summary: Rajini falsely accuses Anupama of demanding a penthouse as a bribe, shocking everyone with the revelation. Later, Anupama lies in front of a bulldozer to protect her locality.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Rajini's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Anupama seeks support of the chawl residents and promises to protect their homes. Later, she confronts Rajini, who reveals her jealousy over Anupama being loved by the people.

episodesList.title: Parag Reveals Rajini's Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Anupama confronts Rajini about destroying the homes of innocent chawl residents. Later, Parag tells Anupama he had no idea that Rajini had changed the papers.

episodesList.title: Pari Plots Against Rajini
episodesList.summary: Sarita and Jaspreet defend Anupama as the Purvi Chaya community urges her to leave. Later, Pari plans to expose Rajini online, and the Shahs support Anupama.

episodesList.title: Parag's Plea for Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Anupama files an FIR against Rajini, while Vasundhara breaks down in front of Lord Krishna over the mortgaged house. Later, Parag apologises to Vasundhara for hiding the truth.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Rahi's Fury
episodesList.summary: Rahi furiously demands Anupama return home and assure Vasundhara she will fix the mess she created. Later, Rajini fumes in frustration vowing revenge on Anupama.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Decision Angers Kotharis
episodesList.summary: Anupama visits the Kotharis and states her decision to stand by the colony people, angering them. Later, Vasundhara fumes at Anupama, accusing her of ruining her children's lives.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Fight for Justice
episodesList.summary: Anupama vows to fight for Parag's justice despite the lawyer's doubts. Later, Rajini mocks her for lacking her children's support after the Ahmedabad visit.

episodesList.title: Rajini's Move to Defame Anupama
episodesList.summary: Rajini makes false allegations about Anupama's character on a news channel to defame her. Later, Vasundhara urges Parag to join hands with Rajini to save the house from being sold.

episodesList.title: Anupama Lashes Out at Rajini
episodesList.summary: Parag gets emotional when Prem offers his support and stands by him. Later, Anupama fumes at Rajini, confronting her for sending goons after Pari and Ishani.

episodesList.title: Fear Strikes Rajini
episodesList.summary: Rajini panics after having a nightmare about Anupama harming Varun. Meanwhile, Prem and Ansh step in to help Parag by arranging loan contacts, bringing hope to the family.

episodesList.title: Anupama Prays for Victory
episodesList.summary: Anupama prays for victory as Rahi supports her. Later, Prerna wears Anupama's shawl to go in Rahi's place, and Varun sets the room on fire to destroy her as per Rajini's order.

episodesList.title: Varun Exposes Rajini to Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama enters the room to save Prerna without a second thought. Later, Varun exposes Rajini's conspiracy to Anupama as Rahi demands justice for the heinous crime.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Clever Trap for Rajini
episodesList.summary: Pretending to be a soul, Anupama frightens Rajini and makes her confess her crimes. Later, Prem consoles an emotional Vasundhara, urging her to have faith in God and not lose hope.

episodesList.title: Anupama Stands Her Ground
episodesList.summary: Rajini is stunned to see Anupama alive as Anupama warns her that wealth won't last beyond life. While neighbours apologise, Anupama admits her mistake and stands firm.

episodesList.title: A Sigh of Relief for Kotharis
episodesList.summary: The Kotharis feel relieved learning the project is cancelled, and the house won't be sold. Later, Rajini seeks forgiveness and begs Anupama to help Varun and Prerana forgive her.

episodesList.title: Anupama Earns Gratitude
episodesList.summary: The residents of Purvichaya Colony earnestly request Anupama to stay back with them. Later, Parag and Vasundhara solemnly acknowledge Anupama for saving their house.

episodesList.title: A Warm Welcome for the Shahs
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara grows upset after overhearing Rahi and Prem's conversation about children. Later, the Kotharis warmly welcome the Shahs to Vasundhara's birthday party.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Birthday Bash
episodesList.summary: Khyati and Parag ask Anupama to let Prarthana deliver her baby at the Kothari house. Later, the Shah and Kothari families joyfully celebrate Vasundhara's birthday party.

episodesList.title: Rahi Gets Injured
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara ignores Paritosh's rude imitation of her in the game. Later, while dancing, Rahi slips and gets injured, prompting Anupama to stay at the Kothari house.

episodesList.title: Anupama Grows Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Rahi recall sweet moments from Rahi's childhood. Later, Anupama becomes wary of Keerti and Kapil's relationship after overhearing their conversation.

episodesList.title: Anupama Senses the Hidden Truth
episodesList.summary: Anupama questions Kapil's strange conduct and urges restraint. As she observes his mother's distress, a troubling truth about Kapil's private life begins to emerge.

episodesList.title: Kapil's Secrets Under Watch
episodesList.summary: As Parag urges Anupama to feel at home, Kapil dodges her questions and grows defensive. Observing Vasundhara's cold indifference, Anupama's suspicions only deepen.

episodesList.title: Anupama Steps In to Protect Kapil
episodesList.summary: Anupama calms Rahi's fears and urges her to trust Prem despite manipulation. Later, she saves Kapil from a desperate act as his years of marital trauma come to light.

episodesList.title: Prem's Stern Warning to Prerna
episodesList.summary: As Prerna grows closer to Prem, he warns her to keep her distance and declares his love for Rahi. Later, Kapil implores Parag, expressing his wish to divorce Keerti.

episodesList.title: Anupama Backs Kapil's Fight
episodesList.summary: Anupama urges Kapil to secure proof and face Keerti's threats firmly. Later, as Keerti intensifies her pressure, Anupama rediscovers her strength through cooking.

episodesList.title: Kapil's Truth Faces Denial
episodesList.summary: Kapil discovers his evidence has been digitally erased, deepening the crisis. Later, Anupama presents video proof, but Keerti dismisses it as fake.

episodesList.title: The Kotharis Stand by Kapil
episodesList.summary: The Kothari family apologises to Kapil for their actions and assures him of support. Meanwhile, Hasmukh and Kinjal warn Pakhi, cautioning her against giving money to Diwakar.

episodesList.title: Hasmukh's Emotional Moment
episodesList.summary: Anil reprimands Meeta for forcing Raja and Pari to plan for a baby. Later, Anupama takes Hasmukh to visit his friend Ravindar, who is admitted to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Anupama Seeks a Miracle
episodesList.summary: Hasmukh speaks emotionally to an unconscious Ravindar as Anupama traces his family for support. Later, she contacts a college to probe Hasmukh and his friends' hidden past.

episodesList.title: Anupama Reunites Old Bonds
episodesList.summary: Anupama seeks Ansh's help to trace Ravindar's lost friends. Later, Ravindar regains consciousness during an emotional reunion, renewing hope for healing old ties.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Silent Resolve
episodesList.summary: Anupama breaks down reading her son's heartfelt diary. Later, she joins Hasmukh in a secret probe near Arjun's home to uncover the truth behind Ravindar's turmoil.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Silent Strategy
episodesList.summary: Anupama shares a warm meal with Arti, gently restoring her strength and confidence. Later, she crafts a silent strategy to help Arti reclaim her dignity and rights.

episodesList.title: Tina's Ruthless Move
episodesList.summary: Parag hands his legacy to Prem, but the latter refuses to walk the path laid out for him. Later, Tina manipulates Arjun into seizing the house and plotting Arti's eviction.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Bold Disguise
episodesList.summary: Anupama senses a hidden presence in the temple as Dibakar secretly watches her. Later, Anupama and Hasmukh disguise themselves as wealthy elites to enter Ravindar's house.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Mission for Peace
episodesList.summary: Kinjal thwarts Pakhi and Paritosh's attempt to steal Hasmukh's assets. Meanwhile, Rahi tries to mend the rift between Prem and Prerana while Tina plays a double game.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Heart Yearns Anuj
episodesList.summary: Mahi feels jealous seeing Khyati and Rahi happily discussing their Valentine's gifts. Seeing Manpreet and Ravindar's love, Anupama breaks down in tears, recalling Anuj.

episodesList.title: Tina Exposes Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama warns Manpreet that Tina and Arjun are only pretending to be kind. Later, Tina uncovers Anupama's truth and confronts her for playing a clever game.

episodesList.title: Tina, Arjun's Apology to Manmeet
episodesList.summary: Tina and Arjun apologise to Manmeet and Ravindar for their actions. Later, Rahi and Prem suspect Gautam's involvement in replacing real diamonds with lab-made ones.

episodesList.title: Anupama Exposes the Truth
episodesList.summary: Anupama slaps Tina and drags Arjun out, exposing their cruelty toward Manmeet and Ravindar. Later, she rallies the public to record the abuse and delivers a fiery warning on Karma.

episodesList.title: Anupama Uncovers a Lead
episodesList.summary: Manmeet slaps Arjun publicly as Ravindar disinherits him and vows to donate his wealth. Later, Anupama secretly records Dibakar with another family, sensing a hidden truth.

episodesList.title: Anupama Exposes Dibakar
episodesList.summary: At the engagement, Anupama reveals Dibakar's secret family, leaving everyone stunned. Later, Pakhi and Khushi slap him and demand his arrest for betrayal.

episodesList.title: Happiness Blooms with a Newborn
episodesList.summary: Joy fills as Prarthana is blessed with a baby girl, and the family showers her with love and blessings. Later, Vasundhara presses Anupama to persuade Rahi to consider having kids.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Happiness Peaks
episodesList.summary: The families celebrate the newborn's arrival and Anupama's birthday. Happiness doubles as Anupama receives an invitation from London for the dance competition.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Fearful Move
episodesList.summary: Anupama grows anxious after a nightmare about Prarthana and her child. Tensions flare as a fearful Vasundhara takes the baby from her, accusing Anupama of posing a danger.

episodesList.title: Anupama Defends Prerana
episodesList.summary: Prerana rescues Rahi and the baby from a fire as Anupama steps in to save her. Later, Anupama defends Prerana's place in the house after the shocking accident.

episodesList.title: Prerana's Shocking Confession
episodesList.summary: Anupama relives Anuj's memories during an emotional Holi. Later, Prerana's intoxicated confession stuns everyone as her hidden feelings for Prem come spilling out.

episodesList.title: Prem Vows Loyalty to Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prem urges Anupama to trust his loyalty to Rahi, insisting he never encouraged Prerana's actions. Later, Anupama warns Prerana to stay away from Rahi and Prem.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Her Past Again
episodesList.summary: Anupama breaks down, fearing her painful past is repeating in her daughter's life. Later, she teaches her children the lesson of karma while agreeing to care for the baby.

episodesList.title: Prarthana's Tragic Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Prarthana pushes Anupama away and takes the hit from a speeding truck. Later, grief engulfs the family as Anupama struggles to accept the tragedy and Prarthana's sacrifice.

episodesList.title: A Setback for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama pushes through pain in a high-stakes cycle race and surges ahead. Later, Paul's foul causes her devastating fall, leaving her shaken at the finish line.

episodesList.title: Paul Throws Anupama Out
episodesList.summary: Paul's malicious scheme forces Anupama out of her home, leaving her shattered. Later, a doctor senses her silent pain and offers her shelter and a ray of hope.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Holds the Reins
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara decides to handle business decisions until Parag returns. Later, Paritosh reveals to Gautam that Ansh and Jessi are growing closer to each other.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Remembers His Daughter
episodesList.summary: Digvijay recalls memories with his daughter when Jaya mispronounces his name. Later, Jessi apologises to the producer who came to discuss her dates for the album shoot.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Humble Request
episodesList.summary: Anupama pleads with Digvijay to stay in the villa after breaking the rules. Meanwhile, Meeta confronts Vasundhara about her share in the company.

episodesList.title: Anil Confronts Vasundhara
episodesList.summary: Prerana pushes Prem to take a bold leap and expand their restaurant empire. Anil challenges Vasundhara over her dominating attitude towards Gautam.

episodesList.title: Rahi's Gratitude for Prem
episodesList.summary: Jaya explains to the principal and Anupama how Saloni behaved with her, and the principal urges Saloni to apologise. Rahi feels happy to have Prem as her husband.

episodesList.title: Gautam and Mahi's Dispute
episodesList.summary: Rahi and her siblings joke and enjoy their time together. Soon after, Gautam and Mahi argue over their relationship, and Anupama loses her job as a cook when Paul takes over.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Unjust Dismissal
episodesList.summary: Anupama stands up against Digvijay's harsh behaviour towards his servant. She is later unfairly dismissed and denied pay, leaving her shocked and humiliated.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Clashes with Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama steps in to help at home, but Digvijay lashes out and warns her to stay away. His past resurfaces as her presence stirs buried memories.

episodesList.title: Anupama Discovers Digvijay's Truth
episodesList.summary: Anupama celebrates a new beginning while sensing something hidden about Digvijay. She uncovers his dreams and struggles, leaving him exposed in a vulnerable moment.

episodesList.title: Prerana Uncovers Gautam's Affair
episodesList.summary: Prerana spots Gautam with another girl and discovers he is cheating on Mahi. Leela takes a podcast, turning it into a comedy chaos.

episodesList.title: Prem, Rahi's Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: As Anupama arrives for her first day at work, Paul spots her and confronts Rossi for hiring Anupama. Prem and Rahi share a tender and intimate moment.

episodesList.title: Rossi Traps Anupama
episodesList.summary: Jaya worries about Anupama's absence and seeks Digvijay's help, while Rossi locks Anupama in a room. Mahi thanks Rahi for her encouragement, which motivated her to make designs.

episodesList.title: Trouble at the Kothari House
episodesList.summary: As Mahi decides to leave the Kothari house, exposing Gautam's extramarital affair, tensions run high. Soon, Anupama finds joy when the management offers her a supervisor position.

episodesList.title: Rahi is Assigned Inspection Duty
episodesList.summary: Anupama saves Digvijay when he feels uncomfortable as an unknown woman approaches him. Rahi is appointed to inspect Prem's restaurant.

episodesList.title: Anupama is Framed for Theft
episodesList.summary: The police arrive and accuse Anupama of theft, leaving her stunned. Despite defending herself, she is framed, confronted by a coworker, and ultimately fired, breaking her spirit.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Saves Anupama
episodesList.summary: Digvijay protects Anupama as Paul attempts to hit her, but later urges her to leave his house. Elsewhere, Mahi confides in Rahi about Gautam's mistreatment.

episodesList.title: Anupama Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: Digvijay is lost in memories of Jaya while Anupama breaks down after her sacred space is disturbed. Tensions rise as family members clash over Mahi's return and decisions.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Trouble
episodesList.summary: Anupama receives a food order but worries about a place to cook. Anil insists that Mahi join him for a business meeting.

episodesList.title: Paul Gets Beaten Black and Blue
episodesList.summary: Gautam confronts Paritosh about why Mahi wasn't removed from the Shah house. Anupama loses her patience, angrily strikes Paul for speaking ill of Jaya, and teaches him a lesson.

episodesList.title: Rossi Targets Jaya
episodesList.summary: Anupama panics upon learning Jaya has been kidnapped, as Rossi locks her in a room seeking revenge. Soon after, Anupama and Digvijay frantically search to find Jaya.

episodesList.title: Anupama Finds Jaya
episodesList.summary: Anupama realises Jaya is being used and pleads for her whereabouts. After a tense chase, Digvijay's instinct leads her to Jaya's hidden location.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Criticises Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama is shattered by Jaya's critical condition and rising medical costs. As she struggles alone, Vasundhara's harsh words deepen her helplessness and pain.

episodesList.title: Anupama Saves Jaya
episodesList.summary: Anupama sells her jewellery to save Jaya, who regains consciousness. As relief sets in, Anupama senses fear in Jaya and suspects she is hiding a dark truth.

episodesList.title: Jaya's Pain Resurfaces
episodesList.summary: Anupama balances Jaya's happiness with family expectations and makes a quiet sacrifice. She is left heartbroken on seeing Jaya's trauma resurface in her sleep.

episodesList.title: Anupama Leaves Digvijay's Home
episodesList.summary: Ishani confronts Pakhi over her neglect while Rahi wakes from a troubling dream. Anupama apologises and bids an emotional goodbye to Digvijay's home.

episodesList.title: Rahi Stands Her Ground
episodesList.summary: Rahi refuses to remain biased in the kitchen, asserting her professional stance. Later, she clashes with Gautam over Pranshi's freedom and stands firm on her beliefs.

episodesList.title: A Stranger Warns Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama shares the news of her job and receives a warm welcome from her employer. She is later shocked by a stranger's cryptic warning. Meanwhile, Rahi celebrates Prem's dream.

episodesList.title: Mahi Gets Thrown out by Vasundhara
episodesList.summary: The family is shocked as Vasundhara throws Mahi out. Meanwhile, Anupama's strict judgment affects Prem deeply, leading to emotional strain.

episodesList.title: Anupama Stands Firm
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara pleads and tries to sway Anupama, but she refuses to compromise. Rahi steps in, leading to a heated clash over Anupama's values and decisions.

episodesList.title: Rahi Faces Prem's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Prem lashes out at Rahi after Anupama withdraws her support when he needed help. Anupama urges Ansh not to give up on his dreams for the sake of responsibilities.

episodesList.title: Prem Confronts Anupama
episodesList.summary: Prem questions Anupama's sacrifices, breaking her emotional shield. As accusations rise, Anupama struggles to defend herself under the weight of her limitations.

episodesList.title: Rahi Rejects Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama breaks down after Rahi's harsh rejection and confesses her pain. As emotions run high, Rahi fears losing Prem while Anupama tries to stay strong.

episodesList.title: Prem Gets Enraged
episodesList.summary: Pakhi clashes with Anupamaa as tensions rise. Prem lashes out under pressure, while Anupama makes a tough choice and prepares to walk away.

episodesList.title: Rahi Persuades Prem
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Digvijay decide to participate in the food carnival, planning to start work the next day. Prerana and Rahi try to convince Prem to restart the inspection.

episodesList.title: Anupama Fights Back
episodesList.summary: Digvijay blocks Anupama's plans, forcing her to face harsh limits. She refuses to back down, vowing to reclaim what's hers with support from those around her.

episodesList.title: Hasmukh Conceals His Pain
episodesList.summary: Anupama's big day brings success, but Hasmukh silently battles hardship. As he hides his struggles, a sudden arrival threatens to change everything.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Troubling Dream
episodesList.summary: Leela hides her pain from Hasmukh. Anupama panics after dreaming of Hasmukh and Leela's struggle, and later begins her day hoping for customers at the cafe.

episodesList.title: Will Kunal Agree to Help?
episodesList.summary: Anupama pleads with Kunal to boost her cafe's popularity on his social media. Gautam cunningly turns Paritosh against Anupama, blaming her for the family's hardships.

episodesList.title: Anupama Wins Kunal's Support
episodesList.summary: Impressed by Anupama's culinary skills, Kunal invites her to join him. Moved by her resolve, Kunal decides to write a glowing review of Digvijay Cafe on Akshaya Tritiya.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Act of Compassion
episodesList.summary: Anupama brings an emotional reconciliation as she persuades an upset daughter to reunite with her mother. Soon, she feels broken when Rahi and Prem remain upset.

episodesList.title: Rossi Apologises to Anupama
episodesList.summary: The Shahs share a happy emotional moment, while Meeta and Vasundhara get into a heated argument. Rossi falls at Anupama's feet and pleads for forgiveness for her rude actions.

episodesList.title: Anupama Persuades Digvijay
episodesList.summary: Anupama urges Digvijay to forgive Rossi and not take action against her. Ranvijay issues an official notice to seize Digvijay Cafe and orders the premises vacated.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Rebukes Khyati
episodesList.summary: Gautam insults Ansh over his job prospects. Vasundhara fumes at Khyati for opting for a remote job, while Prem promises to stand by Khyati in her difficult times.

episodesList.title: Anupama Learns Digvijay's Past
episodesList.summary: Rahi confronts Gautam for misbehaving with Ansh. Digvijay shares his past with Anupama, revealing he once met Anuj, who contributed money to help him open a cafe for Saavi.

episodesList.title: Kinjal Makes a Surprising Return
episodesList.summary: Prem remains upset with Rahi as she praises Anupama, while the Shahs rejoice at Kinjal's return. Anupama arrives in Ahmedabad with Digvijay, Banku, and Jaya.

episodesList.title: Khyati Gets a Big Responsibility
episodesList.summary: At a temple, Anupama performs a graceful dance during Sita Navami celebrations. Khyati is moved to tears as Parag entrusts her with the power of attorney for the business.

episodesList.title: Prerana Guides Prem
episodesList.summary: Memories resurface as Anupama reaches her mother's house, while Rahi comforts an emotional Khyati, missing Parag. Prerana tells Prem his mistake in being upset with Rahi.

episodesList.title: Anupama Finds Hope Again
episodesList.summary: Anupama returns to Ahmedabad to start Saavi's café, stepping into a new chapter. As tensions rise with Vasundhra accusing Rahi, Shruti's arrival makes her happy.

episodesList.title: Rahi, Shruti's Bond Draws Attention
episodesList.summary: Anupama gets emotional as she dreams of owning her own house, recalling moments from her past. Soon, Rahi and Shruti grow closer, sparking curiosity among the family.

episodesList.title: Rahi Forgives Prem
episodesList.summary: Anupama encourages Digvijay to join the food carnival. Amid tensions, Rahi accepts Prem's apology and chooses to support Shruti.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Shruti's Feud
episodesList.summary: Rahi hides the truth from Prem about Anupama's cafe. At the temple, Anupama encounters Shruti, who accuses her of abandoning Rahi, sparking an intense confrontation.

episodesList.title: Prem Opposes Anupama's New Start
episodesList.summary: Anupama begins restoring her café, but tensions rise when Prem learns about it and lashes out at Rahi. As family members take sides, Vasundhara pressures Rahi to shut the café.

episodesList.title: Rahi Lashes Out at Anupama
episodesList.summary: In a fit of rage, Rahi wrecks the cafe, accusing Anupama of shattering Prem's dream. Later, Shruti tends to Rahi's wound, offering her emotional comfort.

episodesList.title: Shruti's Business Proposal
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara humiliates Khyati for advising Anil on business documents. Shruti proposes a cafe partnership to Prem, inviting him to join her business venture.

episodesList.title: Prem Seals the Deal
episodesList.summary: Ansh takes Digvijay on a ride to explore Ahmedabad. Prem gets furious at his friend for praising Anupama, then later accepts Shruti's deal to open a new cafe.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Prem's Retaliation
episodesList.summary: Prem informs Anupama about opening a cafe and challenges her, vowing to make her regret breaking his dream. The Shah family prepares for Leela's birthday as Pari visits.

episodesList.title: Leela's Surprise Birthday Bash
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara shares with Gautam her plan to target Anupama using Shruti. Soon, Leela feels overjoyed as Hasmukh and the family throw her a surprise birthday party.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Praises Shruti
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara commends Shruti, revealing her investment in Prem's cafe and subtly targeting Anupama. The families celebrate Leela's birthday while Anupama remembers Anuj.

episodesList.title: Accusations Break Anupama's Heart
episodesList.summary: Expressing her undying love for Anuj, Anupama reveals the reason behind opening a cafe with Digvijay. But Rahi's allegations about her intentions with Digvijay leave her broken.

episodesList.title: Anupama Slaps Rahi
episodesList.summary: Anupama lashes out, strikes Rahi for claiming she replaced Anuj with Digvijay. As Leela frets about society's opinions, Anupama stands firm, choosing her happiness.

episodesList.title: Khyati Stands Up for Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama vows not to give up on her dream, drawing courage from Anuj's support. Khyati defends Anupama against Vasundhara's criticism, while Anupama reassures Digvijay about Rahi.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara, Gautam Target Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama comforts Mahi when she fears Gautam's reaction to the divorce notice. Vasundhara and Gautam vow to take revenge on Anupama by stopping her cafe from opening.

episodesList.title: A New Trouble for Anupama, Digvijay
episodesList.summary: Pakhi humiliates Banku, mocking his status for speaking with Ishani. Trouble arises for Anupama and Digvijay when the house owner asks them to vacate.

episodesList.title: Digvijay's Brave Act
episodesList.summary: Gautam's goon traps Anupama and Hasmukh in a café after cutting the gas pipe. Digvijay arrives just in time to rescue them from the leaking gas.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Stern Warning
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara warns Gautam not to scheme against the Shah family using her name. Anupama is overwhelmed after seeing the café titled 'Anu Ki Rasoi'.

episodesList.title: Shruti's Surprise for Prem and Rahi
episodesList.summary: Anupama performs a café puja. Shruti surprises Prem and Rahi with the opening of their dream café on Mother's Day—right opposite Anupama's, leaving her shocked.

episodesList.title: Rahi Turns against Anupama
episodesList.summary: Rahi stands against Anupama, leaving her heartbroken over Rahi's hatred towards her. Digvijay and the others celebrate the cafe's successful first-day profit.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Defends Banku
episodesList.summary: Prem aims for business success with Vasundhara's support. Digvijay stands up for Banku when Paritosh and Pakhi attempt to humiliate him.

episodesList.title: Anupama Saves Prem
episodesList.summary: During Vat Savitri Puja, Rahi grows worried as an obstacle disrupts her ritual. Anupama bravely saves Prem from live electric wires, and Prem invites her to his cafe opening.

episodesList.title: Prem Insults Anupama
episodesList.summary: Rahi and Anupama face media questions about their rival cafes. Anupama blesses Prem for his new start, but driven by hatred, he insults and hurts her.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Learns Anupama's Story
episodesList.summary: Digvijay confronts Prem for insulting Anupama. Later, Hasmukh shares Anupama's life struggles with him, leaving Digvijay shocked by her patience and greatness.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Empowering Decision
episodesList.summary: Anupama opens up to Digvijay about her painful past and the challenges she has overcome. She vows to buy her own house, with Digvijay supporting her decision.

episodesList.title: Digvijay's Business Proposal
episodesList.summary: Prerana confronts Shruti for blaming her for exposing their business to Anupama. Digvijay proposes a business deal with Prem to encourage compromise and co-existence.

episodesList.title: A Big Order for Anupama, Digvijay
episodesList.summary: Anupama fills out a competition form, while Prem also joins the contest. Impressed by Anupama's tasty food, Digvijay's friend books lunch for thirty members at his cafe.

episodesList.title: Prerana Gets Blamed
episodesList.summary: Shruti confronts Anupama for stealing her customers and blames Prerana for the loss. Due to Prem's lack of trust, Prerana breaks her friendship with him and quits his cafe.

episodesList.title: Anupama Fumes at Prem
episodesList.summary: Prem vows to ruin Anupama and defeat her in the cafe business. Furious over his actions, Anupama reveals to Prem that Prerana attempted suicide.

episodesList.title: Prerana Gets a New Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Digvijay cheers up Prerana and offers her a chance to work at his cafe. Meanwhile, Pari finds comfort and strength in Anupama and Kinjal's support for her fear of pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Shruti Plots against Anupama's Cafe
episodesList.summary: Pari's pregnancy is celebrated with dance at the cafe, but she misses Rahi's presence. Shruti plots against Anupama by buying out her suppliers and pulling customers towards their cafe.

episodesList.title: Paras's Shocking Revelations
episodesList.summary: Paras shocks Digvijay by revealing that Gautam and Vasundhara met Ranvijay. Meeta taunts Rahi for not planning a baby, but Khyati defends her.

episodesList.title: Prem Faces Digvijay's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Digvijay fumes at Prem for his humiliation and decides not to forgive him. Anupama interrupts Digvijay from explaining his reason for slapping Prem.

episodesList.title: Prem Turns Against Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama learns from Hasmukh that Digvijay was right and realizes her mistake. Prem urges Vasundhara not to respect Anupama and decides to seek revenge on her.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Appeal to Digvijay
episodesList.summary: Anupama apologises to Digvijay for Prem's misconduct and urges him to stay. Prem faces criticism from Khyati and Anil, sparking heated arguments in the Kothari family.

episodesList.title: Prerana Faces Prem's Anger
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Digvijay unveil their bold plan to serve healthy, fusion food to today's kids. Prem confronts Prerana over her shocking business betrayal.

episodesList.title: Prem Humiliates Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama prepares food for her first order, but Prem shocks her by snatching the same order through his connections. After insulting Anupama, Prem challenges to shut down her cafe.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Opens Up to Rahi
episodesList.summary: Digvijay confides in Rahi that he has come to fulfill Anupama's dream and stand by her. Vasundhara gifts a diamond necklace to Pari and urges Raj to put it on her.

episodesList.title: Rahi Chooses Prem
episodesList.summary: Prem asks Rahi to choose between him and Anupama, and she chooses Prem. Meanwhile, Digvijay and Anupama separately question Prerana and Ansh about their feelings.

episodesList.title: Prem Shares the News with Shruti
episodesList.summary: Anupama urges Ansh to confess to Prerana. Prem tells Shruti their café is selected for the Food Carnival festival and feels that Rahi has apologised to Anupama.

episodesList.title: Prem Takes a Stand for Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prem defends Rahi against Vasundhara's questioning and reassures her. Then he secretly hides from Rahi that he removed Anupama's café name from the form list.

episodesList.title: Anupama Reassures Rahi
episodesList.summary: The Shah family celebrates Hasmukh and Leela's anniversary. Anupama supports Rahi through personal challenges, fostering love and understanding.

episodesList.title: Ansh Confesses His Love
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Digvijay admire Hasmukh and Leela's enduring bond. Elsewhere, Ansh proposes to Prerana, while Ishani reveals her feelings to Banku.

episodesList.title: Digvijay's Plea to Banku
episodesList.summary: Digvijay asks Banku to leave after discovering his love for Ishani. A feverish Prem entrusts Rahi with his caféb presentation and other tasks.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Help Causes a Rift
episodesList.summary: As Rahi struggles with a crucial food order, Anupama steps in to help at Anuj's cafe. Soon after, Prem learns about it and fumes at Rahi, sparking a heated clash.

episodesList.title: Prem's Words Leave Rahi Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: An enraged Prem accuses Rahi of betrayal and tells her to leave the cafe with Anupama. Khyati comforts a heartbroken Rahi, while Anupama worries about her.

episodesList.title: Reunion of Rahi and Prem
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara convinces Prem that Anupama is driving a wedge between him and Rahi. After reuniting, Rahi promises never to leave Prem and admits she can't live without him.

episodesList.title: Ishani's Bold Confession
episodesList.summary: Tensions escalate in the Shah family as Leela refuses to accept Ansh and Prerana's wedding. The drama intensifies when Ishani confesses her love for Banku, enraging Pakhi.

episodesList.title: Rahi Reassures Ishani
episodesList.summary: Digvijay urges Banku to protect his relationship and be responsible. Rahi assures Ishani of his support and encourages her to reconsider before committing.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Request to Anupama
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara politely urges Anupama to stop Ishani from marrying Banku. Anupama suggests giving the couple a year to focus on their careers before reconsidering marriage.

episodesList.title: Anupama Is Up for the Competition
episodesList.summary: Ishani and Banku agree to take a year before reconsidering marriage, as Anupama suggested. Anupama is overjoyed when their café is selected for the competition.

episodesList.title: Ansh and Prerana's Eternal Vow
episodesList.summary: Digvijay gives his share of the profit to Anupama for Ansh and Prerana's wedding expenses. Ansh and Prerana pledge lifelong commitment and share a heartfelt moment.

episodesList.title: Anupama Wishes for a Dream Home
episodesList.summary: Anupama dreams of her self-owned house, cherishing the moment. Prem desperately urges Prerana to rethink marrying Ansh before it's too late.

episodesList.title: Prem's Unreasonable Demand
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Hasmukh visit the Kothari house to invite the family to Ansh and Prerana's wedding, but Prem refuses to attend. He agrees on a condition if Digvijay apologises to him.

episodesList.title: Digvijay's Shocking Apology to Prem
episodesList.summary: The Shah family gets emotional as Ansh and Prerana seek blessings from the late Samar. Elsewhere, Digvijay arrives at the Kothari house and apologises to Prem, shocking all.

episodesList.title: Ansh, Prerana Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: The Kotharis arrive at Ansh and Prerana's Gol Dhana ceremony. Ansh and Prerana seal their love with rings, while Paritosh stirs Gautam over Pranshi's custody.

episodesList.title: Prem Under Shruti's Pressure
episodesList.summary: Anupama is filled with joy seeing both families dance together, celebrating Ansh and Prerana. Shruti forces Prem to steal Anupama's secret recipe diary to win the competition.

episodesList.title: Prem Tries to Sabotage Anupama
episodesList.summary: As Anupama and Digvijay gear up for the first round of the cooking competition, Prem steals Anupama's recipe diary. Meanwhile, the competition begins with a unique challenge.

episodesList.title: Gautam Demands Pranshi Back
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Prem clear first round of the cooking competition. Fuming Gautam enters the Shah house demanding Pranshi, but Anupama confronts and exposes his lack of care for her.

episodesList.title: Shah Cousins Plan Bachelor Party
episodesList.summary: The Shah cousins gear up for a bachelor party, inviting Prem and Rahi to join, and wait for Leela's permission. Gautam receives a police warning for troubling the Shahs.

episodesList.title: Gautam Fights for Pranshi
episodesList.summary: Gautam fiercely claims Pranshi as his daughter, vowing no one will separate them. At the bachelor party, destiny unfolds as everyone opens their fortune chocolates.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Entry Sparks Chaos
episodesList.summary: Anupama prepares for Ansh, Prerana's mehendi, but is unaware that he has fallen into Gautam's trap during the party. Later, Gautam arrives uninvited and faces sharp criticism.

episodesList.title: Ansh Faces Accusations
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Prem demand Meeta apologise to Pari for publicly insulting her. The drama intensifies as a police officer arrives to arrest Ansh for molestation.

episodesList.title: Prerana Doubts Gautam
episodesList.summary: Prerana suspects Gautam orchestrated Ansh's arrest out of revenge. Anupama boldly vows to prove Ansh's innocence and confronts the woman behind the false accusation.

episodesList.title: Shruti's Plea to Prem
episodesList.summary: The family urgently calls every guest, determined to find proof of Ansh's innocence. Shruti requests Prem to prioritise his cafe over aiding the competition.

episodesList.title: Anupama Proves Ansh's Innocence
episodesList.summary: Anupama hands the video to the police, proving Ansh's innocence. Elsewhere, Gautam worries that his conspiracy against Ansh may get exposed.

episodesList.title: Pakhi Accuses Banku of Theft
episodesList.summary: The Shahs joyfully celebrate Ansh and Prerna's Haldi ceremony. The mood turns tense when Banku gifts Ishani a pair of earrings, and Pakhi accuses him of stealing money to buy them.

episodesList.title: Anupama Reassures Leela
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Ishani rebuke Pakhi for falsely framing Banku. Leela worries that Prerana is not the right match for Ansh, but Anupama assures her about their relationship.

episodesList.title: Prerana Misses Her Family
episodesList.summary: Prerana is heartbroken as her family says they can't attend her wedding. Hurt by Prerana's disrespect, Leela decides to leave the house, but the family convinces her to stay.

episodesList.title: Ansh, Prerana's Wedding Begins
episodesList.summary: Ansh's arrival with the wedding procession reminds Anupama of Samar, while Prerana makes a stunning bridal entry. Paritosh learns that Prem has Anupama's recipe diary.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Blackmails Prem
episodesList.summary: Paritosh extorts Prem, demanding money in exchange for keeping his diary theft a secret. As Anupama worries over her missing recipe diary, Ansh and Prerana tie the knot.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Exposes Prem's Big Theft
episodesList.summary: Anupama performs Prerana's Gruhapravesh with Ansh as part of their marriage rituals. Tensions rise as Paritosh reveals that Prem has stolen Anupama's recipe diary.

episodesList.title: Prem's Hatred Shatters Anupama
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara confronts Prem over his actions and warns Shruti to stay away from him. Meanwhile, Anupama pours out her heartbreak to Digvijay about Prem's hatred.

episodesList.title: Rahi Draws the Line
episodesList.summary: Anupama meets Prem and has an emotional confrontation over his hatred. Meanwhile, Rahi warns Shruti not to fuel Prem's hatred and asks her to stay away from him.

episodesList.title: Prem's Ultimatum to Rahi
episodesList.summary: Prem asks Rahi to leave the house, demanding that she choose between him and Anupama. Soon after, tensions escalate as Pari arrives at the Shah house in search of Rahi.

episodesList.title: Khyati Fumes at Prem
episodesList.summary: Khyati confronts Prem for letting his ego overshadow his love for Rahi. Overwhelmed with emotion, Rahi confides her grief to Anupama in a heartfelt moment.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Fears for Rahi and Prem
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara worries about Rahi and Prem's relationship and shares it with Khyati. Soon, Anupama opens up to Leela about the joy and peace of having a home of her own.

episodesList.title: Anupama Builds Her Team
episodesList.summary: The competition begins as Anupama and Prem form their teams. While Paritosh and Pakhi choose Anupama, Prem is determined to have Khyati on his side.

episodesList.title: Rahi Stands by Khyati
episodesList.summary: Rahi defends Khyati's sacrifices for the family when Shruti criticises her. Elsewhere, Anupama tells Digvijay about her wish to live in her dream home.

episodesList.title: Anupama, Prem Lock Horns
episodesList.summary: Anupama aims to win the competition to build her house, while Prem is determined to defeat her. Soon after, the host introduces the teams participating in the competition.

episodesList.title: Will Prem Defeat Anupama?
episodesList.summary: Anupama and Prem's teams face the judges as the cooking competition begins. Later, every team races against time to prepare their assigned dish in the first round.

episodesList.title: Anupama Leads with Calmness
episodesList.summary: Anupama guides her team with confidence as the competition intensifies. Meanwhile, Prem's impressive dish raises the stakes as both teams battle for a place in the next round.

episodesList.title: Pari Stands Up for Rahi
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts in the Shah family when Pakhi blames Prerana for the competition mishap. Prem is disappointed with Rahi and Shruti, but Pari steps in to defend Rahi.

episodesList.title: Shruti's Bold Decision
episodesList.summary: Prem announces to the team that he will lead them with arrogance. Shruti is determined to win the competition and take Prem and Rahi with her to the US.

episodesList.title: Prem and Rahi's Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: Prem decides to repay Shruti's cafe investment, while tensions rise between Leela and Prerana. Soon after, Prem and Rahi share a heartfelt moment while preparing a cake.

episodesList.title: Prerana Earns the Family's Respect
episodesList.summary: Prerana wins the family's appreciation after apologising to Leela. Anupama's worsening hand injury adds tension as the host reveals the next round's twist.

episodesList.title: Anupama Battles All Odds
episodesList.summary: Anupama refuses to back down from the cooking challenge despite intense pain. Prem and Anupama's teams compete against time to finish their dishes as the family cheers them on.

episodesList.title: Mahi Holds Prerna Responsible
episodesList.summary: Anupama is heartbroken as her team loses while Prem's team advances to the next round. Soon, Mahi blames Prerna for their defeat, sparking a heated family argument.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Gives Anupama Strength
episodesList.summary: Rahi lashes out at Shruti for underestimating Prem's talent and celebrating Anupama's defeat. Elsewhere, Digvijay uplifts a shattered Anupama to regain her confidence.

episodesList.title: Jaya Rekindles Anupama's Dream
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara consoles Khyati over Parag's decision, while Jaya's words help Anupama regain her strength and confidence. Soon, the family is delighted to see her dream again.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Return Shocks Prem
episodesList.summary: Shruti taunts Anupama over her defeat, but Anupama stays graceful. Moments later, Prem and everyone are stunned as the host announces Anupama's unexpected re-entry in the finals.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Sharp Reply to Prem
episodesList.summary: Prem throws an open challenge at Anupama, but she hits back with a sharp reply. After the judges reveal the rules for the next round, both teams devise their own strategies.

episodesList.title: Prem, Anupama's Blindfold Task
episodesList.summary: A blindfold cooking challenge tests Anupama and Prem as chaos unfolds despite their team's support. Beating the clock, they present their final dish before the judges.

episodesList.title: Prem Challenges Anupama
episodesList.summary: Anupama's team defeats Prem's. Soon after, Prem vows to beat Anupama in the competition and lashes out at Shruti for breaking a rule that cost them the task.

episodesList.title: The Daacooing Round
episodesList.summary: The host announces the new task, 'Daacooing,' blending dance and cooking. As the competition heats up, Shruti secretly plots to ruin Anupama's prepared dish while dancing.

episodesList.title: Shruti Fumes at Prem, Rahi
episodesList.summary: Anupama confides in Rahi about her dream of buying a home. Rahi and Prem firmly stand up to Shruti when she lashes out at them for caring about Anupama.

episodesList.title: Mahi's Decision Stuns Anupama
episodesList.summary: Pari's bed rest leaves Prem anxious about finding a replacement for the competition team. Mahi shocks everyone by telling Anupama that she has decided to withdraw from the team.

episodesList.title: Anupama's Plea to Mahi
episodesList.summary: Prem decides to repay Shruti's money by winning the competition. Anupama apologises to Mahi and asks for her support in the competition.

episodesList.title: Mahi's Move Stuns Everyone
episodesList.summary: As the competition begins, everyone is shocked to see Mahi join Prem's team. The judges announce the details for the next round, leaving both teams anxious.

episodesList.title: Anupama Outshines Prem
episodesList.summary: As both teams race to prepare a traditional meal, Anupama overcomes unexpected setbacks with determination. While her dish impresses the judges, Prem fails to win them over.

episodesList.title: Leela Joins Anupama's Team as Wildcard
episodesList.summary: In a wildcard entry, Leela replaces Ishani in Anupama's team, while Vasundhara replaces Meeta in Prem's team. Anupama then counsels Mahi about her decision to join Prem's team.

episodesList.title: Leela vs Vasundhara Begins
episodesList.summary: Prem's strategy against Anupama comes to light, leaving Rahi stunned. Leela steps into the cooking challenge alongside Vasundhara, where both teams must cook and sing together.

episodesList.title: Tables Turn at the Food Carnival
episodesList.summary: The judges note Leela and Vasundhara's flawless energy in the competition. A plot twist arises when each team captain is asked to taste the opposing team's food before the judges.

episodesList.title: Leela, Vasundhara Get Tied Up
episodesList.summary: The cooking competition takes a tricky turn as Leela and Vasundhara are tied together by a rope and must cook with one hand. Their attempts to outsmart each other create chaos.

episodesList.title: Leela's Dish Wins the Challenge
episodesList.summary: As time runs out, Leela and Vasundhara clash while cooking. Soon after, Leela's dish wins the task, while Vasundhara apologises to Prem for losing.

episodesList.title: The Shahs Panic Over Ansh's Accident
episodesList.summary: The Shahs panic when Prerana informs them about Ansh's accident. Elsewhere, Pandit Ji alerts the Kotharis that negativity has spread throughout their house, affecting the family.

episodesList.title: Shruti, Gautam's Scheme Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara and Khyati's unexpected arrival shocks the Shahs. Meanwhile, Shruti and Gautam plot to inform the organisers about both families staying together and stir up drama.

episodesList.title: Prem, Anupama Face Media Backlash
episodesList.summary: The Shahs and Kotharis gather for a Pooja for Pranshi's health. But chaos erupts when the media claims that Anupama and Prem's rivalry is fake and the competition is scripted.

episodesList.title: Kinjal Outsmarts Shruti's Order
episodesList.summary: The organisers install cameras in the house and reveal the details for the next round. As it begins, Kinjal cleverly defies Shruti's order, earning Anupama's team a point.

episodesList.title: Digvijay Consoles Leela
episodesList.summary: Anupama's team earns a point as Rahi unknowingly follows Anupama's order to rest in panic. Soon, Leela regrets losing to Vasundhara, while Digvijay calms and encourages her.

episodesList.title: Prem's Ego Leads to Loss
episodesList.summary: Digvijay's ego causes Prem to fail the task, leaving Anupama heartbroken. Later, Anupama shares her fears with Digvijay after the organisers announce a lie detector test.

episodesList.title: Gautam's Generous Offer to Anupama
episodesList.summary: Prem gets emotional after tasting the Laddoo prepared by Anupama. Meanwhile, Gautam uses his friendship with the builder to help Anupama get a discount on her dream home.

episodesList.title: Digvijay's Truth Is Unveiled
episodesList.summary: The lie detector test exposes Prem's arrogant response as a lie. Tensions flare between the Shah and Kothari families when Digvijay's answers are proven true.

episodesList.title: Rahi Encourages Prem
episodesList.summary: After two crushing defeats, Rahi urges Prem not to lose faith. Vasundhara hands Gautam a blank cheque, demanding nothing short of victory for Prem.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces a Tough Choice
episodesList.summary: Anupama celebrates Independence Day, but Paritosh's words hurt her deeply. Meanwhile, Vasundhara offers her dream land in exchange for Anupama winning the competition.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara blackmails Anupama
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara uses Rahi to emotionally blackmail Anupama into loosing the competition. As Rahi and Prem reconcile, Anupama remains torn between her decision and her family's happiness

episodesList.title: Anupama Vows to Fight Fair
episodesList.summary: Anupama breaks down before Digvijay, who encourages her to follow her heart. When Vasundhara offers her a deal to lose the competition for money, Anupama boldly refuses.

episodesList.title: Anupama Refuses Vasundhara
episodesList.summary: Anupama firmly rejects Vasundhara's proposal and urges her to motivate Prem instead of bribing her. When Ishani and Prerana expose the deal to the media, Anupama denies it.

episodesList.title: Paritosh Plots Against Anupama
episodesList.summary: Prem confronts Vasundhara for trying to bribe Anupama to secure his victory. At Gautam's behest, Paritosh executes his scheme against Anupama to ensure Prem wins the competition.

episodesList.title: Anupama Faces Taste Trouble
episodesList.summary: Anupama panics after losing her sense of taste and worries about the competition. Khyati informs Prem and Rahi that Parag called and asked her to stay with him.

episodesList.title: Pakhi Learns of Gautam's Scheme
episodesList.summary: Pakhi learns of Gautam and Paritosh's plot to ruin Anupama's sense of taste. Before the final round, everyone performs a spectacular group dance on stage.

episodesList.title: The Bahubali Thaali Challenge
episodesList.summary: Anupama blesses Prem and wishes him luck before the final round begins. The judges then assign a new task to Anupama and Prem's team to prepare the Bahubali Thaali.

episodesList.title: Anupama Shines While Prem Struggles
episodesList.summary: Despite losing her sense of taste, Anupama identifies sugar and salt correctly and completes her dish. While Prem struggles to explain his thali, Anupama impresses the judges.Despite losing her sense of taste, Anupama identifies sugar and salt correctly and completes her dish. While Prem struggles to explain his thali, Anupama impresses the judges.

episodesList.title: Anupama Is Accused of Cheating
episodesList.summary: The judges are impressed by Anupama's thali, but her inability to taste Prem's dish raises doubts. When accused of cheating, Anupama reveals that she has lost her sense of taste.

episodesList.title: Anupama Emerges Victorious
episodesList.summary: After giving an honest judgement on Prem's dish without tasting it, Anupama is declared the winner. As her team celebrates with Garba and a victory parade, Prem is left devastated.

episodesList.title: Anupama Celebrates Her Victory
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Abhira celebrate Anupama's victory as she guides them on parenting. While she praises Prem before the media, Hasmukh gives her a grand welcome, leaving her emotional.

plotHtml:
Anupamaa is a middle-aged housewife who toils for her family but is always insulted by her husband, Vanraj, and her mother-in-law, Leela, for being uneducated. Anupamaa's constant emotional supports are her younger son, Samar, and her father-in-law, Hasmukh. However, on her 25th wedding anniversary, upon discovering that Vanraj has cheated on her with his colleague, Kavya, she feels heartbroken and sets out to create her identity. Meanwhile, Anupamaa's elder son, Paritosh, marries Kinjal, while Samar and Nandini, Kavya's niece, fall for each other. Anupamaa and Vanraj divorce, and he marries Kavya soon after her divorce from her husband, Aniruddh.
Anupamaa, along with Samar and Nandini, opens a dance academy due to their shared passion for dance. However, Nandini breaks up with Samar and leaves him forever because of her misunderstandings and insecurities towards him. Anupamaa later reconnects with her college classmate, Anuj Kapadia, who has been in love with her since her college days. Anupamaa eventually falls in love with Anuj, and they marry. Together, they adopt a girl, Chhoti Anu. Anupamaa struggles to balance her responsibilities between her two families. Amidst all this, Kinjal gives birth to a baby girl, Aarya, and learns that Paritosh has cheated on her, but they reconcile for the sake of their child. Anupamaa's daughter, Pakhi, marries Adhik, who is the younger brother and foster son of Anuj's sister-in-law, Barkha. Samar marries a rape victim, Dimple, who herself was divorced by her husband after her rape.
Later on, Chhoti Anu's biological mother, Maya, arrives and takes Chhoti Anu with her. Anuj and Anupamaa feel devastated on Anu's departure, and Anuj leaves Anupamaa to stay with Maya and Chhoti Anu. Maya and Barkha conspire to keep Anuj and Anupamaa apart. Later on, Anupamaa has a chance to be a part of Malti Devi's Academy, Gurukul. Malti Devi is impressed with Anupamaa's hard work and dedication, and offers her a three-year contract to work with her and declares that she would be the heir of Gurukul. Maya realizes her mistake when she tries to separate Anuj and Anupamaa and asks for their forgiveness, but a truck hits her, and Maya dies. Before leaving for America, Anupamaa learns that Anu's health has deteriorated, and she rushes back to her. This angers Malti Devi, so she expels Anupamaa from her Gurukul. Meanwhile, Kavya is pregnant with Aniruddh's child, and Vanraj learns about that and avoids her. Later on, Anupamaa finds Malti Devi roaming in the streets, in a deteriorated condition, and brings her to her house. On Anuj's birthday, the entire family is shocked to know that Malti Devi is Anuj's biological mother, but Anuj refuses to accept her. Later on, Samar is murdered at a party, leaving behind Dimple, who is pregnant with his child. Anupamaa, Vanraj, and Anuj find out Samar's murderer and have him arrested. Paritosh, Kinjal, and Aarya move out of India.
Pakhi, Barkha, and Malti Devi instigate Chhoti Anu against Anupamaa, and she goes against her, whereas Dimple meets a dancer, Tapish, and they become friends. Vanraj tells Dimple to stay away from Tapish, or else he will keep Dimple's child away from her. Kinjal, Paritosh, and Aarya return to India to celebrate Aarya's first birthday. Anupamaa comes to meet Aarya, but Vanraj asks her to leave and tells her to never return to the house. Kavya also leaves the house after Vanraj tells her that her child has no place in this house. Malti Devi and Barkha collaborate to expel Anupamaa from Anuj's life and start instigating Chhoti Anu against Anupama. Anupamaa, Kinjal, Aarya, and Chhoti Anu go out for a picnic, but the car meets with an accident. Although Anupamaa rescues everyone, she is berated by Vanraj and Paritosh. Anupamaa decides to never return to the Shah house and returns to the Kapadia house. Chhoti Anu berates Anupamaa and avoids her. Anuj feels that Anupamaa has never paid attention to Chhoti Anu and the Kapadia family, and has always paid attention to the Shah family, and feels that he has married Anupamaa hastily. Anupamaa then decides to leave Anuj and Chhoti Anu forever and leaves the house. Anuj divorces Anupamaa and renames Chhoti Anu to Aadhya and leaves India.

title: Aksharathettu
summary:
Aksharathettu (transl. Spelling Mistake) is an Indian Malayalam television series broadcast on Mazhavil Manorama since 6 July 2020. Ishani Ghosh and Dharish Jayaseelan are the main protagonists of the series.
From 26 October 2020 this series was merged with Suryakanthi (transl. Sunflower) which premiered in the channel from 17 August 2020.
Shalu Kurian received the Kerala State TV award for second-best actress for the show Aksharathettu. Ambootti won the award for best male dubbing artiste for Aksharathettu and Suryakanthi.
plot: Lakshmi Sivasankar goes to Madras to pursue a career in the film industry, where she meets Ramkumar, a popular actor. Their relationship progresses and Lakshmi becomes pregnant with Ramkumar's child. Soon he abandons her and Lakshmi gives birth to a son. Believing that the child is born dead, Lakshmi resumes her career and seeks vengeance on Ramkumar. Due to his influence, she struggles in the film industry but manages to bag a challenging role of a mute girl in a film by director Zakhir. She now takes the name Jayalakshmi and believes the film will be a hit. On the other hand, Karan and Arjun, two street boys, find Lakshmi's son and raise him with the help of a poor family. The boys use him to beg for money. Ramkumar marries the daughter of the chief minister, Malarmathi who is now aware of Ramkumar's illegitimate child. Lakshmi and Ramkumar discover that their son is alive, and Ramkumar seeks to kill him. Malarmathi hires a private detective agency to find the child before Ramkumar and bribes some people to badmouth Lakshmi and Zakhir so that they marry.
