episodesList.title: The Story Goes Like This
episodesList.summary: Aliyans is a family comedy sitcom of Kaumudy TV. Its about the love - hate relationship between two brother-in-laws and their families. Aneesh Ravi, Soumya Bhagyananthan, Riyas Narmakala, Manju Pathrose, Sethulekshmi, Binoj Kulathoor, Mani Shornur and Akshayamol. Aliyans is directed by Rajesh Thalachira.

episodesList.title: Search for Cleatus
episodesList.summary: When a Sheikh from Dubai comes in search of Cleatus, everyone starts believing that Cleatus has messed up something in Dubai and the Sheikh is after his life. How will Cleatus save himself from the Sheikh? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Kanakan Gets the Chit Funds
episodesList.summary: Kanakan tells Lilly and Thankam that based on the lucky draw, he has won the Chit Funds. But as soon as they come to know about it, they ask for their share to fulfill their wishes. Helpless Kanakan couldn't refuse but shared with them. Later a man visits Kanakan to ask for some money, but will Lilly and Thankam give up on their share to help the man? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Jasmine Flowers
episodesList.summary: After much pondering, Thambi finally finds a new job, but he hides it from her wife, Sulu, saying that he has got a job but didn't reveal where he has got the job. Sulu suspects that her husband, Thambi is having an extra-marital affair which makes her heavily disappointed as she gets a scent of Jasmine flowers from Thambi's shirt. Is Thambi really having an extra-marital affair? Find out to know more.

episodesList.title: The Speech
episodesList.summary: Takkuddu tells his mother that he has got a chance to give a speech in his school. On hearing this, his mom gets annoyed and stops talking to him till the time he backs off from giving the speech. Later Thankam's brother and his wife consoles her and pacifies her. Takkudu tells his mom that he removed his name from the list. What happens next? Find out to know more.

episodesList.title: Service Co-operation Bank Lilly
episodesList.summary: Thambi visits Lilly and gives her some money to keep it safe with her as she thinks that her wife, Sulu will spend all his earned money which he had earned from his acting classes, till Thambi asks for it. Later, Lilly gives that money to Kanakan to help his friend, Suresh, for his child's medical expenses. Later Thambi visits Lilly and asks for his money back as he has to give it to repay the loan which he took from a moneylender. Now what will Lilly do? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Kanakan's Ooty Trip
episodesList.summary: Ronald receives a message from Kanakan saying that he and his friends have been arrested by the Tamil Nadu Police for partying with a few girls in a hotel room in Ooty. He shares this news from Girirajan but hides it from the other family members. Later Thankam learns the truth from Ronald after getting at his back and consoles Lilly after informing her. After a while, Kanakan returns from the trip, but all are angry on him. What's the truth? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Fight for the Set Saree
episodesList.summary: Thankam and Girija, both of them selected the same few set sarees which were gifted to Ratnamma, because of which, they had an argument. Now the men of the house have decided to convince both of them to wear the set sarees or else Ratnamma had decide to donate it to Orphanage. Will the men succeed? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Girija's Chain Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Ronald asks for some money from Thankam which she refuses to give. Later Ronald visits Ratnamma thinking that she might agree to give money but is a bit doubtful. Later when he comes to know that Amma is getting ready to collect pension from the bank, that's when he agrees to join her. Meanwhile Girija keeps the chain on the table of her room and goes to take bath. After returning, she notices that her chain goes missing and later calls Lilly and Thankam to search for it. Thankam raises doubt that Ronald might have stolen it to get some hard cash in exchange of that. Does her suspicion come out to be true? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Fear of Girija's Anger
episodesList.summary: Ronald informs Thankam that Girirajan felt unconscious and has been sent to the hospital. On return, they informed the family members that it was due to weakness and so they suggested him to do a few physical exercises. Girirajan refuses but Girija warns him that if he doesn't follow, she will impose stricter restrictions on him. Later Girija finds a stick in Girirajan's shirt's pocket which later Lilly identifies it as a smoke weed. What happens next? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Men of Kerala Association
episodesList.summary: Ronald has plans to start an association having all the men of Kerala who are tired of their wife's tantrum and his association aims to solve the problems of the men. Will he succeed in this movement? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Who Gets to Have the Dosa Pan?
episodesList.summary: Lilly, on Thankam's behest, purchases a Dosa Pan for her from a salesgirl who's very young. Later, Girirajan reveals that Lilly has been cheated by that girl as Girirajan purchased a similar dosa pan for even lesser price. On hearing this, Thankam refuses to take the pan from Lilly and also decides not to repay her for the pan she purchased. Who gets to have the pan? Will Thankam accept it? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Scooter Needs a Repair
episodesList.summary: Kanakan, who takes pride and good care of his scooter, find out that his scooter isn't working properly. Voluntarily, Ronald promises to Kanakan that he'll fix his scooter as soon as possible. Will Ronald succeed? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Movie Review
episodesList.summary: Ronald, in order to earn some money, decides to open his YouTube channel for reviewing the movies. Everything was going well, later his greediness takes over him. Now what will happen? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Ratnamma's Fear
episodesList.summary: Ratnamma's friend visits her for the last time before leaving this city as her children does not treat her properly. On hearing this, Ratnamma starts to worry, whether her children and her family would treat her in the same manner as her friend was treated. Later, Kanakan (who left early without meeting Ratnamma), Lilly, Thankam, Takkuddu and Ronald couldn't pay attention to her as they were busy with their work. How will the family members console Ratnamma? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Ronald Takes up the Job of Loading and Unloading Goods
episodesList.summary: Ronald receives a phone call from Rosemary, who requests financial assistance to settle an overdue electricity bill, which has led to a power outage at his residence. In response, Ronald seeks monetary help from his relatives, but only Lilly offers support. Upon noticing the money in Ronald's possession, Kanakan chastises him for frequently relying on family for financial aid. This prompts Ronald to accept a job involving the loading and unloading of goods at a vegetable shop, which pleases Kanakan as he observes Ronald's newfound work ethic. However, as news of Ronald's situation spreads, his family members begin to feel sympathy for him. Tune in to discover more!

episodesList.title: Where is Ratnamma's Phone?
episodesList.summary: Lilly and Kanakan leaves from their home to attend a wedding. Lilly informs Amma that she has prepared the rice but couldn't find the time to make the curry, so she suggests Amma to go to Thankam's place to have the food from there. Later Thankam gets a call from Cleatus asking her to get his important document, leaving Amma, Takkuddu and Ronald behind. Amma reprimands Takkuddu for taking her mobile phone and snatches it away. Later she kept it away from his reach, near the windowsill in the kitchen but later it goes missing from there. Everyone suspects Takkuddu. Has he lost or damaged Amma's phone? Watch the episode to know more!

episodesList.title: Ronald's Plan Goes in Vain
episodesList.summary: Thankam becomes upset with Lilly after she instructs her to remain silent so that the Ladies Meeting can proceed. Subsequently, a sister named Mini visits Lilly to provide a loan for her husband's medical treatment. Ronald discovers the truth about Mini's deception from Sister Omana who had spoken ill of her. Ronald's intention is to expose Mini's dishonesty in front of Lilly and Kanakan the following day when she comes to collect the loan, aiming to impress them. Meanwhile, Thankam secretly learns the full story from Ronald, who was overheard discussing the incident and his plan to reveal it over the phone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: The Ladies' Conversational Gathering
episodesList.summary: When Thankam, Lilly and Takkuddu were returning from the temple, they met Sister Omana, who's heading to meet one of their acquaintances, who are dealing with their family problems. On hearing this, Thankam and Lilly requests Omana to come to their place to give them updates after meeting them. Once Omana reaches, she tells the story to Lilly, Thankam and Ratnamma! What happens next? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Ratnamma Gets Into an Argument With Lilly
episodesList.summary: Ratnamma admonishes Lilly for her negligence in leaving the gas stove on while the rice cooker is preparing the rice. Subsequently, in an effort to support Amma, Thankam engages in a dispute with Lilly, which disturbs Kanakan's tranquility. Eventually, news of Kanakan's unexpected transfer spreads among everyone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to discover more!

episodesList.title: Ronald Demands for a Scooter
episodesList.summary: Thankam and Lilly ask Ronald to purchase some grocery items, but he returns home late, causing frustration among everyone. He proposes that if they buy him a scooter, he will be able to complete his errands quickly, thus saving both time and money. Will they agree to his request? Watch now to discover more!

episodesList.title: Just One Look at Me
episodesList.summary: Akshaya calls Thankam requesting her to ask someone to pick her up from the hostel as all of her friends have gone to their parent's place for a few days. Thankam, at first relucted, later Lilly convinced her to allow her to come back from the hostel. Later, Sulu's cousin brother, Lallu, learns the news of Akshaya's return and is wanting her to see once! Will his dream be fulfilled? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Thankam and Cleatus Argue With Each Other
episodesList.summary: Thankam chastises Cleatus for spending the funds that were specifically set aside for Akshaya's hostel and tuition fees on his party expenses. As a result, they have chosen to live apart and refrain from communicating. What will be the resolution of their conflict? Discover the outcome!

episodesList.title: Akshaya Centre
episodesList.summary: Kanakan expresses his intention to establish an Akshaya Centre, not in the name of his wife, Lilly, but rather in the name of her sister, Thankam. This revelation leaves Lilly feeling disheartened and troubled, however, Kanakan eventually persuades her to see his perspective. Subsequently, both Lilly and Kanakan come to the realization that Thankam does not meet the necessary criteria to qualify as a candidate for opening the Akshaya Centre, which makes her feel upset. Will Kanakan succeed in launching the Akshaya Centre? If so, under whose name will it be registered? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Rising Heatwave
episodesList.summary: Thankam requests a new table fan from Cleatus, as the existing fan in their room is inoperative and the rising heatwave is making it difficult for them to sleep. She hands Cleatus 2000 Rupees to purchase a new fan, but he instead brings back a fan that has been unused at Girirajan's residence. When Thankam asks for a refund, Cleatus refuses, claiming he used the money to fulfill his party obligations. However, it later comes to light that he had actually given the money to settle a debt. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Breaking the Fast
episodesList.summary: A distressed woman seeks assistance from Cleatus, hoping he will confront the moneylender who has threatened to evict her and her two children. Regrettably, Cleatus declines to help because of avenging his revenge against her former husband for deceiving Cleatus. Observing her sorrow and disappointment, Thankam and Lilly devise a strategy to provide financial support to the woman. Will their plan be successful? Discover the outcome!

episodesList.title: Ethakka Appam With Beef Fry
episodesList.summary: When Kanakan, Lilly and Ratnamma were trying to pacify Thankam and Cleatus as they were arguing with each other, on the other hand, Girirajan and Girija Ammayi were arguing with each together while coming to their place, as Girija refused to have Beef Fry and Pazham Poori, a combination which only a few Keralites like. That's when the men of the house decided to give the ladies of the house, a taste of this combination. Will they succeed? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Half Price Scam
episodesList.summary: In the initial scene, Girirajan and Thankam engage in a dispute over a minor issue. Subsequently, news of the Half Price Scheme spreads, voluntarily prompting Girirajan to give Lilly 1000 Rupees to purchase a coupon worth 3000 Rupees. Witnessing this, Thankam feels envious and urges Cleatus to ask Girirajan for an additional 1000 Rupees to obtain her own coupon. Will Girirajan extend his generosity to Thankam as well? Discover the outcome!

episodesList.title: Addiction Free Kerala Campaign
episodesList.summary: Members of the DDT Party, in collaboration with opposition party members, have initiated a campaign aimed at educating the youth about the dangers of illegal drug use for their own well-being. Meanwhile, Lilly, Thankam, and other Kudumbashree members are visiting the nearby neighborhood to promote this initiative. During their outreach, they encounter a woman who appears to be in distress but conceals her situation from them. Will she seek their assistance? Discover the outcome!

episodesList.title: Lilly's Secretary Position at Stake
episodesList.summary: Thankam informs everyone that Lilly failed to perform her duties as the Secretary of the Kudambashree Group and might be expelled from the position of Secretary and Thankam has a higher chance of regaining her position. That's when Ronald comes up with a plan to save Lilly. Will his plan work? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: A Trip to Munnar
episodesList.summary: Ronald receives information from a friend who claims to have seen Cleatus and Kanakan in Munnar. Thankam and Lilly find it hard to believe that they might be betraying them instead of fulfilling their work obligations. Is Ronald's account accurate? Are Kanakan and Cleatus being dishonest with their families? Uncover the truth!

episodesList.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 1
episodesList.summary: While playing, Nallu and Saiyyu noticed that Ratnamma appeared sad and disheartened, and they suspected that she might have been crying. They inquired about her feelings, but Ratnamma chose not to share the truth with them. Later, Thankam also noticed her distress and posed the same question, yet Ratna Amma again withheld her feelings. Eventually, during lunch, Ratnamma opened up to everyone about her disappointment. Shortly after, two unexpected guests arrived at Kanakan's residence, seeking information about Cleatus. Upon their arrival, Cleatus appeared visibly distressed. Who are these visitors, and what has caused Cleatus's unease? Uncover the details to find out more!

episodesList.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 2
episodesList.summary: Tom and Jessy, an eloped couple, seek refuge, triggering comedic attempts to hide them. The episode focuses on the humorous situations and the family's efforts to maintain secrecy from others.

episodesList.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 3
episodesList.summary: The eloped couple's presence creates legal and political worries, given their influential families. A politician's statement adds tension. The episode follows the family's attempts to manage the situation, ending with the couple's departure.

episodesList.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 4
episodesList.summary: The family focuses on convincing the eloped couple to leave their refuge. The episode is filled with comedic situations and dialogues as the family attempts to solve the problem and get the couple to leave.

episodesList.title: The Vishu Celebrations
episodesList.summary: On the fortunate occasion of Vishu, a young girl arrives at Kanakan's home inquiring about his whereabouts from his family. Regrettably, Kanakan is not at home and will be returning late from work. Upon learning this, the girl chooses to remain there until she can meet him. Subsequently, Ronald discloses a startling revelation about the girl to his family. What prompts this mysterious girl's visit? What is her motive for wanting to see Kanakan? Discover the answers to these questions!

episodesList.title: The Armchair
episodesList.summary: Ronald, inebriated, occupies the armchair at Kanakan's residence. Upon noticing this, Girirajan admonishes him, stating that only he and Kanakan, following Kanakan's father, are permitted to use the armchair. Ronald, feeling offended by this trivial matter, engages in a dispute with Girirajan and declares his intention to never return. What unfolds next? Stay tuned to discover more!

episodesList.title: The Missing Blue Churidar
episodesList.summary: Two representatives from a charitable organization visited the homes to collect unused clothing and solicit donations from both households. As Lilly and Thankam were occupied with their domestic tasks, they asked the men to return at a later time. Upon their return, Lilly donated her old clothes and proceeded to Thankam's residence to retrieve the garments that Thankam had placed on the table. After the men departed, Thankam inquired about a missing blue churidar that she had set aside for alterations, which had been given to her by a friend. Eventually, Thankam realizes that Lilly inadvertently included that churidar with her old clothes when she donated them. Will they be able to retrieve it from the charity, or will Thankam need to compensate her friend? Discover the outcome!

episodesList.title: The Buttermilk
episodesList.summary: Ronald asked Thankam for some food to satisfy his hunger; however, she declined his request due to a dispute with Cleatus, which resulted in the spices she was sautéing being burned. Subsequently, Thankam's creditor, Sister Savitri, visited her to collect the money owed, but Thankam was unable to repay the debt as Cleatus had taken the funds. She then asked Ronald to provide an excuse, but in his pursuit of making some money, Ronald deceived Thankam. Shortly thereafter, seeking to quench his thirst, Ronald went out in search of buttermilk but was unable to find any. He eventually made some at home, but soon experienced loose motions. What could be the cause of this? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Thankam's Birthday Celebration
episodesList.summary: Thankam shares her wish with Cleatus to visit a temple and enjoy breakfast from outside in celebration of her upcoming birthday. Cleatus promptly agrees to fulfill his wife's request. Upon their return, when questioned about their outing, Cleatus discloses that it was Thankam's birthday. This revelation surprises everyone, particularly Kanakan, who had forgotten the occasion, further upsetting Thankam, especially since she was already feeling the absence of Akshaya. Meanwhile, Takkuddu finds himself in trouble after creating a mess. How will they resolve this situation? How will Kanakan make amends with Thankam? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Teaching Thambi a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Thambi, eager to evict his new tenants, a police officer and his wife, employs various strategies to achieve his goal, yet all his attempts prove futile. It is at this point that the police team devises a scheme to intimidate Thambi and teach him a lesson. Will they be successful? Discover the outcome!

episodesList.title: Swapping Identities
episodesList.summary: Thankam notifies Lilly that a young woman from the Microfinance bank is scheduled to arrive today to collect the chit funds. Thankam is anxious upon learning that Sister Sulu failed to repay Thankam with the necessary funds, as she doesn't have money, leaving her unable to pay the full amount to the young woman. Subsequently, the young woman arrives at Thankam's residence to collect the chit funds. In response, Thankam decides to assume Lilly's identity, informing the young woman that Thankam (who's actually Lily), has stepped out for an errand and will return late in the evening. However, the young woman insists on receiving the complete payment before leaving. How will Thankam manage to settle the total amount with the young woman? Stay tuned for further developments!

episodesList.title: A Big Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Ronald has noticed that in recent days, whenever Thambi, Sulu's husband, and Sufi, Mammootty's wife, leave the house, they engage in secret conversations. He communicates this observation to the other residents and subsequently informs Thambi and Sufi. How will they respond? What is the reality behind this? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Ronald Causes a Trouble Again
episodesList.summary: Thankam urged Ronald to promptly withdraw cash from the nearby ATM; however, Ronald was reluctant to undertake this task due to his aching legs. After considerable persuasion, he consented to go, opting to either take a rickshaw or use Kanakan's scooter. Initially, Lilly was hesitant to lend the scooter to Ronald, but she eventually relented after he assured her that he would not cause any damage. However, upon exiting the ATM, Ronald discovered the scooter lying on the roadside, resulting in minor damage. He reassured Lilly and Thankam that he would repair the scooter. Will he manage to finish this task before Kanakan returns? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Cleatus Gets Into Trouble
episodesList.summary: Cleatus is presented with an opportunity to appear on a news channel for a contentious debate against the opposition party, which had colluded with a road contractor responsible for a road accident due to negligence. However, he soon finds himself in a predicament upon discovering that the allegations he made against both the party and the contractor were unfounded. What will unfold next? Stay tuned for more details!

episodesList.title: The Story of the Marriage Ring
episodesList.summary: The ex-fiancé of Thankam, who was set to marry her, came to her home to reclaim the ring that her mother had given to her. Unfortunately, Thankam cannot remember where she had kept the ring. After extensive questioning from all the household members, Lilly proposes that Kanakan should inquire with Girirajan as well, believing he may have information regarding its whereabouts. What happens next? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: An Imposter in Disguise
episodesList.summary: One morning, Sufi's youngest sister, Surmi, arrives at Sufi's place to surprise her but instead got a surprise when she learnt that they aren't at home. Thankam calls her to her place to rest and wait till they come. Susbsequently, Lilly arrives and insisted her to stay at her place. Later, Thankam and Lilly leave for the Kudumbashree meeting (Ladies Meeting), leaving Takkuddu behind. When they came back, they found her to be missing. What happens next? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: The Job as an Aanganwadi Helper
episodesList.summary: Both Girija and Thankam convey their eagerness to engage in work rather than idly spending their time after finishing household tasks. The following day, Thankam visits the Aanganwadi Centre for some work and is presented with an opportunity to serve as an Aanganwadi helper. She shares this news with Kanakan, anticipating that Cleatus would decline. Girija asserts that if Thankam is unable to accept the position, she is willing to take it, however, both of their husbands oppose this. Who will ultimately seize this opportunity? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Missing Induction Cooker
episodesList.summary: One morning, Sister Sulu approached Lilly to request a gas cylinder for cooking purposes. However, Lilly was unable to assist as her own gas cylinder was nearly empty. Instead, she lent Sister Sulu, Sufi's Induction Cooker to help her until a new gas cylinder could be obtained. Later, Sulu and Thambi returned to inform Lilly that the Induction Cooker had been stolen. Who could be responsible for the theft? How will Lilly explain this situation to Sufi? Tune in to discover the full story!

episodesList.title: The Friendly Avengers
episodesList.summary: Cleatus and Ronald informs the household members that two people were after them, and in order to save themselves from getting bashed up, they run for their lives, leaving the ladies and Takkuddu behind. After a while, the two men arrive in search of Cleatus. With Kanakan's absence, the ladies try to pacify the men to come back later as Cleatus was not there, but they resisted to stay back unless they teach Cleatus a lesson! How will the ladies manage to pacify the two men? Watch now to know the story!

episodesList.title: A Sip of Redemption for Thankam
episodesList.summary: The narrative commences with distressing news conveyed by Appu Kuttan Sir to Cleatus, informing him of Natarajan's sudden heart attack, which has left him on a ventilator in the hospital. Subsequently, Natarajan clarifies the situation. During this time, Lilly ridicules Thankam for never having offered even a cup of tea to Ansar and Natarajan during their visits to Cleatus. In an effort to counter Lilly's claim, Thankam extends an invitation for them to enjoy a cup of tea. Will Thankam resolve the dispute by disproving Lilly's assertion? Discover the outcome!

episodesList.title: Surmi Gets Blackmailed
episodesList.summary: The narrative commences with Surmi, the younger sister of Sufi, who is in a state of distress after being blackmailed by an individual. This person had spiked her drink, taken unauthorized photographs, and recorded videos of her, subsequently demanding money to prevent the release of this content on social media. Surmi was not in a suitable mental state to confide in Lilly and Thankam, prompting Sufi to inform them of the situation so that Kanakan could step in and provide assistance. How will Kanakan apprehend the perpetrator, ensure he faces consequences for his actions, and safeguard Surmi's dignity from being compromised? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Girija's Love for Poetry
episodesList.summary: The entire household appears taken aback by Girija's transformation, as she begins sharing poetry on social media. The following morning, Girirajan arrives, visibly concerned about Girija's abrupt change in behavior. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

episodesList.title: Why is Thankam Upset?
episodesList.summary: The narrative commences with Cleatus, Thankam, Takkuddu, and Lilly as they prepare to attend a wedding. Upon their return, Thankam appears to be distressed and is uncommunicative. What might be the cause of this demeanor? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Summer Camp
episodesList.summary: The narrative commences with Thankam expressing her frustration over the children constantly watching television. Upon abruptly turning it off, Takkuddu retaliates with a vulgar remark, inciting anger in her and others. The family resolves to send the children to a summer camp, but the kids refuse. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

episodesList.title: Ansar Gets a Second-Hand Car
episodesList.summary: The narrative commences as Ansar acquires a pre-owned vehicle and reaches Cleatus's home. Upon noticing the car, Kanakan ridicules Cleatus for lacking a vehicle. This provokes Cleatus, who, accompanied by Ronald, visits a second-hand car dealership to purchase a car. Will he succeed in buying a car and disproving Kanakan? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Girirajan Saves the Day
episodesList.summary: The story commences with Thankam waking up Takkuddu and sending him to the Summer Camp. Upon his return, Thankam notices that there are red marks on his hands. On questioning, Takkuddu makes excuses and walks away. Later, Thankam learns the truth and informs Lilly about it. Meanwhile Sulu informs Girirajan about this incident and decides to handle the situation. Will he succeed in fulfilling the task? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Thankam's Grand Pretence
episodesList.summary: Thankam and Cleatus gets involved in a fight where Thankam accuses Cleatus of abusing her physically. Everyone gets highly upset on knowing this and express their anger towards him. How will Cleatus save himself from everyone's wrath? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Frock Nighty
episodesList.summary: One morning, Girija Ammayi returns to Kanakan's place after attending the opening ceremony of her friend's store. On her way back, she had purchased three Frock Nighties for the ladies of the house, except for Ratnamma, which makes her feel sad and disappointed. Earlier, unaware of the reason behind her sadness, when Girija asked, Ratnamma opened up and expressed her desire for a Frock Nighty. Will the household members agree to buy one for her? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Cleatus Experiences Severe Itching
episodesList.summary: While traveling by bus to a party event in Kozhikode, Cleatus experiences severe itching. He decides to broadcast a live video to express his discomfort. However, he soon faces difficulties when his assertions are proven to be untrue. How will Cleatus extricate himself from this predicament? What might be the cause of his intense itching? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Lilly is the Star
episodesList.summary: One morning, Lilly receives a phone call from Cleatus, who informs her of an opportunity to perform with her students at a nearby upcoming shoot. Seizing this chance, Lilly starts rehearsing the dance performance with her students. Will she achieve the recognition and fame she desires? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: A Dispute Between the Mother-In-Law and Daughter-In-Law
episodesList.summary: One morning, Sister Omana pays a visit to Ratnamma to inquire about her health. Following an extensive discussion, she encounters Lilly and incites her against Ratnamma by spreading negative remarks about her. Upon hearing this, Lilly becomes very distressed and confronts Ratnamma, leading to a conflict between them. How will their misunderstanding be uncovered? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Kids' Vishu Money
episodesList.summary: As is customary, Cleatus and Ronald find themselves in urgent need of funds. Subsequently, they discover that the children have not yet utilized the money they received during the Vishu Celebrations. The two devise a strategy to determine who will acquire the money. Who will emerge victorious? Read on to find out more!

episodesList.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 1
episodesList.summary: This episode opens with Girirajan alerting Cleatus to the absence of his farm helper, who has also taken some money. The team heads to the Red Spinach farm in search of him, but to their disappointment, he is not found. After returning to Kanakan's home, Lilly and Thankam have a confrontation. Later, Girirajan gets a call from his missing farm helper. What unfolds in the next part? Keep watching to find out!

episodesList.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 2
episodesList.summary: In the latter segment of this episode, Cleatus admonishes Kishanchand, the newly appointed Bengali farm assistant employed by Girirajan, for failing to inform everyone about his location. Subsequently, a small group of Bengali workers organizes a protest at the farm, prompting Girirajan and Cleatus to leave in order to address the situation, but they end up being captured. Where has Kishanchand disappeared to? What consequences will Girirajan and Cleatus face if he cannot be located? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: A Meeting of Love and Friendship
episodesList.summary: Cleatus, together with his DDT Party Members, has chosen to initiate a campaign with the assistance of the opposition party. Conversely, Shashi, the leader of the RDP Party and Cleatus's rival, is strategizing his own plans. Subsequently, at home, the children engage in a dispute among themselves, which is then joined by Thankam and Lilly. After addressing these issues, Girirajan receives a call informing him of Cleatus's arrest. What will transpire next? Stay tuned to discover more!

episodesList.title: Spilled Mustard: Sowing Seeds of Strife
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ratnamma was preparing a dish in the kitchen when she asked Lilly to hand her the mustard seeds. By mistake, Lilly dropped some mustard seeds on the floor. Ratnamma remarked that the spilled mustard seeds would lead to disputes within the household. She indicated that Lilly was bound to have an argument, but Lilly, determined to disprove Ratnamma's assertions, promised not to engage in any fights that day. Will she succeed in her challenge and refute both Ratnamma and the age-old superstition? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Red Spinach - The Root Cause of the Problem
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ratnamma requests the farm helper to provide her with several bundles of Red Spinach. Upon observing this, Girirajan reprimands Ratnamma for her request. Disheartened and furious, she departs from the scene. Later, upon returning home, she resolves to cut off her relationship with Girirajan due to his disrespectful behavior in front of the farm helpers. Girirajan arrives at her home and attempts various methods to soothe her, yet she remains resolute in her decision. How will Girirajan manage to appease Ratnamma and restore their relationship? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Mischievous Little Thief
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam was preparing Takkuddu's bag to send him to the Summer Tuition Classes, however Takkuddu pleaded with his mother not to send him. After considerable persuasion, just as they were about to depart, they realized that one pair of their footwear was missing. Meanwhile, while Kanakan and Lilly were on their way back home, they encountered Takkuddu's teacher, who expressed his concerns regarding his behavior to them. The following day, even Kanakan's one pair of footwear went missing! Who could be responsible for this theft? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Cleatus Lands Ronald In Trouble
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus found himself in urgent need of 500 Rupees and asked Thankam for assistance. However, Thankam declined his request, explaining that she did not possess sufficient funds to help him. While on his way to a party function in Kollam, Cleatus encountered Ronald and inquired if he could lend him money, but Ronald also lacked the necessary funds. Subsequently, Cleatus formulated a scheme that placed Ronald in a difficult position. How will he extricate himself from this predicament? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The God in Disguise
episodesList.summary: One morning, when Girirajan and Thankam reaches home after returning from the temple, Lilly notices that Thankam's chain is missing! Despite an extensive search, they were unable to locate the chain, leaving Thankam feeling extremely disappointed and sorrowful. Will she be able to recover her chain? Watch now to learn more!

episodesList.title: Ronald Foils the Plan
episodesList.summary: One morning, Lilly's friend notifies her of her visit aimed at addressing her husband's alcohol addiction. Lilly conveyed to Thankam and Ronald that her friend has a tendency to boast about her lifestyle in front of others, often comparing herself to them and, as a result, insulting them. Will their plan be successful? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Ratnamma Teaches Everyone a Lesson
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ratnamma receives a phone call from Girirajan, notifying her of the death of her close friend. She asked either Lilly, Thankam, or Ronald to accompany her, but none were available. Subsequently, she contacts Girirajan to come and pick her up. Upon their return, Ratnamma begins to suffer from intense stomach pain! Now, who will be willing to accompany her and Girirajan to the hospital? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Kudumbashree Club's Chair
episodesList.summary: One morning, Lilly receives a phone call notifying her that Cleatus has not yet returned the chairs he borrowed from her, which belong to the Kudumbashree Community. Lilly and Thankam ask him to return them today, and he was somewhat persuaded. At that moment, Kanakan intervened, which infuriated Cleatus, leading him to declare that he would not return the chairs under any circumstances! Now it is a showdown between Kanakan and Cleatus. Who will emerge victorious? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: A Morning Walk Gone Wrong
episodesList.summary: One morning, Lilly and Thankam returned home after undergoing examinations at the Medical Check-up Camp. Lilly's results were normal, but Thankam's cholesterol and sugar levels were elevated! Upon learning this, Girirajan informed Thankam that she needed to take early morning walks, where she encountered a 70-year-old man with whom she would walk and converse daily. What unfolds next? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Akshaya Returns From Her Hostel
episodesList.summary: Everyone is thrilled about Akshaya's return tomorrow. Regrettably, Cleatus is unavailable as he has a meeting with an individual in Coimbatore regarding a new business opportunity. Upon learning this, Thankam becomes quite upset and begins to criticize Cleatus. Will he consent to join? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Why is Akshaya Silent?
episodesList.summary: Since Akshaya's return from the hostel, she has not been communicating effectively with Thankam. Subsequently, she confides in Lilly and Ratnamma. How will Thankam respond upon discovering the truth? Stay tuned to find out more!

episodesList.title: Tickets for Thudarum Movie
episodesList.summary: One morning, at the request of the children, Kanakan purchases six tickets for the Thudarum movie. Later, when Lilly inquires why he booked one ticket fewer, he explains that he did not include Ronald in the count. How will Ronald respond upon discovering this? Read on to find out more!

episodesList.title: The Complaint
episodesList.summary: One morning, as Cleatus was leaving for work, a woman approached him inquiring about Kanakan's residence. When Cleatus inquired about her purpose, she explained the situation, prompting him to take matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Thankam observed this from a distance and was entirely opposed to Cleatus assisting the woman. What could be the underlying reason for this? Will Cleatus ultimately decide to help her? Watch now to find out more!

episodesList.title: Ronald's Prediction
episodesList.summary: One morning, Akshaya asked Thankam to keep her promise of preparing a special dish that she had mentioned while Akshaya was in the hostel. Unfortunately, Thankam was unable to fulfill this promise due to a lack of funds to purchase the required ingredients. At that moment, Ronald predicts that Thankam will receive some money today. Will his prediction prove to be accurate? Watch now to find out more!

episodesList.title: Thankam and Lilly's Scuffle
episodesList.summary: One morning, during a conversation between Thankam and Lilly, they found themselves in a dispute, each defending their respective brothers, which caused distress among others. How will their conflict resolve? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: Akshaya Wears a Saree
episodesList.summary: One morning, Akshaya asks Thankam if she can borrow one of her sarees, as she and her friends are going to a wedding ceremony of a friend. Will Thankam permit her to wear a saree? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Akshaya's Marriage Plans
episodesList.summary:
One morning, while Thankam, Lilly, and Sulu were engaged in conversation, Cleatus returned home feeling disheartened. Despite Thankam's persistent inquiries about the cause of his sorrow, Cleatus declined to share. What could be troubling him? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: A Hundred Ways of Earning Money
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam receives a call reminding her to pay the amount for the chit funds. Unfortunately, she did not have any money since Cleatus took it when he left for Coimbatore to meet the party's requirements. Consequently, she inquired with Lilly, but Lilly also lacked sufficient funds to assist her. It was at this point that she approached Ronald, and to her astonishment, he provided her with the money. However, the source of Ronald's funds remains a mystery. Discover more to find out.

episodesList.title: The Marriage Alliance
episodesList.summary: One morning, as Lilly was on her way to her dance class, she encounters Sister Omana, who previously attempted to sow discord between Lilly and Ratnamma during her last visit. Sister Omana first greets Lilly, then visits Ratnamma at her residence, offering apologies to both. Subsequently, she discloses that she has identified an ideal bride for a young man residing just a few houses away. Will she be able to successfully arrange their marriage alliance? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Meeting the Girl
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus encounters Shashi, the matchmaker, who persistently urges Cleatus to meet several potential grooms for her daughter, Akshaya. Upon hearing this, Cleatus becomes irritated and insults him. This provokes Shashi's anger. What will he do next? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Ronald's Craving for Sharjah
episodesList.summary: One morning, all the household members except Thankam, Akshaya and Ronald have gone to attend a wedding. Meanwhile, Akshaya prepares two glasses of Sharjah for both her and Thankam. Surprisingly Ronald, who was in deep sleep, got up and demanded for a glass of Sharjah, but they couldn't give him as they were out of supplies. On hearing this, Ronald gets angry and challenges them that he'll have a glass of Sharjah today at any cost! Will he prove them wrong? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Cleatus's Foolishness
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus receives an unexpected call from someone named Ashraf—but he lets it ring and chooses not to answer. Shortly after, another call comes in, this time from Ansar. Strangely, Cleatus ignores that too. Why is Cleatus avoiding them both? What’s really going on? Dive in to uncover the mystery behind his unusual behavior!

episodesList.title: The Motherly Love
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam and Akshaya were getting ready to visit Cleatus's father. Thankam wished for Takkuddu to join them, but he declined. Despite numerous attempts to convince him, he remained steadfast in his refusal. Later that evening, he found it difficult to sleep as he longed for his mother and began to throw tantrums, expressing his desire for her presence. How will the family cope with this situation? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Tuition Teacher
episodesList.summary: One morning, as Kanakan, Girirajan, and Cleatus were preparing to enjoy some leisure time together, a saleslady arrived at their home to offer a selection of household goods. Just as she was about to depart, she noticed Kanakan and identified him. Kanakan also recognized her, as they had attended the same school together. What happens next in the story? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: Cleatus's Smartness
episodesList.summary: In this episode, we will observe how Cleatus employs his intelligence to resolve a conflict between two brothers. Will he be successful? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Akshaya Wants to Use Ratnamma's New Phone
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ratnamma's friend 's son gifts her a new phone that he had bought in Dubai. Upon witnessing this, Akshaya speculates that she may have the opportunity to use the new phone since her grandmother may struggle to operate it effectively. Will her speculation prove to be accurate? Watch now to find out more!

episodesList.title: Natarajan's Bangalore Trip
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus receives a phone call notifying him of Natarajan's apprehension by the Karnataka Police. The revelation leaves everyone in shock. What circumstances prompted his arrest? Will Cleatus come to his aid despite facing criticism and damaging both his and the party's reputation? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Cleatus's Preparation for a Speech
episodesList.summary: One morning, Kanakan finds himself ensnared in a predicament when he realizes that he must secure funds to repay the loan for which he is a guarantor. Meanwhile, Cleatus is getting ready for a speech. Will this endeavor lead to success and bring him fame? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Akshaya's Hostel Mates Pays a Visit
episodesList.summary: One morning, all members of the household were engaged in preparing to welcome and serve Akshaya's hostel friends. Initially, only two friends were expected to arrive, but then a third girl, named Lekshmi, joined them, which caused Akshaya to feel anxious. What is the reason for Akshaya's concern regarding her visit? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Girirajan and the Goat
episodesList.summary: One morning, Girija arrives at the homes of Kanakan and Cleatus with a goat, astonishing everyone except for Girirajan, who was enraged because Girija had prohibited him from selling the goat. How will Girirajan dispose of the goat? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Dream Home
episodesList.summary: On a particular morning, Cleatus and Ansar arrive at a well-furnished house to assess it for Appukuttan's daughter-in-law, who is planning to relocate there. However, he later tells Cleatus that they are no longer keen on acquiring this property. Later, Cleatus shares details about the house with Thankam, which makes her enamored with it, prompting her to choose to move there for a duration of six months. Will the other members of the household allow Cleatus and his family to transition to their new residence? Find out to learn more!

episodesList.title: Thankam's Test for Kanakan
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam feels a sense of joy and pride as one of her acquaintances commends her for sewing the blouse exactly to her specifications. She shares this news with her family members, but none of them, including Kanakan, express any appreciation, leading her to question whether he still loves her as he once did. Is Thankam correct in her thoughts? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Mono Act
episodesList.summary: One morning, Nallu informs her mother that she is participating in a mono act and requires her assistance. However, Lilly, as a dance instructor, is unable to provide the necessary help. At that moment, she recommends that Nallu seek guidance from Uncle Thambi, who, as a theatre actor, may be able to assist her. Will Nallu successfully learn the mono act from Uncle Thambi and emerge victorious in the competition? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Akshaya Falls Ill
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam heads to her father-in-law's place to attend a veneration, leaving her kids at home. Akshaya takes on the duty of overseeing the household and looking after her younger brother while she is away, but the following day, Akshaya falls sick. What occurs next? Watch now to learn more!

episodesList.title: The House on Rent
episodesList.summary: One morning, Sulu found herself in distress over the possibility of eviction from the owner's house, along with Thambi, due to their failure to pay rent that was three months overdue. She approaches Thankam to ask if Kanakan could intervene in this situation and help prevent their eviction. In addition, Sulu mentions that the new tenant is a member of the police department. How will the family members manage to save them? Will Kanakan offer his help? Watch now to learn more!

episodesList.title: Best Secretary: A Tale of Two Women
episodesList.summary: One morning, Lilly receives a phone call from Mr. Dinesh Sir of the Kudumbashree Department, inviting her to accept the award for Best Secretary of the Year 2024-25. Upon hearing this news, Thankam feels disheartened and reaches out to Mr. Dinesh to express her perspective. Whose name will appear on that award? Lilly or Thankam? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Akshaya's Results
episodesList.summary: One morning, all the members of the household are disheartened because Akshaya has received low marks in her NEET Exam. Kanakan reassures Thankam, advising her not to dishearten or humiliate Akshaya by discussing her results, but rather to encourage her so that she can progress. How will the members of the household support Akshaya and help her feel comfortable? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Art of Loving
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ratnamma, feeling troubled, meets Thankam and discusses the argument between Lilly and Kanakan, which has led to their silence towards one another. At that moment, Thankam proposed that they consult a psychiatrist who could help resolve their issues. Will they both consent to meet her? Will their conflicts be resolved? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: A Death in the Prison!
episodesList.summary: One morning, Akshaya and Thankam attempt to persuade Cleatus to take them on an outing. To their surprise, Cleatus consents and requests them to also invite Kanakan and Lilly. Shortly thereafter, he receives a phone call notifying him of the arrest of one of his party members by Kanakan and the other police officers, which leads to a conflict. After some time, Ronald informs Lilly and Thankam that the individual arrested by the police has died in custody. Will Kanakan and his team be held accountable? What will unfold next? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Honest Thief
episodesList.summary: One morning, as Kanakan was preparing to leave for his duty, he discovered that his scooter was missing and began to search for it. Shortly thereafter, the household members were notified and joined him in the search for the scooter. Who would have the audacity to steal his scooter, especially that of a policeman? Discover more to learn the details!

episodesList.title: The Plan to Exact Revenge from Akshaya
episodesList.summary: One morning, two boys arrive at the homes of Kanakan and Cleatus, seeking Ronald's assistance to repair their scooter. After some time, when Akshaya and Takkuddu return, she spots the two boys and becomes anxious. What could be the cause of Akshaya's anxiety? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Kanakan’s Big Achievement
episodesList.summary: One morning, Lilly announces to everyone that Kanakan has received a special service medal. Upon hearing this news, all the members of the household are very pleased, except for Cleatus.

episodesList.title: The Forest Trip
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus departs for his excursion into the forest. Subsequently, the family receives news of an unidentified corpse, believed to have been killed by a group of Maoists, which the forest officials suspect to be Cleatus. What unfolds next? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Cleatus, Ronald, and Lilly’s Secret
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus, Ronald, and Lilly convene for a brief meeting during which Cleatus presents his concept for generating quick wealth, aiming for them to become millionaires shortly and astonish their family. Additionally, Cleatus and Ronald have resolved to relocate to Mumbai to accomplish this objective. Will they be successful? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Girirajan Falls in Trouble
episodesList.summary: One morning, Girirajan rushes to Kanakan's home, seeking assistance, as he has been accused of theft. Both Kanakan and Cleatus take charge of the situation and attempt to investigate. What unfolds next? Discover to learn more!

episodesList.title: Cleatus's Phone Addiction
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam makes Cleatus's preferred meal. When it was presented to Cleatus, who was engaged in a phone conversation, he ignored it and left. Subsequently, he treated Lilly, Girirajan, and the children in a comparable manner. Soon after, he became upset with Ronald for breaking his phone. What occurs next? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Wreath!
episodesList.summary: One morning, as Cleatus exited his residence to retrieve the newspaper, he noticed a wreath placed at his door. Upon seeing it, Cleatus became frightened and fainted. The whole household comforts Cleatus as he believes that his demise is imminent. Who was responsible for bringing that wreath? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Missing Iron Box
episodesList.summary: One morning, Kanakan calls for Lilly to inform her that she neglected to iron his police uniform, expressing his frustration as he is running late for a police function. Later, feeling exasperated, Kanakan decides to iron his clothes himself and requests the iron box from Lilly, as he is unable to locate it despite searching the entire room. Everyone begins to look for it, and that is when Lilly remembers that he had lent the iron box to Cleatus a few days prior. However, Cleatus informs them that he had given the iron box to Ronald for its return. Ronald asserts that he has already returned it. Where is the iron box? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Lilly Gets Accused of Theft
episodesList.summary: One morning, Lilly and Kanakan went to a store to purchase some clothing for Lilly. As they were about to leave, the shopkeepers halted them and asked for permission to inspect their bags. Upon searching, they discovered an item in Lilly's bag that they suspected was stolen. Rather than supporting Lilly, Kanakan chose to contact the police to have her apprehended. What prompted Lilly's actions? What unfolds next? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: The Great Charging War
episodesList.summary: One morning, as the family was occupied with their household duties, they faced repeated power interruptions that disrupted their usual routine. Akshaya, Ronald, and Cleatus's mobile devices ran out of battery and required prompt charging to accomplish their tasks. A quarrel ensued among them about whose phone should be prioritized for charging. Who will take advantage of this situation? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: QR Code Payment
episodesList.summary: One morning, while Girirajan was on his way to the bank to settle a payment, Ronald stepped in and recommended that he opt for an online payment instead of spending time in line at the bank. Girirajan appreciated this advice and sought assistance from Thankam to complete the transaction. After some time, Girirajan was notified by the bank that they had not received any funds from him. Where could the money have gone? Discover more to find out!

episodesList.title: Thambi's Alcohol Addiction
episodesList.summary: One morning, Sufi informs Thankam and Lilly about witnessing a heated argument between Sulu and Thambi due to Thambi's struggle with alcohol addiction, which has been causing unrest in the household. Concerned, Thankam and Lilly approach Kanakan for help. Kanakan then suggests to Sulu that he will devise a plan to send Thambi to a de-addiction center. Will their efforts prove successful? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Thambi Instigates Lilly and Thankam
episodesList.summary: One morning, as Thankam and Lilly were casually chatting, Thambi approached them with a suspicion—he believed Ronald was having an extra-marital affair with Sufi, the wife of Mamooty, a police officer and close friend of Kanakan. Initially, the ladies dismissed Thambi's claim, but soon they began to question Ronald's intentions. Could their doubts be valid? Dive in to uncover the truth!

episodesList.title: The Half Truth
episodesList.summary: One morning, as Lilly was leaving Thankam's residence to return home, she overheard Kanakan speaking with a woman on a phone call. This aroused her suspicion, and she confronted him about whom he was speaking to. Although Kanakan told her the truth, Lilly remained doubtful and suspected foul play. She shared her concerns with Thankam, and together they began seeking ways to uncover the truth. What unfolds next? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: The Unique Lucky Draw
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ronald launches his new business venture by selling unique lottery tickets that offer a fully furnished house as the grand prize for one lucky winner. He begins distributing the tickets and charging a small fee for each one, even selling one to Sulu. Later, the household members hear about this and want to participate, but Kanakan forbids them from joining. What happens next? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Motivational Class
episodesList.summary: One morning, the Senior Inspector announces that Kanakan has to lead a motivational class. Overjoyed by the news, Kanakan eagerly invites his family members for a demo session. Ronald, however, seizes the opportunity and slyly extorts some money from Kanakan to attend the demo. What happens next? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: The Veneration for Blessings
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus is thrilled to have the chance to invite a few kids to wash the feet and receive blessings from Appukuttan Sir. However, the opposition party leader, Shashi, stirs up trouble, causing all the invitees to decline. Determined, Cleatus decides to take his son, Takkuddu, to perform the veneration, but Kanakan objects upon discovering this. How will Cleatus handle this challenge? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Girirajan Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus, without informing anyone, went to meet Girirajan, who was waiting for him. While Cleatus stayed back to pay for the food Girirajan had taken, he suddenly heard a noise and saw Girirajan lying injured on the road after being hit by a bike ridden by an intoxicated driver. Despite knowing the situation, Cleatus hurled at the intoxicated biker, slapped him a few times, and reported the incident to the nearest police station. The following day, they learned that the boy had committed suicide, leading them to wonder if Cleatus's actions had driven him to take such an extreme step. Is this true? Will Girirajan and Cleatus face imprisonment? Find out to know more!

episodesList.title: Who Is That Lucky Person?
episodesList.summary: One evening, Cleatus arrived home late at night, intoxicated after spending time with Ansar and Natarajan. His behavior left the household members both disappointed and agitated, prompting them to decide to confront him the following morning once his hangover subsided. The next day, Thankam reprimanded him sternly. Shortly after, she discovered four lucky draw coupons, two of which turned out to be winning tickets. However, Cleatus denied ownership of the tickets. If they weren't his, then who is the fortunate winner? Uncover the mystery to find out!

episodesList.title: Ratnamma is Disappointed
episodesList.summary: One morning, Ratnamma was conversing with Nallu and Saiyyu when they both expressed their desire for a bicycle. Ratnamma, facing financial constraints, promised to buy them one later in the week after receiving her pension. She then noticed Cleatus returning home and called out to him, requesting repayment of the money he owed her. Cleatus calmly attempted to persuade Ratnamma to grant him a week’s extension, but Kanakan intervened, escalating the situation into a heated argument. As a result, both parties declared they would sever ties. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: The Ration Card
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam and Akshaya prepare to visit several colleges for Akshaya's higher education admissions. Before leaving, Thankam hands Ronald the ration card along with some money and instructs him to purchase a few kilograms of rice from the ration shop. On his way, Ronald encounters Girirajan and Girija and shares his errand with them. Girirajan then suggests having a small celebration with Ronald. After the party, Ronald discovers that Girirajan accidentally discarded the ration card along with the trash, which ended up in a nearby river. What happens next? Watch the full story to find out!

episodesList.title: The Failed Family Outing
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus excitedly shares the news of receiving some money and decides to treat his family, along with Lilly and Kanakan, to an outing. However, events take an unexpected turn when Cleatus is compelled to leave the cinema hall during the movie. What unfolds next? Tune in now to find out!

episodesList.title: A Twist in the Tale
episodesList.summary: One morning, a Bengali worker arrives at Cleatus's residence seeking repayment of his money. The household members inform him that Cleatus is out of town. Later that night, when Cleatus returns, Thankam confronts him and questions whether he had borrowed money from the Bengali worker. Cleatus vehemently denies the accusation, but Thankam struggles to believe him. Who is telling the truth? What unfolds next? Watch now to uncover the full story!

episodesList.title: The Culprit Catches the Culprit
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus becomes distressed upon discovering that someone has taken cash in his name, leaving him responsible for repayment. Choosing not to seek Kanakan's assistance, he enlists the help of Ansar, Natarajan, and Ronald to uncover the truth. After a thorough investigation, Ronald identifies the culprit. When he presents the photo to the entire household, they are left in utter shock. Who could it be? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: A Marriage Proposal for the Teacher
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam discovers that Takkuddu is struggling in several subjects and requires assistance from his teacher. Later, the teacher meets with Takkuddu to understand his challenges and identify areas where he is falling behind. Meanwhile, Girija consults with family members to seek their opinions on her suggestion to discuss her brother's proposal with the teacher. How will the teacher respond upon learning this? Watch now to find out more!

episodesList.title: Taking Care of Suresh's Mother
episodesList.summary: One morning, Kanakan and Suresh were discussing arrangements for Suresh's mother, as Suresh needed to leave town with his wife and children. Kanakan volunteered to accommodate Suresh's mother at his home, despite objections from his family, who were concerned due to her mental health issues. However, having given his word, Kanakan felt obligated to follow through. What unfolds when Suresh's mother arrives at Kanakan's residence? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: The Brother-in-Laws Creates a Mess
episodesList.summary:
One morning, Kanakan devises a prank involving Cleatus, Ronald, and Lilly. As Ronald approaches, they begin pretending to plan the construction of a small hall for Lilly's dance classes. Cleatus, suspecting this to be Kanakan's ploy to run his own business under Lilly's name, decides to counter by proposing the idea of building a tailor shop for Thankam to support her business. Both, unaware of each other's true intentions, find themselves caught in a web of complications. What happens next? Watch now to uncover the story!

episodesList.title: Cleatus Gets Suspected
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam requests Cleatus to arrange money to meet household and other essential needs. As usual, Cleatus is short on funds but assures her that he will soon find a way. Shortly after, Cleatus returns with some cash and brings food along with other household groceries. This raises suspicion among everyone, prompting questions about the source of the money. Will Cleatus's actions lead to trouble for those around him? Watch now to uncover the full story!

episodesList.title: The Ghost
episodesList.summary: One morning, Sulu informs Thankam of the passing of Thambi's mother. Moved by the news, Thankam offers comfort to Sulu. Later, Ratnamma also joins in to console Sulu and provide support. That night, Ratnamma, Ronald, and Thankam, at different times, witness the ghost of Thambi's mother. What exactly is happening? Could this be part of an elaborate scheme? Watch now to uncover the truth!

episodesList.title: The Brothers' Cunning Plan
episodesList.summary: One morning, Thankam, Kanakan, and Girirajan attempt to inspire Ronald to pursue a career in politics and become a great leader. Motivated by their supportive words, Ronald decides to step out and contribute to society. Unfortunately, he sustains an injury, and everyone at home notices this upon his return. Cleatus, angered by the situation, holds Kanakan and Girirajan accountable for Ronald's condition. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: The Onam Kits
episodesList.summary: One morning, Cleatus informs Girirajan and Ratnamma that, as in previous years, he has organized several Onam Kits to be distributed to the Bengali workers for their Onam celebrations. However, Natarajan, tasked with arranging the kits, procures something entirely different, leading to Cleatus confronting the shop manager responsible for the mix-up. When a video of Cleatus's argument goes viral, it raises the question: will this incident bring him fame or shame? Discover the unfolding events to find out more!

episodesList.title: The Profit Sharing Scheme
episodesList.summary: One morning, during a discussion about the Kudumbashree Community, Lilly proposed her idea of profit sharing, which sparked disapproval from Thankam and escalated into a heated argument. Curious to know what unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

episodesList.title: Uthradam: The Ninth Day of Onam
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the household is engrossed in the preparations for the ninth day of Onam and is simultaneously making arrangements for the tenth and final day of the festival.
