episodesList.summary: Princess Yasmine goes out on her conquest to find and capture the bald guy and somehow reaches the mastermind behind everything through him. Aladdin convinces Genie to go back inside the magic lamp and takes it to Zafar for the exchange, not having any clue about Zafar's plan to take the lamp and capture the Black Thief.

episodesList.title: Escapades
episodesList.summary: Zafar is furious when he finds out that the Black Thief has escaped. Aladdin and Yasmine are captured by the bald man and are handcuffed to each other. Zafar gets the news of the Black Thief being captured by the bald man, so he decides to go there himself. While Yasmine waits in captivity to confront the Moustache Mastermind, Aladdin plans to escape.

episodesList.title: The Secret Saviour
episodesList.summary: Aladdin yet again escapes from the Bald Man's confinement with Princess Yasmine. The Bald Man then calls out his crows and sends them to pursue Aladdin and lead them into his trap. Aladdin and Yasmine get trapped in the Bald Man's trap.

episodesList.title: The Magic Carpet
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Princess Yasmine are trapped inside a cage and Zafar is on his way to get the magic lamp from the black thief, so Aladdin somehow sets fire around the cage preventing Zafar from entering the area. Just when Aladdin's mother is about to get arrested for not paying the money lenders, a secret savior gives her some money and saves the day.

episodesList.title: A Father's Cry
episodesList.summary: The Jinn with a twist of his wrists turns an ordinary carpet into a magic carpet, with the help of which Aladdin escapes with Yasmine before Zafar can catch him and get hold of the magic lamp. The Jinn escorts Aladdin and Yasmine to their home. Meanwhile, Zafar has turned diabolical due to his failure to possess the magic lamp.

episodesList.title: The Truth Serum
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Princess Yasmine return to Baghdad with Genie's help. Aladdin's mother tells him about his father and how they lost everything in that fire. Gulbadan slips a truth serum in a drink and passes it to Aladdin to get the truth out of him.

episodesList.title: Search For The Magic Lamp
episodesList.summary: Genie drinks the juice in which the truth serum was added by Gulbadan so he is compelled to tell Aladdin's mother the truth about him being 400 years old. At the same time, Gulbadan with his mother comes to get the truth out of Genie. Zafar has a new plan in his mind to get the magic lamp back.

episodesList.title: Secrets Of The Past
episodesList.summary: Aladdin bumps into Piddi while in search of Genie. Piddi, who is head over heels in love with Aladdin, forgets the question and starts daydreaming. Then, Aladdin finds Genie and learns that Genie has given the magic lamp to strangers. Now, Aladdin has to get the magic lamp before it falls on Zafar's lap.

episodesList.title: Introspection
episodesList.summary: Aladdin manages to get the magic lamp from the hands of Zafar's subordinates. Meanwhile, Nazneen is cajoling Genie into revealing his true identity. Aladdin's father visits his old house which is burned down. At the same time, Aladdin and his mother also arrive.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Introspection
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his mother enter their old house and miss Aladdin's father by just a few seconds. Aladdin does some introspection and decides that he is going to give up the magic lamp to the mustache guy. Princess Yasmine saves her father from getting killed by a falling chandelier.

episodesList.title: The Exchange
episodesList.summary: Aladdin signals Muchadd and makes sure that he knows where the exchange of magic lamp is going to take place. Muchadd understands the signal and reaches the Chaand Mehel disguised as an old man. Little does Aladdin know that Zafar plans to either arrest or kill him after the exchange.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Plan
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is asked to remove his mask and in return, Muchhad will reveal his identity. Meanwhile, Yasmine finds out that one of the guards is a snitch. The guard is captured and interrogated but he doesn't reveal any details. Muchhad has decided to end Aladdin's life on the night of Jashn-e-Fateh. Will Aladdin find out about the plan?

episodesList.title: Destined
episodesList.summary: Zafar plans to kill Badshah Alam on Jashn-e-Fateh and hires a killer who is none other than Aladdin's father. Aladdin's mother goes to the market accompanied by Genie to celebrate Jashn-e-Fateh. Aladdin is worried about her mother so he goes out to find her and bring her back.

episodesList.title: A Tough Decision
episodesList.summary: Aladdin makes a hard decision of letting Genie go and giving him to Muchhad and when he informs the same to Genie, he is devastated. The news of Genie leaving and never coming back saddens Aladdin's mother to the core. Omar prepares for the assassination of Princess Yasmine's father.

episodesList.title: The Assassin
episodesList.summary: Zafar dreams of sitting on the throne, but standing in his way is the current Sultan of Baghdad. Meanwhile, Omar has arrived in the city to assassinate Sultan Shahnawaz. When the Sultan is greeting the people, Yasmine grows suspicious.

episodesList.title: A Father And A Son
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is still in a dilemma whether he should hand over the magic lamp to Muchhad or not. Omar is in his position and marks Badshah Alam with his arrow to assassinate him. Will Aladdin give the Genie to Zafar or will he change his mind?

episodesList.title: Genie Is Back
episodesList.summary: Aladdin fools Zafar by giving him a fake magic lamp but later realizes that the coins that Muchhad gave him were also fake so he brings Genie back home and apologizes to him. Princess Yasmine tells Badshah Alam everything about Muchhad and his planning.

episodesList.title: The Doppelganger
episodesList.summary: Zafar comes across a man who resembles the Sultan. An evil plan is conceived by Zafar to exploit this find to his advantage. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Yasmine are at a feast. Genie's magic turns Aladdin and Yasmine into dancers, while Genie tries to defuse the tension between the two.

episodesList.title: A Confession
episodesList.summary: Aladdin confesses his love for Princess Yasmine but when Yasmine reveals her identity he doesn't believe her. Zafar's men try to pursue Omar again, into an attempt to kill Badshah Alam. Yasmine almost catches Sultan Shahnawaz's doppelganger.

episodesList.title: Wicked Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Zafar sends Omar in Badshah Alam's room to assassinate him and then replace him with his doppelganger. But just when Omar is in Badshah Alam's room to kill him, Princess Yasmine arrives at the same time.

episodesList.title: Sultan's Announcement
episodesList.summary: Yasmine is eagerly awaiting her coronation as the Sultan. She hopes that her father will make the announcement shortly. But, the Sultan announces that Yasmine is getting married. Meanwhile, Nazneen sends Gulbadan to Aladdin's house, and asks him to hide the bangles at his place. Will Aladdin find out about Nazneen's plan?

episodesList.title: The Suitor
episodesList.summary: Zafar reveals to Yasmine that she will be getting married to Zayn, who has a rather special ability. Meanwhile, Nazneen blames Aladdin for having stolen the golden bangles. Ruksar is certain that Aladdin hasn't stolen the items and asks Nazneen to search her house.

episodesList.title: Zayn's Hocus
episodesList.summary: Zafar and Zayn plan to hocus princess Yasmine's mind by using Zayn's abilities, and control her in any way they desire. Nazneen asks Aladdin to swear on his mother that he has never stolen anything from anyone. What will Aladdin do now? Will he be able to convince his mother?

episodesList.title: Under The Influence
episodesList.summary: Zayn hypnotizes Princess Yasmine and asks her to complete a task, in order to get a hold of her mind completely. Aladdin realizes that Yasmine is in danger so he decides to rescue her. Rukhsar and Omar almost come face to face.

episodesList.title: Genie Is Compromised
episodesList.summary: Zayn sends Princess Yasmine to fetch the black rose in order to complete the process of controlling her mind. Aladdin tries to stop her from doing that but Genie, who is under the influence of Zayn's magic, attacks him.

episodesList.title: Saving The Princess
episodesList.summary: Princess Yasmine is under Zayn's hocus, and Zayn tries to diminish all the memories of her family and loved ones, in order to compel her mind and her heart. Aladdin gets to know about this plan, so he decides to protect Yasmine. Will Aladdin be able to save Yasmine, while fighting against Genie, who is under Zayn's spell?

episodesList.title: Aladdin Is Adamant
episodesList.summary: Yasmine is still under Zayn's hocus and Aladdin is adamant about saving the Princess, so he tries to get Genie out of Zayn's influence, so that he can help him save Yasmine. Zayn completes the process and controls Yasmine's mind and heart.

episodesList.title: Rescue
episodesList.summary: Aladdin defeats Zyan and breaks the magic pendant, this gets Yasmine out of his influence. Aladdin decides to bring Yasmine to his home, in order to protect her, while she is unconscious. Zafar almost kills Zayn after hearing the news of Princess Yasmine escaping.

episodesList.title: Calling Out Aliza
episodesList.summary: Aladdin brings the unconscious Princess Yasmine to his house, in order to protect her from Zayn. Zafar forces Zayn to call out Aliza and take her help, in order for him to get to his goal. Nazneen Begum sees Yasmine at her shop and starts asking questions.

episodesList.title: Wicked Game
episodesList.summary: Princess Yasmine gets to know about Nazneen using her wicked plans to damage Aladdin and his mother's relations, so she decides to teach her a lesson. Zayn calls out Aliza and she shows up and turns Zayn into a poisonous moth and orders Zayn to kill Aladdin.

episodesList.title: The Deadly Scorpion
episodesList.summary: Aliza turns Zayn into a deadly scorpion and asks him to kill Aladdin. Aladdin, Genie, and Ruksar decide to go to the mosque and Zayn comes there, and plans an attack on Aladdin. Princess Yasmine feels that something is off with her father, so she decides to confront him.

episodesList.title: Another Failed Attack
episodesList.summary: Zayn keeps on trying to attack Aladdin and bite him after turning into a poisonous scorpion, but fails every time. Aladdin asks his mother why do people call his father a traitor. Nazneen successfully ruins the food made by Aladdin's mother for the poor people.

episodesList.title: To Catch A Sight
episodesList.summary: Genie gets to know that Nazneen has put some kind of drug in the food prepared by Aladdin's mother, which can make everyone sick, so he decides to use his magic to prevent this from happening. While at the mosque, Aladdin gets to know that Princess Yasmine is there to visit the mosque, so he runs outside to catch a glimpse of her, where Zayn is waiting for him.

episodesList.title: Aliza Shows Herself
episodesList.summary: While Aladdin is trying to catch a glimpse of Princess Yasmine, his mother gets stung by the poisonous scorpion, Zayn. Aladdin picks his mother up and rushes to the doctor. Zafar gets frustrated and calls out Aliza and finally, she shows herself.

episodesList.title: The Venom Does The Work
episodesList.summary: The venom that Zayn injects in Aladdin's mother's neck, seems to be working as she starts walking unconsciously and even forgetting her memories. Aladdin gets a job offer from Mahal, and decides to take it up to get closer to Princess Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Perseverance Is The Key
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is adamant about joining the job at the Mahal, to get close to Princess Yasmine, but his mother is concerned about his safety. Genie decides to train Aladdin for the job. Omar decides to let the real Badshah go.

episodesList.title: Free To Go
episodesList.summary: Omar lets the real Badshah go, and he ends up going to the place where Princess Yasmine and the fake Badshah are doing charity amongst the poor. Aladdin brings his mother home, after saving her from the guards, but feels that something is wrong with her, after noticing her weird behavior.

episodesList.title: Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Yasmine's father tries to break the security in an attempt to speak with his daughter, but Omar stops him in his tracks. Nazneen breaks into Aladdin's house and steals the magic armor. The next day, Aladdin enrolls his name for the competition. Aladdin hopes to turn his fortune around by landing with a job. Unaware to Aladdin, Gulbadan has something that Aladdin doesn't.

episodesList.title: Struggle Is Real
episodesList.summary: Aladdin finds out about Nazneen stealing his magic armor and giving it to Gulbadan, who is also participating in the competition. Yasmine is worried about her father, so she decides to discuss the situation with Piddi.

episodesList.title: Finding The Truth
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's mother motivates him from the ringside, while he is getting beaten by the other competitor. Zafar and Aliza come close to find the Black Theif's protector. Yasmine and Piddi's plan works, as they are able to reveal the fake Badshah.

episodesList.title: The Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Genie bring Aladdin's mother home, but when she wakes up from the temporary coma, she refuses to recognize them. Princess Yasmine confronts the fake Badhshah, but just then someone attacks him.

episodesList.title: Three Days and Counting
episodesList.summary: Genie reveals to Aladdin that Rukhsar has been poisoned. Rukhsar has to be saved within three days, but there isn't a known antidote available to cure her. Meanwhile, Zafar pushes the fake Badhshah off the balcony and becomes a hero in the eyes of Yasmine. Will Yasmine find out Zafar's true identity? And will Aladdin be able to save his mother?

episodesList.title: Breaking the Enchantment
episodesList.summary: Genie reveals to Aladdin that the one who has mastered the art of magic, will be able to cure Rukhsar. But, Mallika, who had truly mastered the dark arts, has turned to stone. The only way to save Rukhsar is to search for a solution, which is buried in one of the books, containing all the secrets of magic. Genie asks Aladdin to take care of Rukhsar, while he goes in search of the solution.

episodesList.title: The Red Book
episodesList.summary: Genie decides to find the Red Book, which contains the solution to break the enchantment on Aladdin's mother. After acquiring the Red Book, Genie realizes that to break the enchantment, they have to travel to the mountains of Mehran. Yasmine, who is looking for some answers, also decides to go with Aladdin to the mountains of Mehran.

episodesList.title: Mehran, The Valley Of Death
episodesList.summary: When Genie informs Aladdin and Yasmine that they will find the solution to their problems in Mehran, without even thinking for a split second, both of them decide to leave for Mehran. But, little do they know that a huge obstacle is waiting for them in Mehran, which is also called the valley of death.

episodesList.title: Aliza's Plan
episodesList.summary: Zafar and Aliza realize that the Black Theif and Yasmin are traveling to Mehran to find a solution, to save Aladdin's mother, so she decides to hinder their journey by raising a storm. Due to the storm, they crash land into the city of death, Mehran, where Aliza waits for them.

episodesList.title: The Mirror World
episodesList.summary: Aliza's plan works as she successfully traps Aladdin and Yasmine in a mirror world, in an alternate universe, where there's death at every door. Aliza then informs Zafar that her next step is to trap the Genie in the magic lamp and get it to him.

episodesList.title: Trapped
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine are trapped in the mirror world and they try every possible way to escape from there. Genie is trapped by Aliza's magic and gets pulled into the magic lamp. Aladdin and Yasmine find two mirrors where they can't see their own reflections, so they decide to jump into one of those mirrors.

episodesList.title: An Attempt To Escape
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine somehow escape the mirror world and meet Ilmi Baba and ask him for answers to their problems, but Ilmi Baba challenges them for a combat, in order to prove their worth. Aliza and Zafar are successful in capturing Genie.

episodesList.title: The Answers
episodesList.summary: Ilmi Baba finally agrees to answer a question posed by either Aladdin or Yasmine. Aladdin tricks the sage into answering not just one question but two. Illmi Baba reveals the secrets to save Aladdin's mother and Yasmine's father. Finally, Ilmi Baba opens a portal for Yasmine, through which she can escape the magical land. But, what about Aladdin? How will Aladdin find a way out?

episodesList.title: The Showdown
episodesList.summary: Ilmi Baba sends Aladdin to the place where Aliza has taken the magic lamp with the Genie inside it, so when Aladdin reaches there and witnesses Aliza in possession of the magic lamp, he has no other option but to get it back and protect it.

episodesList.title: Genie's Rage
episodesList.summary: Seeing Aladdin in trouble, Genie becomes enraged. Genie's anger knows no bounds and he grows in size and power. Zafar is ecstatic seeing that Genie is finally out of the magic lamp and decides to exploit the situation. Meanwhile, Yasmine manages to find her father, but Omar isn't far away.

episodesList.title: Good Triumphs Over Evil
episodesList.summary: Thanks to Genie, Aladdin comes out alive of the magical maze created by Aliza. Zafar fails to make Genie his slave and returns to Baghdad, to find that the Emperor Shahnawaz has returned. Meanwhile, time is running out for Aladdin, as he needs to save his dying mother. Will Aladdin succeed in saving his mother?

episodesList.title: Forced To Leave
episodesList.summary: A mob comes to Aladdin's house and asks them to leave the house and the area, as they believe that Aladdin's family carries a dark spirit with them. Zafar is furious after knowing that Badshah Shahnawaz has returned, so he starts torturing people.

episodesList.title: The Meeting
episodesList.summary: In the darkness of the night, Omar meets Mucchad. The two plan to usurp the Emperor. Meanwhile, Nazneen is plotting to evict Rukhsar. Aladdin decides to find a solution, in an attempt to stay in the house. Aladdin plans to use the power of the good to defeat the forces of evil. Will Aladdin succeed?

episodesList.title: Joining Forces
episodesList.summary: Zafar manipulates Omar and they both join hands and decide to destroy Badshah Shahnawaz. Aladdin decides to take Badshah Shahnawaz's help and meet him, in order to clear the stain on his father's name. Omar decides to find the Black Theif, so that he can through with his plans.

episodesList.title: A Father's Dream
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tries to enter the royal palace and talk to Badhshah Shahnawaz about his father and to clear his name once and for all. Princess Yasmine decides to fulfill her father's long-lost dream. Zafar puts a bounty on the Black Theif's head.

episodesList.title: The Sultana
episodesList.summary: The Emperor announces that Yasmine will be crowned as the Sultana of Baghdad. Yasmine's happiness knows no bounds, as her dreams have finally come true, but Zafar is infuriated. The Emperor also announces that the work on the oil wells will be overseen by Yasmine. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Genie learn that workers are required for the newly announced oil well project. Aladdin and Genie decide to take up the job, but fate has other plans for them.

episodesList.title: The Crown Thief
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Aladdin carries out the task given by Nazneen and tries to steal the crown. Omar is on a quest to catch the Kala Chor, and tries to figure out the modus operandi used by the thief. When Aladdin tries to steal the crown, Omar attempts to catch him.

episodesList.title: A New Beginning
episodesList.summary: Omar tries to catch Aladdin, but the clever thief escapes. Meanwhile, Aladdin meets Yasmine while trying to escape Omar. Yasmine and Aladdin acknowledge their diverging paths in life, and decide to focus on their respective responsibilities. While Aladdin decides to focus on his new job, Yasmine decides to take the responsibilities of a Sultana seriously.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Ploy
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Genie are ready to take up their new job, but Nazneen blackmails Aladdin and asks him to steal the royal crown. Zafar plans to assassinate Sultana Yasmine, at the oil digging site, when she arrives there. Will Aladdin and Yasmine's path cross once again? Will he be able to dodge the new problem coming their way?

episodesList.title: The Landslide
episodesList.summary: Huge stones come rolling down at the people on the oil digging site, but Aladdin's quick thinking saves the day and Zafar's plan fails again. But people start leaving the site, thinking that the landslide might be a sign from God. So, Princess Yasmine faces the trouble of convincing the people not to leave.

episodesList.title: Gaining People's Trust
episodesList.summary: As people start walking off the oil digging site, Princess Yasmine enters the scene, to convince people otherwise. Omar crosses paths with Aladdin's mother during his search for the Black Theif. Aladdin helps Yasmine to convince the people at the oil site to come back and work.

episodesList.title: The Trap
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Genie decide to meet Yasmine, after they learn that she is looking after the work going on at the oil well. However, Gulbadan stops Aladdin and Genie from meeting Yasmine. Later, Rukhsar arrives at the oil well, to meet Aladdin and Genie. Then, Nazneen reminds Aladdin of the task he has to carry out. Meanwhile, Omar has set up a trap to catch the infamous Kala Chor.

episodesList.title: The Clash
episodesList.summary: Aladdin falls in the trap set up by Omar and then the two clash with each other. While Omar wants to catch the Kala Chor, Aladdin wants to escape. The two are ready to fight till death, in order to get what they want. Will Aladdin be able to escape or will Omar catch him?

episodesList.title: The Escape
episodesList.summary: Aladdin escapes before Omar is able to catch him. Omar learns that the Kala Chor works at the oil well, and decides to work there to accomplish his mission of nabbing the wanted thief. Meanwhile, Yasmine reinstates Zafar, which could turn out to be a costly mistake. Will Omar learn that Aladdin is the Kala Chor?

episodesList.title: Omars Escapade
episodesList.summary: Omar enters the mine in search of the Kala Chor, after getting to know that it was Kala Chor who saved Badhshah Shahnawaz from his captivity. Omar doubts Aladdin to be the Kala Chor after he finds the same wounds on his hand as the Kala Chor had, after he fought him. Will Omar reveal Aladdin to be the Kala Chor?

episodesList.title: A Mothers Concern
episodesList.summary: Zafar is furious due to his plans failing one after the other, so he starts torturing people around him. Later, he comes up with a plan to spread terror and fear among the people of Baghdad. Aladdin's mother is concerned for him and Genie after a bad dream, so she decides to tag along with them to the mine.

episodesList.title: Placing The Bombs
episodesList.summary: Zafar, disguised as a street artist, reaches the oil mine with his partners in crime, in order to plant bombs there. Aladdin suspects one of the street artists and follows him. Will Zafar be able to execute his deadly plan successfully?

episodesList.title: The Distraction
episodesList.summary: Zafar sends his man to plant the bombs inside the mine. Zafar creates a distraction by organizing a dance celebration. While all the workers are outside, enjoying the dance, Zafar's man manages to plant the bombs. Will Aladdin and Genie be able to avert this disaster?

episodesList.title: The Discovery of Oil
episodesList.summary: While trying to capture Mucchad's men, Aladdin discovers oil. Aladdin is hailed as a hero, and a celebration follows this landmark discovery. But, amidst the celebrations, Aladdin is concerned about the bombs placed in the mines. How will Aladdin avert the disaster that is about to happen?

episodesList.title: Chaos Everywhere
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Genie try to defuse all the bombs in the mines, amidst the celebration of finding the oil. They are successful in defusing some of them but not all. So, when the bombs start exploding, people try to run out from the mines to save themselves. What will Aladdin and Genie do now?

episodesList.title: The Savior
episodesList.summary: Yasmine witnesses the destruction in the oil mines and prays to the lord to send a savior and Aladdin emerges as that savior and saves as many people as he can. He takes his mother and Omar and takes them to the relief camp. But, in the process of saving other people, Genie gets injured badly.

episodesList.title: A Pray To The Gods
episodesList.summary: After witnessing the destruction and fire at the mining site, Rukhsar urges everyone in the camp to pray to the Gods to send a solution. Aladdin saves Princess Yasmine from the fire, and Genie uses his magic to pour rain over the fire and rescues everyone.

episodesList.title: The Unfinished Task
episodesList.summary: Genie, Aladdin and Yasmine return to Baghdad safely. While Aladdin is delighted to be back home, Rukhsar doesn't waste a moment to remind him of his unfinished task. However, Aladdin refuses to carry out the task at any cost. Meanwhile, the Emperor announces that jobs will be provided at the palace to those credited with the discovery of oil. Will Aladdin stand a chance of landing the job?

episodesList.title: Finding The Truth
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is about to start his job in the palace, so he promises his mother to find the truth behind his father's death. Omar is happy to know that his wife is still alive. Princess Yasmine is still devastated to find out about Aladdin's feelings, so she decides to keep Aladdin away from her and gives him a job in Kabul.

episodesList.title: Aladdins Job
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's job is hanging in the balance as his name is not announced until the end. Elsewhere, Rukhsar is confronted by Nazneen and her husband, and an argument breaks out against Omar being a traitor, where Rukhsar takes a very strong vow in front of the whole market.

episodesList.title: The Vow
episodesList.summary: Seeing Rukhsar in tears, Omar vows to return only when he proves his innocence. Meanwhile, Nusrat, who is in charge of the royal kitchen, sets things right following a fiasco created by Genie and Gulbadan. Will Omar be able to prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: The Moment Aladdin Awaits
episodesList.summary: On one hand, Omar is looking for a way to prove his innocence by attacking Emperor Shahnawaz, and Aladdin is excited to serve the emperor, as that shall answer his innumerable questions about his father, but unfortunately, Nusrat chains Aladdin so that he can't meet the emperor. Will Aladdin be able to speak to the Emperor?

episodesList.title: Omars Revenge
episodesList.summary: While Omar is looking forward to expose Emperor Shahnawaz, Aladdin disobeys Nusrat and gets expelled from his job. Will the circumstances change for Aladdin and Omar?

episodesList.title: The Locked Door
episodesList.summary: Nusrat learns that Aladdin is Omar's son. Aladdin is searching for Mir Mustafa and finds a locked door, which has Mustafa's name engraved on it. However, Nusrat doesn't want Aladdin to unlock the door. Meanwhile, Yasmine decides to meet Aladdin. What secrets does the locked door contain?

episodesList.title: In the Search of Mir
episodesList.summary: Aladdin fools Yasmine into washing the utensils. Meanwhile, he searches the room of Omar's best friend, Mir. While doing so, he gets caught red-handed by Nusrat, who decides to help Aladdin in search of Mir. Will the search of the room yield any result?

episodesList.title: The Secret of Mir
episodesList.summary: Nusrat and Aladdin find a book in Mir's room which has Farsi writing. Yasmine helps Nusrat and Aladdin to decode what's written in the book. Zafar visits Mir and tries to extract the secret which Mir has kept for 20 years, and fails to do so. Zafar also reveals to Mir that his old and best friend Omar is alive. Aladdin visits the market to find out more about Mir. Will he achieve something?

episodesList.title: Trip to Spice Market
episodesList.summary: While Zafar tries to look for clues as to what Mir is hiding from him, Aladdin who is looking for Mir in the market is spotted by Zafar. He then chases Aladdin to enquire as to why is he looking for Mir. Will he be able to catch him? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: The Man Who Disappeared
episodesList.summary: Aladdin gets a helping hand from Yasmine in his quest to find Mir Mustafa. While trying to trace Mir's location, Aladdin and Yasmine fall into a pit. In the dark unexplored chamber, Aladdin finds an amulet and a jar. Will these items help Aladdin find Mir Mustafa?

episodesList.title: Time is running out
episodesList.summary: Every moment when Aladdin feels he has hit jackpot, he gets stuck at another dead end, but Rukhsar motivates him saying that no effort goes in vain and he should keep on trying. Will Aladdin be able to save Mir?

episodesList.title: The Incomplete Love Story
episodesList.summary: Jinoo and Aladdin go to Nusrat's room to find out the truth about the amulet which has her name engraved on it. Nusrat finally tells Aladdin and Jinoo her story of love with Mir and how he left her in the middle of no where. Aladdin promises that he will find Mir. Will he be able to deliver on his promise?

episodesList.title: Saving Mir Mustafa
episodesList.summary: Zafar stabs Mir Mustafa and Aladdin finds Mir in a bad state. Aladdin takes Mir Mustafa back to his house and tries to save his life. Meanwhile, Nusrat meets Ruksar and informs her that Aladdin is trying to find Mir Mustafa. What secrets will Mir Mustafa reveal?

episodesList.title: The End of Mir
episodesList.summary: Even though Aladdin saves Mir from Zafar's attack, Mir's situation is critical. Nusrat has mixed emotions about seeing Mir. Mir also clarifies that Omar is innocent. After Mir dies, Aladdin finds a key in his hand which belongs to Aladdin's old house. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Key
episodesList.summary: The key which Aladdin found in the hand of dying Mir is taken under custody by Rukhsaar and she asks Aladdin to not to go to their old house. Aladdin steals the key and goes to the house. What will he find there?

episodesList.title: The Magical Ink
episodesList.summary: Aladdin goes to his old house and with the help of the key which he got from Mir, he opens a secret door in the house which leads to another trap door in the house. What will Aladdin find in the end?

episodesList.title: The Magical Book
episodesList.summary: After Aladdin enters the secretive cage in his old house, he finds an ancient magical book. The book tells him about all the genies made by the magical queen Mallika. Aladdin on hearing this, is very excited as Jinoo is not the only genie alive. What shall happen next?

episodesList.title: The Ring
episodesList.summary: Behold the magical ring that shall end the life of the one foolish enough to steal it. Aladdin receives the warning and dares to risk his own life to find hidden secrets. Mucchad is closely watching Aladdin and wants to steal the book, which Aladdin wants to safegraurd. Meanwhile, Genie and Yasmine accidentally bump into Nazneen. Is Yasmine and Genie’s cover blown?

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Retreat
episodesList.summary: After having a fierce battle with Zafar for the magical book, Aladdin loses the book to Zafar. Genie and Yasmine come and rescue him from there. Zafar opens the book and its asks for a price for all the questions asked. Will Zafar pay the price.

episodesList.title: Genie Of The Ring
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Zafar come to know about the Genie of the Ring and Malika, the creator of the Genies. Both realize that Aladdin is very important to acquire the Ring. Omar sees Ruksar but doesn't let her know it's him.

episodesList.title: The Secret Message
episodesList.summary: Zafar sends a message to Aladdin in a coded form. Before Aladdin can open the envelope and decipher the message, Nazneen snatches the envelope from Aladdin's hand and asks him to make a trip to Egypt on an assignment. When Aladdin refuses, Nazneen reminds him that he is yet to prove that his father is innocent. Will Aladdin make the trip or will he decipher Zafar's message?

episodesList.title: Jinoo's Fun
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is trying to battle Zafar in order to stop him from trying to get the magical ring. Jinoo has fun with Gulbadan, when Gulbadan enters into the competition of representing Baghdad in Egypt, Jinoo uses magic and fails Gulbadan.

episodesList.title: Unravelling the Secrets
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is on the lookout for Mucchad, who has managed to escape from Aladdin's hands. Aladdin meets Yasmine and she convinces Aladdin to join hands with her in an attempt to find Mucchad. Before escaping, Mucchad reveals to Aladdin that he is embarking on a trip to Egypt.

episodesList.title: Expedition to Egypt Begins
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is set to sail for Egypt with other Yasmine to find Mucchad and expose him to the world. Before they leave, Aladdin meets Zafar and introduce each other. Also, Aladdin is trying to locate Mucchad in the market with the help of a compass which has Mucchad's braclete in it. Will Aladdin find him?

episodesList.title: Jinoo's Duty
episodesList.summary: Two days into the expedition to Egypt, Aladdin has still not figured about the identity of Muchhad. On the other hand, Jinoo is on house duty of protecting Rukhsaar but himself is in trouble. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Entry into Egypt
episodesList.summary: As the expedition has reached on the entry gates of Egypt, the mystical gates ask Zafar to solve a riddle and only then can they enter into Egypt. On giving the wrong answer, they will all lose their lives. Will Zafar answer correctly?

episodesList.title: Zafars Plan
episodesList.summary: Zafar announces that the doors to Egypt will open at dawn. The next morning, the doors are opened and Zafar is sure that the Genie of the ring will be under his control. Zafar wants to head to east, while the rest of the caravan is marching west. Aladdin and Yasmine are on a mission to catch Mucchad, and stop him from getting to the Genie of the ring.

episodesList.title: The Unseen Future
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Aladdin and Yasmine are determined to find Mucchad. Meanwhile, Omar wants to teach a lesson to Nazneen so that she doesn't trouble Rukhsar in the future. Nazneen asks Rukhsar to leave the house and Gulbadan finds the magic lamp.

episodesList.title: Genies Fate
episodesList.summary: The caravan reaches Egypt. Aladdin suspects that Mucchad's accomplices are traveling with him. Then, Aladdin gets the sign that Mucchad is nearby. Along with Yasmine, Aladdin decides to find Mucchad. Then, a fire breaks out at the camp, which creates panic. Meanwhile, Omar stops Gulbadan from stealing the magic lamp.

episodesList.title: Zafar A Step Closer
episodesList.summary: After the tents catch fire, there's panic everywhere and Zafar takes advantage of the situation and becomes Mucchad. He reaches to the pyramid where Genie's ring is. Aladdin on seeing this, shouts to stop everyone, but it's of no use. Can Aladdin stop Zafar?

episodesList.title: Mucchads Trap
episodesList.summary: Mucchad has laid down a very well planned trap for all the members present in the expedition to Egypt. He takes them inside the pyramid where he plans to sacrifice their lives to Zehral, in order to gain access to the Genie's ring. Can Aladdin save them?

episodesList.title: Rise of the Creature
episodesList.summary: Aladdin has to rescue the innocent people and also catch Mucchad, who has possession to the key. Then, out of nowhere rises a creature no one has heard of before. The creature has the power to burn anyone to death. As the creature approaches, Yasmine puts her life on the line in order to save innocent lives.

episodesList.title: Rukhsaar Comes To Rescue
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Mucchad are in a fix where Muchhad is ready to trade the key for the bridge if Aladdin retrieves the ring in which the genie is there. Elsewhere, Omar's setup has worked properly in defaming Aladdin's uncle and family, when Rukhsar comes to their rescue. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: The Ring or The Key?
episodesList.summary: Aladdin asks Mucchad to stop the creature from devouring the innocent people. Mucchad asks Aladdin to fetch him the Genie of the ring and in return, he will help him save the lives of the people. Aladdin decides to get Mucchad the ring, but will Mucchad keep his end of the deal?

episodesList.title: Mucchad Gets The Ring
episodesList.summary: After Aladdin gives the ring to Mucchad and gets the key from him, Aladdin decides to save the innocent lives first, and then take care of Mucchad later. Elsewhere, Yasmine plans to take on Zehral single handedly. Will Aladdin be able to save the innocent lives and Yasmine be able to kill Zehral?

episodesList.title: Behold The Genie Of The Ring
episodesList.summary: The people safely get out of the pyramid in the nick of time. Mucchad wants to send Yasmine away so that he can release the Genie of the ring. Aladdin realizes that Mucchad has deceived him and has taken the real ring. Then, Mucchad makes an attempt to release the Genie from the ring. Will Mucchad succeed in his evil plan?

episodesList.title: Genie Of The Ring Unleashed
episodesList.summary: The Genie of the ring is unleashed and the Genie tells Zafar that he is fortunate that he is the owner of the ring. Zafar is annoyed by the Genie of the ring as he challenges Zafar's competency. What will be Zafar's reaction?

episodesList.title: Show Off Genie
episodesList.summary: The Genie of the ring shows-off his powers in front of Zafar by controlling Akbar's mind. Zafar is blown away by it. On the other hand, Jinoo and Aladdin meet Rukhsar after a long time. The Genie of the ring is still annoying Zafar by asking him puzzles. What will Zafar do about it?

episodesList.title: Brothers Love
episodesList.summary: While Jinoo is sleeping, Aladdin confesses about how much he loves him and how much Jinoo has given them since he entered their lives. Elsewhere, Yasmine's friend Princess Meher slams down a helper for laughing. Aladdin and Jinoo find the Genie of the ring in their house. What will they do now?

episodesList.title: The Evil Genie
episodesList.summary: Going against Aladdin's warning, Genie steps out of the house. Jinn-e-Anghuti has sensed the presence of Genie and decides to track him. Aladdin sees a magical object in the sky and fears that Genie might be in trouble. Then, Aladdin rushes to Genie's help. Is Genie safe?

episodesList.title: Saving Gulbadan
episodesList.summary: As everyone is trying to save Gulbadan from the kite, Jinoo blames himself for the condition of Gulbadan. Aladdin consoles Jinoo that it's not his mistake. Aladdin also suggests that if you can't hide from the enemy it's better to come out and attack the Jinn-e-Anghuti and capture him first before Jinn-e-Anghuti captures Jinoo.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Wishes To Meet Yasmine
episodesList.summary: As Aladdin wants to meet Yasmine, she goes to him and gives him a task of eating a whole chilly, if he completes the task, Aladdin gets to meet the princess. Elsewhere, the paste of chilly prepared by Aladdin and Jinoo cures Gulbadan of his problem. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: The Trap
episodesList.summary: Jinn-e-Anghuti is on Jinoo's trail. Meanwhile, Aladdin is trying to escape from Omar. Jinoo decides to hurry and reach home before Aladdin does, but Jinoo falls unconscious and is found by Aladdin. Jinn-e-Anghuti is catching up and determined to catch Jinoo. After Jinoo regains consciousness, Aladdin asks him to find a way out before Jinn-e-Anghuti catches up. Will Aladdin and Jinoo escape?

episodesList.title: Jinoos Apology
episodesList.summary: Aladdin motivates Jinoo to do something so that they can escape from Jinn-e-Anguthi. Jinoo creates a tornado and they both escape from there and dupe Jinn-e-Anguthi. Post they have escaped, Jinoo apologizes to Aladdin for not following orders. Aladdin consoles Jinoo and assures him that he won't let anything happen to him. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: The Talismanic Chain
episodesList.summary: After Princess Meher orders Aladdin's ears to be cut-off, Yasmine rescues her. While the guards were taking Aladdin, he notices his amulet is missing and worries for Jinoo and rushes home to find him safe. Elsewhere, Jinn-e-Anguthi has a new weapon to catch Jinoo which is the talismanic chain.

episodesList.title: Chain Captures Aladdin
episodesList.summary: As the talismanic chain is out to capture Jinoo, it encounters Aladdin on the way. Aladdin figures that there's something wrong and in turn, the chain captures Aladdin and takes him away. Will Aladdin be able to escpae the chain and get free?

episodesList.title: Buried
episodesList.summary: Aladdin encourages Jinoo to use his magical skills so that they can overpower Jinn-e-Anghuti. Aladdin and Jinoo enter a cave and bury Jinn-e-Anghuti, unaware that Mustafa is watching them. Meanwhile, Zafar is waiting for the arrival of Jinn-e-Anghuti, believing that Jinn-e-Anghuti will bring Jinoo along with him. Now that Mustafa has seen the cave, what will he do now?

episodesList.title: The Ominous Entity
episodesList.summary: Jinn-e-Anghuti latches onto Mustafa and makes him do things as per his will. Jinoo decides to stay in the house as per Aladdin's wish but Jinoo gets curious when he hears kids playing outside. Meanwhile, Zafar is awaiting the arrival of Jinn-e-Anghuti, unaware that the Genie is in Rukhsar's house to find the identity of the men who buried him.

episodesList.title: Mustafa Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: After Mustafa has been taken under the control of Jinn-e-Anguthi, he is out of control and shouting at everyone. Rukhsar decides to help Mustafa. Jinn-e-Anguthi thinks that Rukhsar sounds sensible and will be the right person to know the details about Aladdin and Jinoo. What information will the Jinn-e-Anguthi get?

episodesList.title: Possessed
episodesList.summary: Jinn-e-Anguthi possesses Mustafa. Gulbadan comes across Mustafa and gets scared after seeing him enraged. Aladdin learns from Gulbadan that another Jinn is probably in the house. Aladdin and Jinoo decide to go to the cave to find out if Jinn-e-Anguthi has escaped.

episodesList.title: Face to Face With Genie
episodesList.summary: After entering the cave, Aladdin finds a bracelet which belongs to Mustafa. On seeing Mustafa in the cave, he understands that Mustafa is under the control of Jinn-e-Anguthi. The Jinn-e-Anguthi questions Aladdin regarding Jinoo. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Zafars Threat
episodesList.summary: After the Jinn-e-Anguthi goes back without Jinoo, Zafar is not happy with his result and mocks him. Jinn-e-Anguthi lies to him about not being able to find Jinoo. He asks Zafar to trust him, but Zafar tells him that he's only got one last chance, otherwise he will put him back in the ring and throw the ring away. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The Troubling Situation
episodesList.summary: The guards arrest Aladdin and take him to the palace. Yasmine sees Aladdin being taken to the palace and follows him. Aladdin is brought before Meher, who asks Aladdin to take her on a tour of the city. When Aladdin is freed, he goes in search of Jinoo. Will Aladdin be able to find Jinoo?

episodesList.title: Motivating Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tells Omar about the Jinn-e-Anguthi and Omar is optimistic about defeating the Jinn-e-Anguthi as they know the most powerful Genie in the world and that is Jinoo. Aladdin and Omar try to convince Jinoo that he can fight the Jinn-e-Anguthi and defeat him. What will be Jinoo's reaction?

episodesList.title: Panic In Baghdad
episodesList.summary: Aladdin reaches home to find his mother and Jinoo safe. Jinoo and Aladdin go to the city market and they see the people in the market talking about what's happening in Baghdad. What Jinn-e-Anguthi did a few moments back has induced fear and panic among the people of Baghdad. How will Aladdin fight the situation?

episodesList.title: Jinn-e-Anguthis Plans
episodesList.summary: Aladdin spots Yasmine in the cave where Omar and Jinoo are trying to train. He stops her right there and strikes a conversation and somehow manages to send her away. On the other side, Zafar is angry with the Jinn-e-Anguthi as he has not been able to do anything as of yet to catch Jinoo.

episodesList.title: The Strength Within
episodesList.summary: The people of Baghdad are in fear after Jinn-e-Anguthi issues a threat. Omar and Aladdin try to help Jinoo realize his inner strength and use his magical skills against Jinn-e-Anguthi. Meanwhile, Yasmine learns that a Jinn has terrorized the people of Baghdad. What will Yasmine and Aladdin do against the powerful Jinn-e-Anguthi?

episodesList.title: Saving Baghdad
episodesList.summary: Jinn-e-Anguthi possesses Gulbadan. In the middle of the night, Nazneen and Rukhsar find Gulbadan trying to set a fire in the neighbourhood. Meanwhile, Yasmine is getting jealous of Meher as she is starting to like Aladdin. Jinn-e-Anguthi sends out a warning to Jinoo and vows to unleash wrath in the city. How will Jinoo and Aladdin save Bagdhad?

episodesList.title: Practice Makes Perfect
episodesList.summary: Yasmine gets stirred by Meher and Aladdin's closeness. Jinoo is in practice, trying to get his powers under control. While the whole of Baghdad is afraid of the dark Jinn-e-Anguthi, the only way for Jinoo is to fight back and save the common people.

episodesList.title: The Magical Battle
episodesList.summary: Jinoo is determined to fight Jinn-e-Anguthi in order to safeguard Aladdin and Rukhsar. Jinn-e-Anguthi and Jinoo engage in a fierce battle, but Jinoo is defeated. Jinoo vows to try harder next time and defeat Jinn-e-Anguthi. Meanwhile, Nazneen gathers her neighbours to find Jinn-e-Anguthi and teach him a lesson. Aladdin takes Meher on a trip around Baghdad.

episodesList.title: Ominous Presence
episodesList.summary: Aladdin takes Meher on a trip of Baghdad on the magical carpet. Jinn-e-Anguthi creates a spell that causes trouble for Aladdin. Then, Jinoo informs Aladdin that he and Jinn-e-Anguthi engaged in a fight. Rukhsar's neighbours request Rukhsar to help them get rid of Jinn-e-Anguthi's ominous presence.

episodesList.title: Possessed
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar informs her neighbours that with the use of a mirror they can spot the Genie. Aladdin and Jinoo are worried as Rukhsar can find out Jinoo's true identity with the help of that mirror. Then, Nazneen gets possessed by Jinn-e-Anguthi. Rukhsar finds Aladdin unconscious and gets worried. What has happened to Aladdin?

episodesList.title: Mirrors
episodesList.summary: Jinn-e-Anguthi plays a trick with Rukhsar and makes her believe that Aladdin is unconscious. On the other hand, Jinoo is nervous seeing mirrors everywhere and fears Rukhsar will find out his true identity. Aladdin instills confidence in Jinoo and takes him outside the city to meet Omar. How will Aladdin and Jinoo defeat Jinn-e-Anguthi?

episodesList.title: Realizing His Powers
episodesList.summary: Aladdin goes to meet Bulbul who tells him that he needs atleast a thousand thorns from a specific venomous plant which will help him in the battle against Jinn-e-Anguthi. Elsewhere, Jinoo is getting trained by Omar, who unleashes a bee hive of Jinoo.

episodesList.title: The Unforgiving Desert
episodesList.summary: Yasmine receives a letter from which she learns Aladdin and Meher's travel escapade. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Meher are travelling through the desert. In Baghdad, Jinoo is scared of getting caught and tries to hide from every mirror possible. Jinn-e-Anguthi unleashes another attack and tries to destroy every mirror. Will Jinoo and Aladdin defeat Jinn-e-Anguthi?

episodesList.title: The Training
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Meher arrive at their destination. Aladdin is attacked by predatory cacti and it is Yasmine who saves Aladdin from the attack. Meanwhile, Nazneen gathers the neighbours and creates a ruckus outside Ruksars house for not catching the Jinn. Jinoo blames himself and seeks help from Omar to enhance his magical skills.

episodesList.title: Music Of Pain
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Meher return to Baghdad. Jinoo and Aladdin decide to meet Aladdin's Ustad, who has devised a new musical instrument that has the power to render the Jinn weak. Rukhsar decides to use this musical instrument to capture Jinn-e-Anghuti. But, the musical instrument also affects Jinoo. Will Jinoo succumb to the pain? Will Aladdin be able to capture Jinn-e-Anghuti?

episodesList.title: Princess Yasmine To The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Meher sends a notification to Aladdin indicating that she is in trouble. When Aladdin comes to see her, Meher tells him that it was all a joke and Aladdin gets mad at her. Princess Yasmine sees both of them, and locks them in their room and goes alone to save Baghdad.

episodesList.title: The Truth
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar comes face-to-face with Jinoo's real identity. Rukhsar refuses to call Jinoo as her son and Jinoo breaks down in tears. Nazneen arrives with the neighbours and asks Rukhsar to open the door. Meanwhile, Meher orders to take Aladdin captive. What will happen to Jinoo?

episodesList.title: Jin Turns To A Jin
episodesList.summary: Jinoo is heartbroken as his so called mother send him out of the house after knowing the truth about his reality. Aladdin comes back home and is made to feel guilty about not being there when it mattered for his mother or Jinoo. His mother knows that Aladdin has also lied about Jinoo's reality.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Turns Against Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Jinoo's elder Jin brother tries to manipulate him when Jinoo uses his powers and pushes him away. Meanwhile, Rukhsar regrets sending him away from her and asks Aladdin to call him back. When Jinoo comes back, he behaves strangely.

episodesList.title: Chasing The Chiraag
episodesList.summary: An evil Genie runs away with Aladdin's lamp. Yasmine and Aladdin chase him and try to get hold of the lamp. They use a lot of trickery to stop the Genie. But will they be able to get hold of him?

episodesList.title: Zafar's Demand
episodesList.summary: After capturing Jinoo, Zafar becomes the new master of the lamp. He asks Jinoo to decorate his court and after that asks him to take him to the Baghdad's treasury. Once they are there, he asks Jinoo to kill his first master. What will Jinoo do?

episodesList.title: Zafar Controls Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Zafar takes control of Jinoo and as his master orders him to kill Aladdin. Aladdin reminds Jinoo of all the good old days and reminds him of his mother as well. Will Jinoo let Zafar control him?

episodesList.title: Aladdin Repents
episodesList.summary: After Jinoo has almost killed Aladdin, Zafar calls Jinoo back into the magical lamp. Aladdin is repenting on the fact that he should have been there to protect him. Yasmine persists on knowing the fact about Jinoo.

episodesList.title: Jinoo's Memory
episodesList.summary: Now that Zafar controls Jinoo and his affection for Aladdin and Rukhsar comes in the way of Zafar's intents, he orders Jinoo to erase all his memories of Aladdin and Rukhsar. How will be a changed Jinoo be?

episodesList.title: Yasmine Orders Meher
episodesList.summary: Yasmine asks Meher to leave the palace as she is not able to serve her responsibilities. Meher denies and urges that she wants to stay back. But Yasmine is adamant and makes sure that Meher leaves the palace. Later, Aladdin dreams of Jinoo and cannot sleep the whole night.

episodesList.title: Yasmine's Father Is Back
episodesList.summary: Nakchadi is very happy as her father returns. Meanwhile, Abbu and his family got kidnapped, but Abbu is unaware of the reason why he and his family got kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Genie In A Negative Role
episodesList.summary: With a new Akka aka Master, Genie undergoes a transformation. He becomes a negative being, and humiliates, condemns and harms Anghuta Chap. On the other end, Aladdin is trying to find ways to have Genie back.

episodesList.title: Aladdin And Yasmine On A Mission
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar prays for Jinoo's well-being and wishes that he returns soon. Yasmine and Aladdin look for a house where Jinoo has been held captive and being tortured. Yasmine is grateful as Aladdin returns her bracelet.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Dream
episodesList.summary: Both Aladdin and Yasmine are lost in their own thoughts of how they feel when they are with each other. On the other hand, Zafar wants to rule Baghdad and to know his status he goes to the market in disguise for his validation.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Refuses To Recognize Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Jinoo laughs it off when he realizes that the Kala Chor is a girl. Aladdin tries his best to find where Jinoo is. Aladdin can't believe himself when he realizes that he has been developing a soft corner for Yasmine. When Aladdin finally comes across Jinoo, he refuses to recognize him and shows hatred towards him.

episodesList.title: Jinoo After Aladdin
episodesList.summary: After Jinoo has failed to recognize Aladdin and has kept him captive, Aladdin uses his intelligence to get free from captivity and runs away. Jinoo starts looking for Aladdin and warns him that as soon as he finds him, he will kill Aladdin.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Talks About Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is so excited seeing Yasmine that he hugs her tightly. Yasmine is shocked when Aladdin tells her that Jinoo tried killing him. Aladdin still believes that Jinoo somewhere remembers him and Rukhsar.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Attacks Zafar
episodesList.summary: Seeing Zafar dressed like Kala Chor, Jinoo starts attacking him. Rukhsar pulls Aladdin's ears when he misbehaves with their guests. Aladdin informs Yasmine that the sundial will help them lead to Jinoo's lamp.

episodesList.title: Aladdin The Saviour
episodesList.summary: Wazir gifts a sword called Shamsher to Princess Yasmine. They are having a conversation just when two men attack them. Aladdin comes to their rescue and single handedly defeats those two men. Wazir summons Gullu and his family at his court to know what information they have collected till now.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Decides To Propose Yasmine
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar guides Aladdin to propose Yasmine before its late and in the meantime, he gets a reminder of finding Jinoo. Yasmine informs him about the depleting magical Dhoopghadi when he meets her. Later, Aladdin tries finding a way to make Dhoopghadi work so as to find Jinoo.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Tricks Zafar To Hide Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin hides in Yasmine's room while Zafar arrives and tries entering, but Yasmine somehow stops him. Later, after Zafar's exit, Aladdin plans of searching the three rooms of the castle to reach Jinoo and the magic lamp.

episodesList.title: Zafar To Impress Yasmine
episodesList.summary: Zafar plans on defeating Princess Yasmine in sword fighting so that she is impressed of his skills. And later in the fight, Zafar falls into water and gets defeated by Princess Yasmine instead.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Informs His Mother About Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Aladdin finally informs his mother Rukhsar that he is not so far from Jinoo and he is returning soon. And later, Yasmine informs him to be a part of workers those are going to be involved in the decoration of the castle.

episodesList.title: Zafar Employs Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Zafar doubts Princess of meeting Aladdin without making him know about this fact. Later, Zafar calls Jinoo and employs him to have an eye upon Princess and her activities.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Mocks Aladdin's Makeover
episodesList.summary: Aladdin enters into the castle as a worker with a different getup than usual, which makes him unrecognizable even for Yasmine. Later when she recognizes him, she mocks his getup and laughs out loud.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar Reunites With Omar
episodesList.summary: As soon as Aladdin gets his hands on the lamp, he kisses it with extreme joy. Zafar is surprised when he learns that one of the secret doors to the palace is locked from inside. Rukhsar breaks down seeing her husband Omar.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Gets Confused
episodesList.summary: Aladdin gets confused after seeing so many lamps in the room and starts searching for the Jinoo's lamp restlessly. On the other side, Rukhsar gets emotional upon meeting her long lost husband.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Tries Escaping
episodesList.summary: Aladdin just escapes from getting caught by the King's men and keeps on struggling to get out of the castle. On the other side, Yasmine tries finding Aladdin in the crowd, but fails.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar Saves Her Husband
episodesList.summary: While Rukhsar and her husband were staring at each other from a distance, suddenly a soldier comes towards them in search of a thief. But, Rukhsar saves her husband from being arrested by the soldier.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Recalls The Events
episodesList.summary: Aladdin gets confused in his own thoughts and tries finding the solutions, and leaves to inform Yasmine about the facts. On the other side, Rukhsar decides to make Aladdin meet his father and gets excited, but also feels sad upon missing Jinoo.

episodesList.title: Yasmine's Dream
episodesList.summary: Aladdin goes to see Yasmine in her chamber to tell her how he feels and tells her that he has decided to leave. Yasmine stops him and confessess her own love for him. Is it a dream?

episodesList.title: The Locked Door
episodesList.summary: Yasmine's father declares that he wants to meet the man who won her heart. Aladdin is trying to get into a locked door guarded by the Genie, but he is unsuccessful. Yasmine and Aladdin meet up in a hurry to tell each other their news.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Knows Zafar's Secret
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tells Yasmine that Zafar is up to something shady. He also tells her that Genie was going to tell him something but he couldn't. Aladdin thinks that the Genie's magical lamp is with Zafar only. Yasmine wants to tell Aladdin that she loves him but she keeps her mouth shut because she doesn't want to come in between Genie and Aladdin.

episodesList.title: Old Friends, New Enemies
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine depart from each other reluctantly. Zafar is given the news that Omar is still alive. Zafar tries to figure out Omar's next moves. The young couple, Aladdin and Yasmine are busy daydreaming about each other.

episodesList.title: A Troubling Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's mother has a nightmare about Omar. She is unwilling to tell her son more on this matter. Jafar is in a conference with the Genies deciding on what to do with Omar. Yasmine's mother confronts her about her affair with Aladdin. Find out more on this episode.

episodesList.title: Secrets Of The Room
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine enter the secret room and are about to blow the horn when Zafar suddenly enters the room and they go into hiding. It is revealed that it was actually the genie in disguise who entered the room to stop them. The couple leaves the room in a hurry, planning to return. Meanwhile, the real Zafar continues to torment Omar. Find out more on this episode.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is busy thinking about Yasmine while eating his dinner and is not responding well. So, his mom asks him what is the matter. He says there is also another matter bothering him. Find out more in this episode.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Poisonous Words
episodesList.summary: Yasmine is troubled by thoughts of Aladdin and wants to know what is in his heart when she gets a surprise visit from Zafar, who brings a gift for her. He tries to brainwash her with his words. Omar is still being held prisoner with the power of the genies.

episodesList.title: The Cat Thief
episodesList.summary: Aladdin observes the cat thief and surmises that he must be the same person who hid the sword in his room before. Aladdin asks himself why this is happening and plans his next steps. Omar is trying desperately to escape and gets his chance when his chains break. Aladdin meets Yasmine and tries to patch up.

episodesList.title: Omar Escapes
episodesList.summary: Yasmine and Aladdin are nearly overheard by Gulbadan but Yasmine notices him and is able to trick him. Omar swears revenge against Zafar and escapes from his prison. Yasmine continues to stroke Gulbadan's ego and gets information from him as Aladdin watches the fun.

episodesList.title: Dark Powers
episodesList.summary: Omar and Aladdin both are looking for each other to tell them very important things. But when they meet, a sandstorm comes and none are able to hear what they want to say. Aladdin's scientist uncle tells him that tomorrow is the day when the dark powers will be at peak.

episodesList.title: Night Of The Eclipse
episodesList.summary: A Lunar Eclipse is about to occur. Aladdin's mother spills milk while in a hurry and she sees this as a bad omen. As everyone is preparing for the night, Aladdin has his own plans against Zafar. What will happen tonight?

episodesList.title: Shocking Discovery
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is shocked at his discovery, and behind the scenes, Zafar is jubilant at seeing this reaction. Earlier, Zafar had advised the Sultan to meet Aladdin as a common man as he didnt know that Yasmine is a princess. Find out more in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Sultans Rage
episodesList.summary: Yasmine has been caught by her parents and her mother blames it on her father for not being stricter. Zafar is feeling over the top seeing the misery of the royal family. The Sultan is totally against Aladdin after realizing his identity as the Kala Chor.

episodesList.title: The Puppet Sultan
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is apprehended by the soldiers of the Sultan and Aladdin swears revenge against him. However, things are not what they seem as the Sultan is being used as a puppet by the Genie. Aladdin snaps and attacks the Sultan but he is defeated.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's mother wakes up from a nightmare and finds him missing. Zafar is celebrating with the genies and further explains his plans to them. To find out his next move, and what happens next, watch this episode.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Mourns
episodesList.summary: Rukhsaar finds Aladdin missing from the house and it worries her. Yasmine on the other hand is mourning that Kala Chor is the person who attacked her father and she loved him.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Gets Convicted
episodesList.summary: Zafar claims in front of the general people that Aladdin is the murderer of the King and promises them to kill him as soon as he finds him. And he also asks the gene named Angootha to give statement against Aladdin. Will he succeed in his conspiracy?

episodesList.title: The Sentencing
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is being judged and Yasmine pronounces her sentence. His crimes will not be forgiven by the laws of Baghdad. To see what happens to the fate of the Kala Chor, watch this episode.

episodesList.title: Is Omar Aladdins Father?
episodesList.summary: Omar is woken up by the genie and reveals to him that they have other plans for him. Zafar tells Omar about how he manipulated him into following his plan and his true relations with Aladdin.

episodesList.title: Ruksar's Confession To Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Yasmine allows Aladdin's mother to visit him. They have an emotional reunion as Aladdin ask his mother for forgiveness. Then, she reveals that she had kept a secret from him for a long time.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Heroics
episodesList.summary: Aladdin saves all the workers who might have died by getting crushed under the falling statue. Everyone praises Aladdin for his heroics and on the other hand, Rukhsar is missing Aladdin and makes his favourite dish for the kids around her.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Fools Zafar's Man
episodesList.summary: One of Zafar's men with some soldiers gets Aladdin and tries to make him captive again but he finds Angutha Chhap's ring in his hand and tries fooling him. Aladdin gets success in fooling him and he throws the ring where Aladdin is made captive.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Decides To Take Revenge
episodesList.summary: Genie tells Aladdin that Zaffar plotted the whole drama against him. Aladdin decides to take revenge on Zaffar. Yasmine agrees to get married to Zaffar since it was her father's last wish. Aladdin takes up a new identity to go back to Baghdad.

episodesList.title: Ruksar Meets Yasmine
episodesList.summary: Aladdin escapes from the prison and gives away his magical ring to Tahir but when he asks Genie to kill Aladdin he steals the ring back from him. Ruksar comes to meet Yasmine and tells her to do as her heart says. Aladdin tells Genie that he is going to Baghdad to make Zafar's life hell.

episodesList.title: Anguthi And Aladdin Team Up
episodesList.summary: Jinn-E-Anguthi and Aladdin join hands after Aladdin escapes the prison. Aladdin asks Jinn-E-Anguthi about tackling Jinoo in order to get to Zafar and defeat him as he only knows how to trick people.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Makes An Announcement
episodesList.summary: People of Baghdad congratulate Zafar and Yasmine on their wedding announcement. Yasmine makes an announcement that she will become the Sultana of Baghdad and will always protect it from any danger.

episodesList.title: Cave Of Death
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, while in search of treasury cave with Angootha Chhaap, falls into a cave where he finds only the dead bodies of human beings. His companion gets afraid of the situation, but not Aladdin, and he tries finding a way out.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Treasure
episodesList.summary: Aladdin along with Almardoot and Angootha Chhaap reaches the secret cave where the treasure is hidden. But greedy Almardoot tries exploiting Aladdin and relives the dead people lying there.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Meets A New Genie
episodesList.summary: Aladdin fights an army of souls. Yasmin is behaving weird. Zaffar addresses Genie as his brother. Anguthi Chaap tells Aladdin that there are two Genies around them. Aladdin finds out there's a genie inside a bottle.

episodesList.title: Magic Fish
episodesList.summary: Aladdin gets some water to drink . But after drinking it he feels something stuck in his throat and throws it out. To his surprise, it is fish and genie as well as Angootha Chhap start impressing her.

episodesList.title: Baghdad's Throne In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Aladdin with his companions succeed in hunting the treasured cave. A shrewd Zafar, with the intention of usurping the throne turns Yasmine into a parrot. Will Zafar succeed in his evil endeavour?

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Condition
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's new companions tell him that he needs them as much as they need him. Aladdin lets them come with him and Angoothi Chhap but he has a condition.

episodesList.title: Alis Grand Entry In Baghdad
episodesList.summary: Angoothi Chhaap gets upset because Genie Minnie calls her brother. Ali and his companions make a grand entry in Baghdad. Zafar prepares for a celebration and asks genie to bring various things from different parts of the world.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Plans
episodesList.summary: One of princess' maids is feeding fresh chillies to the parrot and suddenly it flies away and Zafar is seen planning something but he hides it from Jinoo, who feels bad about that. Later, Zafar meets Aladdin in the feast.

episodesList.title: Zafar Recognises Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Zafar is shocked to see Aladdin alive and immediately orders to kill him. Aladdin tells that he is Ali, Aladdin's doppelganger. Zafar now heads to the place where Aladdin was executed, to know the truth.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Exposed
episodesList.summary: After Zafar has decided to find out what happened with Aladdin's execution, he takes his doppelganger to the place where he was buried to crosscheck about his lies. Will Zafar find out?

episodesList.title: Aladdin In Baghdad Court
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's own people see him when he is presented in the court. He tries to fake his identity when Chimma Jalaad, one of his old pals is called by Zafar to punish him.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Is Revengeful
episodesList.summary: Zafar shows Aladdin how Yasmin is now a mere parrot. A grieved but revengeful Aladdin is determined to take action against Zafar.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Meets His Mother
episodesList.summary: Aladdin while dining with Zafar sees his mother serving him food. An emotional Aladdin is now in a dilemma. How will he react?

episodesList.title: Zafar Is Concerned
episodesList.summary: Zafar realizes that people of Baghdad should know the effort he is putting in to help Yasmine recover. Hence, he invites people from places for the same.

episodesList.title: Zafar Imprisons Yasmine
episodesList.summary: Scholars around the city try to turn the parrot into Yasmine but fail. Even Aladdin tries to do so. Will Aladdin be able to bring back Yasmine?

episodesList.title: Aladdin Breaches The Palace
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his companions break into the palace in search of Yasmine in order to help her recover. In the meantime, Jinoo suspects their presence.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Brings Yasmine Back
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his companions attempt to turn the parrot back into Princess Yasmine. Aladdin is nostalgic while Zafar is curious.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Is Shocked
episodesList.summary: A shocked and angry Yasmine tells Zafar to send Aladdin out of the kingdom after she has a brief encounter with him. Aladdin is nostalgic and finds ways to talk to Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Gifts Zafar
episodesList.summary: After Aladdin and his companions are ousted from Baghdad, Aladdin plans to send an extravagant gift to Zafar. Zafar is both happy and confused.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Plan
episodesList.summary: Aladdin sends Zafar some gold as gift and he calls a goldsmith to verify the authenticity. Zafar assumes that Ali wants to be friends with him. But Ali only tries to tempt him.

episodesList.title: Zafar Is Trapped
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his companions trap Zafar in a scary cave. Anghuthi Chhaap is enraged and dares to scare Zafar even more. How will Zafar escape?

episodesList.title: Aladdin Reunites With Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his friends rescue Zafar from the deadly place and Chand Changezi is also found. Meanwhile, the cave begins to collapse and Aladdin sends Zafar and Jinoo out of the place.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Is Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Jinoo has doubts about Aladdin's intentions and he doesn't want Aladdin to come to Baghdad. He tries to find the truth by questioning Aladdin in various ways.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Plans Against Zafar
episodesList.summary: Anguthi Chhaap asks Aladdin about the formalities when their actua; intention is to harm Zafar. Aladdin tells Anguthi Chhaap to calm down and plans accordingly for the destruction of Zafar's resources.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Greed
episodesList.summary: Aladdin offers Zafar a great amount of wealth with an intention to trap him. Zafar is spellbound and tells Aladdin various reasons as to why he needs the wealth.

episodesList.title: The Secret Deal
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tells Zafar that the Baghdad fort is his but Zafar can stay there for as long as he wants, because he is his friend. Zafar asks Aladdin to not tell anyone about this deal and keep it a secret.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Goes To The Desert
episodesList.summary: Zafar appoints Gulbadan to accompany Jinoo when he heads for the desert. Aladdin and his companions secretly follow them in the palace.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Catches Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zafar loses the gold earned from Ali and out of anger he shouts at the Subedar for not being careful. But Ali comes to Zafar's bedroom to check who was shouting and warns him to keep the gold safe.

episodesList.title: The Broken Trust
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tells Zafar that he no longer trusts him. Zafar apologizes to Aladdin. Jhumroo informs Zafar that he will have to leave the fort by the morning. What will Zafar do now?

episodesList.title: Aladdin Tricks Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Jinoo gives the wrong gold biscuit to Aladdin's mother after Anguthi Chhaap shows him the same. Aladdin takes both the gold biscuits and tricks Jinoo.

episodesList.title: Zafar Is Helpless
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tries to frighten Zafar by asking questions related to his past. Zafar starts feeling insecure and Aladdin takes advantage of the situation. Zafar loses his authority in this way.

episodesList.title: Zafar Gets Surprised
episodesList.summary: Early morning, Jinoo surprises Zafar by informing him about Jasmine's return. Zafar wakes up and scolds Jinoo for not letting him know early. On the other hand, Aladdin explains about his meeting with Jasmine to his friends.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Confronts Zafar
episodesList.summary: After punishing Yasmine's father, Zafar takes a loan from Ali in the form of gold coins, keeping the mansion in debt. Furious to know, Yasmine takes on Zafar and confronts him for his deed.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Asks For A Favor
episodesList.summary: Aladdin asks Angoothi Chhap if he told Genie Mini about their plan or not. Angoothi Chhap tells Aladdin that he forgot to tell Genie Mini about their plan. Aladdin lies to Genie Mini and tells her that whatever Jinoo did was his mistake. Aladdin asks for a favor from Genie Mini.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Plans To Oust Ali From Baghdad
episodesList.summary: Yasmine shares her plan of getting Ali banished from Baghdad to Piddi. According to her plan, she will pretend to have an affair with Ali and this will be an issue for Zafar. Zafar and Ali are great friends and he tells Ali about his attraction for Yasmine. Ali assures him of his help to win the love of Shehzadi Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Questions Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Ali helps Yasmine to remove her foot from under the heavy box. Yasmine's plan is in danger and it might just fail. She also asks Ali to drop her to the room. On the other hand, Zafar is dreaming about his love.

episodesList.title: Ali Finds The Solution
episodesList.summary: Ali and his gang are looking for the person who had sent the letter. Ali comes up with this amazing plan which will help them capture the person they are looking for. Jinoo, on the other hand, learns the greatness of apology.

episodesList.title: An Important Day
episodesList.summary: Zafar is going to announce the winner of the gold from among the beggars. He, however, doesnt want to give the gold away. Jinoo is distracted as per Ali's plan.

episodesList.title: Winner Of The Gold
episodesList.summary: Jinoo can't play his magic and Yasmine draws out the chit with the name of the winner. Aladdin's mother Rukhsar wins the gold. Zafar is not happy at all but he endures all to impress Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Jinoo In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's mother Rukhsar wins the prize. Everyone is happy in the fort. Jinoo receives the news and congratulates Rukhsar. But in that very moment, he realizes that he screwed up. He was not supposed to let anyone win except for Zafar's people. He goes into a huge dilemma.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Is Scared
episodesList.summary: Aladdin wakes up in a stranded desert with flying carpet under him. After looking around a bit he sees a scarecrow which is alive and scared for his life. It doesn't know what to do. Meanwhile, Jinoo is roaming around the market in search of a present for Sarah Ji.

episodesList.title: Ali Goes Down The Memory Lane
episodesList.summary: After finding out that it was none other than Bulbul Chacha who had a command over Alis magic carpet, Ali gets confused. But after making peace with it, Ali takes Bulbul Chacha to his flashback story, about how he became Ali from Aladdin.

episodesList.title: The Golden Tower
episodesList.summary: Zafar takes Jinoo to his golden tower. There he explains what are his true intentions. He wants to build an entire empire of gold, in which Ali plays an important role. Zafar asks Jinoo to apply some magical spell on his tower so that no one can get past it.

episodesList.title: Ali Is Concerned
episodesList.summary: Ali deceives Zafar by pretending to be unconscious in the desert. He asks for help and Zafar, with the help of Jinoo takes Ali back to the city. Ali runs off to the palace to make sure that his mom is safe and sound. There he finds out that 227 people are missing from the city.

episodesList.title: The Palace Library
episodesList.summary: Ali and the others go to the library in the Palace in search of the magical book which Zafar had stolen from him earlier. They find the book after a lot of efforts and now they are at an advantage.

episodesList.title: Aladdins Life Threat
episodesList.summary: Ali gets caught while eavesdropping on Zafar and Jinoo. Zafar tells him everything about the Golden Tower and also that Zafar will need the blood of Yasmine. Then he tells Ali that Jinoo is not a human but a Jin. Jinoo is ordered by Zafar to kill Ali and he tries doing that. Ali then disappears.

episodesList.title: Ali Is Trapped
episodesList.summary: Ali is caught by Zafar, eavesdropping on his conversation with Jinoo about Raaz-E-Qaynat. Zafar orders Jinoo to kill Ali. Jinoo takes them to a stranded place where he appears in his evil form. He strangles Ali in his gigantic palm. Ali struggles a lot but can't do anything about it.

episodesList.title: Gulbadan Creates Trouble
episodesList.summary: Gulbadan enters Ali's chamber and disturbs him while he is busy planning to rescue the missing women. But Ali and his friend somehow make him turn his head and send him away. Meanwhile, all people of Baghdad get worried about the missing women.

episodesList.title: The Use Of Wisdom
episodesList.summary: When Aladdin gets to know the plan of Zafar, he is very happy to know that Zafar is doing what he expects him to and with the use of Bulbul Chacha's wisdom and knowledge, they shall defeat Zafar.

episodesList.title: Undoing Black Magic
episodesList.summary: Ballu and Chandu, together form the machine which will produce clouds and bring the storm needed to bring back the disappeared people. With the machine, Jinoo and Ali go beyond the magical gate and reach the golden tower. They want to undo the magic that was made while making the tower.
