In the process, Jinoo starts to remember his times with Aladdin.

episodesList.title: The Iron Key
episodesList.summary: Ali and Jinoo fail in their attempt to undo the black magic. When they return he comes across a fact in the most unprecedented manner. He goes to Zafar and tells him about the solution. Ali finds out that iron is the key to undoing the black magic. The iron key, the iron vase, the sword are all part of the magic that resulted in the disappearance of the women of Baghdad.

episodesList.title: Jinoos Triumph Over His Inner Darkness
episodesList.summary: Ali asks the villagers to bring some iron things which belonged to their women. Ali collects it and with the help of Jinoo, he tries to bring back all the women who disappeared. Jinoo is feeling under confident about his magic, but Ali comforts him and the magic works.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Jinns On Task
episodesList.summary: Ali tries to wake Yasmine up but Zafar refuses to participate. Instead, Zafar orders Jinoo to lay a magic cover on Yasmine so that no one can try to wake her up. After that Ali's Jinns listen to the entire conversation of Zafar and Jinoo and report back to Ali.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Gets A Thought
episodesList.summary: Jinoo keeps on working at the orders of his master and he recruits few workers to complete the task. But in between something awkward happens and the workers start running away from their work.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Ghost
episodesList.summary: Ali goes on throughout Baghdad scaring some people like the ghost of Aladdin. Ali's friends help him by distracting Jinoo. Ali goes and scares Zafar till he trembles. Later, he returns and discusses the entire story with his friends.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar Is Blamed
episodesList.summary: Jinoo comes to check on Ali at night and he gets away after a close call. On the other hand, Rukhsar is being blamed by the people for Aladdin's ghost. Zafar, Jinoo, and Ali discuss the problems. The people from Yemen leave the Golden Tower and will not work there.

episodesList.title: Gulbadan Is Promoted
episodesList.summary: Zafar appoints Gulbadan as the supervisor of the golden tower of Baghdad. Gulbadan is overwhelmed by this. Ali advises him to take along his family with him while supervising the tower tonight.

episodesList.title: Ali Scares The People Away
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar and Piddi are hopeful about Yasmine's good health and coming back to consciousness. They also see her hand move a little and are very happy. Zafar is upset by the news of Yasmine's possible return. On the other hand, Ali and his friends torment and terrorize the people who are going in search of the Golden Tower.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Gulbadan and his family see the spirit of Aladdin in a room. They are highly terrified and Gulbadan tries talking to Aladdin but Aladdin accuses him of betrayal.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Ghost Doesn't Rest
episodesList.summary: Ali is attacked by Jinoo and is unconscious but his friend comes and saves him. They return to the palace and they are happy that they fooled Jinoo. On the other hand, Baghdad is in unrest due to the doings of Aladdin's ghost. Zafar tries to encourage the people and tells them not to be afraid.

episodesList.title: Facing The Fear At The Golden Tower
episodesList.summary: Ali and Zafar go to the Golden Tower and want to see what is happening there. In Baghdad Bulbul Chacha and Anguthi Chhap scare the people personifying as Aladdin's ghost. In the Golden Tower, they all scare Zafar.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Gives Zafar A Beating
episodesList.summary: Zafar is beaten by Aladdin and at the same time, Aladdin asks him to bring Yasmine back to her consciousness. Jinoo comes to Zafar's rescue but Aladdin threatens him to kill Zafar.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Is Back
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's ghost blackmails Jinoo into getting Yasmine back to her consciousness. Aladdin's ghost drops Zafar from far up in the air but in the nick of time Jinoo saves him. Yasmine remembers dreaming of Aladdin and then she meets Zafar and Ali.

episodesList.title: Ultimate Threat To Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin promises Yasmine to bring out the truth. He then goes to Zafar and scares him till he stutters. Zafar is asked to speak the truth. Aladdin and his friends have managed to keep Jinoo away and also to threaten Zafar. Jinoo however, comes to save Zafar.

episodesList.title: Yasmines Doubt
episodesList.summary: Ali, Jinoo, and Yasmine come to check on Zafar. They talk for a while and Yasmine sees the blue mark on Alis ear. She doubts the connection between Ali and Aladdins ghost. Alis friend also makes Zafar hallucinate.

episodesList.title: Nearing The Truth
episodesList.summary: Jinoo tries to protect Zafar from Aladdin's ghost and puts protective charms. However, Zafar treats him in a very bad manner. Anguthi and Ali go and try to trick Zafar into telling the truth and calls him. They also go and call Yasmine to know the truth.

episodesList.title: Ali's Mission
episodesList.summary: Ali, along with his friends, gets out to make his plan a success whereas, on the other side, Princess Yasmine tries her best to find the link between Aladdin's ghost and Ali. Terrified, Zafar asks Jinoo to stay with him till Aladdin's ghost gets caught.

episodesList.title: An Open Confession
episodesList.summary: Yasmine wants to take Ali to the market where Aladdins ghost has called her. She wants to be sure that Ali and Aladdin are two separate persons. Zafar comes to the market as well. Anguthi does his trick and shocks everyone. Jinoo cannot work his tricks against Anguthi.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Confesses To Yasmine
episodesList.summary: The shadow of Aladdin confesses the truth to Yasmine that he has not killed her father and also the love he has for her. Later while returning he gets encountered with his mother and both get emotional.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Speaks Up
episodesList.summary: Jinoo is frustrated with how Zafar treats him and he speaks up to him. Zafar is angry and wants to punish him. On the other hand, Yasmine is dreaming of Aladdin. Zafar forces Jinoo back into his lamp.

episodesList.title: Ali Wants To Rescue Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Ali learns about Jinoo's punishment and wants to rescue him. Zafar almost confesses to Ali about his crimes. Yasmine asks Aladdin about the truth.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tells Yasmine the truth about what happened that night. Yasmine partly believes it but she is also skeptical. Aladdin comes to see his mother sleep. Jinoo's lamp is not found and the others are in search of it.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Questions Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zafar talks to himself after getting drunk. Ali comes looking for Jinoo's lamp and fails. Yasmine calls for Zafar and needs to ask him questions. Yasmine is starting to have doubts about Zafar's integrity. She interrogates him with trapping questions.

episodesList.title: Nazneen Gets The Truth Goggles
episodesList.summary: Anguthi tries to save Bulbul Chacha when the truth goggles fall off his bag. Nazneen takes it and escapes. Will the truth come before everyone? Zafar tells Ali about the conversation with Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Coaxes Out The Truth
episodesList.summary: Aladdin purposely gets himself trapped in a net and instigates Zafar to tell the truth. Zafar comes clean and Anguthis ring records everything. They also manage to get Jinoos lamp and escapes with Aladdin and the ring.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Plan To Expose Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin threatens Zafar and escapes with the ring, Jinoo's lamp, and returns to the palace. He has a little problem with the blue color on his body but that is managed. The truth giggles breaks and Ali is about to release Jinoo.

episodesList.title: The Revelation
episodesList.summary: The lamp with Ali is the duplicate lamp and they cannot release Jinoo yet. Ali and his friends propagate the news that the truth will be revealed soon. Chachi comes up with a new evil trick.

episodesList.title: Aladdins Ghost Haunts Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zafar is well known about the intentions of Aladdins ghost and to escape the same, orders all the people to not show up outside the respective house after evening. On the other side, Aladdin as Ali plans for his success and to meet Yasmine before the confession.

episodesList.title: Execution Of The Plan
episodesList.summary: According to the plan, Aladdin gets ready to go in front of the people of Baghdad and confess his truth. But one of his self-made team members arrives with a magic flute which can attract people to listen to his confession.

episodesList.title: Aladdins Truth
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his friends reach the place where he is about to confess. Zafar arrives in time and tries to defy that Aladdins truth is a hoax but Yasmine asks him to stay away and requests the people to listen to Aladdins truth for one last time.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Failure
episodesList.summary: Aladdin was going to show the truth to all the people of Baghdad. At that time the ring from Anguthi starts to disfunction. Someone must have tampered with the ring's magic.

episodesList.title: Ruksar Gives Up
episodesList.summary: Aladdin gets disrespected by everyone. He is extremely sad and moreover, his mother also turns her back on him. He is helpless and leaves, promising never to return.

episodesList.title: Gulbadan Tries To Save Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Jinoo tries to kill Aladdin on order from Zafar. Aladdin is in trouble and is hanging from a cliff. His friends are looking out for him. At that time Gulbadan, who knows the truth about Aladdin comes to help him.

episodesList.title: Gullu Learns Everything
episodesList.summary: Aladdins brother, Gullu gets to know all the secrets about Aladdin. He gets to know about the Jinns. He also knows about magic and is a part of their gang now.

episodesList.title: Zafars Leverage
episodesList.summary: Yasmine tries experimenting to find out the truth. On the other hand, Jinoo and Zafar discuss how they ensured the failure of Aladdins plan. He also keeps Yasmine and Ruksars lives as leverage against Aladdin.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Begins To Believe
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tells Zafar that he will go away to save his mother and his love. Aladdin comes to Yasmine to say goodbye. Yasmine tells him that she believes him and doesnt want him to go.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Prepares His Team
episodesList.summary: Aladdin talks to all his team members assembled to unmask Zafar. Later while discussing Gullu joins them and asks Aladdin to make him one of his team members so that he will be able to help them.

episodesList.title: Ruksars Reminiscences
episodesList.summary: Ruksar is alone and misses his son, Aladdin. She remembers the times when she taught Aladdin the values of life. She has a bittersweet time reminiscing the memories. On the other hand, Jinoo is busy with something else.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Rattles The Facts
episodesList.summary: Yasmine learns that Junaid is Jinoo through the Truth Goggles. Thereafter, she starts rattling the facts that had happened the night her father died. She goes to the store and finds the fake beard used by Muchchar.

episodesList.title: Zafar Is Almost There
episodesList.summary: Yasmine digs deeper into the facts and gets to the Golden Tower. There she is stuck by the traps set by Jinoo. Jinoo and Zafar perform the ritual and they reach the gate. Zafar is very close to his dream.

episodesList.title: Face The Demon
episodesList.summary: Yasmine is in trouble but Ali and his friends save her and escape without being noticed. Zafar and Jinoo enter the gate and find trouble there. They see a demon so powerful that even Jinoo is scared.

episodesList.title: The Devil Is Released
episodesList.summary: Jinoo and Zafar meet the devil inside the gates. The devil tries to kill them but they escape. However, they leave the gates open when they left. The devil can leave the confinement now.

episodesList.title: The Hallucinating Smoke
episodesList.summary: After Zafar leaves the gates open and escapes, Heblish the demon escapes. From the gates, a certain smoke os released that makes everyone troubled. Ali, his friends, and even Zafar feel the effects.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Wants To Punish Zafar
episodesList.summary: Iblis is free and wants to poison the air. He wants to destroy Baghdad. Yasmine returns to her room to get her sword and goes on to kill Zafar. Aladdin tries to get to her before she leaves but fails. Aladdin and his friends go on to help Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Iblis Has A Weakness
episodesList.summary: Zafar and Jinoo try to get the key from Iblis but they fail. Ali is captured by Naznin but he escapes. Ali finds Yasmine and tries to stop her from killing Zafar just yet. The darkness and night is the weakness of Iblis.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Gets Aladdin Back
episodesList.summary: Ali is hurt in the throat and is unable to speak. Yasmine tries to kill him but at the nick of time, she realizes that it is none other than Aladdin who has been disguised as Ali for all this time. They are extremely happy and they want to punish Zafar together.

episodesList.title: Iblis Releases The Poison
episodesList.summary: Yasmine and Aladdin catch up on what happened all this time. Aladdin brings Yasmine to make her meet his friends. Iblis releases the poison into the water of Baghdad. It poisons the waterbodies in the city.

episodesList.title: Preparations To Prevent Danger
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, Yasmine, Aladdins friends, and Gulbadan are together and they want to stop Zafar. They divide the responsibilities among themselves and get to work. They want to stop the poisoned water from contaminating all the water bodies.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Encounters Iblis
episodesList.summary: Aladdin goes to the main water source of Baghdad. He meets Iblis over there and Iblis starts attacking him. After a while, Aladdin understands the weakness that Iblis has and he escapes. Yasmine makes Zafar work.

episodesList.title: Exploiting Desperate People
episodesList.summary: Yasmine and Aladdin find out the truth about Iblis and also get the map to track him down. They now realize the true source of the poisoned water. On the other hand, Nazneen and her husband are exploiting desperate people and selling water to them.

episodesList.title: Sticking To The Plan
episodesList.summary: Nazneen is scared and she is stopped from doing wrong. On the other hand, Yasmine goes on to check up on Ruksar Khala. Aladdin gets a book that will help him to get rid of Iblis. They manage to get through with the plan.

episodesList.title: Decoding The Mystery
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine try to decode the way to defeat Iblis with the help of the old book from the library. A few of the pages fly away and they retrieve them. Zafar carries on with his evil plans.

episodesList.title: Playing With Zafars Mind
episodesList.summary: Yasmine and Aladdin pretend to not know each other and play the usual game. Aladdin poses as Ali and Yasmine treat him rudely. Zafar is caught in the storm and is confused.

episodesList.title: Yasmines Prayer Brings Back Water
episodesList.summary: Yasmine, Aladdin, and Zafar go to the water source and the person with the cleanest soul has to pray for the water to come back. Yasmine prays honestly and her prayer is heard. The source is full of water and the water problem gets solved.

episodesList.title: Fighting Iblis Together
episodesList.summary: Zafar and Jinoo are already trying to kill Iblis but it is difficult for them. Aladdin, Yasmine, and their gang come up for their help. Together they try to end Iblis forever.

episodesList.title: Zafar Escapes With The Key
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Zafar were stuck because Iblis had made Yasmine and Jinoo hostages. Aladdin throws his poison on Iblis and he dies. On the process, the poison touches Jinoo as well and he is in pain. Zafar sees the chance and escapes with the key.

episodesList.title: Jinoos Fight Within
episodesList.summary: Jinoo has a storm inside his mind. He keeps transitioning from the dark Jinoo to the good Jinoo. The process is very hard for him. On the other hand, Zafar opens the second gate.

episodesList.title: Zafar Warns Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Zafar is all set to reach the 2nd gate and unlock the same but Jinoo becomes trouble for him as he keeps on turning into a better Jinoo. Zafar scolds Jinoo and exploits him so that he can reach the gate as soon as possible. Aladdin sees the condition of Jinoo and gets worried.

episodesList.title: Ransacking The Treasure
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his friends ransack the treasure box and try to find something that can help Jinoos situation. At last, they find something that can help. Aladdin disguises himself as the doctor and goes on to check Jinoos condition.

episodesList.title: Saving Jinoo From Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tries to get Nazneen and Zafar away while he tries to help Jinoo. Later Yasmine also comes to help him out. Zafar tries to get them away but Anguthi helps them to remain in the room.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Is Awake
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine manage to get Nazneen as well as Zafar out of the room. Aladdin and his friends pray for Jinoo. later Aladdin puts the Moon-Stone on Jinoos neck. Jinoo is in and out of conscience.

episodesList.title: The Moon Mark
episodesList.summary: Jinoo wakes up and the moon mark on his neck starts to work. Chacha tells Aladdin that it will take a long time for Jinoo to recover completely. Jinoo is shifting from the good one to the bad one.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Disobeys Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zafar mistreats Jinoo and ensures that he remains in his limits. Zafar even slaps Jinoo and orders him to open the second gate of Raaz-E-Kainat. Jinoo denies to follow the order and speaks up to Zafar.

episodesList.title: Prayers And Fasting
episodesList.summary: Chacha informs the people that the next night was a special night and if a person fasts for an entire day, he will be performing the Roza-e-Maafi. The person is forgiven of his or her sins. Apart from that someone close to him or her has to pray for the person as well. Aladdin plans to do this for Jinoo.

episodesList.title: Zafar Is The Hurdle
episodesList.summary: Aladdins plan is working well as Jinoo starts to remember things from his past. Jinoo almost even confessed that he was only Shiek Jinoo but Zafar stopped him. Zafar is really troubled and wants to fix Jinoos issue. Jinoo even remembers Yasmine from his past.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Makes Zafar Apologize
episodesList.summary: Yasmine forces Zafar to apologize to Ruksar Begum. Zafar is furious because he had to bend down and apologize to someone else. Jinoo is almost back to normal and Aladdin is ready to execute the plan to make him completely okay.

episodesList.title: Zafar Follows Instructions
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his friends carry out the plan and prepare for the prayer session to get Jinoo well. Jinoo is occupied so that he cannot eat. On the other hand, Yasmine tells Zafar a few things and he has to follow those instructions.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, Yasmine and the others are in a tight spot as they don't have anyone to pray for Jinoo. At the right time, Rukhsar comes in and tells Yasmine that she also wants to pray. This saves the entire plan from falling apart.

episodesList.title: A Rough Time For Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Zafar continues his search for Jinoo and finally spots him arranging flowers. As he gets closer to confronting him, he is blocked in the path by a few vendors. Will Zafar catch Jinoo?

episodesList.title: Yasmine Saves Aladdin
episodesList.summary: While Aladdin and his friends are worried about Jinoo falling in Ammis sight, another shocker befalls Aladdin when Zafar confronts him out of nowhere. Will this be the end to their plans?

episodesList.title: Rukhsars Courthouse Prayer
episodesList.summary: Ammi walks into the courthouse trembling with fear about performing the prayer to the Lord amidst a big crowd. But, Yasmine steps in and boosts her confidence by saying that she should only focus on praying to the almighty and not the people around. Will Ammi be able to get over her fear and perform the prayer?

episodesList.title: Yasmine Stands Up For Rukhsar
episodesList.summary: When Zafar uses the opportunity to further insult Rukhsar for having stopped the prayer midway and seeks permission to announce the same to the public, Yasmine stands up for her. Despite the public creating a ruckus, Yasmine says that Rukhsar will finish the prayer. Will she be able to do so?

episodesList.title: Jinoo Is Back
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar is fine and gets back to singing the hymns. Aladdin goes to look for Jinoo and finds that he has changed back completely into the old Jinoo that he used to know. Aladdin Is very happy and so is Jinoo.

episodesList.title: The Gang Reunites
episodesList.summary: Jinoo is back to his senses but his only sorrow is that Aladdin is not his master. Later the entire gang comes and finds out that Jinoo is fine. They all reunite and everyone is really happy. Zafar has bad days ahead of him.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Meets Rukhsar
episodesList.summary: Jinoo misses Rukhsar and at the right time, she comes in with his favourite dish. Jinoo enjoys her company as well as her food. He almost spills the beans but handles himself somehow. A banshee appears at the Golden Tower and reaches the second gate.

episodesList.title: Snowstorm Hits The City
episodesList.summary: While people were cured of the poisoned water, the city gets attacked by a snowstorm which decreases the temperature increasing the difficulty. People are struggling to find warmth and shelter which caused due to the opening of the second door of hell.

episodesList.title: Battle Of Brains
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his gang are worried and are doing their best to stop the snowstorm. They are also worried that Zafar will command Jinoo to open the third gates of Raaz-e-Kainat. Zafar does the same and Aladdin tells Jinoo to show him who is more intelligent. Jinoo plays along with Zafar.

episodesList.title: The New Princess
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, Yasmine and Zafar reach the new kingdom and wants to find a solution to the snowstorm at Baghdad. They hide and get to the castle and later instead of being hostile, the hosts are welcoming. They get to know that either Aladdin or Zafar will now have to marry the Princess of that empire.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's New Game
episodesList.summary: The Sultana wants to marry Aladdin and not Zafar. Yasmine tries to wave her away but she is stubborn. Aladdin, on the other hand, accepts her proposal and is ready to marry her. However, this is a game that Aladdin is playing and tells the plan to Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Is Jealous
episodesList.summary: Sultana Enters Aladdin's room while Yasmine was present beforehand and listens to them secretly. On the other hand, Sultana is happy that she is getting married to Aladdin and presents him with the outfit for Mehendi Ceremony. Later Yasmine Enters the room and denies Aladdin to wear the outfit.

episodesList.title: Sultanas Mehendi Ceremony With Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin reaches the function hall where everyone is waiting for him and Sultana to arrive, and just after few moments Sultana arrives and the Mehendi ceremony starts. Meanwhile, Yasmine interrupts the scene and tries her best to not let what is happening.

episodesList.title: Marriage Gets Preponed
episodesList.summary: Aladdins and Sultanas marriage gets preponed and is about to happen two days earlier. Sultana is happy and excited about her marriage but Yasmine gets jealous. On the other hand, Aladdin knowing Zafars evil intentions takes a step to rescue the kingdom.

episodesList.title: Fighting As A Team
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine blame Zafar for preponing the marriage because he is the one who will benefit from it. Aladdin and Sultana enter the holy room for the marriage ceremony. At the same time, Zafar and Yasmine join hands to fight the soldiers and try entering the holy room.

episodesList.title: Zafar Gets What He Wants
episodesList.summary: Sultana releases the Aatish-e-Aftab and they all start praying to it. Zafar orders Jinoo to release poison gas and in the meanwhile, he escapes with the Aatish-e-Aftaab. Jinoo ensures that he escapes with all the others safely.

episodesList.title: Sultana Wishes The Very Best
episodesList.summary: The Sultana is furious on Aladdin and Yasmine. Later when she learns the truth she has a change of heart. She also admires Yasmine for being such a great Sultana of Baghdad. Zafar brings back the sun for Baghdad.

episodesList.title: Zafar Loses To Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine together save Baghdad from the snowstorm. Zafar forces Jinoo to open the last door of Raaz-e-Kainat and Jinoo has no option but to follow his orders. But Aladdin and Yasmine use the golden stone to stop Zafar.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Is Captured
episodesList.summary: Jinoo disobeys Zafar and as a result, Zafar captures Jinoo back in the lamp. Nazneen watches this and asks for this weird jewellery on Zafar. That jewellery eventually takes Zafar to much superior power.

episodesList.title: Zafar Brings Trouble Again
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine are searching out for Jinoo as he is missing. On the other hand, Zafar seeks help from this mysterious woman to find Magician Mallika. Zafar goes forward with a mirror that he receives. The man in the mirror gets permission to torture humans in return of help to find Magician Mallika.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Accuses Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine find out that Zafar had forced Jinoo to do the black magic because of which Baghdad is facing trouble. Meanwhile, the green clouds are converting people into Pigeons. When Yasmine goes to Zafar to accuse him of the bad things happening, they realise that Aladdin has become a pigeon as well.

episodesList.title: Zafar Gets Questioned
episodesList.summary: Aladdin tries to help Rukhsar against the green clouds, but he gets attacked and converts as a pigeon. Being a pigeon, Aladdin irritates Zafar and Yasmine questions Zafar about Jinoo. Zafar becomes speechless, and later Jinoo is been called out from the magic lamp by Zafar.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Problems As A Bird
episodesList.summary: Since Aladdin has become a bird, he is having a lot of problems. He wanted to see his mother and made Yasmine take him to her. Later, he stops Jinoo and Yasmine to fight Zafar, as they wouldn't be able to harm him. Aladdin wants to get back to his own body soon.

episodesList.title: A Special Date Night
episodesList.summary: Yasmine and Aladdin are discussing on keeping an eye on Zafar. On the other hand, Chacha and Anguthi are keeping Zafar busy. Later, Aladdin and Yasmine see Jinoo and Jinee Minee having a sweet moment. As Yasmine also wants to have a special moment, Aladdin takes her on a special date.

episodesList.title: Turning Into Zombies
episodesList.summary: Nazneen starts to use the Magical Mirror that she finds. The Magical Mirror tricks her and takes away her soul. Later, she becomes a zombie. The Magical Mirror wants more souls from Baghdad and plans to make this place one of living deads.

episodesList.title: Protecting Baghdad
episodesList.summary: Ali, Zafar and Yasmine plan on how to keep Baghdad safe. Aladdin almost loses his cool over Zafar and starts choking him. Aladdin and his gang plan on fixing the zombie problem. On the other hand, Gullu becomes a victim of Nazneen and turns into a zombie as well.

episodesList.title: The Army Of Zombies
episodesList.summary: Gullu tries to attack Aladdin but Jinoo saves him. They see that most of the people in Baghdad have turned into zombies. Aladdin also plans to follow the army of zombies in disguise. Jinoo helps in his disguise and Aladdin goes on with the crowd.

episodesList.title: Handling The Growing Trouble
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is walking among the zombies and has a narrow escape from being caught. A few of his friends are caught by Gullu after he wakes up and they are turned zombies as well. Aladdin gets the Magical Mirror and escapes the zombie parade with the help of Anguthi Chhap.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Realises About Fake Confession
episodesList.summary: Anguthi gets emotional and confesses Jinoo that he had given him negative energy. Jinoo also confesses to Aladdin and Yasmine that he changed Yasmine's father's confession in Zafar's pressure. Jinoo reaches Zafar's house in search of the real confession.

episodesList.title: The Search Begins
episodesList.summary: Jinoo keeps the Magical Mirror trapped in his room so that he can't spill the secret about Aladdin to Zafar. As the Magical Mirror tries to break free from Jinoo's trap, Zafar also starts to search the palace for it. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Yasmine decide to find Jaat-e-Zameen to retrieve Noor-e-Taj.

episodesList.title: Solving The Puzzle
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine are set to solve the puzzles to reach Jaat-e-Zameen to retrieve Noor-e-Taj. Meanwhile, Jinoo hides the Magical Mirror from Zafar to unravel the truth. Aladdin and Yasmine reach to the doorstep of Jaat-e-Zameen.

episodesList.title: Close To Noor-e-Taj
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine are on their way to find Noor-e-Taj. They see a tree with fresh red apples, and later find out that it's a trap by Shamsher, who demands them to answer three questions correctly, which would lead them to their freedom. Meanwhile, there's terror in Baghdad.

episodesList.title: Baghdad In Big Trouble
episodesList.summary: In Jaat-e-Zameen, Yasmine meets her great great grandmother who has been protecting the Noor-e-Taj all this while. Yasmine enlightens her about what's happening in Baghdad and how only Noor-e-Taj can stop all of it. Meanwhile, in Baghdad, Jinoo drops the Magical Mirror which Zafar has been searching for.

episodesList.title: Magic of Crown
episodesList.summary: Yasmine wears the crown and prays to save Baghdad. Zafar is furious about his defeat. Once again, Aladdin and Yasmine together win the battle.

episodesList.title: Sultana Of Baghdad
episodesList.summary: Yasmine wears the crown and prays to save Baghdad. The Crown does it magic and the magical mirror breaks into pieces. Once again Aladdin and Yasmine together win the battle and Yasmine becomes the Sultana Of Bagdad. Zafar is furious about his defeat.

episodesList.title: Daawat-E-Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin traps Zafar into throwing a daawat for Yasmine. Zafar poisons the food with which Yasmine is going to start the daawat. What is Aladdin's big plan and with Yasmine's life at stake, will Zafar win?

episodesList.title: Zafar Ki Saazish
episodesList.summary: In the whole celebration as Zafar is waiting for Yasmin to take the first bite, Chota Jinoo starts eating the food first which makes Ginoo angry as he is going with Ali's plan to distract Zafar and it leads to a fuy food fight between everyone. A man reAlises that the chandelier is about to drop on Yasmine. Will Aladdin able to save Yasmin?

episodesList.title: Aladdin Reveals Zafar's Plan
episodesList.summary: Aladdin reveals a fact that shocks everyone. What did Aladdin reveal? Did he know about Zafar's plans? What is Aladdin's next mission?

episodesList.title: Zapped Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zafar is shocked to see his sister there and tells her that it was not his fault that the mirror has been destroyed and Zehar tells him then he needs to know who did. GB who had come to Zafar's room earlier had left the bunch of pictures that he had clicked from the crowning ceremony and the daawat. In the series of events, Zehar and Zafar get to know that there needs to be someone who would have helped Yasmine get the crown and Zehar gets her hands on the photos left by GB there and she is shocked. She tells Zafar that it is Ali who is helping the Sultana as per the photos and Zafar is zapped to know the same. He takes an oath to get the truth out anyhow with proper proof. What's his next plan of action?

episodesList.title: Zafar's New Plan
episodesList.summary: After Zafar gets to know that Ali is somewhere involved in the failure of all his plans along with Yasmine, Zafar along with his sister plans to take advantage of his family/toli to know the truth about him. On the other hand, Aladdin and toli plan on taking some time of their own to think of a plan to get the lamp from Zafar. Zafar with the help of chachi sends out secret invitation from his lamp and asks them to meet him at a particular place separately. They all reach the place and are shocked to see each other there together. Zafar is planning a new plan.

episodesList.title: Zafar Turns into Ali
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine look for the toli and can't find them. Yasmine tries to console him by saying that they must be in their zones of thinking about the plan and should give them some more time.

episodesList.title: Jam-E-Behroopiya
episodesList.summary: Zafar goes to Ali's room to find 3 devices. Yasmine enters the room searching for Ali and notices Zafar's shoes and as she removes the curtain, she sees Ali is standing behind. Zafar uses the 'jam-e-behroopiya' made by her sister.

episodesList.title: The Truth Of Ali's Identity Comes Out
episodesList.summary: As Zafar gets the devices, with the help of her sister she unleashe's the truth about their identity and all the jis come to their ji avatar and Zafar is shocked to see GOR Alive. Zafar becomes hundred percent confident that Ali is Aladdin now and Zafar along with Zehar plan on a new trick where in she creates a poisonous apple for Yasmine which will have only one way of getting out- the kiss of love. The truth of Ali's identity will soon come out through him saving his love. We end the episode where we see that the apple is consumed by Yasmine and chachi tells Zafar and Aladdin to visit a cave which has a witch who can give them the antidote to the poison.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Vs Zafar
episodesList.summary: As Zafar and Aladdin reach the cave, the witch tells Aladdin about the kiss of love which is the only solution for the problem. Aladdin falls into a daldal and it seems that Aladdin is just about to get engulfed, when Aladdin emerges as a hero.

episodesList.title: Timnasa And Zafar's Collaboration
episodesList.summary: We start the crossover episode from this day. After the open challenge given by Aladdin to Zafar- Zafar plans on doing something really big through Jinoo. As Jinoo and Zafar talk about it, all of a sudden a portal appears out of nowhere and we see Timnasa and Bhaymar come out of it. They introduce themselves and Timnasa tells Zafar her plan of getting the 3 precious stones which will help her control the past present and future and she would need Jinoo for getting the same. They both come to a conclusion that Timnasa will leave Bhaymar to turn Bagdadh into a no mans land and Timnasa can take Ginoo with her till then. Timnasa along with Ginoo step into the future

episodesList.title: Zafar's Fatal Agenda
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine think of what will be the next step of Zafar. Aladdin orders GB to get the pious thread for everyone in Bagdadh so that they can be away from all evil. Zafar is surprised seeing Bhaymaar's power as he creates a magical snake woman- Nagini who has the power to convert anyone who looks into her eyes into a statue and she can take anyones disguise. Zafar commands her to change into Yasmine. With the help of the jis, he gets Yasmine kidnapped. Now Nagini in the roop of Yasmine gets with Aladdin and plans the destruction of everyone.

episodesList.title: Good Vs Evil
episodesList.summary: As we see Yasmine in the roop of Nagini, Aladdin and GB get the whole of Baghdad in the underground hiding place. Nagini knows the secret place and Bhaymaar is helping her with the plan constantly.

episodesList.title: Aladdin and Vivaan's CoAlition
episodesList.summary: As Aladdin and Vivaan see the situation of the people underground,he moves towards ammi to see if she is okay and there is a hit and miss and Aladdin just manages to save ammi from Yasmine (Nagini). She asks ammi to hide at a secret place along with other woman. Vivaan and Aladdin through Bulbul chacha's lab get hold of a flute which they use to find out that Yasmine itself is Nagini and Aladdin is shocked to see the transformation. Vivaan tells him that they need to travel to the future to get Ginoo back and they get into the portal from where Vivaan came.

episodesList.title: Ateet Ki Jung
episodesList.summary: Zafar is successful in procuring all three time stones via Jinoo. Meanwhile, Baalveer travels back to the past Bagdad along with Aladdin and Jinoo. The heroic duo then fights Nagini and manages to turn her into stone using a mirror. Then, Baalveer destroys the three stones and defeat Zafar. It is then Aladdin learns that Yasmine was never captured by Nagini, but she is in some another grave danger.

episodesList.title: Chachi Blinds Ammi
episodesList.summary: To Aladdin's surpise, Zafar calls all three djis to protect him. Chachi blinds Ammi with the surma. After being told by Zafar that Ammi is in grave danger, Aladdin and Jinoo start looking for her.

episodesList.title: Zafar Challenges Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Jinoo finally find Ammi lying unconscious on the floor in her old house. They realise that Ammi has lost her eyesight due to some dark magical powers of the surma. When Zafar openly challenges Aladdin from stopping him from meeting Malika, Aladdin goes to Omar's old house looking for a solution in his study material.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Finds A Cure
episodesList.summary: While going through Omars written books, Aladdin overhears a few fakirs talking about a pious place outside Bagdad where angels listen to the prayers of the pure hearted. Aladdin persuades the fakir to take him with them. This fills Aladdin with hope and he informs his mother, Rukhsaar, about the same. Rukhsaar is elated. Aladdin and Rukhsar then leave for the place on a cart.

episodesList.title: The Cuing Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, stays empty stomach, but provides Ammi with all the nourishments. Zafar hatche's an evil plan of making a potion to reach Mallika, that would need sacrificing the djis. Though, he would also need to get Yasmine to meet his evil ends, a quick start makes him happy for the moment.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Meets Omar
episodesList.summary: Despite Aladdin's persistence and prayers, Ammi does not get back her vision. Losing all hope, Aladdin is about to give up when to his disbelief, Omar, his long lost father, appears in the form of an angel to help him. Ammi, too, feels his presence. Omar blesses Ammi who then recovers and sees Omar.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Super Plan
episodesList.summary: Reunited Aladdin, Ammi and Jinoo plan their next step. Jinoo goes to Zafar. There, he sees Zeher for the first time. Zafar tells them that before the sacrifice he will have a grand celebration. Jinoo is shocked to learn that Zafar is going to sacrifice the three djis after the celebration. Jinoo tells the same to Aladdin. This shocks him and he promises that he won't let Zafar touch his djis. Aladin informs Jinoo of his plan and asks him to meet him at his old house. Aladdin meets Bulbul Chacha, where he gets an invention, a cockroach. A camera is installed in that cockroach, which will help Aladdin in pinpointing the location of the djis objects.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Quirky Plan
episodesList.summary: Aladdin makes a plan with Jinoo and GB. All of them disguise themselves as Female Dancers. When Jinoo and GB distract Zafar and Zeher with their charm, Aladdin asks the three Jis to follow him to the other room. The cockroach shows them the location of the box with the objects. Aladdin and three Jis take out the box but at the same time, GB's wig also falls off. Will everyone know GB's truth?

episodesList.title: The Battle For Djis
episodesList.summary: Zafar identifies GB and shocks everyone. Aladdin, on the other hand, gets hold of the ring and summons CJ and once again, he becomes CJ's master. Meanwhile, Zafar and Zeher find that all the three Djis are missing from their respective places. They rush towards the place where Zafar has kept the che'st. Aladdin is about to summon JM, when Zafar enters the room and confronts Aladdin. A scuffle breaks out between them. In the end, Aladdin gets the bottle and succeeds in taking back the bottle. JM finally returns to Aladdin. Zafar is furious. He grabs the ring and asks Zeher the time of sacrifice. Zafar immediately blurts now. Zafar throws the ring into the potion and Gor gets covered up in flames. Aladdin and team are shocked.

episodesList.title: Anghuti Chhaap Burns To Death
episodesList.summary: The moment the ring falls into the potion, Anghuti Chhaap gets covered in flames. His whole body starts burning. Aladdin his friends are saddened to see this. They have a very emotional moment. Aladdin and others say Aghuti Chhaap their last goodbye. Rukhsaar witnesses the last visual of a dying Anghuti Chhaap. Keeping her emotions in check Rukhsaar, and tells Aladdin and others that its time to fight to end Zafar's story. When Zafar and Zeher reach there, Zafar realises that Aladdin has saved his mother. Zafar then reveals his next plan. He tells them the whole of Baghdad is waiting at the palace gates to question Ali's identity, who apparently is Aladdin.

episodesList.title: Black Smoke Kidnaps Rukhsaar & Djis
episodesList.summary: The day of the confrontation finally comes. Zafar gets Aladdin's truth out in front of the people of Baghdad. Zafar also tells the masses that Aladdin's entire family are of djis. He says that Aladdin's mother, Rukhsaar is the mastermind of the entire game, and alleges that whatever problems Baghdad faced, including Yasmine becoming a parrot, is because of Rukhsaar. Zafar's provocative words angers the crowd. They start beating Aladdin and his gang. On the other hand, Yasmine somehow escapes from the cave. She then heads in the palace's direction. However, before she can reach there, a black smoke engulfs everyone. Rukhsaar, JM and CJ get kidnapped. Only Aladdin and GB are left behind, fainting.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Fights Zafar And Zeher
episodesList.summary: Yasmine challenges Zafar to fight with her. Zafar agrees to do so. Both of them duel with their swords. After a spectacular swordfight, Yasmine corners Zafar and she is about to kill him, when suddenly Zeher charges in with her sword and throws Yasmine away. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Bulbul Chacha is the one who kidnapped Chand Changezi, Jinee-Minee and Ammi from the Crowd. Aladdin and Gul Badhan meet with them as well. Bulbul Chacha tells everyone that it was Jinoo's plan to save them. Aladdin promises Ammi that he will save Yasmine from Zafar. Aladdin, Chand Changezi and Jinee-Minee head out to save Yasmine. On the other hand, Zeher joins Zafar in the fight and she throws a magical potion on Yasmine which transforms her into a flower.

episodesList.title: Yasmine's Condition Shocks Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zafar is surprised to see Yasmine turn into a rose. He is shocked by the power of the magical potion. He yells at Zeher and blames her for transforming Yasmine into a rose, as Yasmine is the only one person that could help Zafar reach Malika. On the other hand, Aladdin, Chand Changezi and Jinee-Minee reach the cave and notice that Yasmine is not present there. Aladdin realises that Yasmine has freed herself and has gone to the Palace. When Aladdin reaches the palace, he notices that a lot of people have gathered around. Meanwhile, Zeher tells Zafar that Yasmine can be returned into her original self. When Zafar learns that Aladdin might come back to save Yasmine, he plans to publicly anounce that Aladdin and his Jis have turned Yasmine into a rose.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Gets The Rose
episodesList.summary: The people of Baghdad are searching for Aladdin and his genies. Aladdin and his genies find the location of the rose. It is in a garden. Aladdin wears the invisible cloak he got from Bulbul uncle to enter the garden. Aladdin successfully manages to obtain the rose but feels bad for Yasmine's condition. Thats when, Jinoo tells Aladdin that Yasmine can get back to her original form with the help of a seed of life located at Yunan. Meanwhile, Zeher also informs Zafar that a seed of life can help him reach Mallika. Aladdin and Zafar separately, leave for Yunan to find the seed of life. Will they cross each others path on their way?

episodesList.title: Zafar Creates A Sandstorm
episodesList.summary: Zafar and Aladdin cross their paths in Yunan. Zafar notices Aladdin carrying the rose with him. Zafar tells Aladdin that he will never be able to reach the Seed of Life. Zafar creates a sandstorm with the help of Zeher's magic. Aladdin and his team get stuck in the storm, while Zafar, Zehar and Jinoo march ahead towards the Seed of Life. The sandstorm creates a shock wave which cause the rose cage to fall off. At the same time, a huge rock falls on it.

episodesList.title: The Maze
episodesList.summary: Zafar reaches a Maze. He enters the Maze alone leaving Jinoo and Zeher outside as no magic users are allowed inside the Maze. After a while, Aladdin and his team also reach the Maze. Aladdin then enters the Maze alone. Jinoo is happy to see Aladdin and his team. Jinoo, Chand Changezi and Jinee - Minee create a magic to destroy Zeher's magical potions.

episodesList.title: Jinoo Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Jinee-Minee and Chand Changezi destroy Zeher's apparatus. Now, Zeher is unable to make to an important potion. Aladdin and Zafar are stopped by Khatral, the guardian of the seed. Zafar manages to escape Khatral and he runs toward the seed of life. Aladdin outsmarts Khatral and destroys him. He runs towards the seed of life as well. Aladdin manages to get past Zafar and reach the seed of life first. Meanwhile, Jinoo, Jinee-Minee and Chand Changezi are celebrating their victory. Zeher secretly notices them, she learns that Jinoo was never on their side. Zeher yells at Jinoo and slaps him, she is about to hurt Jinee-Minee when Jinoo turns into his warrior transformation and he flings Zeher Away. Later, it is shown that Zeher is lying down unconscious when Zafar tries to wake her up. She tells him the truth about Jinoo. What will Zafar do to Jinoo?

episodesList.title: Zafar Melts Jinoo's Lamp?
episodesList.summary: Jinoo rejects to help Zafar in his ambition to reach Mallika even if it means death to him . Zafar and Zeher are surprised by Jinoo behaviour, but then they realize that Jinoo's lamp will help them reach Mallika as she made the lamp herself. If Zafar and Zeher melt the lamp, its magical metal will open the gates to reach Mallika. After listening to their plan, Jinoo decides to inform Aladdin about it. Jinoo reaches Bulbul Chachas House and meets with Aladdin, but suddenly, his body starts burning and he is unable to speak as Zafar puts Jinoo's lamp in fire. How will Aladdin save Jinoo?

episodesList.title: Will Bulbul Uncle Save Jinoo?
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his team cannot find any solution to Jinoo's burning. So Aladdin asks Bulbul uncle for help. At the same time, Zafar and Zeher enjoy melting Jinoo's Lamp. Aladdin's mother pained at watching Jinoo burn, pours ice cold water on him. It causes Jinoo to get a bit of relief but Zafar and Zeher then decide to melt his lamp in molten lava. Jinoo's suffering grow higher. Meanwhile, Bulbul uncle discovers a device which can show the owner's thoughts. He places the device on Jinoo's head so that Aladdin and his team can get the location of Jinoo's lamp. Will Jinoo show his lamp's location to Aladdin in time?

episodesList.title: Zafar And Zeher Trap Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Bulbul Uncles invention fails as Zeher puts the lamp into the lava. Aladdin and company are now in a fix as to what to do. Jinoo starts throwing fireballs from his mouth, which start hitting everyone. Therefore, he leaves as he feels that he can hurt someone. Everyone is scared as Jinoo is in his dji avatar and is spitting fireballs. Somehow, Aladdin and GB save Jinoo along with CJ and JM and move on to their next plan, i.e., Ammi. Ammi encourages Jinoo to think and tell them where the lamp is, or where Zafar and Zeher are. Finally, Jinoo takes the name of Zeher's cave. While Ammi and others take care of Jinoo, Aladdin rushes towards the mentioned cave. Aladdin reaches there and manages to get the lamp out of the lava. Just then, Zeher opens a trap door for the lamp to fall down, so that no once can reach there. However, Aladdin uses his wit and jumps down. The trap door closes. Zafar and Zeher are on the upper floor, whereas Aladdin is below them with the lamp.

episodesList.title: Will Aladdin Find Jinoo's Lamp?
episodesList.summary: After his fall, Aladdin finds himself in a room of mirrors. He finds the reflection of the lamp in each mirror. This confuses him and he wonders that where the actual mirror is. Seeing no other way, Aladdin starts breaking the mirrors, but he fails in finding anything. Just then, Zafar also enters the same room. Meanwhile, Jinoo is still in flames. What will happen next? Will Aladdin succeed in getting the real lamp and saving Jinoo?

episodesList.title: Aladdin gets Jinoo's Lamp
episodesList.summary: Jinoo's lamp is still in the mirror maze. Aladdin and Zafar cross their swords against each other to obtain the lamp. After a while, Aladdin uses his wit to defeat Zafar and gets the lamp from him. Meanwhile, Jinoo on the verge of death, is waiting for Aladdin to return. While Aladdin's mother is concerned about him, Yasmine arrives at Bulbul Uncles house and tries to cheer Jinoo. Finally, Aladdin reaches Bulbul Uncles house and tells Jinoo that he has brought Jinoo's lamp with him. Aladdin asks Jinoo to get back inside his lamp, but Jinoo fails to do so. After a lot of struggle, Jinoo returns to his lamp and becomes Aladdin's genie again. In the end, Zafar gets furious at his defeat and tries to hurt himself, but Zeher notices this and tries to console him.

episodesList.title: Zafar On The Run
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his team decide to catch Zafar, but Zafar and Zeher plan to run away to the Mucchad cave, as they think it is highly secure. Meanwhile, Yasmine interacts with the people of Baghdad. She announces a big celebration for her return and decides to expose Zafar in the same celebration. Later, Zafar and Zeher encounter two beggars on their way to the Mucchad cave. As one of the beggars accidentally pushe's Zeher, she makes a big deal out of it. The furious beggars then start walking towards Zeher and Zafar menancingly.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Exposes Zafar
episodesList.summary: As all the beggars hurl up around Zafar and Zeher, it is revealed to be Aladdin's plan to corner them along with Raees. On the other hand, Gulbadan is being followed by Aladdin's uncle and aunt to know where Zafar might have escaped. Later, Aladdin discloses the real identity of Mucchad in front of everyone as Zafar. Being exposed in front of everyone, how will Zafar run away from this situation now?

episodesList.title: Zafar Escapes
episodesList.summary: The palace is decorated for the celebrations of Jashn-e-fateh. Yasmine comes forward to give a speech. There, Zafar manages to disappear into thin air along with Zeher from the spot. Later, Aladdin asks Jinoo to teleport them to Zafar's hideout. Will Aladdin be able to track down Zafar?

episodesList.title: Queen Yasmine's Judgement
episodesList.summary: Aladdin gets hold of Zafar, and drags him in front of entire Baghdad. Yasmine tells everyone about Aladdin's iocence and Zafar's misdeeds including that of killing their king as well. After showing the whole evidence, Queen Yasmine announces a death sentence for Zafar, while Zeher is imprisoned.

episodesList.title: Zeher Hopes To Escape
episodesList.summary: As Zafar is given a death sentence, Aladdin's mother tells Aladdin and Jasmine that humans have no right to take away anybody elses life. Hence, they give Zafar life imprisonment in a strict jail and decide to keep Zeher in Baghdad. As Aladdin and Toli rejoice in the victory of the palace, Zeher thinks of a way to get out of the jail. Zeher notices that the bangles have gone black indicating the para to be active. She is hopeful of Malika coming to life.

episodesList.title: Zeher Finds Aladdin's Lamp
episodesList.summary: In order to stop Zafar from being taken to the jail, Zeher manages to run away. Meanwhile, Rukhsaar is spending some lone time, when Zeher hits her on her hand. Later, Zeher enters the palace and finds Aladdin's lamp.

episodesList.title: Para's Life In Danger?
episodesList.summary: Zeher leaves to free Zafar after she manages to get Para. Later, Aladdin finds the lamp and Jinoo realises that Para is missing. Meanwhile, Zeher succeeds to free Zafar, and they decide to drop Para in the volcano.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Corners Zafar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin comes and rescues lamp as Zafar and Zeher throw it into the lava. Yasmine and Zeher fight. This is Yasmine's ploy to keep Zeher away from Zafar. Zafar and Aladdin fight at the other end of the cave and Zafar manages to take back lamp. Zafar reaches a dead end hence has nowhere else to go and decides to fall with the lamp. The lamp goes into the lava and Zafar dies. At the same time, Malika turns from a stone into human form.

episodesList.title: Baghdad In Danger Again?
episodesList.summary: Malika is about to step outside the portal but Jinoo uses his power and closes the portal at the last moment. Aladdin , Yasmine and Jinoo celebrate their victory over successful stopping Malika from entering. But theyre mistaken as Malikas face appears in the sky.

episodesList.title: Will Yasmine Accept Aladdin's Proposal?
episodesList.summary: Baghdad is celebrating Jashn-e-Dilbar, the festival of love. Mallika enters Baghdad and starts following Aladdin. Later, Aladdin proposes to Yasmine. Will she accept?

episodesList.title: Malika Takes a Disguise!
episodesList.summary: Malika pretends to be Yasmine's aunt and writes to her, informing about her visit to Baghdad. She states that her kingdom was destroyed in an earthquake and thats the reason for her visit. Yasmine requests Aladdin to receive her. Aladdin and Jingoo go to receive the aunt, whos actually Malika in disguise.

episodesList.title: Malika and Aladdin Enter the Palace
episodesList.summary: Malika and Aladdin enter the palace. JM and Yasmine are having a conversation when a glass vase breaks and JM believes it to be a bad omen. Meanwhile, Jinoo and other genies realises that their magic has suddenly stopped working.

episodesList.title: Mallika Impersonates Yasmine's Aunt
episodesList.summary: Upon reaching the palace, Yasmine enquires with Aladdin about her aunt. She reminds him that he had to fetch her. Aladdin clarifies that she never turned up. Yasmine criticises her aunt. But Mallika, pretending to be the aunt, overhears Yasmine and comes face-to-face with her.

episodesList.title: Malika's Truth Revealed?
episodesList.summary: While on the palace tour with Aladdin and Yasmine, Malika senses that something is off. When she reaches the kitchen, she finds out that JM and CJ are performing magic in their genie form. Malika is totally shocked.

episodesList.title: Malika's Sudden announcement
episodesList.summary: Malika knows the advantages that Aladdin has because of his three genies and a magic carpet. She knows that she needs to be in his good books. During dinner, Malika announces the engagement of Aladdin and Yasmine. Everybody is surprised with this sudden announcement.

episodesList.title: Malika’s Hidden Motive
episodesList.summary: The engagement preparations are in full swing. Malika has a hidden motive behind getting Aladdin and Yasmine engaged. She reveals this hidden motive, which is to destroy the world using an instrument.

episodesList.title: Malika Faces A Hurdle
episodesList.summary: Malika requires a dagger in order to put her plan in action. Malika can use this dagger to make a genie tonic which can be used to turn people into genies. Malika currently has only one of the genie tonics remaining. So, she requires the dagger to make some more of it. But there is one person stopping her from actualizing her plan.

episodesList.title: The Dagger Thief
episodesList.summary: When Malika tells her story about the missing dagger, she reveals that the one who stole her dagger is from Baghdad as he had Baghdad's badge on him.

episodesList.title: Malika Hunts For The Correct Key
episodesList.summary: Malika is in search of the correct key that will bring her closer to finding the dagger. She uses her powers to summon all the keys to her room, after which all the people of Baghdad can't find their keys. Aladdin is confused as to how everybody can't find their keys in Baghdad. Aladdin and CJ enter Malikas room as Malika is looking for the correct key in her room. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: The Engagement
episodesList.summary: Ruksaar and Gulbadan decorate the whole palace for Aladdin and Yasmine's engagement. On the other hand, Aladdin struggles to find the perfect gift for Yasmine, but he ends up getting his mother's beautiful bangle for her. As Aladdin and Yasmine rekindle their love, Malika hatches a plan to take over Baghdad after Zafar's death. What will happen now? Check out in this episode.

episodesList.title: When Blessings Count
episodesList.summary: It's the day of the ring ceremony. The bride and the groom get ready for the big event. Just then, Ammi announces the arrival of a revered guest. Who is this guest that Ammi has invited? Why did Ammi invite the guest? Watch the episode to know what Ammi is upto.

episodesList.title: For Ammi's Sake
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is all set to swear on his mother as desired by Malika. But he stops just in time. Something catches his attention. What could it be that stops him from swearing? What will Malika do to make him do as she wants? Watch this episode reveal.

episodesList.title: Back To Normal?
episodesList.summary: Ammi is no longer her usual self. She has turned into a Jinn. Witnessing this shocking happening, Aladdin makes a promise. What is that promise? Does Aladdin have the time on his side or has the countdown begun? You need to watch this episode to know better.

episodesList.title: Ruins of Baltish
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, accompanied by Anghuti Chhaap, set about their journey to the old world of Baltish. Aladdin is in search of a person who can provide him with magic potion. Who is the person in question? Will Aladdin be successful in getting the magic potion? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Twin Twist
episodesList.summary: When Aladdin falls into the trap of Zeher, there is no one to help him, save one person. The person is none other than Zafar's twin brother. In order to establish this fact, Aladdin and Genie Of The Ring plan a fun quiz. Who is this twin? Will he be able to convince Aladdin of his mistaken identity? Watch this episode to know.

episodesList.title: Team Game
episodesList.summary: While Aladdin, Genie of The Ring and Faraz are catching up, Faraz reveals how his witch mother always knows about Malika. Aladdin confides in Faraz that Malika was at work again - this time converted his Ammi into a Genie. Faraz decides to help Aladdin. The trio head to Baghdad. To know what happens next, stay tuned to this episode.

episodesList.title: Malika's Menace
episodesList.summary: There is just one way in which Aladdin can get back his Ammi in human avatar. Aladdin needs to comply with Malika's condition and fetch her the special dagger. Left with no choice, Aladdin agrees to her whims and begins his journey towards the first adventure. Join Aladdin in his adventure, in this episode.

episodesList.title: Magic In The Fruit
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, Genie Of The Ring and Faraz finally have arrived at their destination- the jungle. But this is no ordinary jungle, it is a mystical and magical jungle. The magic soon transpires as Genie ends up gobbling a fruit. What happens next will leave you baffled. Don't miss this episode of magic and adventure.

episodesList.title: Dangerous Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is no longer behaving like a friend to Faraz or Genie Of The Ring. He has become a dreadful creature whom Faraz and Genie have a tough time tackling. Faraz has one last option to make Aladdin alright, to which Genie does not agree. Meanwhile Aladdin is becoming a threat to both. What is Faraz's suggestion and why doesn't Genie agree? Watch this episode to know.

episodesList.title: The Khanjar Hunt
episodesList.summary: During an encounter with GOR, Faraz attacks Aladdin with a silver object. This attack wards off the magical effect and makes Aladdin normal again. Soon, the sun and moon rays help Aladdin locate the Khanjar. Aladdin gets his hands on the first part of the Khanjar. Watch the interesting turn of events in this magical episode.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Proposes A Deal
episodesList.summary: When Aladdin gets the first part of the Khanjar, he goes to the palace, but instead of handing over the part to Malika, he puts forth a condition. He proposes that he will retrieve and hand over all the parts of the Khanjar to Malika, only after she brings his Ammi back to normal. Will Malika agree to this condition? Will Aladdin be able to seal the deal with Malika? Watch this adventurous episode to know better.

episodesList.title: Blood Rejects Blood?
episodesList.summary: Omar is shocked to discover that Aladdin has joined hands with Malika. So, he confronts him about the same. However, when Aladdin lets his father know that Ruksaar was turned into a Jinn by Malika, Omar feels disheartened. Aladdin asks his father to help him find the missing pieces of the dagger to save Ruksaaar. Will Omar help him? Check out this high-on-drama episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Omar Refuses To Help Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Omar is unable to come to terms with the fact that Aladdin is helping out Malika. Even his reasons seem to be insufficient to propel Omar to help him. Aladdin tries to convince his father that he is only trying to save his mother, and the only way he can do that, is by handing over the dagger to Malika. But Omar backs off from helping Aladdin. What will Aladdin do now? Watch this episode to know his next move.

episodesList.title: The Secret Destination
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is shattered for not having his father's support, but nothing can deter him from saving his mother. He moves on to find the next missing part of the dagger. However, the quest is not an easy one and this time, he is faced with riddles to solve. Will Aladdin find a lead? Tune into this adventurous episode and join Aladdin on his quest of finding the missing part of the dagger.

episodesList.title: The Transformation Trick
episodesList.summary: Aladdin has set out on his quest to find the answer to the riddle. When he lands up at the palace, he meets Sultana, present there in the form of a cat. When he approaches her for help, she transforms into a beautiful woman and introduces herself as Tamanna. Aladdin wonders if she would know the answer to the riddle and asks her the same. But Tamanna uses her powers on Aladdin. See what challenge crops up in Aladdin's life after that and how he tackles it. Tune into this thrilling episode.

episodesList.title: The Cat Cracks The Code
episodesList.summary: Tamanna's magic transforms Aladdin into a cat and a further element makes him speechless. However, Aladdin decides to reach out to Yasmine and Faraz for their help. But he struggles to convince them that he is Aladdin, since he is under a spell. He manages to play around to get their attention and give out his identity. Once Yasmine and Faraz learn that he is Aladdin, will they be successful in helping him further in his mission? Watch this interesting episode to know what happens next.

episodesList.title: The Cats Devise A Plan
episodesList.summary: Tamanna is operating as per the directions from Omar. She gears up to transfer the dagger to a realm where no human can get by. At the other end, Aladdin and Yasmine, who encounter two more cats, try convincing them that they must find a way to reach Tamanna, as only she can undo the spell that's been cast on him. He promises to help them out in return. Will the cats buy Aladdin's word? Or are there more obstacles for him to encounter before he transforms back to his human form?

episodesList.title: Leaping Into Victory
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his gang have been through a series of troubles to find the missing part of the dagger. Yasmine, who turns into a cat for Aladdin's mission to be successful, is happy, as Aladdin vaults over every obstacle and brings back the second part of the dagger. He heads back to Baghdad with his find. He begins to prepare tactfully for his next step in the mission. Will Aladdin find success again? Will he unearth the last missing part of the dagger? Watch this adventurous episode of Aladdin.

episodesList.title: An Enormous Challenge
episodesList.summary: As per Ammi's advice, Aladdin and his team follow the mountain shadow and get to the flower. But when Aladdin digs out the box, the impossible happens. In a fraction of a second, Omar appears and reveals to him that he has transported the last part to Farishta land, and no human can trespass that territory at any cost. How will Aladdin get to the last part of the dagger? What other challenges will follow him? Tune into this interesting episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Puppet Land
episodesList.summary: En route Farishtabad, Aladdin and Faraz, land up in a strange land, which has only puppets. The leader happens to be a dwarf, who only wakes up from her slumber at the sight of human visitors. She thwarts Aladdin with lifetime captivity. Will Aladdin be reduced to a puppet? Watch this magical episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Turning To Puppets
episodesList.summary: The dwarf leader of the puppet land is all set to turn Aladdin and Faraz into puppets. Just in the nick of the moment, Aladdin comes up with an innovative idea, which may deter their transformation into puppets. What is Aladdin's idea and will it distract the puppet leader? Watch this nail biting episode to discover.

episodesList.title: Sinking Son
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is refused the part of dagger by his father, Omar. Aladdin is in dire need of this dagger for the sake of the promise made to his mother. Torn between the whims of his parents, Aladdin has no other option but to end his life. Will this step change his father's decision? Will Aladdin's promise remain unfulfilled? Watch this sentimental episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Little Choice
episodesList.summary: Omar has no other option but to part with the third piece of the dagger for the sake of his dear son, Aladdin. Aladdin returns to Baghdad with the dagger and meets Malika for the potion. Malika, being her sly self, turns the table on her opponent and there takes place a magical fight. Who will win this fight? Watch this episode to find out the fight outcome.

episodesList.title: Smoked
episodesList.summary: Just as Aladdin is about to strike Malika with the dagger, he starts getting consumed in an evil smoke. Malika rejoices as this will bring an end to Aladin's life. If Aladdin dies, will his Ammi ever be released from the curse of being a genie? Will Aladdin be able to come out of this cursed smoke? Watch this dramatic episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Winning Stroke
episodesList.summary: Backed by a pure soul, Aladdin succeeds to win over the Shaitaan. This makes Malika a loser too. As she stands there transfixed at the scene, one wonders whether this will mean that Aladdin will be able to have the tonic to bring back his mother to human form. Will Malika give in? Watch this nail biting episode to know better.

episodesList.title: End Of Evil?
episodesList.summary: Aladdin finally manages to get the dagger from Malika and it's celebration time at Baghdad. However, what Aladdin does not know is that there awaits a nasty twist of events for him, something which he cannot even think in his wildest dreams. Watch this episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Enemy Undercover
episodesList.summary: Seeing Faraz with the dagger, Aladdin demands to know the reason. Faraz reveals a fact which leaves Aladdin shattered. Aladdin's friendship with Faraz is under scanner. What does Faraz tell Aladdin to cause this level of astonishment? Watch this crucial episode to know further.

episodesList.title: Zafar - The Ayiyyar
episodesList.summary: Zafar reveals his new found sorcerer avatar with the help of which, no task seems impossible for him anymore. He uses this magical power to put Aladdin and the entire toli under arrest. Will Aladdin and his family be ever able to get out of this prison? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jahannum Awaits!
episodesList.summary: When Aladdin disagrees to go with Zafar on a quest to obtain the 'Laal Sandook', Zafar informs him that after Omar handed over the final part of the Devil's Dagger to Aladdin, he has been banished to 'Jahannum'. And if Aladdin wants to save Omar, he should join Zafar on his way to hell. Aladdin realises that the stakes are too high, but will he participate in Zafar's hunt for the Red Box? Find out more about it, in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jinoo's Warning
episodesList.summary: As Aladdin and Yasmine plan to leave, they present a lovely gift to Ammi. Ammi is elated with the gift and promises that she will always hold it close to her heart. Meanwhile, Jinoo is not very comfortable with Aladdin going with Zafar and cautions him for the same. Watch this episode to know if Jinoo's warning will change Aladdin's mind.

episodesList.title: Genie's Vision
episodesList.summary: Genie of the Ring sees a scary vision pertaining to Aladdin and Yasmine. He is so perturbed, that he frees himself from Zafar's captivity and rushes to Baghdad to warn Aladdin. However, on reaching Baghdad, he gets to know from Ammi that Aladdin and Yasmine have already set about their journey. What vision does the Genie see? Are Aladdin and Yasmine in any danger? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Hell Of Fire
episodesList.summary: The only way to save Omar is to get hold of the trunk. The search for the trunk takes Aladdin and Yasmine to the hell of fire. Once there, they find that the trunk is being guarded by a deadly creature. Can they defeat the guard and get hold of the trunk? You can get the answer as you watch the episode, stay tuned!

episodesList.title: Trunk Twister
episodesList.summary: As Aladdin and Yasmine reach jahannum, they encounter a deadly dragon that is protecting the laal sandook. The dragon is killed and they finally get the trunk. Zafar, true to his promise, releases Omar after getting the trunk. Omar is furious at Aladdin for letting Zafar have the magic trunk. Did Aladdin really part away with that important trunk or is there a twist in the offing? Watch this episode to find out how the mystery unfolds.

episodesList.title: A New Chapter Begins
episodesList.summary: Before Zafar could use Aladdin to trace the red box, Omar does the unexpected. He puts a mark of the moon and a star on Aladdin and Yasmine respectively, and pushes them into the lava. A defeated Zafar returns to Baghdad and casts a spell which makes everyone, including Rukhsar, forget about Aladdin and Yasmine. But in a far away kingdom, two babies are born with the same mark of the moon and a star. Have Aladdin-Yasmine taken a rebirth?

episodesList.title: Aladdin And Kaala Chor
episodesList.summary: Aladdin's father has set a target for him to catch the Kaala Chor. While roaming on the streets, Aladdin chances upon Kaala Chor. The meeting is memorable. Meanwhile, Zafar ropes in Ammi to fulfil his evil intention of finding a pawn for his mission. What happens when Aladdin meets Kaala Chor? What is Zafar upto? Watch this episode to know the twists in the story.

episodesList.title: A Bait For The Kaala Chor
episodesList.summary: While Zafar is trying to use Ammi's pathshala to get an Aladdin-like person to carry out his evil deeds, Ammi's mind has other thoughts. On the other hand, the King never forgets to remind Aladdin about catching the Kaala Chor. To honour his father's order, Aladdin thinks of a way to tempt the Kaala Chor to come out in the open, so that he can be caught red-handed. What is Ammi thinking? Will Aladdin's plan work? Watch this high-on- drama episode to know better.

episodesList.title: Anguthi Chhaap's Captive Life
episodesList.summary: Aladdin sees flashes from the past whenever he is in close proximity to Yasmine. On the other hand, Zafar, in Baghdad, has held Genie of the Ring captive. But, Genie is pretending to suffer from a memory loss. However, he knows the crucial information which may prove too costly for Zafar. What is Aladdin going through? What is Genie's secret? Watch this episode to know better.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Nabbed
episodesList.summary: Aladdin finally succeeds in catching the Kaala Chor red handed and brings her to the mahal. The Sultaan, however, makes a shocking announcement. Meanwhile in Baghdad, Zafar is inching closer to finding his sidekick from the paathshala. What does the Sultaan declare? Will Zafar get lucky this time? Catch all the drama in this episode.

episodesList.title: In Search Of The Taaj
episodesList.summary: After being asked to leave the Kingdom of Turkistan, Aladdin and Yasmine are left with the solo choice of finding the Taaj. However, both are clueless about the right destination and end up tussling with one another. Meanwhile, Anguthi Chhaap, seeing a vision, plans to lend a helping hand to the oblivious Aladdin and Yasmine. What is Anguthi Chhaap's plan? Will Aladdin and Yasmine discover their correct destination?

episodesList.title: The Forgotten Friend
episodesList.summary: Anguthi Chhaap, in his disguise, guides Aladdin and Yasmine to Baghdad. But after traveling for a while, Anguthi Chhaap implements his next step. He changes the route and instead takes them to a cave. This cave houses such a surprise, seeing which Aladdin and Yasmine will remain jaw dropped. Meanwhile, the countdown at Baghdad has begun. What do they get in the cave? What is Baghdad awaiting for? Watch the episode as the answers are hidden right here.

episodesList.title: An Aqaa In The Making
episodesList.summary: After facing numerous stumbling blocks on their way, Aladdin and Yasmine finally lay their hands on the magic lamp inside the cave. As Aladdin starts rubbing the lamp, he dons the hat of an Aqaa and is in for a pleasant surprise. Watch this episode to find out all about the lamp story and much more.

episodesList.title: Here Comes Jinoo!
episodesList.summary: Jinoo turns out to be a cool dude who is always high on the banter quotient. Aladdin and Yasmine along with Jinoo start flying on the magic carpet. Parallelly, the countdown of Zafar's hunt for a new Aladdin has begun. Where will the magic carpet take the trio? How far is Zafar from getting his desired version of Aladdin? Watch this episode to get the answers.

episodesList.title: After 18 Years
episodesList.summary: Finally, Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo reach the kingdom of Baghdad and reminisce about their past life. Whereas, Rukhsar arrives in a market of Baghdad to buy some groceries. As Aladdin strolls through the same market, he coincidentally stands next to his loving Ammi. Will he remember her? Will both of them encounter each other? Find out in this highly-dramatic episode.

episodesList.title: Ammi Meets Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Ammi and Aladdin seem to be sharing a completely different equation with each other which is nothing like the old times. Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo are focussed on their mission to grab the Taaj from the palace of Baghdad. Zafar, on the other hand, wants Aladdin to fail in his mission. Eyeing the lamp are Chacha - Chachi, who as you rightly guessed, are thieves. How is Zafar planning to stop Aladdin from laying his hands on the Taaj? Will Chacha and Chachi prove to be expert thieves? Stay tuned.

episodesList.title: Deal Struck Between Opponents
episodesList.summary: Chacha and Chachi succeed in their ordeal of stealing the magical lamp from Aladdin. Seeing the lamp missing, Aladdin and his toli set about to find Chacha-Chachi's hidden den where the lamp is likely to be found. Luck seems to favour Aladdin and he catches the thief -couple red handed. Fearing that their secret will be out, Chacha and Chachi offer crucial help to Aladdin in lieu of him keeping their secret intact. This help is likely to take Aladdin one step closer to the Taaj. Keep watching!

episodesList.title: Zafar's Naya Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo finally set foot in the school which is managed by Ammi. After some hide and seek moments, they are caught by Ammi, who orders them to be out of the premises. On the other hand, Zafar arrives at the school, hopeful of finding his Naya Aladdin once and for all. Will Zafar's wait to find Aladdin finally end? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Yasmine’s Sensual Dance
episodesList.summary: It is the day of the competition in Baghdad. Aladdin and toli are all set to get the Taaj that day. As per plan, Yasmine plans for a sensual dance to confuse Zafar so that they can inch closer to the Taaj. As luck would have it, by the end of the performance, she trips, hits her head and faints. Although Aladdin and Jinoo manage to whisk her out from there, they now need to come up with a better plan. Will they get another chance?

episodesList.title: Zafar Attacks Rukhsar
episodesList.summary: While Aladdin tries his best to get hold of the crown using Jinoo's magical rope, Zafar fumes in anger, as both Koyal and Shefaan fail in the competition. Furious, he throws a bomb towards Rukhsar, but Aladdin saves her just in time. This fuels Zafar's anger and he moves towards Aladdin. Will Zafar and Aladdin come face-to-face? Watch to know.

episodesList.title: A Great Revelation For Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zafar is curious to find out who is Ammi's saviour. But when he sees the face of the boy, Zafar is shell-shocked! He cannot believe what he sees, because before him, stands Aladdin, accompanied by Yasmine and Jinoo. The magical mirror reveals to him the entire story of Aladdin and Yasmine's rebirth and their journey to Baghdad. Tune in to this dramatic episode and find out how Zafar digests the resurfacing of his greatest enemy, Aladdin.

episodesList.title: Aladdin, The Chosen One
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his toli introduce themselves to Shefaan and Koyal, outside the school and there's tashan between the two groups.
