On the other hand, Rukhsar is irritated with Aladdin's team as they create nuisance. However, Zafar summons Rukhsar and Aladdin, and asks Rukhsar to train Aladdin. Zafar claims that Aladdin is the chosen one and will accompany him on the mission to find the black lamp. But will Rukhsar agree to train Aladdin? Find out in this exciting episode.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar's Task For Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Reluctant to train him, Rukhsar assigns a task to Aladdin. She asks him to compete with his opponents to pick up the legendary hammer. And she also informs him that according to the old legends, whoever could pick up the hammer, was considered to be the real chosen one. However, looking at Aladdin's struggle to keep up with Rukhsar's training, Anguthi Chhaap takes matters into his own hands. Will Aladdin pass Rukhsar's test? Watch this highly-entertaining episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Taaj
episodesList.summary: Genie of the Ring has planned to take Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo to an ethereal place. It is a pink lake where a tremendously large statue of Zafar with his taaj stands tall. In order to acquire the taaj from the statue, they need to cross the lake. And crossing it, requires walking on water, a skill only Rukhsar Begum can teach them. Will Aladdin be able to convince her to teach them the trick? Watch this episode to see if Aladdin makes it.

episodesList.title: The Black Lamp Mystery
episodesList.summary: Aladdin succeeds in lifting the hammer leaving Ammi in shock. Now Ammi has no choice but to train Aladdin in the Paathshala. Next when Ammi visits the palace on Zafar's summon, she hears Zafar discussing his evil plan with Zeher pertaining to the black lamp and manipulating naya Aladdin for the same. Ammi is horrified. What is Zafar's plan? Watch to know further.

episodesList.title: Ammi's Delay Tactics
episodesList.summary: When Rukhsar coincidentally finds out about Zafar's evil intention behind having Aladdin trained by her, she decides to delay it as far as possible. She devises a plan for the same and hosts a competition between two teams. Whoever wins the competition, gets to learn how to run on water. Tune in to find out if Rukhsar manages to keep Aladdin away from harm and who wins the competition.

episodesList.title: The Mystery Of Mehzabeen
episodesList.summary: As Ammi instructs them, the kids rush to the cave to find the udta hua lantern. They follow it and it leads them to a painting of a lady. It has a message written on it. The kids make a mistake that causes major havoc. They run away from the scene. What has the lady in the painting got to do with their journey? Find out the many mysteries by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Mehzabeen And Aladdin's Date Night
episodesList.summary: The mysterious Mehzabeen is drawn towards Aladdin. On the other hand, Zafar's curiosity begins to mount as to who let Mehzabeen out of the Makbara. He turns to Rukhsar with his questions. Without flinching, she tells him that it is a part of their on-going syllabus. Meanwhile, we see Mehzabeen asks Aladdin out on a date, something he cannot refuse, but why? Find out what mysteries unfold when Aladdin goes out on a date with Mehzabeen.

episodesList.title: Jashn-E-Kabristan
episodesList.summary: It's Aladdin's date night with Mehzabeen. Set up in Kabristan, they are having a good time. The toli have followed them and are plotting to help Aladdin distract her so they could get the lantern. Finally, at an appropriate moment they ask her to give it. But is that all they need to do to get the esteemed lantern? Watch here in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mystery Of The Beating Heart
episodesList.summary: Mehzabeen agrees to give information about the lantern, provided Aladdin and his toli are able to find the spot that houses the beating heart. Aladdin and team divide in groups and manage to find the wall from which the heartbeat sound is coming. However, there lies the threat of Nazar Battu. Keep watching to know more.

episodesList.title: The Jungle Man’s Help In Crisis
episodesList.summary: As the ten feet tall monster, Nazar Battu, attacks Aladdin and the other team members, they somehow manage to save themselves and reach paathshaala. Aladdin receives help from a jungle man in tackling this giant. However, the kids venture out the next day once again to defeat the monster. It is no easy task, more so, when Aladdin is in his deadly grip. Who is this jungle man? Will Aladdin be able to topple Nazar Battu.

episodesList.title: Mysteries Of Manhoos Mehzabeen
episodesList.summary: Aladdin solves the mystery of the beating heart, which belongs to Bulbul Chacha. Hence, Bulbul Chacha finally meets Aladdin, and now can pass away in peace. Whilst Aladdin is solving the mystery, he does something that surprises him and Rukhsar Ammi. Later, Mehzabeen assigns Aladdin on the next task to solve another mystery. What could it be? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mystery Of The Chopped Hand
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and his friends reach the nameless cottage to dig out the mystery of the chopped hand. After a lot of struggle and errors, they finally manage to spot the mysterious hand. Just then, the walking hand poses a threat for Koyal and Jinoo. What is going to happen to them? Will Aladdin be able to save them? Stay tuned to this episode to get answered.

episodesList.title: Jinoo And Koyal Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: The walking hand has kidnapped Aladdin's friends, Jinoo and Koyal. In order to save them, Aladdin seeks Yasmine and Sheefan's help. They reach the cottage and try with all their might to distract and defeat the walking hand, but in vain. The walking hand does something audacious which leaves Aladdin jaw dropped. Will this menace ever end? Continue watching.

episodesList.title: Legend Of The Walking Hand
episodesList.summary: While Aladdin is having a tough time to open the door to rescue his friends whom the walking hand has kidnapped, Sheefan accuses Aladdin of putting his friends' lives in danger. Just then, the jungle man appears and enlightens Aladdin about the legend of the Kata Hua Haath. Watch this episode to know the whole story.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Faces Ammi’s Anger
episodesList.summary: It is Shefan who informs Ammi that Aladdin solved the mystery of the kata hua haath not solely by himself but with the help of someone else. Hearing this, Ammi gets very angry and upset and comes to a tough decision. Her decision is beyond expectation as far as Aladdin is concerned. He does not know what to do now. What does Ammi do that makes Aladdin so helpless? Watch this episode to know the answer.

episodesList.title: Ammi's New Challenge For Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar Begum is furious at Aladdin after being fed wrong information by Shefan. She refuses to train him and asks him to leave the paathshala. Aladdin is trying his best to convince her to rethink her decision. However, once again Shefan creates havoc and brainwashes her. In the fit of rage, Ammi throws an open challenge at Aladdin. What is the challenge? Will Aladdin accept it? Tune in to this important episode to know better.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Asharfi Challenge
episodesList.summary: Ammi has challenged Aladdin to earn twenty asharfis by toiling on his own. Aladdin has accepted the challenge to appease Ammi without knowing that it is easier said than done. He realises that he is incapable of doing any task without Jinoo's help. Finally, he meets Tuglaq, who agrees to employ him. Who is Tuglaq? What sort of work will Aladdin do now?

episodesList.title: Shefan Upturns Aladdin's Mehnat
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, after accepting Ammi's challenge of independently earning money, has found a job in a brick factory. With a lot of effort, he starts making the bricks. However, just as he is about to stack the bricks inside the furnace, Shefan spills water on them, letting Aladdin's hard work go in vain. Shefan has further plans of causing trouble to Aladdin and Yasmine. What is Shefan upto? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Asharfi Challenge Goes Awry
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, facing all odds finally manages to earn the ten asharfi as per Rukhsar Begum's challenge. Elated he runs to the paathshala to meet Ammi. However, Shefan has other plans for Aladdin. What is Shefan upto? All well with Aladdin? Continue watching the episode to know better.

episodesList.title: Aladdin On His Own
episodesList.summary: When Aladdin is unable to show the asharfis that he earned, Ammi refuses to train him any further. Aladdin, too, gets angry and leaves from there, with a promise to learn walking on the water on his own. Meanwhile, Yasmine has hidden herself in a barrel that is going out of Baghdad. Will Aladdin learn the trick without Ammi's help? Is Yasmine alright? Catch all the drama in this episode.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Saves Badi Ustaad
episodesList.summary: After being abandoned by Rukhsar Begum, Aladdin has vowed to learn to walk on the water on his own. As he tries doing so, he notices Ammi getting drowned in water. He goes ahead to save her and in the process learns to actually walk on the water. Meanwhile, Yasmine decides to come back to Baghdad to locate a person named Mucchad. Will Aladdin earn Ammi's forgiveness? Who is Mucchad? Stay tuned as a lot is going to take place in this episode.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's New Trainer
episodesList.summary: Zafar, who is known for his evil and cunning ways, has one more game plan up his sleeve. He declares himself as the new trainer for the kids, including Aladdin. Hearing this, Rukhsar Begum gets very anxious and furious. Can she think of something to ensure Zafar stays away from Aladdin and other kids? Stay tuned to know.

episodesList.title: Zafar, The Tough Trainer
episodesList.summary: Ever since Zafar has taken over the responsibility of the training, there is chaos all around. The kids are fighting with each other to reach the training venue on time. And when they reach the ground, they are shocked to find a new and difficult hurdle placed by Zafar. How will they cope with this tough trainer?

episodesList.title: Zafar's Task For Aladdin
episodesList.summary: The kids are unable to withstand Zafar's atrocities during training such that only Shefan, Yasmine and Aladdin are able to make it to the last leg. Zafar then asks them to run and on reaching the right spot, awaits their last task. Aladdin makes it to the right spot. What task awaits him there? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Gets Aag Baboola's Bangle
episodesList.summary: Aag Baboola,the monster, gives Aladdin a bangle and asks him to trace its owner. This bangle belongs to someone important from Aladdin's past life. Aag Baboola too has a shocking legend to his existence. As Aladdin accepts the monster's task, Shefan follows him with a bad intention. Will Aladdin find out the bangle's owner? Who is Aag Baboola? What is Shefaan upto?

episodesList.title: Aladdin’s Search For The Bangle Owner
episodesList.summary: After having fooled Shefan with a fake bangle, Aladdin flaunts the original one, only to have it thrown away by Shefan. As Aladdin runs behind the rolling bangle, he reaches an old house, which brings him memories from the past. Is there a chance that Aladdin will find the owner of the bangle there? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Aladdin’s Past Rekindled
episodesList.summary: While Aladdin is struggling with the mystery of the old dupatta and kangan, he realises it belongs to Rukhsaar Begum. He decides to go back to the house as he feels an unknown connection with its past. Soon, he gets puzzled by a picture found in the house as a part of the portrait of Rukhsaar Ammi. Whose picture is it and where are these clues trying to take Aladdin?

episodesList.title: Allah Rakha: The Vicious One
episodesList.summary: Aladdin succeeds in solving the first mystery of the kangan. He then is given another task in which Aag Baboola hands him a bioscope containing all the memories of the past. Aladdin has to unlock the same, to see what's inside. It is at this moment, that Allah Rakha appears out of nowhere and snatches the bioscope. Will Aladdin succeed in getting his bioscope back?

episodesList.title: Aladdin At Akupara's Mercy
episodesList.summary: Aladdin seeks Jinoo's help in getting to the earth's core. As they reach there, they come across a huge turtle with elephants on top of it, representing the balance of the earth from the old books. Mother nature, Akupara is the one balancing it. She gets quite upset when she sees two humans standing in front of her. Aladdin seeks her help in finding Allah Rakha. Akupara agrees to help, but says that first he has to pass a test. Tune in to know what's in store for Aladdin?

episodesList.title: Zafar: The Evil Plotter
episodesList.summary: Allah Rakha tells Ammi that the next day is laal chand ki raat, when no evil forces work. So, he plans to kill Zafar to end her entire struggle. Meanwhile, Zafar is all set to kill Rukhsar Begum and to take everything under his control, as he thinks she is a traitor. Parallelly, Aladdin, sees a vision of his Ammi getting engulfed by the fire with laal chand in the background. Aladdin feels that something bad is going to happen to his mother, who is still alive. What will he do next?

episodesList.title: Badi Ustaad’s Safety Cell
episodesList.summary: Allah Rakha tells Rukhsar Begum that he shall kill Zafar on the night of laal chand. However, Aladdin and Jinoo are back to the paathshala and Allah Rakha advises Rukhsar Begum to make sure that Zafar does not meet Aladdin. Badi Ustaad locks both Aladdin and Jinoo inside her secret prayer room and further asks Jinoo not to use his magic to escape from there. Will this plan work?

episodesList.title: Zafar Sets Haveli Ablaze
episodesList.summary: Allah Rakha steps in Zafar's way as he marches towards the old house. A fight sparks between them leaving Zafar weak as its the night of the laal chaand. Just when Allah Rakha is about to kill Zafar, Zeher steps in killing him with her poisonous potions. Later, Zafar spots Rukhsar Ammi in the balcony. The vision alone infuriates him, making him bomb the house. What's going to happen to Ammi and will Aladdin notice? Watch this episode right now to know more, only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Ammi In Fire
episodesList.summary: Just when Aladdin is about to leave the house with Ammi, he catches a whiff of burning from the surrounding. His guess proves to be right, for the house has indeed caught fire. Parallelly, Yasmine sees Muchchad hurl a bomb towards the house, in which Ammi is trapped. What lies in Ammi's fate? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Ammi In Flames
episodesList.summary: Ammi regains consciousness and to her shock, she realises that the house is completely engulfed by the flames. She tries desperately to look for a way out of this blazing inferno, but in vain. So, she starts singing her dua as the last resort. At that moment, Aladdin goes inside in search of the kidnapper and is attracted by Ammi's song. Just then, her dress catches fire and she runs here and there, screaming for help. Will Aladdin be able to save her?

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Entangled Past And Present
episodesList.summary: When Aladdin learns about Rukhsar Begum to be his mother from the previous lifetime, he tries to confront her about the same. However, Anguthi Chhaap stops him in time and requests him to keep his discovery hidden from Zafar. After Aladdin finds out about Zafar manipulating everyone's memory, furious, he decides to have a word with him. What will happen now? Check out in this mind-blowing episode.

episodesList.title: Zafar Dared
episodesList.summary: Aladdin comes to meet Zafar with the sole intention of killing him. He hides a dagger behind his back. Zafar is oblivious to Aladdin's intention and talks of a new task for him. Ammi, meanwhile, has regained consciousness and wants to apologise to Zafar, for the sake of her favorite kids. Watch ahead in the episode, to know more.

episodesList.title: Aladdin-Yasmine, An Ugly End?
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine have a heated argument, which eventually results in Yasmine walking away, asking Aladdin to never utter her name again. Just then, Anguthi Chhaap visits Aladdin, assuring him the ring will take care of his future. Meanwhile, Rukhsaar Ammi gets emotional about having been harsh with Aladdin and promises Jinoo that she will rescue him from the lamp as soon as Aladdin comes back, so as to return to Aladdin, his lamp and his companion.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar Gets Kidnapped!
episodesList.summary: To witness the death of a parent is a great shock, be it for real, or in imagination. So, when Aladdin sees his mother's death in his dreams, he loses control. Only when he sees Rukhsar before him, he finds some solace. Rukshar warns him about Zafar's intentions and tells him that he is seeking a black lamp, which will change the course of the universe. She asks him not to support Zafar, but Aladdin denies her plea, which breaks her heart. Later, Rukhsar gets kidnapped. What is Zafar upto?

episodesList.title: Will Aladdin Hit The Bull's Eye?
episodesList.summary: Zafar kidnaps Rukhsaar Begum and stuffs her inside a sac and mounts it on a board, at which Aladdin is asked to aim his knives. However, Zafar lies to Aladdin that the sac contains sand. Aladdin starts aiming his knives one by one on the board. Will he end up killing his ammi unknowingly? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Game Has Begun
episodesList.summary: Ammi thinks that Aladdin is not a good soul to be around, because of his proximity to Zafar. Aladdin, on the other hand, is only faking his support to Zafar for acquiring the Kala Chirag. His real intention is to seek revenge from the evil Sultaan. Watch the drama that unfolds, as Aladdin defeats Zafar in a game of chess and very smartly extracts information about the Kala Chirag.

episodesList.title: Zafar Under Aladdin's Deception
episodesList.summary: Aladdin succeeds in making Zafar believe that they should go to the sandalwood forest, to get some sandalwood, as the Kala Jinn loves this fragrance. Zafar agrees and in the avatar of Muchchad, he accompanies Aladdin. Yasmine too follows them. What is brewing in Aladdin's mind? Will Yasmine expose Muchchad this time? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Yasmine's Shocking Observation
episodesList.summary: The web of troubles and conspiracy continues in the kingdom. On one hand, where Rukhsar, under Zeher's spell, continues to be bothered by the weird speech curse, Aladdin and Muchhad reach the sandalwood forest to meet Zorappan. After an initial code language conversation containing animal sounds, Zorappan shows up. At this point, Muchhad has no idea that he is entering deep into Aladdin and Jinoo's trap. Yasmine is there too. When she sees Aladdin with Muchhad, she loses her cool.

episodesList.title: Unmasking Mucchad, Yasmine
episodesList.summary: After Yasmine successfully manages to knock Mucchad out, she tries to uncover his real identity. But, Aladdin does not like the idea and tries to stop her. While Aladdin and Yasmine get into a tiff, Shefan makes another attempt to unmask Mucchad. But this time, Jinoo regains his consciousness and turns Shefan into a snake with his magic. What will happen now? Tune into this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Aladdin’s Plan Fails
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is inching closer to fulfilling his plan, and accordingly takes Zafar to the venue that is supposed to have all the sandalwood piled up. As they reach the spot, a shock awaits them, for the sandalwood is burnt to ashes. Aladdin miserably fails in his plan and Zafar is furious. Who is behind this destruction?

episodesList.title: Yasmine Creates Trouble For Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Evil Zafar wants to know all about Aladdin's plan, which is why he makes him consume a drink containing the truth serum. However, as Anguthi Chhaap was aware of Zafar's ugly move, he ensured that Aladdin didn't consume the actual drink. Though Aladdin thinks he has outwitted Zafar, his happiness is short-lived when Zafar traps him in a magical sphere. At the same time, Yasmine arrives and rats out Aladdin. What will happen next? Find out in this dramatic episode.

episodesList.title: Yasmine's Wiped Out Memory
episodesList.summary: When Zafar gets to know from Yasmine that she knows about Muchchhad, he realises that his major threat is not from Aladdin, but from Yasmine. Thus, Zafar wipes outYasmine's memory about Muchchhad. Aladdin, who is held captive behind an invisible wall, finds out that there is a room, in which Zafar stores all the memories that he erases. What will Aladdin do next?

episodesList.title: Aladdin Controls Yasmine's Senses?
episodesList.summary: Yasmine has been interfering with Aladdin's mission for quite some time. So, he wants to control all of her actions. But in order to do that, Aladdin, according to the magical book, needs to win over all five of Yasmine's senses. Although Aladdin starts with her sense of smell, dominating it is easier said than done. Find out if Aladdin gains control over Yasmine's sense of smell and the other senses or not, in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Yasmine-Zeher Swap
episodesList.summary: Aladdin prepares a concoction with the help of which he plans to swap Yasmine with Zeher. This is his ploy to break the inseparable jodi of Zafar and Zeher. Aladdin's jinn friends trap Zeher and Aladdin proceeds with Yasmine to fulfil his plan. But fate has something else designed for Aladdin, when Yasmine falls deep in water. What will Aladdin do now?

episodesList.title: Lovestruck Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is left with no other choice but to dive after Yasmine into the deep river, in order to save her. Under the water, Aladdin gets mesmerized by her beauty and realises for the first time that he has fallen head over heels for her. Powered by his overwhelming love, will Aladdin manage to save Yasmine afterall? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Cracking The Code, Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is resolute about helping Yasmine and saving her from Zafar's claws. Zafar, who feels betrayed by Zeher, unintentionally reveals a few things about Yaadon Ki Baaraat to Aladdin. In an attempt to dig more information from Zafar about the memory room, a challenging question pertaining to Yaadon Ki Baaraat stands in front of Aladdin. Tune into this dramatic episode to find out if Aladdin succeeds in his quest.

episodesList.title: Zeher Attacks Zafar
episodesList.summary: The appearance of Zeher-turned-mouse creates a nuisance, not only for Zafar, but for Aladdin too. He fears getting exposed, but his jinn friend saves him at the critical moment. Meanwhile, Jinoo brings back Yasmine's consciousness. Yasmine is annoyed and gets into an argument with Jinoo, thereby making him vanish from the scene. Later at night, when Zafar is sleeping, a cloaked figure comes and attacks Zafar with a knife, and to his shock, it's none other than Zeher. Why would she do so?

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Search For Yaadon Ki Baaraat
episodesList.summary: Aladdin decides to unfurl the mystery of Yaadon Ki Baraat and accompanying him in this mission are his two faithful genies. Aladdin's search takes him to a secret palace, which belongs to Zafar and no trespassers are allowed in it. Seeing Aladdin steal her boots, Yasmine tail-gates him, all the way to the palace. Will Aladdin get his answer? What if Zafar gets an inkling about Aladdin's intention? Watch this dramatic episode to get answered.

episodesList.title: Hide And Seek With Aladdin-Yasmine
episodesList.summary: After entering the palace, Aladdin and Yasmine get into another secret room through the room of mirrors. The room is nearly empty except for a single cupboard. It arouses their curiosity and they walk towards the cupboard. It's at that moment, Zafar enters the room, taking Aladdin and Yasmine by surprise. Finding no other place, they hide inside the cupboard. Zafar starts looking around. Will he find Aladdin and Yasmine?

episodesList.title: Aladdin In Mystical Snow World
episodesList.summary: When Aladdin discovers that there is a whole new space inside the magical cupboard, he is intrigued and decides to explore it. While exploring, he comes across three doors and only one leads to the right path. Surprisingly, Aladdin manages to enter the right door which leads him to a mystical snow world. Meanwhile, Zafar visits the snake woman, to know the name of his betrayer. Will Zafar succeed in finding the truth about Aladdin?

episodesList.title: Aladdin And The Memory Tree
episodesList.summary: Aladdin arrives at the mystical snow world and chances upon his mother. Thereafter, he learns about the memory tree. It is in this memory tree, that Zafar stores all the memories that he has erased from various people. Aladdin begins his quest for the memory tree, which proves to be a rather daunting one. On the other hand, Zafar almost gets to know the name of his traitor. Watch the rest of the story, in this episode.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Loses His Eyesight
episodesList.summary: The moment Aladdin touches Ammi's memory ball, he gets hit by a bolt of sharp light. This makes him lose his eyesight and he struggles to get out of the cupboard. Zafar, meanwhile, approaches the cupboard and danger looms large over Aladdin's head. In order to protect his master, Anguthi Chhaap takes a drastic step. What happens when Zafar finds out about Aladdin's quest? Tune in to this adventurous episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Eyes, Jinoo
episodesList.summary: Aladdin without his eyesight, needs Jinoo's help to tell him about the surroundings, so that Zafar doesn't detect his blindness. Jinoo hides behind his aaka's ear and goes on guiding him. But when Aladdin senses that Zeher wants to harm Yasmine, he sends Jinoo away to save her. Just then Zafar challenges him to a sword fight. Can Jinoo save Yasmine? How will Aladdin manage without his sight? Stay tuned to this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Blackmails Zeher
episodesList.summary: Yasmine accidentally sprays a chemical in Aladdin's eyes, when Aladdin and Jinoo try to rescue her from Zeher's captivity. This brings back his eyesight. The three of them then hatch a plan, to ensure that Zeher frees Yasmine by herself. Yasmine blackmails Zeher with the secret of Zafar once being a mere wazir, and that it is Zeher who has blurted out this truth, in her sleep-walk. Zeher gets uneasy hearing this. Will she succumb to Yasmine's blackmails and free her? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Alasmine
episodesList.summary: Zafar has plotted hard to sacrifice Anguthi Chhaap in order to get the black lamp, but the blood rain ruins his plans. This frustrates him and he marches to the snake witch for clarification. She tells Zafar that he is cursed. Later, the snake witch meets Aladdin, and gives him a clue to find his destiny. It takes Aladdin to a flight of magical stairs, which then leads him to a room with a big frame, and when Aladdin unveils it, he is shocked to find Yasmine's portrait in Sultana's attire.

episodesList.title: Baghdad's Sultana,Yasmine?
episodesList.summary: Aladdin gets confused on learning that Yasmine was the Sultana of Baghdad in her previous life. So, he requests Jinoo to help him solve the puzzle. Aladdin feels relieved when Jinoo decides to transport him to Anguthi Chhaap. Elsewhere, Zafar discovers Yasmine's intentions of finding more about the Sultana of Baghdad. So, he decides to hold her hostage for the rest of her life, in a desert.

episodesList.title: Aladdin, Off To The Past
episodesList.summary: Anguthi Chhaap transports Aladdin to Baghdad of old times, and shows his connection with Yasmine, who was then the Sultana of Baghdad, and Aladdin, the Kala Chor. Aladdin is amazed at this revelation, and wants to learn more. But time is ticking fast, so, he needs to be back to the present. How will Aladdin know more about his past?

episodesList.title: Furious Zafar, Resolute Aladdin
episodesList.summary: After learning about his past connection, Aladdin is wrapped in a bundle of questions and is looking for answers. Yasmine's struggle to find a way out of the desert grows intense, making her feel handicapped for a solution. Aladdin, who learns about this, decides to head to the desert to save Yasmine from Zafar's trap. Meanwhile, Zafar gets to know about Aladdin's movement, and gets enraged. Tune into this dramatic episode to find out what happens further.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Kala Chor Avatar
episodesList.summary: Aladdin, with great difficulty, manages to convince a furious Zafar with reasons for saving Yasmine. Later, Aladdin disguises himself as Kala Chor and decides to go to the palace to meet Zafar. What is going on in Aladdin's mind? Tune in to this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Steals Zafar's Magical Glove
episodesList.summary: After learning about his past, Aladdin is prepared to knock-off his long-standing enemy, Zafar. He makes his first move by disguising himself as Kala Chor, and sneaking into the palace. Aladdin notices Zafar using a mysterious trunk as a gateway to the secret chamber. Grabbing the opportunity, Aladdin enters the chamber when Zafar falls asleep. Though Aladdin succeeds in stealing Zafar's magical glove, what will happen when Zafar learns about this robbery?

episodesList.title: Zafar Steals A March On Aladdin
episodesList.summary: Aladdin works his ways to convince Zafar to keep the box of memories in a magical cave, so that no one can lay their hands on it. Zafar takes his prized possession, and heads to the cave along with Aladdin. Instructing Aladdin to stay outside, Zafar tucks away the box of memories in the cave. Aladdin, eager to get his hands on the box, returns to the cave the next day, only to find that the doors have been sealed with Zafar's blood. Tune into this adventurous episode to know Aladdin's next move.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Breaks A Memory Ball
episodesList.summary: Aladdin enters the cave and Yasmine follows him closely. She confronts him about his interest in Zafar's sandook, and they engage in a heated argument. Aladdin, losing his cool, ends up breaking one of the memory balls, that is of Jinoo's. Jinoo is about to experience a strong reaction. What's it? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Truth Uncovered
episodesList.summary: As Jinoo gets all the memories back, Aladdin opens up to Yasmine about Zafar's cruel intentions to wipe out the entire humanity. Ammi tells Yasmine to join forces with Aladdin to defeat Zafar, so that he cannot accomplish his cunning plan. Anguthi Chhaap informs Aladdin about Zafar's hidden powers. Tune into this thrilling episode to find out how Aladdin plans to strike Zafar.

episodesList.title: Aladdin In The Land Of Scorpions
episodesList.summary: Using the information given by Anguthi Chhaap, Aladdin and his team head out to meet the scorpion clan. Upon their arrival, Aladdin meets Zarina, a beautiful young woman, who has never ventured out of the clan. After making Zarina aware of his mission and Zafar's evil plan to carry out the atrocities on innocent people, Aladdin requests Zarina to join his gang. While Zarina readily agrees to be a part of the team, will all work out well for Aladdin and his toli?

episodesList.title: Zarina Saves Aladdin's Toli
episodesList.summary: Due to his growing suspicion on Aladdin, Zafar enters his room to find the magical glove. However, Anguthi Chhaap ensures that Zafar doesn't get his hands on the glove. Elsewhere, the merciless soldiers of the scorpion clan capture Aladdin and his team place them in front of a huge and deadly scorpion. But before things can go awry, Zarina, keeping her word, arrives to save the trio using her magical powers. Tune into this adventurous episode to find out what unfolds further.

episodesList.title: Zarina In Love With Zafar
episodesList.summary: Zarina crosses the magic portal and arrives in Baghdad to help Aladdin complete his mission. While Zarina is busy roaming in the market and getting a feel of the place, things go awry, leading her to Zafar. Oblivious to the fact that he is the cunning person who Aladdin was talking about, Zarina's interaction with Zafar sprouts feelings for him in Zarina's heart and vice-versa. What will happen when Aladdin will learn about Zarina's feelings?

episodesList.title: Zarina's Love, Aladdin's Enemy
episodesList.summary: Entrusted with the task of terminating Zafar, Zarina meets him in his chamber, but starts falling deeply in love with him. Though she hands him the rose, she has a change of heart at the last minute, and snatches the magical rose from his hands. Aladdin, who is watching this act, is met with a rude shock. Later, when Aladdin confronts Zarina, her silence speaks louder than her actions. Aladdin warns Zarina to keep away from telling Zafar the truth. Will Zarina pay heed to Aladdin's words?

episodesList.title: Zarina In Danger
episodesList.summary: Zarina, who is insanely in love with Zafar, meets him for the Nikaah. However, the musical night brings out Zarina's true identity in front of Zafar, as the drum beats turn her into a scorpion. Elsewhere, Aladdin and Yasmine are caught up in an ugly fight. What will happen when Zafar will see Zarina's true avatar? Tune into this dramatic episode to find your answers.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Tyrannical Rule Ends
episodesList.summary: When Zarina transforms into a scorpion, Zafar stabs her. But Zarina ensures that she stings him before dying. As Zarina's poison begins to spread in Zafar's body, he starts losing all his magical powers, and turns to a wazir like before. While Zafar is shattered, the people of Baghdad rejoice at the end of his cruel rule.

episodesList.title: Zeher's Zeher
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar finds out that she is Aladdin's mother. Evil Zeher makes the most dangerous poison and gives it to Zafar to use as a weapon as he has lost his powers. Yasmine memories come back and she realizes that she was wrong about Aladdin. Aladdin and Yasmine come up with a plan to defeat Zafar. What will they do? Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Yasmine's Sense Of Justice
episodesList.summary: Jinn explains how Rukhsar plans on delivering justice to Zafar for his evil deeds. Yasmine quickly finds a flaw in her plans and says that the plan won't work on someone like Zafar. She decides to pull out a sword and deliver justice with her own hands.

episodesList.title: Zeher Loses Her Zeher
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is looking for Yasmine and stumbles upon Zeher and Zafar at the graveyard. They claim that they haven't seen her, and later check the coffin where they kept her, unaware that they are being fooled. Later, Jinn and Yasmine torture Zafar with hopes that he will lose his mind.

episodesList.title: Zafar Is Caught
episodesList.summary: All Rukhsar's plans are succeeding one after the other and Zafar gets caught. Later, he faces troubles as he is taken for his sentencing. However, Zeher has gained consciousness and won't back down without a fight.

episodesList.title: Zafar Twists The Truth
episodesList.summary: Aladdin finally gets Zafar to face the trial for his crimes. Just as Yasmine predicted, the worst happens, and Zafar twists the truth to avoid punishment. Meanwhile, Zeher has caught upto Rukhsar and Jinn.

episodesList.title: Zeheriley Duo Captured
episodesList.summary: Aladdin and Yasmine manage to free the captured Jinn and Rukhsar and help them escape. After leaving Ammi in the safety of the palace, Jinn returns to assist his aaka capture the Zeheriley Duo.

episodesList.title: Sultana Yasmine
episodesList.summary: Aladdin declares Yasmine as Sultana in front of the entire mulk. Meanwhile, Khalibali tries to kill Zafar in jail. Someone attacks Aladdin's mother and she faints. Later, Yasmine starts wondering if she has started falling for Aladdin.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar Hypnotized
episodesList.summary: Zeher and Zafar manage to hypnotize Rukhsar, and they use her to invite Fairoz to the castle so she could free them from the dungeon. Meanwhile, Aladdin realizes his love for Yasmine and tries to find the best way to confess it.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Proposes
episodesList.summary: Aladdin finally confesses his love to Yasmine, but Yasmine has a lot on her plate and rejects his proposal. Meanwhile, Rukhsar is still under Zeher's control and is executing Zafar's evil plan for revenge and escape.

episodesList.title: Yasmine's Taaj Poshi
episodesList.summary: After Yasmine rejects Aladdin's proposal, both plan to go their separate ways. Aladdin plans to leave for Turkistan after Yasmine's crowning ceremony. Later, Aladdin finds Chulbul tied up, who reveals that Rukhsar is under Zeher's mind control.

episodesList.title: Rukhsar Rescued
episodesList.summary: During Yasmine's taaj poshi Fairuz begins singing. Zafar's plans are on the verge of success as Fariruz's voice puts everyone to sleep. But, Yasmine who is lost in her thoughts and not listening to the song does not fall under her spell. Meanwhile, Aladdin has also discovered about Zafar's schemes.

episodesList.title: Zafar's Elaborate Trap
episodesList.summary: Ginn uses Zeher's medallion and potion to track her location. Aladdin and Yasmine quickly set out to capture the evil brother and sister duo. Meanwhile, Zafar gets into an arrangement with an old acquaintance to trap Aladdin and get rid of his Ginn.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Trapped
episodesList.summary: Shehezaadi puts on a display of her magical prowess and manages to catch Aladdin. She then creates a clone of Aladdin, who she controls and manipulate him into capturing Yasmine.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Choices
episodesList.summary: Zafar gives Aladdin a choice to return to his loved ones by handing him over the kala chiraag. Soon, Yasmine and Haider, Aladdin's clone, reach home and realize that Aladdin is acting and talking strangely.

episodesList.title: The Palace Under Haider's Control
episodesList.summary: Haider manages to put everyone in the palace, except Ginn, under his control. Meanwhile, Aladdin tries to convince Sheherzaade to let him go but, she is too smart for him to handle. Back at the palace, Ginn also tries his best to free everyone from Haider's control.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Outsmarted
episodesList.summary: The face-off between Aladdin and Sheherzaade continues as both try to outsmart each other. Meanwhile, Ginn and Chatarpatar are trying to get Ginn back to Yasmine and Rukhsar's side. Haider continues to control Yasmine and Rukhsar and leads them to the edge of a cliff to throw them off it.

episodesList.title: Who Is The Real Aladdin?
episodesList.summary: Cheenu tells everyone what happened. Sheherzaade tells Aladdin only she can help him defeat Haider. Later, Cheenu and Yasmine try attacking Haider but, nothing works on him. Just then, Aladdin comes there and, everybody is happy to see him. Aladdin and Haider get into a fight and, everyone gets confused about which one is the real Aladdin. How will they find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Zafar's Warnings
episodesList.summary: Aladdin manages to free everyone from Haider's grasps after burning Haider's book. Later, Zafar warns Aladdin to make a choice - either hand him the Kala Chirag or watch his world burn.

episodesList.title: Aladdin and Yasmine Engaged
episodesList.summary: Yasmine realizes that she and Aladdin are meant to be together and goes down on her knees to propose to him. Meanwhile, Zafar and Zeher are working on becoming stronger and getting their revenge.

episodesList.title: Zafar And Zeher Make Their Moves
episodesList.summary: Aladdin infiltrates the lair because he was in possession of the pen. To let Yasmine in, Aladdin throws the pen but Zafar sweeps in and intercepts it. Meanwhile, Zeher, with her slaves, threaten Chulbul and asks him to deliver a message.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Turned Into An Old Man
episodesList.summary: In their quest to find the Kala Chirag, Aladdin, Yasmine and Zafar encounter a man with a red mask who claims to be the guardian of the Chirag. Meanwhile, Zeher's slaves manage to capture Rukhsar and Chulbul, and Ginn makes a promise to his older brother.

episodesList.title: Aladdin Breaks The Curse
episodesList.summary: After capturing Angoothi Chaap, Zeher forces him to do her dirty work to bring the Kala Ginn back. Meanwhile, Aladdin managed to break free from the guardian's cure and turns back to his real age. Zafar, Aladdin and Yasmine continue their quest to find the Kala Chirag.

episodesList.title: Yasmine Defeats The Masked Guardian
episodesList.summary: Ginnu with all his powers is unable to return Chatarpatar its voice. Meanwhile, Yasmine quickly realizes the masked guardian's weakness and defeats him so they can continue with their search for the Kala Chirag. Later, Rukhsar and Ginnu teleport to Angoothi Chaap's location and ask him about his fealty to Zeher.

episodesList.title: Kala Chirag Found
episodesList.summary: Anguthi Chaap is on his deathbed when he gives Chatarpatar its voice back. Chatarpatar claims that consuming water from a jheel can heal anyone's wounds. Ginnu and Chatarpatar immediately leave on a quest to find the Jheel. Meanwhile, Zafar releases the Kala Ginn, and Aladdin and Yasmine tell him to request the Kala Ginn to stop the shooting star from destroying the world.

episodesList.title: Kala Ginn Takes Over Aladdin's Body
episodesList.summary: Angoothi Chaap reveals Zafar had separated his body from his soul and secured his soul in a locket. Rukhsar immediately sets out to find this locket so they can fight against Zafar and Kala Ginn. Meanwhile, Ginn teleports to Aladdin and Yasmine who get sealed by Zafar in their fight and quickly releases them. However, the worst nightmare comes true when Kala Gin takes over Aladdin's body and continues to assist Zafar in his quest for world domination.

episodesList.title: Zafar Defeated
episodesList.summary: Rukhsar arrives with the locket containing Zafar's room and manages to turn the tide in their favour. Later, Aladdin delivers the finishing strike to Zafar, and everyone celebrates their victory. They come back to the castle and help Aladdin and Yasmine with their marriage ceremonies.

episodesList.title: Aladdin's Heroics
episodesList.summary: Aladdin saves all the workers who might have died by getting crushed under the falling statue. Everyone praises Aladdin for his heroics, on the other hand, Rukhsar is missing Aladdin and makes his favourite dish for the kids around her.

episodesList.title: The Blue Diamond
episodesList.summary: Zafar Khan is the Wazir-e-Azam of Baghdad, who wishes to get his hands on the magic lamp and marry Princess Yasmine to become the Emperor of Baghdad, but Princess Yasmine wants to become the first Empress of Baghdad herself. Aladdin receives his next mission to steal Zimmidar Habibullah's, Blue Diamond.

episodesList.title: And Thats How They Met
episodesList.summary: The Black Theif, Aladdin, is assigned to steal the famous Blue Diamond so the owner of the diamond, Zimmidar Habibullah comes to Princess Yasmine and asks her for protection. Princess Yasmine herself goes to the place where the diamond is kept and Aladdin reaches there to steal the diamond.

episodesList.title: The Search For The Magic Lamp
episodesList.summary: Aladdin is assigned to find the magic lamp by Wazir-e-Azam Zafar Khan, who gives him a map. The map leads Aladdin to Manghreb Dessert, where he struggles to find the lamp. On his way, he comes across Princess Yasmine in Salim Khilji's den.

episodesList.title: Baghdad In Danger Again?
episodesList.summary: Malika is about to step outside the portal but Jinoo uses his power and closes the portal at the last moment. Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo celebrate their victory over successful stopping Malika from entering. But they're mistaken as Malika's face appears in the sky.

episodesList.title: Will Yasmine Accept Aladdin’s Proposal?
episodesList.summary: Baghdad is celebrating Jashn-e-Dilbar, the festival of love. Mallika enters Baghdad and starts following Aladdin. Later, Aladdin proposes to Yasmine. Will she accept?

episodesList.title: Malika Takes a Disguise!
episodesList.summary: Malika pretends to be Yasmine’s aunt and writes to her, informing about her visit to Baghdad. She states that her kingdom was destroyed in an earthquake and that’s the reason for her visit. Yasmine requests Aladdin to receive her. Aladdin and Jingoo go to receive the aunt, who’s actually Malika in disguise.

episodesList.title: Malika and Aladdin Enter the Palace
episodesList.summary: Malika and Aladdin enter the palace. JM and Yasmine are having a conversation when a glass vase breaks and JM believes it to be a bad omen. Meanwhile, Jinoo and other genies realise that their magic has suddenly stopped working.

episodesList.title: Mallika Impersonates Yasmine’s Aunt
episodesList.summary: Upon reaching the palace, Yasmine enquires with Aladdin about her aunt. She reminds him that he had to fetch her. Aladdin clarifies that she never turned up. Yasmine criticises her aunt. But Mallika, pretending to be the aunt, overhears Yasmine and comes face-to-face with her.

episodesList.title: Malika’s Truth Revealed?
episodesList.summary: While on the palace tour with Aladdin and Yasmine, Malika senses that something is off. When she reaches the kitchen, she finds out that JM and CJ are performing magic in their genie form. Malika is totally shocked.

episodesList.title: Malika’s Sudden Announcement
episodesList.summary: Malika knows the advantages that Aladdin has because of his three genies and a magic carpet. She knows that she needs to be in his good books. During dinner, Malika announces the engagement of Aladdin and Yasmine. Everybody is surprised by this sudden announcement.

episodesList.title: Malika’s Hidden Motive
episodesList.summary: The engagement preparations are in full swing. Malika has a hidden motive behind getting Aladdin and Yasmine engaged. She reveals this hidden motive, which is to destroy the world using an instrument.

episodesList.title: Malika Faces A Hurdle
episodesList.summary: Malika requires a dagger in order to put her plan in action. Malika can use this dagger to make a genie tonic which can be used to turn people into genies. Malika currently has only one of the genie tonics remaining. So, she requires the dagger to make some more of it. But there is one person stopping her from actualizing her plan.

episodesList.title: The Dagger Thief
episodesList.summary: When Malika tells her story about the missing dagger, she reveals that the one who stole her dagger is from Baghdad as he had Baghdad’s badge on him.

episodesList.title: Malika Hunts For The Correct Key
episodesList.summary: Malika is in search of the correct key that will bring her closer to finding the dagger. She uses her powers to summon all the keys to her room, after which all the people of Baghdad cannot find their keys. Aladdin is confused as to how everybody cannot find their keys in Baghdad. Aladdin and CJ enter Malika’s room as Malika is looking for the correct key in her room. What will happen next?

title: Avalum Naanum
summary:
Avalum Naanum (transl. Her and Myself; tamil: அவளும் நானும்) is a Tamil-language family soap opera starring Mounika Devi in a dual role opposite Amruth and Dharish, and is directed by Dhanush. It started airing on 26 February 2018 on Vijay TV in an afternoon programming block called "Vijay Matinee Thodargal".
The show is a family melodrama based on twin girls Nila and Diya (both played by Mounika Devi). It ended on 22 June 2019 after a run of more than 300 episodes.
plot:
Nila and Diya (Mounika Devi) are identical twin sisters. Nila's parents try to force her to marry Praveen (Amruth) because he comes from a wealthy family even though they know Nila loves Vijay (Shri Mahadev) and wants to focus on her career. On her wedding day, she leaves a note for her father and leaves for Pondicherry to be with Vijay. Diya's father, Sathyamoorthy (Supergood Kannan), forces Diya to pretend to be Nila and marry Praveen for the sake of the family's reputation. After the wedding ceremony is over, Diya's boyfriend Aravind (Dharish) comes as a guest and discovers the twin switch. He tries to help Diya stand up to her parents because she can be a bit of a pushover.
Meanwhile, Nila marries Vijay, but he is killed in a road accident on the wedding day and she becomes a widow. Vijay's relatives, except for her father in law and brother in law, blame her for his death. She tries to return home but her mother Gayathri almost kills her in a fit of rage. Her father Saythamoorthy pretends to disown her to save her from her mother's wrath. Nila returns to Pondicherry with her father in law and earns the love and respect of her in-laws by saving her mother in law's life.
Diya wants to tell the truth and leave Praveen's house but her parents abandon her for some time and then emotionally blackmail her into keeping the secret. Aravind is brainwashed by his sister in law, Kavitha, who is very greedy and believes that Diya has betrayed him for money and consequently plans to get revenge on her. Diya also discovers that Aravind took money from her parents to stay quiet about the twin switch that results in her resenting him as well. During this time, Praveen constantly bothers Diya to accept him and claims to be in love with her even though he knows nothing about her, not even her real name. Diya eventually also falls in love with him. Diya understands Praveen's love for her and she accepts for the first night function where Diya and Praveen are supposed to consummate their marriage. Diya is a girl who believes in the concept of marriage. She even expressed her corroboration for it when she once mentioned it to Manasa stating that whatever wish a woman may have, a woman's life begins only with marriage. She goes on to say that a woman indeed is the one who takes care of the family along with bearing children that ensures the continuity of the family lineage with future generations. Aravind becomes furious after discovering that Diya and Praveen have consummated their marriage
Manasa, Praveen's sister falls in love with Aravind, who pretends to be in love with her so that he can attempt to marry her with the ulterior motives of becoming part of a rich family in order to get an employment at Manasa's father's company. He manipulates the whole family against Diya who tries everything to prove Aravind is a bad guy. Diya tries to stop their engagement by telling the truth about the twin switch to save Manasa from Aravind's trickery but her mother pushes her down the stairs and she falls into a coma. Nila also comes home in this time to try and help Diya stop the Aravind-Manasa engagement. Sathyamurthy and Gayathri emotionally blackmail Nila into pretending to be Praveen's wife until the engagement is over so Diya doesn't lose more respect in the family. After the engagement they learn that the doctor is uncertain if Diya will ever regain her consciousness.
Nila decides to keep up the facade as Praveen's wife until Diya wakes up so that she can stop Aravind and Kavitha's evil plan. Praveen claims to be in love with Nila but he doesn't even know which twin she is and tries to sleep with both of them. He gets very mad that Nila isn't interested in him and gets angry at her whenever she tries to help the rest of the family but not pay attention to him.
Kavitha, Aravind and Manimaaran(the union leader of Praveen's company) come up with a plan to scam the company. Aravind's brother Prabhakhar doesn't like their plan so he tries to expose the truth, but they keep him captive and eventually kill him. They also turn everyone in the family against Nila and she is made to leave the house until Manasa & Aravind's wedding is over. Diya wakes up from the coma and is very mad at Nila for her actions and wants Praveen back even though Praveen doesn't even recognize her as his real wife when she goes to meet him. Eventually Nila proves Kavitha, Aravind and Manimaaran were involved in murdering Prabhakhar, and Kavitha is arrested. Aravind goes to Praveen's house to tell the entire family the truth about the wedding day and twin switch before he also gets arrested. At the same time, Nila and Diya are heading to Praveen's house to tell them about Kavitha's arrest and try to get Diya back in the house as Praveen's wife the fake Nila. Aravind gets arrested because he tries to shoot Praveen but Nila saves Praveen and got shot in the neck. After a sequence of events, Praveen parents engaged Manasa to Vasanth. During Manasa and Vasanth's engagement everyone is aware of the truth concerning Nila and Diya.
Praveen's family is once again angry with Diya's family, and expels Diya from the family. Praveen's mother manipulates Praveen to file a mutual divorce or else would lodge a complaint with the police on the Nila and Diya incident of switching identities. Praveen agrees for a mutual divorce, and Diya simply accepts it. Praveen's mother finds a bride, Sandhya for Praveen once the divorce is finalised. Sandhya meets Diya and asks Diya to be her maid of honour which Diya accepts. Praveen realizes he loves Diya but is unable to express it because of his mother's pressure and persistence to marry Sandhya. Following a series of events, Sandhya and Nila make plans to test Praveen's love for Diya. The divorce was granted for Diya and Praveen. At the wedding, Sandhya says she cannot marry Praveen because Praveen has given his heart to Diya. Sandhya pushes Diya meanwhile Praveen ties the knot. The show ends with Diya saying she is pregnant.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Upcoming artist Mounika and Amruth who play the lead roles, are making their Tamil-language debuts with the series. Mounika Devi, who grew up in Andhra Pradesh, found it difficult to speak Tamil for her role. She played dual roles in the series and found it difficult to convincingly play both roles during the same take.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: Following an issue regarding the trending #MeToo at the time between the director Dhanush and Mounika, the director left the series in February 2019.

plotHtml:
Nila and Diya (Mounika Devi) are identical twin sisters. Nila's parents try to force her to marry Praveen (Amruth) because he comes from a wealthy family even though they know Nila loves Vijay (Shri Mahadev) and wants to focus on her career. On her wedding day, she leaves a note for her father and leaves for Pondicherry to be with Vijay. Diya's father, Sathyamoorthy (Supergood Kannan), forces Diya to pretend to be Nila and marry Praveen for the sake of the family's reputation. After the wedding ceremony is over, Diya's boyfriend Aravind (Dharish) comes as a guest and discovers the twin switch. He tries to help Diya stand up to her parents because she can be a bit of a pushover.
Meanwhile, Nila marries Vijay, but he is killed in a road accident on the wedding day and she becomes a widow. Vijay's relatives, except for her father in law and brother in law, blame her for his death. She tries to return home but her mother Gayathri almost kills her in a fit of rage. Her father Saythamoorthy pretends to disown her to save her from her mother's wrath. Nila returns to Pondicherry with her father in law and earns the love and respect of her in-laws by saving her mother in law's life.
Diya wants to tell the truth and leave Praveen's house but her parents abandon her for some time and then emotionally blackmail her into keeping the secret. Aravind is brainwashed by his sister in law, Kavitha, who is very greedy and believes that Diya has betrayed him for money and consequently plans to get revenge on her. Diya also discovers that Aravind took money from her parents to stay quiet about the twin switch that results in her resenting him as well. During this time, Praveen constantly bothers Diya to accept him and claims to be in love with her even though he knows nothing about her, not even her real name. Diya eventually also falls in love with him. Diya understands Praveen's love for her and she accepts for the first night function where Diya and Praveen are supposed to consummate their marriage. Diya is a girl who believes in the concept of marriage. She even expressed her corroboration for it when she once mentioned it to Manasa stating that whatever wish a woman may have, a woman's life begins only with marriage. She goes on to say that a woman indeed is the one who takes care of the family along with bearing children that ensures the continuity of the family lineage with future generations. Aravind becomes furious after discovering that Diya and Praveen have consummated their marriage
Manasa, Praveen's sister falls in love with Aravind, who pretends to be in love with her so that he can attempt to marry her with the ulterior motives of becoming part of a rich family in order to get an employment at Manasa's father's company. He manipulates the whole family against Diya who tries everything to prove Aravind is a bad guy. Diya tries to stop their engagement by telling the truth about the twin switch to save Manasa from Aravind's trickery but her mother pushes her down the stairs and she falls into a coma. Nila also comes home in this time to try and help Diya stop the Aravind-Manasa engagement. Sathyamurthy and Gayathri emotionally blackmail Nila into pretending to be Praveen's wife until the engagement is over so Diya doesn't lose more respect in the family. After the engagement they learn that the doctor is uncertain if Diya will ever regain her consciousness.
Nila decides to keep up the facade as Praveen's wife until Diya wakes up so that she can stop Aravind and Kavitha's evil plan. Praveen claims to be in love with Nila but he doesn't even know which twin she is and tries to sleep with both of them. He gets very mad that Nila isn't interested in him and gets angry at her whenever she tries to help the rest of the family but not pay attention to him.
Kavitha, Aravind and Manimaaran(the union leader of Praveen's company) come up with a plan to scam the company. Aravind's brother Prabhakhar doesn't like their plan so he tries to expose the truth, but they keep him captive and eventually kill him. They also turn everyone in the family against Nila and she is made to leave the house until Manasa & Aravind's wedding is over. Diya wakes up from the coma and is very mad at Nila for her actions and wants Praveen back even though Praveen doesn't even recognize her as his real wife when she goes to meet him. Eventually Nila proves Kavitha, Aravind and Manimaaran were involved in murdering Prabhakhar, and Kavitha is arrested. Aravind goes to Praveen's house to tell the entire family the truth about the wedding day and twin switch before he also gets arrested. At the same time, Nila and Diya are heading to Praveen's house to tell them about Kavitha's arrest and try to get Diya back in the house as Praveen's wife the fake Nila. Aravind gets arrested because he tries to shoot Praveen but Nila saves Praveen and got shot in the neck. After a sequence of events, Praveen parents engaged Manasa to Vasanth. During Manasa and Vasanth's engagement everyone is aware of the truth concerning Nila and Diya.
Praveen's family is once again angry with Diya's family, and expels Diya from the family. Praveen's mother manipulates Praveen to file a mutual divorce or else would lodge a complaint with the police on the Nila and Diya incident of switching identities. Praveen agrees for a mutual divorce, and Diya simply accepts it. Praveen's mother finds a bride, Sandhya for Praveen once the divorce is finalised. Sandhya meets Diya and asks Diya to be her maid of honour which Diya accepts. Praveen realizes he loves Diya but is unable to express it because of his mother's pressure and persistence to marry Sandhya. Following a series of events, Sandhya and Nila make plans to test Praveen's love for Diya. The divorce was granted for Diya and Praveen. At the wedding, Sandhya says she cannot marry Praveen because Praveen has given his heart to Diya. Sandhya pushes Diya meanwhile Praveen ties the knot. The show ends with Diya saying she is pregnant.
tagline: Nila and Diya (Mounika Devi) are identical twin sisters.

title: America Mappillai
summary: America Mappillai  (transl. The Groom from America) is a 2018 Tamil-language streaming television series, starring Raja Krishnamoorthy, Leela Samson, Arjun Chidambaram, Namita Krishnamurthy, Rakesh Ram and Gokul Anand. It premiered on ZEE5 from 2018. The show was writer by Raja Ramamurthy and director by Praveen Padmanabhan.
plot: Ganesh is a young man who his father constantly nags to get married. His gay friend suggests that Ganesh pretend to be gay so as to avoid marriage. Ganesh acts out the plan but there are unintended consequences.
reception:
The News Minute reviewed America Mappillai as a light hearted and funny webseries. They also stated that it was hard to understand the characters due to lack of time to elaborate more about the individuals. The series takes on the Indian obsession of marriages and caste differences. Anyhow, the format of the series is easy to understand.
The Indian Express gave a review of the series stating that the story is quite interesting but some moments portrayed in the series feel stagey and unnatural. The episodes in the web series are named after colours in an ode to its queer story, with minimal music. Some moments throughout the series don’t have any sound, however, the silence in those scenes was brilliant. The overall performance of the actors in America Mappillai was good.
A Pot Pourri Of Vestiges reviewed by stating that the series has an interesting perspective on marriages in India. America Mallipai overturns all the stereotypes making the series a worthy addition to binge-watch all eight episodes in one go. The director of the series Praveen Padmanabhan has done a great job in bringing out the right kind of performances from all the actors.

title: Aakhri Station
summary:
Aakhri Station (Urdu: آخری سٹیشن; English: The Last Station) is a seven-part Pakistani television drama mini-series, created by Sarmad Khoosat and Kashf Foundation. It premiered on ARY Digital on 13 February 2018 and concluded on 28 March 2018. Written by Amna Mufti, it is directed and co-produced by Khoosat with Roshaneh Zafar of Kashf Foundation Productions and Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade. The series consist of seven episodes.
The show introduced an ensemble cast with Sanam Saeed, Nimrah Bucha, Malika Zafar, Anam Goher, Eman Suleman, Ammara Butt and Farah Tufail portraying seven strangers with different economic, social and cultural backgrounds suffering from domestic and mental issues, meeting in a train compartment en route to Karachi. The show aims to explore women-eccentric subjects that its creators feel have not been emphasized in Pakistani shows openly, such as women's rights, drug abuse, HIV, PTSD, acid attacks, forced prostitution, and domestic violence.
The OST, a rendition of an Amjad Islam Amjad poem, ‘Mujhe Apne Jeenay Ka Haq Chaihiye‘ has been composed by Arshad Mahmood and sung by Tahira Syed. The last verse of the poem is recited by Indian actress Shabana Azmi.
plot: Each episode explores a different story based on women's empowerment and social issues affecting women, especially in Pakistan.

articleSections.title: Episode 1
articleSections.text:
A group of women, each belonging to a different socioeconomic class, sit together in a train compartment, going to Karachi.
They are joined by two more; a mother, Yasmin, and her daughter, Mahno, and a transgender lady.
The trans woman was being insulted in another compartment, whereupon an old conductor intervened and told the culprit to fear God, as He created all and that all people have a right on the land. He advised the trans woman to move to a place in the front, and call for him in case of any trouble.
Back in the main compartment, the lady in the saree, Tehmina, commented on the various new colours of nail polish, causing Yasmin, who was wearing turquoise on one hand, to say "i hate this, it's not coming off". Tehmina offered Yasmin cotton and nail polish remover.
It is revealed that Yasmin belonged to a very poor family, and lived with her parents in law and husband, Waqar, who would not work. They were knee deep in debt, to the extent people had started to shame her. The man she was married to was an alcoholic, a gambler and had sold every sellable item in the house.
He stole Yasmin's gold earrings, which her mother had gifted her before she died, sold them, and lost all the money in a bet. His friends offered to give him a loan for another game, in exchange for a night with his wife. The man agreed. Drunk and staggering he went home and opened a room at the roof of his house which was flooded with red light. He laid down a mattress on it and put a bedsheet on it. Then he went down to talk to Yasmin who immediately asked about the money from the earrings. Waqar told her to wash her face and commented on how unkept she looked. She responded by saying that washing her face won’t get them any money. The man pulled her by force and dragged her out where he washed her face under a tap with extreme force. Then he took her to the room on the roof and another guy went in after which the door was promptly locked with Waqar outside smoking a cigarette and not responding to his wife’s cries of help.
Yasmin was traumatized. The man boasted of a "business" to his parents, who were clueless. At night, he told her soon their daughter would run this (inhumane) business and earn for them, and then the "clients" were about to arrive. He had brought with him a turquoise nail polish, a red lipstick and a wine bottle which he thought were necessities to lure men in and make them happy with the “service”. His friends had told him that he need never worry about money because he had a “blank cheque” at home. He had started applying nail polish on her finger nails while she blankly stared ahead clearly traumatised. But when she heard the comment about her daughter, she took out the red lipstick and went to the mirror to put it on, her stare wasn’t blank anymore.
She put on an act, and fooled the man into thinking she was okay with his crimes. She asked him to go buy some ice for the alcohol that he brought.
As soon as he left, she grabbed her daughter and made a run for it.

articleSections.title: Episode 2
articleSections.text:
The other women consoled Yasmin and assured her she did the right thing.
But Yasmin's pain triggered another passenger, Gul Meena.
Gul Meena was very nearly due, and had left her village with her husband, Yousuf, and in laws, to escape war.
They travelled from refugee camp to refugee camp on buses, looking for a new place to restart life.
In a camp one night, everyone was awoken by a woman's wailing. She too had left to flee the war, but while she was asleep, a man got into her tent and snatched her only family, a young daughter.
Contractions hit Gul Meena, who started to cry out in pain. Her mother in law, Ma Gul, forbade Yousuf from looking for a gynecologist. He went anyway and returned late in the night with the doctors address and a horse ridden cart.
Yousuf talked his father into travelling to the next camp with Ma Gul and brother, Younas, while he himself would take his wife to the city to visit the doctor.
On the way to the city, Gul Meena was in pain again, and Yousuf asked the driver to take him and his wife to his, the driver's, place.
Yousaf was given the good news of the birth of his first child, a son.
The new parents tried to track down Yousuf's family but could not find them. Some time later, while going for the Fajr prayer, Yousuf suffered a sudden heart attack, and died before he could be rushed to a doctor.
Gul Meena's in laws were finally traced, and they came to take her and her son, Rustum Khan, home.
Ma Gul, who already disliked her daughter in law as it was, began to loathe her, accuse her of Yousuf's death, and curse her.
She then falsely accused Gul Meena of trying to "trap" Younas.
Gul Meena had had enough and agreed to marry their old, aged neighbor, but on the condition that she would take her baby with her.
After the nikkah, the man refused to take in Rustum Khan, and Gul Meena was forcibly taken inside, empty handed. Yousuf's family move with Rustum to Karachi.
Meanwhile, the old man began to question Gul Meena's character without any basis. She begged him to let her bring her child back, but he refused, because she nothing more than a slave to him.
In his anger, he said he'd beat her up, and that there was no space for her in his home if she kept crying for the son of another man, and then left for work.
Gul Meena decided she would no longer live without Rustum, and ran.
Episode 3:
Tehmina had a flashback of witnessing her mother's suicide as a child.
The train stopped along the way and the Conductor came to recheck everyone's tickets. Yasmin left the berth to hide from him, as she did not have one. He went after her and she excused herself, telling him she ran away from an abusive husband and did not have the money to purchase a ticket. A woman listening to the conversation began to call Yasmin out saying "women must bear everything". The Conductor corrected the lady, reminding her the females are also Gods creation, and should not be oppressed.
He bought Yasmin a ticket, and, upon her insisting, agreed to give her his address so she would be able to pay him back.
Back in the compartment, a few ladies were singing, and Farzana, who was trying to sleep in the top bunk, snapped at them.
She then apologized saying she had been up all night, listening to the others talk, and could not help but feel like, unlike the others, she herself was solely responsible for her misery.
Upon Tehmina's inquiring, she told them she was educated woman, with a masters degree. She had met a guy, Sajjad, at her university, and despite her parents warning her not to, kept seeing him. They were eventually married.
Sajjad always complained of how his family would demean him all the time, and would win Farzana's sympathy. For this reason, they move out of the family home. However, some time after marriage, she saw he was actually vain and bitter. He began to project all his negative emotions onto her, being pleased by emotionally abusing her.
They had a daughter, nicknamed Bunty, upon whom they would both dote. Sajjad didn't earn enough to be able to singly support his family, and, because of his own insecurities and shortcomings, began to accuse Farzana of working just to "spend time with other men".
Her self control broke one day, and she retaliated, attacking him with words as poisonous as his own. This drove Sajjad mad, and he dragged her into a room and beat her up.

title: Anjaan: Special Crimes Unit
summary: Anjaan: Special Crimes Unit is an Indian paranormal investigative crime horror television series, which airs on Discovery JEET. It features Heena Parmar and Gashmeer Mahajani in lead roles. They investigate crime cases, that are connected to the supernatural. The show premiered on 12 February 2018.
plot:
The series shows the journey of ACP Vikrant Singhal who is after a gangster named Vanraaj. Many people believe Vanraaj to be an evil spirit. Vikrant is a logical and level headed police officer, who does not believe in ghosts, his junior officer ACP Shivani Joglekar can see paranormal species. They are paired together at an abandoned police station of Mumbai Police - Shaitan Chowki, which is full of unsolved case files. Shivani's deceased elder brother Shiddhant Joglekar was killed mysteriously with bullet wounds with no bullets. Shivani and Vikrant find out that Siddhant was in charge of Vanraaj's investigation and they try to link these cases.
Meanwhile, they are called for another mysterious cases which are linked to certain files from Shaitan Chowski. The paranormal species that were wronged in their lives try to contact Shivani in order to get justice. Vikrant and Shivani are thus called to solve series of unsolved cases from other police stations as well. In between Vikrant gets glimpses of information regarding Vanraaj, and every time he fails to catch him. All they have is a mysterious symbol from Brahmi script. Vanraaj kills Shivani on night, and Vikrant decides to avenge her murder. He finds a link between the symbol and an orphanage in Rajasthan and heads there. There he meets Aditi Sharma, who is an Delhi-based ASP. Like Shivani, Aditi is also capable of seeing paranormal species, she is sent by Shivani's spirit to save Vikrant.
The orphanage was abandoned since 20 years but Aditi finds an old photograph of four small kids including herself. Her father tells her that she was adopted from an orphanage in Bengaluru, where she was shifted after a massive fire accident in the orphanage in Rajasthan. Determine to solve the mystery, she and Vikrant decide to get her transferred from Delhi to Mumbai.
The episodes are based on unsolved case stories that are solved by Vikrant and Aditi. The link to Vanraaj and the orphanage reveals slowly through the episodes in parallel. In the season finale, Aditi finds out that in the photograph of the four kids was of herself with Siddhant and Shivani who are her siblings. These four are destined to protect the one who can destroy the evil that is Vanraaj. This person is meant to be Vikrant, who is pulled into the portal to another world by Vanraaj leaving Aditi alone.

title: Aap Ke Aa Jane Se
summary: Aap Ke Aa Jane Se (English meaning-By Your Arrival) (international title: Age is Just a Number) is an Indian soap opera which aired on Zee TV from 15 January 2018 to 31 May 2019. It is produced by Bodhi Tree Multimedia and it starred Suhasi Dhami and Karan Jotwani as Vedika and Sahil. The show marked the comeback of Dhami after a three-year break from television. It replaced Dil Dhoondta Hai in its timeslot and was replaced by Hamari Bahu Silk.
plot:
Vedika Mathur, a 42-year-old, simple and single mother, lives with her mother, Manjula and 15-year-old daughter, Arya. Sahil Agarwal, a 24-year-old irresponsible young man, returns to his home where his aunt, Bimla, the family matriarch, fixes his wedding to his friend, Nidhi, but he declines and is thrown out. Vedika, who is in need of money rents out a room in her home to Sahil. During this period, Sahil forms a bond with Arya and Manjula, while Vedika tries to keep a platonic relationship between them as a landlady and tenant. Sahil falls in love with Vedika and confesses this, but Vedika rejects him due to their age gap and social problems. Soon enough, she realizes her love for Sahil, though in denial, but eventually accepts it.
A rich man named Yash, who wants revenge on Bimla, makes an entry and reveals his relationship with the Agarwal's. Although against Vedika and Sahil's union, Bimla is revealed to be a hypocrite as she had once seduced a married man, five years younger than her, for his wealth. He then threw out Yash and his mother on Bimla's behest. Vedika is forced to marry Yash. Later, he is diagnosed with cancer and asks Vedika to give him a child. They both decide on IVF, but due to a nurse's mistake, Sahil becomes the donor for Yash and Vedika's child. Vedika's distant cousin arrives in Kanpur and along with Arya, try and help Sahil win over Vedika. Soon, Yash dies, leaving Vedika a widow once again.
Not wanting Sahil and Vedika to unite, Bimla poisons Sahil's mother, Anjana. When she finds out that Vedika is pregnant with Sahil's baby, Anjana happily goes to Vedika's house to propose marriage. Sahil hears of this from Bimla and he too goes to see Vedika. The poison takes effect at Vedika's house, where Anjana falls down the stairs and dies. Sahil arrives at that moment and misunderstands Vedika to be the culprit and has her jailed. In a fit of rage, Sahil marries Bhumi in prison. Vedika delivers a son while Bimla's daughter, Gauri delivers a daughter in the same hospital. Bimla replaces Vedika's son with a stillborn child and flees. Meanwhile, Gauri's husband, Deepak exchanges that same stillborn baby with his daughter as he wanted a son.
Vedika leaves the city with Gauri's daughter and Bimla lies to Sahil that Vedika has abandoned her child. Sahil names the baby Ved and adopts him, unaware that the child is his.
Vedika returns to Kanpur with her daughter, Sadika while Sahil lives with Bhumi and Ved. Arya returns to India after her studies. Vedika soon learns that Sadika is Gauri and Deepak's daughter, and Ved is her real son. Later, Sahil also learns Ved is his son and Anjana was killed by Bimla. Enraged, he leaves her and Bhumi; reunites with Vedika. Ved is in need of a bone marrow transplant from his full sibling and thus Vedika gets pregnant with Sahil's child. Sahil is presumed dead after falling off a cliff, but is rescued by his lookalike, Jackie, who turned out to his twin brother. Prachi's husband, Puneesh, kills Jackie, assuming him to be Sahil. Sahil returns to the Agarwals' as Jackie with Jackie's adoptive family and reveals the truth to Vedika. They together expose Puneesh. Arya and Guddu, Jackie's adoptive brother, fall in love and marry.
Having lost his memory, Sahil unintentionally marries Pankti, to save her from her politician father, Tej Pratap Singh. Vedika delivers another son, Virat, and Ved recovers. Sahil and Vedika find a partner for Pankti and she leaves with him. Bimla's long-lost son, Kshitij comes to destroy Agarwals and kills Guddu, framing Sahil. Arya marries Kshitij for revenge but realises that Sahil is innocent and that Kshitij is responsible for Guddu's death. Later, he kidnaps Ved and Virat, but Sahil and Vedika manage to save them with Arya's help. Enraged, Kshitij shoots Sahil and Vedika. The two fall down a cliff and die vowing to reunite in their next lives to complete their love story.
Vedika and Sahil are reborn. Reborn Vedika is a 32-year-old caring and kind-hearted divorcee. Reborn Sahil is a 26-year-old carefree man, who falls for her but is engaged to her sister, Avantika. The two meet the now old Manjula, who reveals they're reborn. Avantika runs away from her wedding and Sahil and Vedika get married. Regretting her decision and being greedy, Avantika teams up with Tanuj, Vedika's ex-husband, to separate them. Tanuj kidnaps Vedika, but is killed by her. Avantika is exposed and arrested. Sahil and Vedika regain their memories of their past life and remarry to unite forever.
