Vedika Mathur, a 42-year-old, simple and single mother, lives with her mother, Manjula and 15-year-old daughter, Arya. Sahil Agarwal, a 24-year-old irresponsible young man, returns to his home where his aunt, Bimla, the family matriarch, fixes his wedding to his friend, Nidhi, but he declines and is thrown out. Vedika, who is in need of money rents out a room in her home to Sahil. During this period, Sahil forms a bond with Arya and Manjula, while Vedika tries to keep a platonic relationship between them as a landlady and tenant. Sahil falls in love with Vedika and confesses this, but Vedika rejects him due to their age gap and social problems. Soon enough, she realizes her love for Sahil, though in denial, but eventually accepts it.
A rich man named Yash, who wants revenge on Bimla, makes an entry and reveals his relationship with the Agarwal's. Although against Vedika and Sahil's union, Bimla is revealed to be a hypocrite as she had once seduced a married man, five years younger than her, for his wealth. He then threw out Yash and his mother on Bimla's behest. Vedika is forced to marry Yash. Later, he is diagnosed with cancer and asks Vedika to give him a child. They both decide on IVF, but due to a nurse's mistake, Sahil becomes the donor for Yash and Vedika's child. Vedika's distant cousin arrives in Kanpur and along with Arya, try and help Sahil win over Vedika. Soon, Yash dies, leaving Vedika a widow once again.
Not wanting Sahil and Vedika to unite, Bimla poisons Sahil's mother, Anjana. When she finds out that Vedika is pregnant with Sahil's baby, Anjana happily goes to Vedika's house to propose marriage. Sahil hears of this from Bimla and he too goes to see Vedika. The poison takes effect at Vedika's house, where Anjana falls down the stairs and dies. Meanwhile, Gauri's husband, Deepak exchanges that same stillborn baby with his daughter as he wanted a son.
Vedika leaves the city with Gauri's daughter and Bimla lies to Sahil that Vedika has abandoned her child. Sahil names the baby Ved and adopts him, unaware that the child is his.
Vedika returns to Kanpur with her daughter, Sadika while Sahil lives with Bhumi and Ved. Arya returns to India after her studies. Vedika soon learns that Sadika is Gauri and Deepak's daughter, and Ved is her real son. Later, Sahil also learns Ved is his son and Anjana was killed by Bimla. title: Ardhangini
summary:
Ardhangini is an Indian Bengali-language television drama series that was broadcast on Star Jalsha and Star Jalsha HD and streamed on Disney+ Hotstar. The series debuted on 8 January 2018 and endedon 18 November 2018. This show comes from the house of Acropoliis Productions. The series is the official remake of Hindi drama Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh, Piyaji.
Ardhangini tells the story about overcoming and embracing each other's differences in ideologies and embarking on a journey of love after marriage. The series was starring  Nabanita Das as Ishwari, Jeetu Kamal as Ayush, Rahul Banerjee as Umapati and Payel De as Ganga.
plot:
Umpati is a man deeply rooted to traditional value system and believes that men and women are born for separate duties. He is a famous Ayurveda Practitioner and dreams of an ideal, ritualistic wife who would share his values. Ishwari, conversely, is a free spirited, independent, empowered lady who is exceptionally talented and well trained in classical dance. She believes a woman is no less than a man. These two completely different personalities meet each other on a chilly morning at the holy Ghat across the Ganges in Haridwar. When two entirely different individuals, antipodal as personalities meet, their destinies having had a significant role to play, their respective worlds eventually come crashing down.
But at this point, they've seen a long and happy spell with each other overcoming many challenges thrown on the way to rediscover herself Ishwari is bound to perform the challenging task of a housemaid a consultant a care giver and finally a lover to prove herself as a worthy wife not only to her husband umapati but also to all her in laws. Next she comes across challenges posed by the jealous Ganga Umapati's childhood friend who secretly wants to become Umapati's wife but fails to do so and then comes challenges from Umapati's Aunt Mamoni who just cannot tolerate Ishwari and makes life very difficult for her, but Ishwari uses her intelligence to single-handedly prove her innocence against every accusation and thereafter bring out the real culprits of the misdeeds for which she is falsely implicated. All these family drama finally culminate to a happy point when Ishwari finally proves that Mamoni Umapati's own sister Anjali and Mamoni's son Vishnu are involved in a robbery in their own house.
After Mamoni Vishnu and Anjali are put behind bars by the Law peace returns to the Bhattacharya family and they start planning for Nandi and Dev's marriage to the daughters of the family Arati and Payel. After this the family decide to go to Haridawar. On the way disaster strikes as their train derails and the sole survivors of the accident are Ishwari and Kakamoni. Everyone else Thammi Boroboumoni, Payel, Arati, Nandi and Umapati die in the train accident on the other side Ishwari's mother also suffers a massive heart attack in Haridwar and is assumed to be dead. After gaining consciousness Ishwari sees Umapati die due to lack of proper treatment in front of her eyes. This causes her a deep trauma and she suffers from major amnesia and mentally is transported back to be 10 years old girl. This comes as a big challenge for Dr. Ayush who is treating Ishwari and is also her secret childhood admirer.
Later the story explored the life of a mentally unstable Ishwari after the sad demise of Umapati, the troubled yet exhilarating path that her life has taken on. Here comes Ayush, an old friend that adores Ishwari like no other, takes her by the hand and takes on the world with her, but then Ishwari in Episode 304 regains her memory and completely forgets Ayush and then leaves Ayush. Ayush tries to commit suicide but Ishwari comes back and stops him and tells him that she is not going to leave him with the serial ending on a happy note.

title: Azhagu
summary:
Azhagu (Beauty) is a 2017 Indian Tamil-language soap opera starring Niranjan BS, Shruthi Raj, 
Sangeetha Sai, Revathi, and Thalaivasal Vijay. The show premiered on 20 November 2017, replacing the serial Vamsam, and ended on 3 April 2020 due to COVID-19 pandemic. It was subsequently replaced by the serial Abhiyum Naanum. The show was produced by Vision Time India Pvt Ltd on Sun TV.

articleSections.title: Season-1
articleSections.text:
The story is about the nuances of love between husband Palaniswamy and his wife Azhagu, even though they have been married for decades, and have successful and robust individual personas.
Azhagu is the one who finds amicable solutions to all family problems and issues while struggling to help her
five children Aishwarya and Ravi, Mahesh, Thiruna and Kavya survive peacefully.

Soon, it is revealed that Poorna and Sudha are Sakundala's long lost daughters. Despite, Poorna turns eviler, and she creates various problems.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Revathi was cast as the lead Azhagu who making her comeback after 10 years. It is the second serial for the male lead Thalaivasal Vijay after 27 years. Shruthi Raj and V J Sangeeta were cast as the next leads. Aishwarya makes a TV serial comeback after 3 years sabbatical. Niranjan Bs was cast as Thiruna.
In October 2019, Sahana Sheddy playing Kavya quit the series stating less screen space for her role. However, within few days, she rejoined the series after the production team convinced her. In November 2019, Vaishnavi Arulmozhi replaced Akshitha Bopaiah as Nivedita. In the same month, Revathi returned to the series after 2 months break after her film shootings.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
On 1 April 2018, a special celebration sequence of Azhagu and Palanisamy getting married took place with the invitation of their friends and public.
The production and shooting of all Indian television series and films were halted, due to COVID-19 pandemic in India, on 19 March 2020 and were supposed to resume after 31 March 2020. However, due to nationwide lockdown in the country imposed from 25 March 2020, it could not resume and the last new episode was broadcast on 3 April 2020. After about three months, the shooting resumed after being granted permission in early June 2020 and some sequences were shot with some cast including Urvashi as a new addition. However, Tamil Nadu Government announced full lockdown from 19 June 2020 to 30 June 2020 for Chennai and its surrounding three districts. Due to it the production and filming was also once again halted. In July 2020, Sun TV abruptly confirmed the series not returning as many of the cast members including Revathi and Sruthi Raj were sceptical to arrive to shoot owing the pandemic.

title: Aisi Hai Tanhai
summary: Aisi Hai Tanhai (Urdu: ایسی ہے تنہائی, lit. 'Such is Loneliness') is a Pakistani television serial that originally aired on ARY Digital Network on 8 November 2017 and ended on 21 March 2018. It is written by Mohsin Ali, produced by Fahad Mustafa, and Dr. Ali Kazmi, and directed by Badar Mehmood. In this serial, Sami Khan has played the lead role, which was based on a love story with Sonya Hussain and Nadia Khan. Aisi Hai Tanhai talks about how social media can become a curse for someone's life and destroy everything.
plot:
Pakeeza (Sonya Hussain) is a college student who lives with her widowed mother Khadija (Saba Hameed) and older sister Kinza (Nadia Khan). She falls in love with her classmate Hamza (Sami Khan) and soon they are engaged. Meanwhile, Kinza is married into a respectable family. One day, Hamza challenges Pakeeza to prove the love and trust she has for him. She takes bold pictures on her phone, and the next day she offers Hamza to take a look. He feels ashamed and denies the offer. Immediately afterwards, some goons snatch Pakeeza's phone and shoot her in the process. Hamza rushes her to the hospital, where she recovers fully but expresses concern over the contents of her phone.
The goons leak Pakeeza's photos all over social media, where they go viral. Hamza's friends hold him responsible for this and Hamza goes to lengths to ensure that Pakeeza's family remains oblivious. His close friend Ramsha is in love with him and feels jealous of his relationship with Pakeeza. To sabotage their engagement, she forwards Pakeeza's photos to Hamza's mother. This causes Hamza's parents to break off their son's engagement. Pakeeza's family learns the truth about her viral photos when Kinza's husband divorces her. In retaliation, Khadija poisons Pakeeza. As Pakeeza is admitted to the hospital in critical condition, Khadija leaves and informs everyone that Pakeeza committed suicide. This devastates Kinza and Hamza, while Ramsha feels guilty for the betrayal. Pakeeza is shifted to another ward in the meantime, where Dr. Saad (Kamran Jilani) takes interest in her case and takes it upon himself to try and heal her. When Khadija returns to the hospital, she is told that there is a deceased patient in the ward Pakeeza had been in, causing her to believe that Pakeeza is dead.
While she is in a coma, Pakeeza is raped by a hospital custodian and this goes unnoticed by the rest of the staff. She eventually awakens, much to Dr. Saad's delight, and begins to recover slowly. In the meantime, Hamza marries Kinza as he feels responsible for ruining Pakeeza and her family's reputation. Dr. Saad offers Pakeeza shelter in his home after she is discharged and learns that she is pregnant. The hospital custodian is arrested, while Pakeeza is distraught over the trauma she has faced. Dr. Saad begins to receive threats for helping her and to protect him, she leaves to stay in a women's shelter. There she is shunned once it is discovered that she is pregnant. Now homeless, Pakeeza travels to a local shrine and suffers a bad fall. Ramsha, who had been volunteering at the shrine, sees this and is shocked to know that Pakeeza is alive. She takes her to a hospital, where Pakeeza is told that she has had a miscarriage. While Ramsha takes care of Pakeeza at her own home, Dr. Saad works hard to take the custodian to court. He urges Pakeeza to provide testimony so that justice can be served. Khadija receives a notice to appear in court, where she is shocked to find Pakeeza alive. Kinza and Hamza are also surprised to learn of Pakeeza's rape case. During the trial, the prosecutor questions Pakeeza's character and discusses her leaked photos. After Khadija and Ramsha admit their wrongdoings in court, this further traumatizes Pakeeza. She confronts her mother and Hamza, questioning their actions. Khadija passes away the next morning after wallowing in guilt. Soon after this, Hamza is shot and dies in the hospital as Pakeeza weeps beside him. The court finds the custodian guilty after he confesses his crime and is sentenced to jail. Pakeeza forgives Ramsha and moves in with her. She opens up a self-defense school for young girls, promising to fight for their rights.

articleSections.title: International broadcast
articleSections.text: The serial was dubbed in Arabic and was broadcast under the title Karamati (کرامتی) on MBC Bollywood across Arab World and North Africa.

title: Aadat Se Majboor
summary: Aadat Se Majboor (transl. Forced to habit) is an Indian comedy television series. The show aired from 3 October 2017 to 26 February 2018 on SAB TV.
plot: When five young people with completely different personalities work together in one space it is bound to create some competition as well as some comic situations. Such is the life of these five frenemies -Sunny, J.D, Ranjan, Riya and Sam who work together in a magazine publishing company filled with co-workers of individual personalities as well.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Sana Makbul as Riya Tootejaa * Vanshika Sharma as Samiksha, a.k.a. Sam * Anuj Pandit Sharma as Sunny Sharma * Rishab Chadha as Jamnadas Dhirubhai Majithia, a.k.a. JD * Haresh K Raut as Ranjan * Anant Mahadevan as Roshan Lal Tootejaa/Darshan Lal Tootejaa

articleSections.title: Guest cast
articleSections.text: Krishna Abhishek as Bunty Sharma * Mithun Chakraborty as Himself * Kapil Sharma as Himself * Bharti Singh as Herself

producedBy: Dharampal Thakur, Bharat Kukreti, Pankaj Sudhir Mishra

episodesList.title: The Interview Day
episodesList.summary: Sunny, JD, Ranjan, Riya and Sam arrive in the Mumbai for the job interview of City Chakkar Magazine. Everyone creates a decent impression in the interview. But during the group discussion, everyone gets themselves caught in an inappropriate situation. Will Sunny, JD, Ranjan, Riya and Sam get the job?

episodesList.title: Finding Accommodation
episodesList.summary: Sunny, JD, Ranjan, Riya and Sam secure a job in the City Chakkar Magazine. Excited, they start looking for the accommodation. But they realize that Riya and Sam's broker has shown them the same apartment that Sunny, JD, Ranjan's broker has shown them. Who will get the apartment?

episodesList.title: Setting Up The New Apartment
episodesList.summary: JD, Ranjan and Sunny come to the new house and find it in a mess. They meet Chaubey and Dubey from the City Chakkar Magazine who try to tell them about the rules of the house. Later, at night, the guys are terrified when Sam and Riya scare them. The next day, a surprise awaits the new recruits at the office. What will it be?

episodesList.title: Motivational Speech
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the office tries to find a motivational story for Bunty Sharma's workshop. Meanwhile, Bunty Sharma demotivates everyone by proving their statements wrong. He asks everyone to give a motivational speech. JD cleverly plagiarises Ranjan and Sunny's story and presents as his own. Watch this episode to find out Ranjan and Sunny's expression after listening JD's speech.

episodesList.title: Fake Baba
episodesList.summary: Boss assigns everyone a work to bring an advertisement for the magazine. Ranjan, JD, and Sunny try to sell their advertisement idea but get kicked out. Later, everyone decides to visit a Baba. They discover that the person is Ranjan's neighbor and not a Baba. Riya plans to write an article on the fake baba's life. Will they find an advertisement for the magazine?

episodesList.title: Search For a Celebrity
episodesList.summary: The Boss is annoyed after realizing that everyone is passing time in office. Meanwhile, Ranjan, JD, and Sunny receive a message for the advertisement. They decide to tell the news to their boss but discover that the boss himself is the sender. Later, the boss assigns the new task of finding a celebrity for the advertisement. Will Ranjan, JD, and Sunny be able to find a celebrity for the advertisement?

episodesList.title: Who will be The Model
episodesList.summary: Sunny, JD, and Ranjan enter film city to find a celebrity for their magazine photoshoot. Sunny fails to impress Kapil Sharma and get kicked out of the stage. Meanwhile, JD meets Mithun Chakraborty and asks him to be a model for the magazine, but he too gets kicked out of the studio. Later, Boss decides to appoint a model from the office staff after Sunny, JD, and Ranjan's multiple failures.

episodesList.title: Desperate Models
episodesList.summary: The entire office is ready to make a statement as they prepare for the modeling competition by their client. Sunny, JD and Ranjan are all desperate for a shot at winning this competition by ridiculing themselves in front of the office. But they were all in for a big surprise. Watch the full episode and find out who eventually wins it.

episodesList.title: Village Shoot
episodesList.summary: Riya and Pune Baburao More wins the modeling competition, now they make their way into Baburao's village to shoot the advertisement. The city bunch gets a taste of village life and they also get to meet Baburao's weird family. Watch the full episode to find out where this journey takes them.

episodesList.title: Village Shoot Part 2
episodesList.summary: As the team spends more and more time in the Village, they get to meet new people and experience new things. Especially Sunny and JD, they finally found their dream village girl, but that dream eventually becomes their nightmare.

episodesList.title: Jd and Sunny’s Jealousy
episodesList.summary: Sunny and JD get jealous of Ranjan having a good time with Riya in his village. Boss announces that he is throwing a party but, fools everyone by giving snacks at the party. JD and Sunny lose hope when Riya credits Ranjan. What will JD and Sunny do to Ranjan now?

episodesList.title: Ranjan’s Marriage Invitation
episodesList.summary: Sunny and JD regret being responsible for Ranjan being fired from his post.  They are tempted to admit it to their boss, but are unable to convince themselves to do so.  Then, Ranjan sends a marriage invitation to all the employees in the office

episodesList.title: More In Trouble
episodesList.summary: More's father-in-law comes into the office and catches More. Meanwhile, Ranjan prays that the culprit should be punished, but JD and Sunny confirm that does Ranjan have any doubt about them. Will Ranjan find out that JD and Sunny are the real culprits?

episodesList.title: Diwali Outside Home
episodesList.summary: Ranjan brings sweets his parents sent him on the occasion of Diwali. JD and Sunny offer condolences and shares their memories of Diwali. Meanwhile, JD receives a phone call from his father. JD's father makes him embarrassed by asking whether Ranjan and Sunny have boxers. How will be Ranjan, JD and Sunny's Diwali?

episodesList.title: Not So Sweet Shop
episodesList.summary: Riya decides to expose Disco Sweets Shop for adulterating sweets. Sam and Riya meet Disco Sweets Shop owner, Nathulal. Riya pretends to be the interviewer and wants to visit the kitchen, but Nathulal denies her request. How will Riya expose Disco Sweets Shop?

episodesList.title: Escape Plan
episodesList.summary: Riya and Sam try to fool workers of the sweet shop. Meanwhile, Ranjan and JD blackmail Ranjan for calling Riya an inhuman entity. Riya and Sam keep irritating shop workers to flee from the shop. Will Riya and Sam manage to flee from the shop?

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Boss instructs everyone to come in time after seeing everyone late in office. Meanwhile, More gets beaten by Sam after seeing Deepti crying in the office. Deepti tells that she is upset as she is missing his brother. Riya adds by saying that she also wish to have a brother. Who will be Riya's brother? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Bhai Dooj
episodesList.summary: JD falls into his trap and drinks the milk that has sleeping pills. He wakes up late and notices Riya outside the door waiting for someone to open the door so that she could find a brother. Meanwhile, Rupesh tells Menka that Patel is at home. Who will be Riya's brother?

episodesList.title: Sam’s New Phone
episodesList.summary: More calls everyone at Sam's desk to show her new phone. Looking at the new phone, everyone asks her for a party. Meanwhile, Riya arrives and announces the Boss' birthday. Riya tells that they will plan a surprise party. Will the birthday party be successful?

episodesList.title: Worried Sunny
episodesList.summary: JD and Sunny return home worried about the phone. Ranjan scares him more by telling them that the Police will catch them. Sunny tells that he plans to take an off tomorrow. But, JD warns him that if he takes an off then the Police will doubt him. Will the Police catch JD and Sunny?

episodesList.title: The Big Birthday Bash
episodesList.summary: Riya gives More and Ranjan the credits for all the decoration. Meanwhile, Patel enters the hall and throws the rose on Minakshi, but Patel feels heartbroken after Minakshi crushes his rose. Later, Sunny, JD and Ranjan arrives at the venue and start flirting with Riya. How will everyone celebrate Boss' birthday?

episodesList.title: Advertisement Woes
episodesList.summary: Boss calls everyone for a meeting to talk about teamwork. Meanwhile, Boss asks Sunny, JD and Ranjan about bringing ads published in the magazine. But Sunny tells that because of the cover story, no one is willing to give the advertisement. Later, Ranjan, JD, Sunny, Riya and Sam start arguing on the story. Will Boss remove them from Job?

episodesList.title: Sunny Gets an Advertisement
episodesList.summary: Sunny promises Lina to make her the model for the advertisement in City Chakkar Magazine. Meanwhile, Boss accepts Riya's cover story on pottery. Later, Sunny returns home and tells about getting an advertisement for the magazine. Will Sunny keep his promise?

episodesList.title: Jd Blackmails Sunny
episodesList.summary: Sunny asks Ranjan to pray for his good fortune. He also tells that Riya will always be his permanent love, but currently, he loves Lina. Meanwhile, JD and Ranjan record his statement on their phone and blackmail him to reveal it to Riya and Lina. Later, JD and Ranjan tell Sunny to give a commission in the advertisement. How will Lina react after seeing her photo in the magazine?

episodesList.title: Jd Needs Money
episodesList.summary: JD throws a party for Ranjan, Sunny, Riya and Sam for getting advertisement worth two lakhs. He tells that from the advertisement, he will get 10 percent of commission. Meanwhile, JD's father calls him and asks him to send fifty thousand rupees urgently. Riya tells JD to ask Boss for money. Will Boss give money to JD?

episodesList.title: Jd Leaves The Apartment
episodesList.summary: Sunny and Ranjan try to convince JD about rethinking his decision of leaving the apartment. But, JD declines their request and leaves the apartment. Meanwhile, Riya tells Menaka the reason behind Sam getting worried. Will JD regret his decision?

episodesList.title: Jd’s New Car
episodesList.summary: JD expresses his gratitude to Life High magazine owner thinking that he transferred fifty thousand rupees to his father. Meanwhile, JD meets Sunny, Ranjan, Riya and Sam on a bus stop and offers the lift to drop in his new car. But, everyone rejects his offer. Will Ranjan find out that Tuteja gave him money and not Life High magazine owner?

episodesList.title: Sam’s Husband
episodesList.summary: Sam gets worried to see her parents arriving at her house. Sam's father tells her that he has selected a husband for her. Riya and Sam decide to tell Sam's parents that she is already married. Who will be Sam's husband?

episodesList.title: Patel Becomes The Boss
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets worried after lying to Sam's parents about Sam being married. Sunny, JD and Ranjan convinces Patel to act as a boss in front of Sam's parents. Can Patel play boss' role properly or will Sam's parents understand their plan?

episodesList.title: Ranjan’s Father In The House
episodesList.summary: Ranjan's father gets shocked to find out about Ranjan getting married. Ranjan gets worried after getting a nightmare of his and Sam's marriage. Meanwhile, Ranjan's father arrives at Ranjan's house. How will Ranjan handle the situation?

episodesList.title: The Parents Meet
episodesList.summary: Riya and Ranjan plan to change Sunny's appearance to make him JD's father in front of Sam's parents. Meanwhile, JD's real father gives a surprise visit. JD tells everyone that Sunny is Riya's father. How will JD's father react to JD's marriage?

episodesList.title: Terrorists At City Chakkar
episodesList.summary: Sunny and JD make fun of Ranjan as he gets worried watching the news of terrorists running from jail. Meanwhile, Ranjan receives a phone call from his aunt telling that his uncle lost his job. His aunt tells him that she will meet his boss. How will Ranjan handle his aunt?

episodesList.title: Hostage Situation
episodesList.summary: Terrorists enter the City Chakkar office and take the employee hostages. Meanwhile, in Boss' cabin, Ranjan and his Aunt try to convince Boss to give Ranjan's uncle a job. Later, Terrorists call the police to tell their demand. How will the police save City Chakkar employees?

episodesList.title: The Meeting
episodesList.summary: Riya tries to handle the situation by giving some food to terrorists. Meanwhile, the police accept Manmeet's request to speak to his wife. Bhabhiji pleads with the terrorists to let her meet Manmeet. Will the terrorists allow Bhabhiji to meet her husband?

episodesList.title: Bharti Singh’s Interview
episodesList.summary: Riya asks Ranjan, Sunny, and JD their opinion about women empowerment, but ends it with a fight. Meanwhile, Boss tells Riya to cover an exclusive interview of Bharti Singh. Sunny pleads to Riya for letting him come with her. Will Riya take Sunny to the interview?

episodesList.title: Ranjan In Jail
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Ranjan, who is suspected of trying to attack Bharti Singh. Ranjan calls members of City Chakkar for help. Riya, JD, Sunny give hope to Ranjan of getting him a bail from the jail. Everyone decides to take Bharti Singh's help to bail Ranjan. Will Bharti Singh help?

episodesList.title: Warning Phone Call
episodesList.summary: Riya, Sam, Sunny, and JD speaks to Bharti Singh after getting attacked. JD tells that he still has a doubt on Harsh and thinks that he attacked Bharti Singh. Meanwhile, Boss receives a phone call from the attacker to warn him to stop Sam, Riya, JD, and Sunny's research. Will Sam, Riya, Sunny, and JD be able to catch the attacker?

episodesList.title: In Search Of Tarzan
episodesList.summary: Riya and Sam arrive at Boss's cabin to show him City Chakkar's rival magazine. Riya tells that the rival magazine has published a story of Tarzan's fourth generation has been found in Maharashtra jungle. Riya asks Boss to allow her to cover the story and find Tarzan's fourth generation. Will Boss allow Riya and Sam to cover the story?

episodesList.title: Trouble In The Jungle
episodesList.summary: Tribe members catch Sunny and Sam and tie them. Sunny tries to ask them for food but gets scared to notice tribes preparing to eat them. Meanwhile, JD and Ranjan return to consciousness and notices him surrounded by tribal women's. Will Sam and Sunny be able to save themselves?

episodesList.title: Sam, Queen Of The Tribe
episodesList.summary: JD gets scared to see that he has been married to the unattractive tribal queen. JD and Ranjan plan to run away from the tribal people. Meanwhile, tribal men accept Sam as their queen. Will City Chakkar be able to save themselves from tribals?

episodesList.title: Fake Tarzan
episodesList.summary: City Chakkar members bring Tarzan out of the jungle thinking him as Tarzan's descendant to show to the media. But, City Chakkar members find out that he is not Tarzan, but he is Babu who was sent by City Chakkar's enemy. Will City Chakkar magazine enemy accept their mistake?

episodesList.title: Visit The Resort
episodesList.summary: Sunny, Sam, Riya, Ranjan and JD go to Boss’s Resort and meet an unusual lady while on their journey.  The lady advises them to return home, and informs them it’s risky to travel further.  They decide however to venture farther to the resort, as directed by their boss

episodesList.title: Paranormal Activities
episodesList.summary: Riya, Sunny, JD, Ranjan and Sam arrive in the Blue Moon resort as per Boss's instruction. There they experience paranormal activities. Meanwhile, Sunny tries to find Sam and suddenly someone pushes him in the swimming pool. Is the resort haunted?

episodesList.title: The Headless Ghost
episodesList.summary: Sunny, JD, Ranjan, Sam and Riya decide to take on the ghost with no head.  They discover that Anna has taken on the headless outfit and was terrorizing everyone.  In the meantime, staff members are told to have to scare guests to close the resort

episodesList.title: Extra-marital Affair
episodesList.summary: Patel arrives at Chaubey's desk and tells he is upset on Riya's article. He tells that according to Riya's article, 90 percent of world's married men is involved in extra-marital affairs. Everyone asks More about his opinion on the extra-marital affair. Watch this episode to find out who is in the extra-marital affair in the office.

episodesList.title: More Working Overtime
episodesList.summary: Surli calls Manmeet to tell him to bring her suit which she has given to the tailor while returning from office. Meanwhile, boss notices More in the office doing overtime. More tells the boss that he has to write few lines to dedicate his wife or else his wife would not allow him to get inside the house. Will more be able to write few lines for his wife?

episodesList.title: Manmeet Doubts Surleen
episodesList.summary: In the middle of the night, Manmeet wakes up to check Surlin's mobile phone. Sunny prays to god to help him with the work he is doing to help Surlin and gain Sam, Riya, JD and Ranjan's faith. Meanwhile, everyone reaches to Manmeet's function and notice Manmeet upset. Will Sunny be able to gain the faith of everyone again? Will more be able to write few lines for his wife?

episodesList.title: Jd, Ranjan In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Badshah bhai arrives at Manmeet's function and catches JD and Ranjan. Badshah gets unconscious as he hits a pole while catching Ranjan and JD. JD tells Sunny about the happenings and asks for help. How Sunny, Ranjan, and JD will handle unconscious Badshah in the function?

episodesList.title: Badshah Bhai Dead
episodesList.summary: Office staff arrives in the office and notices JD, Ranjan, Sunny, and Badshah Bhai sleeping in the office. JD lies by telling Boss that Badshah Bhai is their client who is interested to give advertisement. How will Ranjan, JD, and Sunny handle the situation?

episodesList.title: Badshah Bhai Returns
episodesList.summary: City Chakkar members run as they notice police searching them. The police catch them and ask about Badshah Bhai. Meanwhile, everyone gets shocked to see Badshah alive as he threatens JD and Ranjan for trying to kill him. JD and Ranjan tell the police that Badshah came to kill them as they published his picture. Will the police save JD and Ranjan from Badshah?

episodesList.title: Election
episodesList.summary: City Chakkar staff starts sloganeering in the office for Boss Tuteja. Everyone tells the boss to change his attire as people give votes to only those people who wear decent clothes. Everyone gives the Boss a new dress that suits his personality for the election. Will Tuteja win the election?

episodesList.title: Fight For Seat
episodesList.summary: JD and Sunny call Ranjan to throw Sandal on the opposition party leader. But in return opposition party leader tells that he will answer to the insult by people's vote. Meanwhile, Sam gets furious with a reporter for thinking women as lacks skills. Will Chotidhari Party led by Tuteja win?

episodesList.title: Tuteja In Controversy
episodesList.summary: Riya arrives in the office to ask about the work allotted to everyone. Meanwhile, Boss arrives followed by More who tells everyone to watch the news Boss. They notice news channel broadcasting boss's picture with a woman. How will Tuteja face this controversy?

episodesList.title: Fake Video Maker
episodesList.summary: Sunny and Riya change their attire and find the fake video maker of Tuteja. City Chakkar members catch the culprit and present him in front of the police. Tuteja tells the constable to work on the path of non-violence. The police tell Tuteja that he was the person behind making his fake video. Will the police give bail to Tuteja?

episodesList.title: Post Election Rivalry
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets happy after Chotidari wins the election. JD brings Jalebi-fafda for everyone as a winning party. Mantu Bhaiya celebrates after losing the election and tells his disciple that he knew that he won't will the election. He tells that he made a plan before the election. What is the plan of Mantu Bhaiya?

episodesList.title: Boss Flirting
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets happy after Chotidari wins the election. JD brings Jalebi-fafda for everyone as a winning party. Mantu Bhaiya celebrates after losing the election and tells his disciple that he knew that he won't will the election. He tells that he made a plan before the election. What is the plan of Mantu Bhaiya?

episodesList.title: Big Brother
episodesList.summary: Fake Roshanlal Tuteja tells everyone that he is the boss of the office and nobody should tell me how to behave. Meanwhile, Darshanlal Tuteja enters the office and surprises everyone telling he is the elder brother of Roshanlal and the real Boss of City Chakkar. Can Darshanlal Tuteja find the fake boss?

episodesList.title: Mission Save Boss
episodesList.summary: Ranjan, JD, and Sunny change their attire before visiting Montu Dada. They notice their Boss wandering around in the house. They find out that Boss's elder brother Darshanlal has changed the appearance to look alike Roshanlal. Can JD, Ranjan, and Sunny save their boss?

episodesList.title: Ranjan has a Kid
episodesList.summary: Ranjan visits a temple and prays to god a life full of happiness. Suddenly, a bag falls on his hands. A woman with a kid comes to Ranjan and tells him to keep his kid and she will take her kid after two days from him. Ranjan decides to leave the kid in the temple. Will Ranjan leave the kid alone in the temple?

episodesList.title: Kid In The Apartment
episodesList.summary: Ranjan brings a kid as a woman gives him to keep her kid safe. Sunny, Ranjan and JD try to make the kid sleep by singing song. But, Riya and Sam gets disturbed and arrives in boys apartment to find the reason behind Ranjan, JD and Sunny singing. Will Riya and Sam find out the kid inside boys apartment?

episodesList.title: Patel Kids
episodesList.summary: JD, Sunny and Ranjan are planning to drop the child at Patel’s home.  JD plays with the son of Patel Roopesh and then takes the kid into the house of Patel.  In the meantime, JD devours all the Jalebees in Deepesh, Roopesh, and Patel’s dinner plate, which causes an argument with Patel and his children

episodesList.title: Missing Bhaijaan
episodesList.summary: Riya and Sam get shocked to see Ranjan having a kid. Ranjan explains that how the lady gave him her kid and left. Sam and Riya feel proud of Ranjan and scolds JD and Sunny for leaving the kid in the temple again. Riya and Sam prepare Khir for the kid and have fun. What will Sunny, JD, and Ranjan face while returning the kid to his mother?

episodesList.title: Christmas Planning
episodesList.summary: Riya and Sam get shocked to see Ranjan having a kid. Ranjan explains that how the lady gave him her kid and left. Sam and Riya feel proud of Ranjan and scolds JD and Sunny for leaving the kid in the temple again. Riya and Sam prepare Khir for the kid and have fun. What will Sunny, JD, and Ranjan face while returning the kid to his mother?

episodesList.title: Sunny Lies to Ranjan
episodesList.summary: Sunny notices Ranjan counting currency notes and decides to take some money out of his pocket. He fakes a call to his father and acts as his father needs the money for the hospital. Ranjan agrees to help him with some money. Will Ranjan find out Sunny's lie?

episodesList.title: The Office Party
episodesList.summary: The boss instructs JD and the others to hook a client that will sponsor a commercial party for the company. In a bid to attract a sponsor JD, Riya and the others lie that Justin Bieber will be performing at the event.

episodesList.title: Sunny Becomes Justin Bieber
episodesList.summary: Sunny disguises himself as Justin Bieber. But Boss finds out and he goes on stage and confesses to cheating everyone. How will Sunny fix this. Find out.

episodesList.title: Memory Loss
episodesList.summary: Sunny, JD, and Ranjan gets worried after knowing that they have messed up in the club last night. Meanwhile, Patel calls Ranjan and tells him that all of them have been fired and also have to vacant the apartment. JD and Sunny decide to visit the nightclub to find out the what happened last night. What happened with Ranjan, JD, and Sunny which caught them in serious trouble?

episodesList.title: Finding Monty
episodesList.summary: Following a night of drinking, JD along with the other guys have been trying to find out what went wrong.  The girl that was there in the group finally awakes.  JD and her friends inquire about her mysterious Monty however she reveals to them that Monty is a problem for her for quite a long time

episodesList.title: The Boss
episodesList.summary: The episode starts with JD and the others having a dream about being the boss. Later in the office, the boss informs them that a multi-national comapny will be going to leading publishing houses to see which one of them is hard working and professional to be able to handle a five year contract. Will JD and the other be able to impress the company?

episodesList.title: Elaichi Helps Sunny
episodesList.summary: Sunny does not know what to do to fix his KK problems.  Therefore, he contacts his trusted friend, Elaichi

episodesList.title: Ranjan’s Parents Arrive
episodesList.summary: Ranjan's parents arrive at the office. It is Ranjan's turn to pretend to be th boss. His parents are impressed.

episodesList.title: Ranjan Tells The Truth
episodesList.summary: JD pretends to appear to be Sunny and is Ranjan’s servant.  The mother of Ranjan’s tells them about how happy she is.  So Ranjan confesses

episodesList.title: Sunny Cant Go Home
episodesList.summary: Sunny is excited about going home. He wants to celebrate Lodi at home. But when he goes to boss to ask for a leave, the boss denies him his leave.

episodesList.title: Sunny Injured
episodesList.summary: Sunny and JD engage in an arm wrestling match. JD beats Sunny, but Sunny injures his hand. His colleagues scare him with stories. So JD starts panicking and takes him to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Office Misses Jd and The Others
episodesList.summary: Elaichi pretends to be a snake. So Pancham takes it upon himself to know more about Elaichi. However Elaichi continues to torment Pancham by pretending to be a snake.

episodesList.title: The Nightmare
episodesList.summary: JD and the other have a nightmare that Riya is getting married. Meanwhile Riya's father talks to her about getting married. Ranjan prays to god that Riya falls in love with him and they get married. JD's father asks him to arrange Rupees 1 lakh.

episodesList.title: The Fake Boyfriend
episodesList.summary: Riya asks Sam to help her. Sam says she will get a boy for her, all she needs to do is pretend to flirt with him. Meanwhile JD tells Ranjan that Riya likes him.

episodesList.title: Competition For Raj
episodesList.summary: JD and the others go over to Riya's place. They want to impress her so that she forgets about Raj.  But it is Raj who impresses everyone. Back home Ranjan convinces the others to join forces with him, so that they can break up Raj and Riya.

episodesList.title: The Date
episodesList.summary: JD and the others go over to Riya's place. They want to impress her so that she forgets about Raj.  But it is Raj who impresses everyone. Back home Ranjan convinces the others to join forces with him, so that they can break up Raj and Riya.

episodesList.title: Sam’s Makeover
episodesList.summary: JD, Sunny and Ranjan are fuming as Riya decides to continue her dating rendezvous with Raj. But, in twist of fate, Sam expresses her budding love towards JD; undergoing a complete makeover for her crush. Meanwhile, Riya is about to find out a bitter truth about Raj.

episodesList.title: Riya’s Poetry
episodesList.summary: Riya is taking part in a poetry competition, which is being organised Maldives. JD, Ranjan, and Sunny dream of an outing with Riya in Maldives and in order to impress her plan to pen a poem.

episodesList.title: Bhide is Bitten
episodesList.summary: JD, Ranjan, and Sunny dream of penning a poetry strong enough to pierce Riya’s stone heart. They put their brains to work and conjure up a few lines, while Sam mocks at them. When the time arrives, Ranjan recites poetry that wins accolades. Now, that JD and Sunny are jealous, watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Ranjan’s Short Lived Dream
episodesList.summary: Ranjan is busy penning a poem while JD and Sunny are forced to make breakfast for him. He gets a call from Riya, who asks him to pay her a visit for breakfast. Hearing this JD and Sunny are jealous and decide to end his daydream.

episodesList.title: Jd’s Increment
episodesList.summary: Every employee has got an increment. But not JD. Hearing this he meets with his boss and asks him to give an increment. But, Boss informs him that if he as a degree he will get an increment. What will JD do now?

episodesList.title: Impress Riya
episodesList.summary: Following Riya’s success, JD, Ranjan, and Sunny try to impress her. JD, in order to get a promotion, has informed his boss that he has received a degree. But, as it turns out later, he mistakenly tells the Boss that his degree is fake. What happens next, watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Acting Bug
episodesList.summary: Sunny’s father has arrived in Mumbai to try his luck in acting. Helpless Sunny has to give answers to his colleagues, while trying to resolve the differences between his father and mother. What happens next, watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Divorce
episodesList.summary: Sunny’s parents are on the verge of getting divorced. He does not want his parents to end their marriage. So, Sunny takes the help of his friends to resolve the differences between his parents. Will he be successful?

episodesList.title: Sunny’s Intentions
episodesList.summary: Sunny does not want his parents to get divorced. But, the lawyers want to make sure his parents apply for a divorce at any cost. Sunny with the help of his friends manage to resolve the differences between Sunny’s parents and foil the lawyers plan.

episodesList.title: Dubey’s Ghost
episodesList.summary: Sunny does not want his parents to get divorced. But, the lawyers want to make sure his parents apply for a divorce at any cost. Sunny with the help of his friends manage to resolve the differences between Sunny’s parents and foil the lawyers plan.

episodesList.title: Dubey Comes to The Office
episodesList.summary: When Dubey arrives in office, his colleagues think it’s his ghost and panic. Sunny, JD, and Ranjan inform them that Dubey is not dead. But, Dubey’s son refuses to acknowledge this fact. Sunny and his friends decide to teach him a lesson.

episodesList.title: Dubey’s Son Realises His Mistake
episodesList.summary: JD, Sunny, and Ranjan come up with a plan to show Dubey’s son a lesson.  Dubey’s son complies but later realizes the mistake

episodesList.title: Sunny The Star
episodesList.summary: Sunny introduces the film director to his boss, who fancies a chance of getting a role in the film. Meanwhile, Sunny is rehearsing a scene with Riya and Sam, when Sam interrupts as she does not like the dialogues and a fight ensues between her and Sunny.

episodesList.title: The Actor Within
episodesList.summary: Sunny introduces the film director to his boss, who fancies a chance of getting a role in the film. Meanwhile, Sunny is rehearsing a scene with Riya and Sam, when Sam interrupts as she does not like the dialogues and a fight ensues between her and Sunny.

episodesList.title: Cookery Challenge
episodesList.summary: Sam is furious as Riya has published a story on male chefs, proclaiming them to be better at cooking. Sam feels offended and challenges Riya to a cooking contest in order to prove that women can cook better than men.

episodesList.title: Cookery Battle
episodesList.summary: Riya questions Sam about her refusal to click photographs of the chef. Annoyed by the male dominance around her, Sam decides to put up a challenge. She asks Boss to hold a cookery competition between men and women. Who will win this competition?

episodesList.title: The Secret Of The Bindi
episodesList.summary: It was first Sunny and he had the look of a bindi.  Some of his colleagues quickly make fun of his face.  However, the boss was ashamed as his own face was covered in a bindi.  The bindi soon turns dark as colleagues begin to suspect that there is ghosts

episodesList.title: Ghost In The Office
episodesList.summary: A ghost-buster is called to the office to find the spirit that has been terrorizing everyone. The secret of the bindi, which is being found on everyone’s face still remains unsolved. Will the ghost-buster be able to solve this riddle?

episodesList.title: Ranjan’s Job is At Stake
episodesList.summary: Rajan is reprimanded by Boss for not knowing English. He asks him to learn the language if he wants to stay in the company. Meanwhile, Riya and Sam are interviewing a Chinese businessman who is well-versed in Hindi and has come to India to establish his business. Will Ranjan learn English and keep his job?

episodesList.title: Atithi Devo Bhava
episodesList.summary: The Chinese businessman, who is willing to advertise in the magazine, arrives in office. Sunny, Ranjan, and JD do not know that the Chinese guest knows Hindi and start abusing him. The Chinese guest complains to Boss and decides to withdraw his partnership with the magazine.

episodesList.title: Hidden Talent
episodesList.summary: Sunny, Ranjan, and JD have to come up with an ad jingle. Rohit, who is taunted by his mother for being an underachiever. But, Sunny, Ranjan, and JD discover that Rohit is exceptionally talented and helps the trio to produce the ad jingle. Will Rohit’s mother acknowledge her son’s talent?

episodesList.title: Jingle All The Way
episodesList.summary: Boss believes that Sunny, JD, and Ranjan have created the jingle for the ad. Riya informs him that it is Rohit who is the creative genius behind the ad. Then, Boss and Riya decide to surprise the client by allowing Rohit to present the jingle at the meeting.

episodesList.title: Jd is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Boss tells Riya that the kid who was saved by her must receive a shelter.  Sunny, JD, Riya and Sam are all at the same spot for a discussion about the incident.  Sunny asks JD to dress himself in the disguise of beggar.  The matter gets way out of control when JD gets kidnapped.  Who kidnapped JD? Find out in this episode

episodesList.title: Sunny is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: To find JD, Sunny disguises himself as beggar.  Sunny is also kidnapped by the gangsters.  They lock him up along with JD.  In order to free JD and Sunny freed, Boss and his employees pretend to be Gangsters

episodesList.title: Jd’s Plan
episodesList.summary: JD is planning to badmouth his company in front of the clients and partner with them to start his own company. Sam follows JD as she presumes that something is wrong and overhears his conversation with one of the clients.

episodesList.title: The Best Magazine
episodesList.summary: JD, Sunny, and Ranjan are upset for having been shifted to a different profile in the company. Riya informs them that the company is in a loss and Boss did not want to fire them. She also reveals that she is the owner of the company, which leaves JD, Sunny, and Ranjan startled.

plotHtml: When five young people with completely different personalities work together in one space it is bound to create some competition as well as some comic situations. Such is the life of these five frenemies -Sunny, J.D, Ranjan, Riya and Sam who work together in a magazine publishing company filled with co-workers of individual personalities as well.
tagline: When five young people with completely different personalities work together in one space it is bound to create some competition as well as some comic situations.

title: Ayushman Bhava
summary: Ayushman Bhava is an Indian television series which aired on STAR Bharat. The series stars Avinash Sachdev and Sumit Bhardwaj.
plot: Set in present-day Mathura, Krish Mehra (Ricky Patel / Sumit Bhardwaj) is the troubled son of Madhav and Sudha Mehra who grows up recalling his past life when he was Avinash Dubey (Avinash Sachdev), a software engineer who was betrayed and killed by his best friend, girlfriend, and boss. The story is about Krish and how he takes his revenge on those who killed him in his past life.
directedBy: Jalinder Kumbhar Sohit k sarkar Thakuri

episodesList.title: Krishna Makes Vikrant Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Krishna sprays Samaira's perfume in Sudheer's room and makes Vikrant doubt Samaira. What's his plan?

episodesList.title: Krishna Misleads Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Krishna misleads Vikrant about Samaira and Sudheer's affair. In a fit of rage, Vikrant interrogates Samaira!

episodesList.title: Will Samaira Get Caught?
episodesList.summary: Samaira leaves the house to run away with Krishna. But Krishna wakes Vikrant up. Will his plan work?

episodesList.title: Sudheer Loses His Memory
episodesList.summary: Sudheer recovers from paralysis, but suffers from memory loss. Krishna is dejected about Vikrant and Samaira's bond.

episodesList.title: Krishna Saves Kavya
episodesList.summary: Krishna saves Kavya from the man who drugs her and tells the media personnel that he will marry Kavya soon. What's on his mind?

episodesList.title: Krishna Makes it Official
episodesList.summary: Krishna's announcement that he will marry Kavya infuriates Vikrant. Kavya rescues Krishna from Vikrant's wrath. Elsewhere, Mai is on a mission to destroy Krishna.

episodesList.title: Will Krishna's Plan Work?
episodesList.summary: Samaira sneaks out of the house at night to meet Krishna at the temple. She panics on seeing Vikrant and Mai in the temple. Will she get caught according to Krishna's plan?

episodesList.title: Kavya's Image is Ruined
episodesList.summary: Vikrant is furious as someone is spoiling Kavya's reputation in the media. For her sake, he decides to get her married to Krishna!

episodesList.title: Mai's New Plan
episodesList.summary: Mai strongly opposes Vikrant's decision of getting Krishna and Kavya married and suggests a plan to ruin Krishna's life. Samaira is keen to know what Krishna feels for her.

episodesList.title: Krishna Under a Spell!
episodesList.summary: Samaira is sad as Krishna and Kavya decide to get married. Krishna spits blood after Mai applies black magic on him.

episodesList.title: Mai Learns Krishna's Secret
episodesList.summary: Krishna urges Kavya to persuade Vikrant to call off their marriage. Meanwhile, Mai discovers Krishna's secret. Will she expose him?

episodesList.title: Krishna Reveals His Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Kavya successfully complete their wedding rituals. Krishna admits before Vikrant that he is on a mission to take revenge on him, Sudheer and Samaira!

episodesList.title: Vikrant Learns Krishna's Motive
episodesList.summary: Vikrant learns about Krishna's motive against him and threatens Samaira. Krishna maintains a distance from Kavya.

episodesList.title: Mai to Destroy Krishna
episodesList.summary: Krishna and Kavya engage Vikrant and Sudheer in the household chores. Mai is determined to ruin Krishna's life.

episodesList.title: Krishna Foils Vikrant's Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishna foils Vikrant's plan of ruining his and Kavya's relationship. Later, Kavya desires to build her bond with Krishna.

episodesList.title: Mai Poisons Krishna's Drink
episodesList.summary: Samaira is upset with Krishna for ignoring her. Later, Vikrant and Mai poison his drink. Will he drink it?

episodesList.title: Krishna Infuriates Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Krishna wants Vikrant to sign the property papers. Later, Vikrant is irritated with Krishna's behaviour and threatens him.

episodesList.title: Bad News for Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Mai are devastated as Kaushalya becomes the owner of their property. Will Vikrant show his true colours before Kavya?

episodesList.title: Sudheer Plots against Krishna
episodesList.summary: Sudheer instigates Samaira and Vikrant against Krishna. Samaira decides to play foul.

episodesList.title: Kavya is in Love!
episodesList.summary: Kavya tells Vikrant that she loves Krishna. Will Vikrant take it kindly?

episodesList.title: Vikrant Kills Badri!
episodesList.summary: Kavya proposes to Krishna. Vikrant captures Badri and kills him. Will Krishna stay quiet on learning about Badri's death?

episodesList.title: Krishna Assaults Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Samaira warns Vikrant to not compare Krishna with Avinash. Later, Krishna assaults Vikrant for killing Badri.

episodesList.title: Sudheer, Samaira to Come Clean
episodesList.summary: Vikrant manipulates Kavya against Krishna by showing her a video. Samaira and Sudheer realise their mistakes and decide to reveal the truth to Kavya!

episodesList.title: Kavya Feels Cheated!
episodesList.summary: Kavya learns from Krishna's doctor that he is critically ill. Sudheer feels guilty of his wrongdoings, while Vikrant vows to kill Krishna!

episodesList.title: Sudheer, Samaira Disclose All
episodesList.summary: Sudheer and Samaira tell Kavya about Krishna's past and Vikrant's atrocities. Will she believe them?

episodesList.title: Kavya Puts Her Foot Down
episodesList.summary: Sudheer and Samaira feel guilty about their wrongdoings. Kavya expresses her strong hatred towards Vikrant, leaving him furious.

episodesList.title: Krishna at Vikrant's Gunpoint!
episodesList.summary: Vikrant traps Krishna by taking advantage of his illness and points a gun at him. Is this the end of Krishna?

title: Azhagiya Tamil Magal
summary:
Azhagiya Tamil Magal is a 2017 Indian Tamil-language soap opera starring Sheela Rajkumar (who later replaced by Sathya Sai Krishnan), Puvi Arasu, Subalakshmi and Anju Aravind. It premiered on Zee Tamil on 28 August 2017. The show ended on 14 June 2019 after 457 episodes.
The story is of a village girl named Poongkodi, who is a kabaddi player. The game will change her life and take her to Chennai to fund her education and helps pursue her further studies.
plot:
The show showcases the story of Poongkodi, a kabaddi and Bharatnatyam enthusiast, who dreams of excelling in the field of sports and pursues further studies. However, the bitter past of Poonkodi's mother prevents Poonkodi from excelling.
Poongkodi's teacher and her grandfather push her to participate in a kabaddi game that will change her life and take her to Chennai to fund her education and pursue higher studies. She is pulled down by her rival Deepika whom she later discovers is her half-sister. Poongkodi goes through various tiffs. Meanwhile, there is a love triangle between Deepika, Jeeva and Poongkodi. How will her life change after this truth is revealed and how it affects the entire family forms the crux of the story.

title: Adhi Gawahi
summary:
Adhi Gawahi  (Urdu: آدھی گواہی, lit. 'Half Witness') is a Pakistani romantic television series that was first aired on 5 July 2017, replacing Nazr-e-Bad. It was directed by Fahim Burney and written by Saima Akram Chudhery.
Sohai Ali Abro plays the main protagonist, and Azfar Rehman plays the antagonist in their sixth on-screen collaboration after Tanhai, Dhol Bajnay Laga, De Ijazat Jo Tu, Tumhari Natasha, and Kaisi Ye Paheli.
plot:
The story revolves around Salwa and Saad, childhood best friends and cousins, Hamdan, and the issue of an unintentional nikkah.
Salwa is a modern, sweet, kind, and fun-loving girl living with her mother, uncles, and their respective families following the death of her father. Most family members are quite happy with this arrangement, especially Saad's mother and the older Bhabhi, Rana, who sees Salwa as her own and wants her son and Salwa to get married.
This does not sit well with the younger Bhabhi Khawla, who sees Salwa as competition for her own daughter, Soha, who is deeply in love with Saad and deeply despises her for the attention Saad reserves just for Salwa while basically ignoring Soha.
Enters Chaudhry Hamdan Mustafa, a rich, egoistic, spoiled brat who fancies Salwa and is deeply possessive about her. Not only is he possessive about her, but he would do just about anything to ensure that Salwa is his. He is used to getting what he wants, courtesy of his mother who turns a blind eye to all of his faults out of love, and to him Salwa is no different.
Salwa dislikes Hamdan and his backward mentality, but puts up with him for the sake of Saad and the rest of their friends.
The five are students of media studies at a prestigious university. Their semester is coming to an end, but there is one last production assignment standing in the way of these friends—a short film that is due very soon. At first everything is seemingly fine, until Saad breaks his leg, which prompts Salwa to be paired up with Hamdan for the project that is due soon. Saad takes time to recover, which makes things worse for the friends, and Saad and Salwa's relationship turns bitter. The accident turns their lives around.
Even though the theme of the project revolves around women empowerment, it becomes the downfall for Salwa. By agreeing to shoot a Nikkah scene with Hamdan, Salwa unknowingly marries Hamdan for real, which sets the premise of the entire show since she is to be married to Saad soon after. Before the marriage, Salwa is kidnapped, unbeknownst to everyone else who believed she ran away. Due to Salwa's disappearance, Saad is married to his cousin Soha. After his marriage, Salwa comes home to find a married Saad, her mother has an angina attack and is in the hospital. She turns her back against her family for not trusting her.

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text:
Salwa and her cousin Saad are going to get married, but their schoolmate Hamdan approaches with pictures and video of his marriage contract with Salwa, which was recorded as a joke.
The title refers to the Islamic tradition that in a court of law, the claims of one witness who is a man can be overturned by two who are women. Since Salwa is fighting Hamdan by herself, this makes her a "half witness" (aadhi gawahi) against him.

title: Aarambh: Kahaani Devsena Ki
summary:
Aarambh: Kahaani Devsena Ki (transl. Initiation: Story of Devasena)is an Indian historical fiction television series, produced by Rose Audio Visuals. It was aired on StarPlus, on weekends, from 24 June 2017 to 10 September 2017. The story revolves around the rivalry between the Dravidians and Aryans. The story was written by V. Vijayendra Prasad. The title song is sung by Mahalaxmi Iyer and Siddharth Mahadevan.
As the series did not receive expected ratings, it ended with 24 episodes which was earlier planned for 32 episodes.
plot: Set in ancient India during the decline of the Indus Valley Civilization and beginning of the Vedic age, this epic follows a saga of war between the Dravidians and the Aryans. In Arambh, Devasena, the daughter of Chamundi, leads Dravidians in a battle against the Aryans. However, she meets Varundev on the battlefield and falls in love with him, despite knowing that he is an Aryan.
reception:
The Quint wrote, "The show promos - visually, it didn’t seem as great as we had seen in Mahadev, Mahakumbh and Siya Ke Ram. Over all, the performances and execution of Aarambh was quite average. It failed to connect with the viewer."
Anvita Singh of India Today wrote, "It promises good things; like a tight script, decent acting, and some great visual effects. The treatment of the basic 'plot' is not completely bizarre. The scenes chase each other, and the pilot packs in a lot of information. Rajniesh Duggall (Varundev), Karthika Nair (Devasena), Tarun Khanna (Veer Kayast), and Tanuja (Hahumaa) were believable."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Aarambh is a high budgeted series with ₹1 crore spent for each sequence. Before its premiere, the series was promoted at India Gate in New Delhi.
Writer Vijayendra Prasad quoted "This is a creation of a parallel world of heroism. My story of Devsena will be the first and only narration of a woman so strong that she could rule the world of patriarchy by knowledge and sword. This is the only project which has brought me to the small screen".
To increase its viewership, it went through many changes including a 200 years leap and a change in its title from Aarambh to Aarambh: Kahaani Devasena Ki.

title: As I'm Suffering From Kadhal
summary: As I'm Suffering from Kadhal (transl. As I'm suffering from love) is a 2017 Indian Tamil-language romantic comedy television series created, directed and written by Balaji Mohan. Set in urban Chennai, it narrates the story of three uniquely different young couples and a young divorced father and his 8-year-old daughter, and their quirky take on the varied aspects of modern-day love. The principal characters of the series include Sunder Ramu, Yuvina Parthavi, Sananth, Sanchana Natarajan, Dhanya Balakrishna, Balaji Mohan, Nakshathra Nagesh and Abhishek Joseph George. The ten-episode series was released on 16 June 2017 on Hotstar, and opened to positive reception from audiences. The series was renewed for a second season.
plot:
The show revolves around the lives of Bala Kumar, a divorcee who shares the custody of his daughter Smriti; Divya and Badri, a live-in couple, who completely oppose the fact of getting married; Meera and Santhosh, a married couple, who absolutely hate each other; Raghav and Tanvi, who are in the process of getting married.
The series starts with Meera crashing her car and ruining Tanvi-Raghav's Pre-pre-engagement party. Divya then tells Raghav to check on Meera, and it is later discovered that Meera cheated on Santhosh with Raghav as Santhosh too cheated on her at his Bachelor party with a girl called Nii-vaa-suin in Bangkok. Badri hears their conversation and struggles to hide the truth. He eventually tells it to Divya.
At Raghav and Tanvi's pre-engagement party, Meera learns that she is pregnant. She throws the pregnancy-kit in the dustbin that is later seen by Divya. Santhosh and his friend add alcohol to Divya & Badri's juice. A drunk Divya and Badri blurt out the truth in front of everybody and even confess to Divya's dad that they don't want to get married.
Tanvi breaks up with Raghav. Meera tells Santhosh that she is pregnant with his baby and they both reconcile. Divya's dad warns Badri to marry Divya. Bala Kumar gets extremely sad and upset because his ex-wife shifts with Smriti and her husband to Bangalore. This story ends with a lot of confusion and happiness.
reception: Sujatha Narayanan of Firstpost wrote "The story of As I'm Suffering From Kadhal is bold with a capital B – without harming value systems or taking sides or passing judgement." Sruthi Raman of The Times of India assigned a score 3.5 (out of 5) and wrote "The show loses steam towards the end, culminating in a played-out revelation. But the characters seem to stay with us till the end." Vikram Venkateshwaran of The Quint wrote "As I’m Suffering From Kadhal is a refreshing rom-com that anyone living in a metro city can relate to. It comes with subtitles, so even if you don't speak Tamil or Telugu, you might enjoy it."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Quote box |text=In our scenario, in Tamil films or south Indian films for that matter, a large side of reality is not shown. It's mostly about two people meeting and how they fall in love. I'm more interested in what happens after the relationship starts [...] There's so much potential and content there which I feel we haven't explored. I thought it's high time we did it...and a platform like this offers me the space to say what I believe in and a lot of people are happy to see their life being shown on screen. |source=—Balaji Mohan on the narrative of As I'm Suffering From Kadhal Balaji also stated that the series is a more mature and deeper version of Kadhalil Sodhappuvadhu Yeppadi (2012), his feature film debut.
Balaji opined that the moral compass of the characters in the series is different from feature films, stating, "The whole audience that watches a feature film won't watch this . The people watching this series are also people who watch films... but I'm not targeting this for the whole of Tamil Nadu or all age groups. This is for people who've seen all this happening around them, and they understand that this is what happens today." He also said that making it a series ensured significant freedom, due to less restrictions and censoring when compared to feature films.
The digital distribution of the series' rights were sold to Hotstar, which was owned and operated by Star India. Balaji produced the film under his Open Window banner and Trendloud, an original content studio tied up with the platform as his creative team ensured the creative freedom needed to create the show as he had envisioned.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: As I'm Suffering from Kadhal was the first ever Indian series for Hotstar Originals. All the ten episodes of the series were released simultaneously on Hotstar on 16 June 2017. The series opened to positive reception from audience and followed by the response, the makers renewed for a second season during the time of release. Balaji Mohan said that he had finished writing of the second season and ensured that the series will progress soon.

It comes with subtitles, so even if you don't speak Tamil or Telugu, you might enjoy it."

title: Andarmahal
summary:
Andarmahal was a Bengali television soap opera that premiered on 5 June 2017 and initially aired Monday to Friday at 10:30 PM IST on Zee Bangla. It had been later shifted to the 9:30 pm time slot. The show is produced by Magic Moments Motion Pictures, and started Koneenica Banerjee and Kaushik Chakraborty in the lead roles and Debolina Dutta, child actress Ashmi, Santu Mukherjee and Rita Dutta Chakraborty among others in prominent supporting roles.It went off air on 9 November 2018 and it got replaced by Nokshi Kantha.
This show marked the return of actress Koneenica on Bengali Television after more than a decade. Koneenica, who was last seen in the role of Megh in the ETV Bangla serial, "Kokhono Megh Kokhono Brishti" (opposite Badshah Moitra) and as Brishti in Zee Bangla's serial "Raat Bhor Brishti" (opposite Saswata Chatterjee), played the lead role of "Parameshwari", an ordinary girl with an extraordinary talent of music, who fights through all odds to establish herself as an ideal daughter-in-law and lovable mother to Juju, her husband's daughter from previous marriage. The show, written by Leena Gangopadhyay, focused on the journey of Parameshwari, an average housewife who struggles through the rules and regulations of a joint family to become self-dependent utilizing her passion for music as a career.
plot: Andarmahal is the tale of an average middle-aged woman named Parameshwari who had to give up on her formal education to support family expenses and her sisters' studies. She harbors a deep connect with music that gives her some solace in her lonely life, consisting mainly of her family, housework and her music school that she runs at home. She gets engaged and subsequently married to Abhimanyu Bose, a divorcee man in his early forties who has a teenage daughter, Juju from his previous marriage with Ananya. He marries Parameshwari at the condition that she will have to look after her daughter Juju and care for her, gaining her trust as a mother and will also have to handle the housework. In return, he will give her financial stability and security. Despite such humiliating treaty as the foundation of their marriage, Parameshwari, without any expectations from Abhimanyu and his family members, gives her utmost effort to win Juju's heart. She loves Juju as her real mother would and later, being touched by her selfless love, Juju to begins to love and respect her new mother Parameshwari whom she fondly calls "Mamoni". However, this makes Ananya, Juju's real mother insecure and she fears about losing her daughter. So, she entices Abhimanyu, tries to reconnect their relationship and Ananya begins living at Abhimanyu's household, much to Juju's embarrassment. After Paro helps her father-in-law understand his faults regarding house management and his relationship with his wife, her father-in-law, realizing his mistakes, begins to support Parameshwari. He asks Abhimanyu to show Ananya the door, but Abhimanyu revolts and due to his misconception that Parameshwari was involved in an illicit affair with his boss and her senior from college, Juboraj Sengupta, and due to repeated instigation from Parameshwari's ill-wishes Kamalini, Shreya and Katha; Abhimanyu further misunderstands Parameshwari and in a fit of rage, announces that he will divorce her. Juju stands by a heart-broken Parameshwari, and on her insistence and with Juboraj's help, starts her singing career to become self-dependent. Parameshwari Bose becomes a rising star and singing sensation overnight with the release of her first album and begins to actively contribute in running the family, when Abhimanyu becomes ill and loses his job. Taking Juboraj's help, Paro bears the entire expenses of Abhi's treatment; and Abhi finally realizes his mistake. He then asks Ananya to leave the house and starts his relationship with Parameshwari afresh.

articleSections.title: Parallel tracks
articleSections.text:
In addition to Parameshwari's struggle, the series has also been showcasing parallel story arcs of Parameshwari's sister-in-laws- Shreya and Katha. Shreya's husband, Karna utterly humiliates her and cheats on her by trying to woo a sub-ordinate nurse at his workplace. When Shreya gets to know about the matter, Karna doesn't feel like giving her any explanation, for she is financially dependent on him. Shreya realizes that she can't patch up with Karna anymore by sacrificing her self-pride and decides to work on her. Paro supports Shreya in her tough time, by helping her get a job to earn a living. Shreya realizes her previous mistakes in the wrongs done by her to Parameshwari, and the two sort out their differences.
Katha develops a fatal disease and much to her shock and amazement, his doting husband Arghya and mother-in-law, Kamalini star misbehaving with her and taunt her for being a burden. Arghya doesn't anymore allow Katha to share a room with him as her disease is infectious. And a distraught Katha has to make her way to the store room, when even her own family refuses to stand by her. Parameshwari, however, forgiving all of Katha's previous misdeeds, lends a helping hand towards her in her times of need. Katha too whole-heartedly apologizes to Parameshwari, who becomes her emotional strength and inspiration, while she starts preparing for the I.A.S. exam to get a fresh job. Arghya, then, enters into a relationship with his colleague, Sreeradha, further hurting Katha, who now, following Parameshwari's footsteps, protests and decides to teach Arghya a lesson.

articleSections.title: Parameshwari's dilemma
articleSections.text: Some days after Abhimanyu gets a new job, Ananya visits him and informs him that she has decided to file a case in the court over the rights for Juju's custody. So that Abhi and the family doesn't have to go through the legal procedures and resultant degradation of their social prestige, Parameshwari keeping a heavy heart, asks Juju to leave the house and live with her mother Ananya till she becomes 18 years old, 3 years later. Juju is shattered and extremely disheartened at Paro's request, however obliges her by leaving the house with Ananya. Ananya who is a perfectionist thoughtlessly imposes her rules and regulations over the child Juju, who perceive that no one, even Paro, is her near one and well-wisher and goes into a life of self-imposed salvation in Anaya's house. Paro repents her decision of sending Juju away and when the latter pays no heed to her earnest calls and repeated words for forgiveness, a remorseful Paro decides to withdraw herself from singing so that she can penance for the "sin" she did by hurting her child, Juju. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu proposes her to have a child together, but Paro declines his proposal. Her self-imposed starvation leads her health to decline to a dangerous extent, but, is nursed back to health by Juju. Paro and Juju now clear up all their misunderstandings, and Juju starts living with the family again, much to Ananya's chagrin. Meanwhile, Parameshwari receives the " Sharno Kontho " award.

title: Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahi Kahi
summary: Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahi Kahi (trans: haven't seen madness like this) is an Indian romantic drama television series, produced by Dee Jaa Films, which premiered on 22 May 2017 and ended on 2 February 2018, being replaced by the series Kaleerein. It was broadcast on Zee TV. The show starred Pranav Misshra and Jyoti Sharma in the lead roles. Set in Gujarat, the story revolved around two individuals, Prem and Tejaswini, who started off in the wrong foot but eventually fell in love with each other.
plot:
Tejaswini Metha is a middle-class girl who was given the opportunity to study at Rajpipla University. There, she meets the heirs of the Singh Rathore family including Prem who terrorizes the other students with his cousins. By opposing them regularly and one day saving their mothers from an attempted murder, Teja attracts the other members of this family's sympathy, contrary to Prem's wishes. He also creates much drama to drive her out of his house, because it turns out that Dharam, his father, authorized him to live under his roof after his nephews kidnapped him one evening from his campus.
Knowing that his new rival is living with him without telling his parents, Prem threatens Tejaswini to reveal the truth to his overbearing mother. But clever as she is, the concerned one blackmails him by threatening not to expose the identities of his kidnappers who happen to be Prem and his cousins. From there, their rivalry increases, until the day when Tejaswini, celebrating her success in the exams, sees Sharda, her mother, disembark at Dharam's mansion. As the girl is forced to leave town and be separated from her new family, everyone blames Prem for it, unaware that it was Prem's cousin Arjun who called Teja's mother.
Prem now senses Tejaswini's absence from the house, and blames himself. But, she returns a few days later to Rajpipla only to concentrate on her studies. Sharda made sure that her daughter promised her that she would no longer have any connection with the Rathores. Prem may try to bring his former rival home, but nothing works. Tejaswini's promise prevents him from succeeding. But soon another misunderstanding arises due to Prem and Tejaswini's different thoughts. They both become enemies again and then reconcile after a racing match.
Unable to keep her promise for too long, Tejaswini confronts her mother. The latter, after some hesitation, reveals to her the main reason for her contempt for the Rathores: Dharam is the murderer of her husband. Shocked by the news and without seeking to learn the truth about this story, Teja decides to take revenge on Dharam by using Prem's affection for her. Meanwhile, her cousin, Preeti, who joined Rajpipla University, fell in love with Prem. And knowing Teja's intentions, she goes so far as to ruin her marriage to stop him, even though Prem and Tejaswini eventually marry.

On 17 May 2017, an extended promo of the title song was released before the show started on 22 May 2017.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: In January 2018, actors Jyoti Sharma and Pranav Misshra accused show's producers of exploitation and mistreatment. which lead to the serial shutting down in February 2018.

title: Ammuvinte Amma
summary:
Ammuvinte Amma (ml;അമ്മുവിൻ്റെ അമ്മ) (English:Mother of Ammu)  is an  Indian Malayalam television serial that  began on Mazhavil Manorama from 27 March 2017.
The series replaced the serial Manjurukum Kaalam. The series went off-air on 13 July 2018 completing 357 episodes.
plot:
Anupama alias Anu lives with her mother Padmaja alias Pappa and sister Ammu who is in 1st standard.
A boy falls in love with her who works with her in office. Later, it is revealed that Ammu is Anu's daughter and she is already married to her maths tutor, Kiran who had a mental disorder. He made Anu work so much and punished her for silly things. One day, Anu goes to her home. Kiran comes there and takes her with force.
While driving with her fast due to anger with her accident happens and Anu loses her memory and Kiran goes missing. Later, Anu becomes pregnant and as Anu don't know anything, Anu's mother tells Ammu is her daughter and Anu becomes her sister. Later, it is revealed that Kiran's aunt who looked him after his parents death gave him medicine to make him mad so that she will get his wealth.

title: Aliyan vs Aliyan
summary:
Aliyan vs Aliyan was an Indian Malayalam-language sitcom directed by Rajesh Thalachira, broadcast on Amrita TV from 17 February 2017 to 25 April 2019. The show aired on every Monday to Friday at 9:00 PM (IST). The sitcom won the 2017 Kerala State Television Award for Best Comedy Program.
A sequel titled Aliyans aired on Kaumudy TV since 24 February 2020 with same cast.
